title_zh: 身体、毒素与加纳电子废弃物处理的劳动干预：迈向一种有毒的后殖民身体性？
abstract_zh: 本文探讨了加纳阿克拉阿格博格布洛谢（Agbogbloshie）电子废弃物处理工人的生活经验，该地是一个主要的电子垃圾回收中心和废品市场，曾被描述为地球上污染最严重的地方之一。为了对这些工人的生活及其有毒身体体验形成更批判性和情境化的理解，本文提出了"有毒的后殖民身体性"这一概念，该术语用于在有毒物质、身体与绿色回收干预措施在后殖民城市废品场的争议性交汇中进行导航和应对。在介绍了阿格博格布洛谢的社会、经济及毒性维度之后，本文总体上讨论了有毒渗透性的问题与政策，并特别关注在后殖民背景下身体、环境与风险缓解实践之间的脆弱边界。本文认为，有毒的后殖民身体性提供了一种环境健康的批判视角，可以为人类学参与那些在渗透性世界中导航的生活提供信息。

title: Cuerpos, toxinas e intervenciones laborales con residuos electrónicos en Ghana: ¿Hacia una corporalidad poscolonial tóxica?
abstract: Este artículo explora la experiencia vivida de los trabajadores de residuos electrónicos (e-waste) en Agbogbloshie, un centro primario de reciclaje de desechos electrónicos y un mercado de chatarra en Accra, Ghana, que ha sido descrito como uno de los lugares más contaminados de la Tierra. Para formular una comprensión más crítica y contextual de las vidas de estos trabajadores y su experiencia corporal tóxica, el artículo presenta el concepto de «corporalidad poscolonial tóxica», un término que se despliega para navegar y afrontar la controvertida intersección entre cuerpos, toxinas e intervenciones de reciclaje «verde» en un desguace urbano poscolonial. Después de presentar las dimensiones sociales, económicas y tóxicas de Agbogbloshie, este artículo trata en general sobre los problemas y las políticas de la permeabilidad tóxica, y en particular sobre las fronteras precarias de los cuerpos, ambientes y prácticas de mitigación de riesgos en un contexto poscolonial. Se argumenta que la corporalidad poscolonial tóxica proporciona una perspectiva crítica de la salud ambiental, que puede informar a los compromisos antropológicos con las vidas que navegan por los mundos permeables y entrecruzados de la contaminación y la poscolonización.
title_zh: 身体、毒素与加纳电子废弃物的劳动干预：走向有毒的后殖民身体？
abstract_zh: 本文探讨了加纳阿克拉电子废弃物回收中心兼废品市场Agbogbloshie（被称为地球上污染最严重的地方之一）的电子废弃物工人的生活体验。为了对这些工人的生活和有毒身体体验形成更具批判性和情境性的理解，文章提出了“有毒的后殖民身体”概念，这一术语用以导航和应对后殖民城市废品场中身体、毒素与“绿色”回收干预之间有争议的交汇。在介绍Agbogbloshie的社会、经济和毒性维度后，本文整体上讨论了有毒渗透性的问题和政策，特别是后殖民背景下身体、环境和风险缓解实践的不稳定边界。文章认为，有毒的后殖民身体提供了一种环境健康的批判性视角，可为人类学与那些在污染和后殖民的渗透、交织世界中航行的生活的接触提供参考。

title: Digitalizing the State: Data Centres and the Power of Exchange
abstract: Big-Tech’s data centres have recently emerged as important socio-political figures in the ongoing digitalisation of the Danish state. Locating vast swathes of data in a country renowned for its renewable energy has prompted a series of questions about the nature of the relationship between these two actors. Our ethnographic interest resides in analysing how, and why, Denmark is rapidly becoming Europe’s primary US data centre location, and in exploring the transformative processes through which the Danish state is being reconfigured as digital. In doing so, we emphasise the role of infrastructures in digital state-making and draw upon a particular reading of anthropological exchange theory to conceptualise how the state is being reconstituted through exchange practices with data centre actors. We argue that as Big-Tech territorialises state land and resources, the state in turn reterritorializes the promising digital futures that come with Big-Tech, making visible its new digital frontier.
title_zh: 数字化国家：数据中心与交换的权力
abstract_zh: 大型科技公司的数据中心最近作为丹麦国家持续数字化中的重要社会政治角色出现。在一个以可再生能源闻名的国家中定位大量数据，引发了关于这两个行动者之间关系本质的一系列问题。我们的民族志兴趣在于分析丹麦如何以及为何迅速成为欧洲主要的美国数据中心所在地，并探索丹麦国家被重新配置为数字化的转型过程。在此过程中，我们强调基础设施在数字国家建设中的作用，并借鉴人类学交换理论的特定解读，来概念化国家如何通过与数据中心行动者的交换实践被重新构成。我们认为，随着大型科技公司对国有土地和资源的领土化，国家反过来对大型科技公司所带来的有前途的数字未来进行再领土化，使其新的数字前沿变得可见。

title: Hackerspace Network: Prefiguring Technopolitical Futures?
abstract: ABSTRACT Under the practical symbol of “hacking,” computer expertise has been translated into renewed forms of political action in the past two decades. In this article, I examine this phenomenon through the study of self‐organized collectives for technoscientific experts who identify as “hackers.” Based on multisited field research in global cities of the Pacific Rim, I describe the formation of a network of community spaces called “hackerspaces” with a focus on their exchange practices and transnational ties. The alternative globalization of hacking through these convivial spaces for socialization and self‐training has created new political locations and horizons, shifting the moral valence of hacking toward more open and collaborative practices. The hackerspace network is one of the key sites for the observation of this transformation for prefiguring new technical and political practices, hence its relevance for anthropological studies of technology and politics in the contemporary moment. [ computing, expertise, hacking, technopolitics, hackerspaces ]
title_zh: 黑客空间网络：预演技术政治的未来？
abstract_zh: 摘要：在“黑客”的实践符号下，计算机专业知识在过去二十年中被转化为新的政治行动形式。本文通过研究那些自称为“黑客”的技术科学专家的自组织集体来审视这一现象。基于环太平洋全球城市的多点实地研究，我描述了名为“黑客空间”的社区空间网络的形成，重点关注其交换实践和跨国联系。通过这些用于社交和自我培训的友好空间，黑客的另类全球化创造了新的政治位置和视野，将黑客的道德价值转向更开放和协作的实践。黑客空间网络是观察这一转变为预演新的技术和政治实践的关键场所之一，因此对于当代技术和政治的人类学研究具有重要意义。[计算，专业知识，黑客，技术政治，黑客空间]

title: Mobile identities: photography, smartphones and aspirations in urban Nigeria
abstract: Abstract Since 2012, the influx of affordable smartphones to urban Nigeria has revolutionized how young people take, store and circulate photographs. Crucially, this ever-expanding digital archive provides urban youth with a means to communicate new ideas of self, allowing a marginalized group to display fortunes that often belie their difficult realities. Through gestures and poses, fashion and style, the companionship of others, or the use of particular backdrops and locations, these photographs contain certain semiotics that allude to the subject owning the means for success in urban Nigeria. Similarly, as youth constantly store photographs of themselves on their handsets alongside those of celebrities, patrons and friends, coveted commodities and aspirational memes, they construct personal narratives that place them at the centre of global flows and networks. With the ability to constantly retake, update and propagate photographs, the discrepancies between in- and off-frame identities become ambiguous. This article explores how young people in Calabar, south-eastern Nigeria, use digital photographs on their mobile phones to cultivate new visions of themselves. Arguing that these photographs not only represent superlative aspirations but are also integral to social becoming, the discussion examines how digital images allow youth to reposition themselves within (and beyond) Nigerian society. Ephemerality is central: digital photographs can be easily circulated and retain some permanence on social media, yet these immaterial objects can easily be lost from handsets. In thinking about the futures of African youth and African photography, this article therefore interrogates the tensions of private and public archives.
title_zh: 移动身份：尼日利亚城市中的摄影、智能手机与渴望
abstract_zh: 摘要 自2012年以来，价格实惠的智能手机涌入尼日利亚城市，彻底改变了年轻人拍摄、存储和传播照片的方式。至关重要的是，这个不断扩展的数字档案为城市青年提供了传达自我新观念的手段，使边缘化群体得以展示往往掩盖其艰难现实的财富。通过手势和姿势、时尚和风格、他人的陪伴，或使用特定的背景和地点，这些照片包含某些符号，暗示着主体拥有在尼日利亚城市成功的途径。同样，当青年们不断在手机上存储自己的照片，以及名人、赞助人、朋友、令人垂涎的商品和有抱负的迷因的照片时，他们构建了将自身置于全球流动和网络中心的个人叙事。凭借不断重拍、更新和传播照片的能力，帧内和帧外身份之间的差异变得模糊。本文探讨了尼日利亚东南部卡拉巴尔的年轻人如何利用手机上的数字照片来培养对自己的新看法。文章认为，这些照片不仅代表了最高的渴望，也是社会成长不可或缺的一部分，讨论了数字图像如何使年轻人能够（在尼日利亚社会内外）重新定位自己。短暂性是核心：数字照片可以轻松传播并在社交媒体上保持一定的持久性，但这些非物质对象很容易从手机中丢失。因此，在思考非洲青年和非洲摄影的未来时，本文审视了私人和公共档案之间的张力。

title: Selling with Prejudice: Social Enterprise and Caste at the Bottom of the Pyramid in India
abstract: How do you sell a solar powered lamp to India's un-electrified, rural poor? This contribution to Anthropology for Sale explores the work of direct selling in rural India, reflecting on the forms of prejudice, difference and exclusion that are produced as multinational companies create markets for consumer goods in places of chronic global poverty. In the highlands of Orissa, India, a US company sells solar powered lights through a network of young male sales agents. The company and its products express empathy and proximity, attachment and connection to India's indigenous and low caste communities. Yet the company’s salesmen are often more concerned with maintaining forms of structural advantage and their sales practices articulate social differences based on caste, class and gender. Rather than see prejudice as a peripheral effect of expansion and growth in emerging markets this paper proposes that we see it as a constitutive feature of markets at the ‘bottom of the pyramid’.
title_zh: 带有偏见的销售：印度的社会企业与种姓金字塔底层
abstract_zh: 如何向印度未通电的农村贫困人口销售太阳能灯？这篇为《待售的人类学》撰写的文章探讨了印度农村直销工作，反思了当跨国公司为长期全球贫困地区创造消费品市场时所产生的偏见、差异和排斥形式。在印度奥里萨邦的高地，一家美国公司通过一个由年轻男性销售代理组成的网络销售太阳能灯。该公司及其产品表达了对印度原住民和低种姓社区的同情与亲近、依恋与联系。然而，该公司的销售人员往往更关注维持结构性优势的形式，他们的销售实践体现了基于种姓、阶级和性别的社会差异。本文不将偏见视为新兴市场扩张和增长的边缘效应，而是将其视为“金字塔底层”市场的构成特征。

title: Social upgrading and cooperative corporate social responsibility in global value chains: the case of Fairphone in China
journal_name: GLOBAL NETWORKS-A JOURNAL OF TRANSNATIONAL AFFAIRS
abstract: Abstract In this article, we explore how a lead firm's strategy for corporate social responsibility influences the social upgrading of a supplier in a global value chain. Based on a single case study approach, we investigate the interaction between Dutch smartphone producer Fairphone and its Chinese supplier Guohong. On the one hand, the case illustrates how a cooperative approach to corporate social responsibility can lead to progress in suppliers' social upgrading. In particular, we highlight the role of a so‐called workers' welfare fund as a mechanism not only for improving measurable labour standards but also for enabling rights. On the other hand, the case demonstrates how the limited production and technological capabilities of the suppliers, a competitive market environment and lead firms' limited strategic access to the supply chain might constrain the extent of social upgrading through a cooperative approach towards corporate social responsibility in a global value chain.
title_zh: 全球价值链中的社会升级与合作性企业社会责任：以Fairphone在中国的案例为例
abstract_zh: 在本文中，我们探讨了领先企业的企业社会责任战略如何影响其供应商在全球价值链中的社会升级。基于单一案例研究方法，我们调查了荷兰智能手机生产商Fairphone与其中国供应商国红之间的互动。一方面，该案例说明了合作性企业社会责任方法如何促进供应商的社会升级。我们特别强调了所谓工人福利基金的作用，该机制不仅改善了可衡量的劳动标准，还赋予了工人权利。另一方面，该案例也展示了供应商有限的生产和技术能力、竞争激烈的市场环境以及领先企业对供应链有限的战略接入，可能会限制通过合作性企业社会责任方法在全球价值链中实现社会升级的程度。

title: Andean–Pacific Commerce and Credit: Bolivian Traders, Asian Migrant Businesses, and International Manufacturers in the Regional Economy
journal_name: Journal of Latin American and Caribbean Anthropology
abstract: Resumen Este artículo analiza la configuración cambiante del comercio regional de artefactos electrónicos. Basado en un trabajo etnográfico iniciado en 2013 en varias localidades (mercados populares en La Paz, Bolivia, y la zona franca de Iquique, norte de Chile) y en un análisis histórico de las últimas tres décadas, el objetivo ha sido comprender la conexión cada vez mayor del comercio popular boliviano con las cadenas comerciales y empresas del este asiático, específicamente de los mercados internacionales centrados en China. De este modo, se puede afirmar que en la zona franca, el proceso se caracteriza por la circulación del crédito comercial entre los distribuidores de origen asiático y los comerciantes bolivianos. Mientras que en mercados urbanos en Bolivia, las formas locales de generar confianza han sido adoptadas por todos los actores, también por las empresas transnacionales. Otro aspecto a destacar es cómo las recientes cooperaciones chino–bolivianas e inversiones chinas en Bolivia también incorporan prácticas pasadas, pero al mismo tiempo intentan fomentar cadenas comerciales racionalizadas; y como consecuencia de estos procesos, las empresas multinacionales están contribuyendo a la creciente diferenciación socio‐económica entre los comerciantes bolivianos.
title_zh: 安第斯-太平洋商业与信贷：区域经济中的玻利维亚商人、亚洲移民企业和国际制造商
abstract_zh: 本文分析了电子产品区域贸易格局的变化。基于2013年在多个地点（玻利维亚拉巴斯的大众市场、智利北部伊基克自贸区）开始的民族志研究以及对过去三十年的历史分析，旨在理解玻利维亚大众贸易与东亚特别是以中国为中心的国际市场之间的日益增长的联系。由此可以断言，在自贸区，这个过程以亚洲裔分销商与玻利维亚商人之间的商业信贷流通为特征。而在玻利维亚的城市市场，所有参与者（包括跨国公司）都采用了本地化的信任建立方式。另一个值得注意的方面是，近期中玻合作和中国在玻利维亚的投资既沿袭了过去的一些做法，又试图推动理性化的贸易链条；这些过程导致跨国公司正在加剧玻利维亚商人之间的社会经济分化。

title: COMUNIDADES INDÍGENAS, EMPRESAS DEL LITIO Y SUS RELACIONES EN EL SALAR DE ATACAMA
abstract: La importancia global creciente del litio otorga visibilidad a las regiones donde se produce. En el llamado "tringulo del litio" destaca el Salar de Atacama, en explotacin desde la dcada de 1980 para la obtencin de potasio y litio de salmueras. Menos conocidos son los efectos ambientales y sociales, as como los procesos sociales relacionados localmente con la minera de salares. Este tema aborda el artculo, destacando las relaciones que en el periodo se han sucedido entre empresas y comunidades atacameas. Esos vnculos coevolucionan en uno y otro sentido. Los cursos de accin hacia las localidades circundantes y el municipio de San Pedro de Atacama tienen lugar al mismo tiempo que se forman actores locales y tnicos que van estableciendo demandas territoriales y socio culturales. Tales demandas van dirigidas en parte a las empresas mineras, discutiendo derechos territoriales, daos en los acuferos y los ecosistemas del salar, usos alternativos del salar, redistribucin de ganancias y participacin. En el cambiante cuadro de vinculaciones comunidades-empresas estas desarrollan, ajustan e innovan trminos de relacin con las comunidades (del paternalismo a los valores compartidos) y aquellas tambin crean trminos de relacin dinmicos y estrategias (de la aceptacin pasiva a formas de contraposicin abierta). Lo hacen en escenarios (polticos, econmicos, locales, nacionales y globales) que presentan oportunidades y abren posibilidades de accin o las restringen e impiden otras.
title_zh: 土著社区、锂企业与阿塔卡马盐沼的关系
abstract_zh: 锂日益增长的全球重要性使得其生产地区备受关注。在所谓的“锂三角”中，阿塔卡马盐沼自20世纪80年代以来就被开采，用于从盐水中提取钾和锂。环境和社会影响以及当地与盐沼采矿相关的社会过程鲜为人知。本文探讨了这一问题，重点关注这一时期内企业与阿塔卡马社区之间的关系。这些联系相互演化。对周边地区及圣佩德罗-德阿塔卡马市采取的行动与当地和族裔行动者的形成同时发生，这些行动者逐渐提出领土和社会文化诉求。这些诉求部分针对矿业公司，涉及领土权利、含水层和盐沼生态系统的损害、盐沼的替代用途、利润分配和参与。在社区与企业关系不断变化的图景中，企业制定、调整和创新与社区的关系条款（从家长式管理到共享价值），而社区也创造了动态的关系条款和策略（从被动接受到公开对抗）。它们是在（政治、经济、地方、国家和全球）情境中进行的，这些情境提供了机会并开辟了行动可能性，或限制了行动并阻止了其他可能性。

title: Crypto‐miners: Digital labor and the power of blockchain technology

authors.name: Filipe Calvão
institutions: Graduate Institute of International and Development Studies

abstract: This article examines the labor power of digital miners. Though an obscure and still incipient facet of the digital economy, crypto‐mining powers and secures transactions across blockchains, or public distributed digital ledgers. Drawing from interviews with cryptocurrency enthusiasts, blockchain advocates, and developers; participation in online and offline discussions; and a survey with small‐scale crypto‐miners, this article takes on the material and technoscientific valuation of crypto‐mining to understand how a future of open, decentralized accountability implicates human labor alongside automated processes. The work of digital mining, performed in the work of inscribing, registering, and politically organizing mining operations, enables the formation of democratic communities in the digital economy and remains inevitably embedded in social relations as a mode of productive, meaningful action.
title_zh: 加密矿工：数字劳动与区块链技术的力量
abstract_zh: 本文考察了数字矿工的劳动力量。尽管数字货币挖矿是数字经济中一个模糊且尚处于萌芽阶段的方面，但它为区块链（即公共分布式数字账本）上的交易提供动力和保障。基于对加密货币爱好者、区块链倡导者和开发者的访谈，参与线上和线下讨论，以及对小型加密货币矿工的调查，本文探讨了加密货币挖矿的物质和科学技术估值，以理解开放式、去中心化的问责制的未来如何将人类劳动与自动化过程结合在一起。数字挖矿的工作——在登记、注册和组织挖矿操作的政治活动中进行——使得数字经济中民主社区的形成成为可能，并且作为一种生产性、有意义的行为模式，不可避免地嵌入社会关系之中。

title: Digital afterlife: (Eco)civilizational politics of the site and the sight of e‐waste in China
abstract: This article aims to examine the ongoing changes in ‘green politics’ in China by focusing on the example of e‐waste recycling and, specifically, transformations in one given town, Guiyu. It is argued that the spontaneous stage of development in e‐waste recycling in Guiyu has become the object of civilizational politics, which includes the formalization, centralization and spatial and visual evolution of the recycling site. Civilizational politics is conceptualized as an approach towards adapting to the existing socio‐technical conditions and the introduction of a new infrastructural regime, which is discursively framed as a civilized one: modern, environmentally friendly and socially beneficial. The ‘informal’ sector in e‐waste recycling is the main target of civilizational politics, as it is associated with ‘low‐tech’ and polluting technologies and small‐scale enterprises powered by migrant labour. While the target of civilizational politics is upscaling via the creation of large, centralized, ‘formal’ facilities, the social and environmental sustainability of such a transition should be questioned.
title_zh: 数字来世：中国电子废弃物场所与视界中的（生态）文明政治
abstract_zh: 本文旨在通过关注电子废弃物回收的案例，特别是广东省贵屿镇的变化，审视中国“绿色政治”的当前变革。本文认为，贵屿电子废弃物回收的自发发展阶段已成为文明政治的对象，这包括回收场所的正规化、集中化以及空间和视觉的演变。文明政治被概念化为一种适应现有社会技术条件并引入新基础设施制度的方法，该制度在话语上被构建为文明的：现代、环境友好且对社会有益。电子废弃物回收中的“非正规”部门是文明政治的主要目标，因为它与“低技术”和污染技术以及由农民工驱动的小规模企业相关联。虽然文明政治的目标是通过创建大型、集中、正规的设施来实现规模升级，但这种转型的社会和环境可持续性应受到质疑。

title: From Digital Divides to Creative Destruction: Epistemological Encounters in the Regulation of the "Blood Mineral" Trade in the Congo
abstract: For nearly 20 years, the eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo has endured massive human and ecological casualties, marked by harrowing tales of atrocities at the hands of various state and non-state actors. At the center of all this conflict is the extraction of and trade in minerals (such as coltan) essential to produce most of the electronic products we now associate with the digital age (mobile phones, gaming consoles). Some regard the calculus for the global exchange in these products as simple: militias that control these minerals (often through theft or forced labor of miners) buy arms to further their campaigns of terror. The 2010 Dodd-Frank Act, which requires American companies to exercise due diligence in ensuring that minerals used in the manufacture of their products are conflict-free, emerged out of those presumptions. But for thousands of Congolese involved in the production and trafficking of its mineral wealth, minerals represent the potential for enduring social networks and positive economic and social futures. Based on ethnographic data collected Anthropological Quarterly among middlemen in the mineral trade, we can identify at least three factors that can account for this disjuncture: the demonization of artisanal miners, the vilification of Congolese mineral traders, and the complications wrought by an elaborate international system in which minerals are laundered
title_zh: 从数字鸿沟到创造性破坏：刚果“血矿”贸易监管中的认识论遭遇
abstract_zh: 近20年来，刚果民主共和国东部遭受了巨大的人员和生态伤亡，各种国家和非国家行为体制造的恐怖暴行令人痛心。所有这些冲突的核心是提取和贸易矿物（如钽铁矿），这些矿物对于生产我们如今与数字时代相关的大部分电子产品（手机、游戏机）至关重要。一些人认为这些产品全球交换的算盘很简单：控制这些矿物的民兵（通常通过盗窃或强迫矿工劳动）购买武器以推进其恐怖行动。2010年《多德-弗兰克法案》正是在这些假设下出台的，该法案要求美国公司进行尽职调查，确保其产品制造中使用的矿物是无冲突的。但对于数千名参与刚果矿物财富生产和贩运的刚果人来说，矿物代表着持久社会网络以及积极经济和社会未来的潜力。基于在《人类学季刊》上收集的矿物贸易中间商的民族志数据，我们可以确定至少三个因素可以解释这种脱节：对个体矿工的妖魔化、对刚果矿物贸易商的诋毁，以及一个复杂的国际体系造成的复杂情况，在该体系中矿物被洗白。

title: Material Epistemologies of the (Mobile) Telephone
abstract: This article examines the ways of knowing that govern public constructions of knowledge in the manufacture of the mobile phone—its cultural meaning, sociality of labor, and environmental consequences. It does so to consider the "material epistemology" of the mobile phone, the way in which one comes to know these devices, especially through the devices themselves. In modern manufacture, the incorporation of corporate supplier audits and investigative reporting into public discourse reveals an epistemology of production that is primarily imagined, rather than historically and ethnographically realized. Although the public epistemology of the mobile supply chain is built from the model of the telephone and telegraph, these networks were themselves mystified, displaced, and obscured. This is illustrated by examining material and conceptual differences between the historic supply chain of the telephone manufacturer Western Electric, and those imagined for contemporary companies like Apple.
title_zh: （移动）电话的物质认识论
abstract_zh: 本文探讨了在移动电话制造过程中主导公共知识建构的认知方式——其文化意义、劳动社会性和环境后果。这样做是为了考量移动电话的“物质认识论”，即人们如何认知这些设备，尤其是通过设备本身。在现代制造业中，企业供应商审计和调查性报道融入公共话语，揭示了一种主要在想象中而非历史和民族志现实的生产认识论。尽管移动供应链的公共认识论建立在电话和电报模型之上，但这些网络本身就被神秘化、置换和遮蔽了。通过考察电话制造商西部电气的历史供应链与当代苹果等公司所想象的供应链之间的物质和概念差异，这一点得以阐明。

title: Scaling the Cloud: Making State and Infrastructure in Sweden
abstract: Popular representations imagine the internet as being immaterial and fluid; hidden from the public eye are the industry and complex infrastructure securing the functionality of the World Wide Web, as well as this industry’s social and environmental effects. Focussing on the implementation of a Facebook data centre in the Swedish city of Luleå, this article investigates how the global cloud is localised within a specific historical and social context. It shows how this new industrial development becomes a part of state-making and regional identity-building processes by triggering the re-scaling of territories and shaping new geographies in relation to expanding cloud infrastructures. Tracing those infrastructure-making processes reveals some of the key dynamics between the Swedish state, its regions and the global IT economy.
title_zh: 扩展云：瑞典的国家与基础设施建设
abstract_zh: 流行表征将互联网想象为非物质的、流动的；保障万维网功能的产业和复杂基础设施，以及该产业的社会和环境影响，则隐藏在公众视野之外。本文聚焦于瑞典吕勒奥市一个Facebook数据中心的实施，探究全球云如何在一个具体的历史和社会背景下被本地化。它展示了这一新的工业发展如何通过引发领土的重新尺度化，并在不断扩展的云基础设施周围塑造新的地理景观，而成为国家构建和区域认同建构过程的一部分。追踪这些基础设施建造过程，揭示了瑞典国家、其地区与全球IT经济之间的一些关键动态。

title: The Materiality of Cell Phone Repair: Re-making Commodities in Washington, DC
abstract: In this piece, we shed light on the materiality of cell phones in the United States by comparing two cell phone repair shops in the Washington, DC metro region, and analyze the different ways in which these repair shops confront customers with the material realities of cell phones through variable yet systematic narratives and practices of repair. We argue that cell phone repair shops provide a distinctive site in which to unpack various articulations of the commodity fetishism of cell phones, the craft of repair, and thus the distinctive materiality of these now essential technological devices. By focusing on the tools and the techniques for their use, this ethnographic account highlights the ways in which repair, as an embodied practice, variously reveals, conceals, and constructs the value and agency of cell phones in the context of an emerging post-Fordist economy
title_zh: 手机维修的物质性：华盛顿特区商品重塑中的实践
abstract_zh: 在这篇文章中，我们通过比较华盛顿特区大都会区的两家手机维修店，揭示了美国手机的物质性，并分析了这些维修店通过各自不同但系统的叙事和维修实践，如何让顾客面对手机的物质现实。我们认为，手机维修店提供了一个独特的地点，用以拆解手机商品拜物教、维修手艺以及这些现代必备技术设备的独特物质性的不同表达。通过聚焦工具及其使用技巧，这一民族志记述突出了维修作为一种具身实践，在新兴后福特主义经济的背景下，如何以不同方式揭示、隐藏和构建手机的价值与能动性。

title: Tracing indium production to the mines of the Cerro Rico de Potosí
abstract: In this article, I examine the valorization process in the indium commodity chain. The first section of the article looks closely at small‐scale polymetallic production in Potosí. Here I demonstrate how producers and mill operators in Bolivia, because of the nature of the metal, do not know their production contains indium and instead perceive their production to be less valuable. The second section of the article seeks to link Bolivian production to international indium markets. I demonstrate how accumulation occurs along the commodity chain for companies that deny the Bolivian origin of their mill feeds. I conclude with an analysis of the state of the commodity in economic anthropology. I argue, with help from Bolivian miners, that previous and contemporary notions of the commodity have neglected an important part of its composition, what Marx referred to as “dead/past labor.” Incorporating this notion into our understanding of commodities, I argue, can help us understand the way raw material mineral markets function today.
title_zh: 追踪铟的生产到波托西山富矿的矿山
abstract_zh: 在本文中，我考察了铟商品链中的价值化过程。文章第一部分仔细考察了波托西的小规模多金属生产。在此，我展示了玻利维亚的生产者和选矿厂经营者由于金属的性质，并不知道他们的产品中含有铟，反而认为其产品价值较低。文章第二部分试图将玻利维亚的生产与国际铟市场联系起来。我展示了那些否认其选矿原料来自玻利维亚的公司如何沿着商品链实现积累。最后，我以经济人类学中关于商品状态的分析作为结论。我认为，在玻利维亚矿工的帮助下，先前和当代的商品概念忽略了其组成的一个重要部分，即马克思所指的“死劳动/过去劳动”。将这一概念纳入我们对商品的理解中，我认为可以帮助我们理解今天原材料矿物市场的运作方式。

title: Unseen Connections: The Materiality of Cell Phones
abstract: Unseen Connections:The Materiality of Cell Phones Joshua A. Bell, Briel Kobak, Joel Kuipers, and Amanda Kemble In his much cited 1986 essay on the "Cultural Biography of Things," Igor Kopytoff proposes a biographical approach to objects and things as a way to understand commodities and commodification. Doing so he remarks, "What would make a biography cultural is not what it deals with, but how and from what perspective. A culturally informed economic biography of an object would look at it as a culturally constructed entity, endowed with culturally specific meanings, and classified and reclassified into culturally constituted categories" (1986:68, emphasis added). Kopytoff's work, and indeed the collection in which it appeared (Appadurai 1986a), helped spawn an entire genre of anthropological writing, and initiated a wider rethinking of the role of commodities in everyday lives globally (see Miller 1987; Gosden and Marshall 1999; Hoskins 1998, 2006; Bestor 2004; Foster 2008; West 2012; Tsing 2015; Joyce and Gillespie 2015). This collection of essays focuses on the aspect of reclassification inspired by Kopytoff's work by applying the biographical approach to a contemporary commodity that emerges from a network of transnational supply chains: the cell phone. Kopytoff's work helped launch a powerful approach to the longue durée of capitalism and commoditization in Africa (cf. Burke 1996), and indeed elsewhere (cf. Thomas 1991). However, while he was well aware of the ways [End Page 465] in which commodities were made and unmade, Kopytoff's biographical approach insists that commodities are born at the moment of exchange.1 Taking a cue from recent anthropological work on globalization and commodity supply chains (see Lee and LiPuma 2002; Tsing 2005, 2015; Foster 2008; West 2012), the articles in this collection explore the life of the cell phone both before and after its point of sale, evaluating its position as a commodity during the various phases of its production and manipulation. Doing so, the collection seeks to bring the "global assemblage" (Collier and Ong 2005) of the cell phone into view, as well as the networks that the device helps to sustain and create (see Hockenberry, this issue). Each piece in this special collection examines the sorts of exchange spheres that Kopytoff described, detailing how different relations and contexts foreground various aspects of an object's materiality throughout its lifetime. The essays reaffirm that the significance and value of the object is always unstable and open for reclassification (Graeber 2001, Tsing 2015). In this collection's discussions of the cell phone such negotiations are present through concerns over origins of material, like coltan (Mantz, this issue), in debates over who makes one's device (Hockenberry, this issue), the nature of infrastructure that they are a part of (Taylor and Horst, this issue), conversations over digital versus landline connection (Dent, this issue), or attempts to conceal broken phone parts and repair from anxious customers (Bell et al., this issue). By paying attention to the social and material relations within production, use, breakdown, repair, and innovation, this collection aims to demonstrate the extent to which the life of a commodity indeed merits biographical attention even—perhaps, most especially—as supply chains grow in scope, scale, and complexity. Doing so, this collection pulls together an analytical approach to commodities, and their supply chains, with a materially focused ethnography of infrastructure and media. Anthropology of the Cell Phone Smartphone, shŏujī, keitai, handy, celular, móvil, ponsel, ovare voa2: with over 6 billion users worldwide and counting, and some 2 billion purchased annually, what we in this collection will refer to as the "cell phone" has become integral to people's lives throughout the world. Alongside the rapid and global proliferation of cell phones, there has been a steady growth in anthropological research on the device's integration into daily life. Since [End Page 466] the mid-2000s much of the ethnographic literature on cell phones has explored the social and communicative transformations of these devices.3 Anthropologists have focused on how cell phones mediate social relationships (see Glotz, Bertscht, and Locke 2005; Horst and Miller 2006; De Bruijn, Nyamnjoh, and Brinkman 2009; Lipset 2013), and shape subjective experience, such as identity and gender, along specific...
title_zh: 看不见的连接：手机的物质性
abstract_zh: 看不见的连接：手机的物质性  Joshua A. Bell, Briel Kobak, Joel Kuipers 和 Amanda Kemble 在其1986年广为引用的《物的文化传记》一文中，Igor Kopytoff 提出了一种对物品和事物的传记式方法，以理解商品和商品化。他评论道：“使传记具有文化性的不是它处理的内容，而是它的方式和视角。一个具有文化意识的物的经济传记会将其视为文化建构的实体，赋予其特定文化意义，并不断分类和重新分类到文化构成的类别中”（1986:68，强调为原文所有）。Kopytoff 的工作，以及它所属的文集（Appadurai 1986a），催生了整整一个人类学写作流派，并引发了对商品在全球日常生活中作用的更广泛反思（参见 Miller 1987; Gosden 和 Marshall 1999; Hoskins 1998, 2006; Bestor 2004; Foster 2008; West 2012; Tsing 2015; Joyce 和 Gillespie 2015）。本文集受到 Kopytoff 工作的启发，聚焦于重新分类的方面，将传记式方法应用于一种来自跨国供应链网络的当代商品：手机。Kopytoff 的工作为理解非洲资本主义和商品化的长时段历史（参见 Burke 1996）以及其他地区（参见 Thomas 1991）提供了有力方法。然而，尽管他深知商品被制造和消解的方式，Kopytoff 的传记式方法坚持认为商品诞生于交换的时刻。借鉴近期关于全球化和商品供应链的人类学工作（参见 Lee 和 LiPuma 2002; Tsing 2005, 2015; Foster 2008; West 2012），本文集的文章探讨了手机在销售点之前和之后的生命，评估其在生产和操纵各个阶段作为商品的位置。通过这样做，文集旨在揭示手机的“全球集合”（Collier 和 Ong 2005），以及该设备帮助维持和创造的网络（参见 Hockenberry，本期）。本特刊中的每篇文章都考察了 Kopytoff 所描述的交换领域，详细说明了不同的关系和背景如何在物品的整个生命周期中凸显其物质性的不同方面。文章重申了物体的意义和价值总是不稳定的，并随时可能被重新分类（Graeber 2001; Tsing 2015）。在本集关于手机的讨论中，这些协商体现在对材料来源（如钶钽铁矿，Mantz 本期）、谁制造了设备（Hockenberry 本期）、它们所属基础设施的性质（Taylor 和 Horst 本期）、数字与固定电话连接的对话（Dent 本期），或试图向焦虑的顾客隐瞒破损手机部件和维修（Bell 等人本期）的担忧中。通过关注生产、使用、故障、维修和创新中的社会和物质关系，本文集旨在展示商品的生命确实值得传记式的关注，即使——或许尤其是——随着供应链在范围、规模和复杂性上的增长。通过这样做，本文集将一种对商品及其供应链的分析方法与对基础设施和媒体的物质聚焦民族志结合起来。手机人类学 智能手机、手机、keitai、handy、celular、móvil、ponsel、ovare voa：全球超过60亿用户且持续增长，每年约购买20亿部，本文集所称的“手机”已成为世界各地人们生活中不可或缺的一部分。随着手机在全球的迅速普及，对该设备融入日常生活的人类学研究也在稳步增长。自2000年代中期以来，大部分关于手机的民族志文献探讨了这些设备的社会和沟通变革。人类学家关注手机如何调解社会关系（参见 Glotz, Bertscht 和 Locke 2005; Horst 和 Miller 2006; De Bruijn, Nyamnjoh 和 Brinkman 2009; Lipset 2013），以及如何塑造主观体验，如身份和性别，沿着特定的...

title: Zapotec innovation in a Mexican village: Building an autonomous mobile network
abstract: In 2013, a Zapotec village in the Mexican state of Oaxaca drew international attention when its citizens successfully created an autonomous mobile phone network. Using open‐source software and with technical assistance from an NGO (non‐governmental organization), the people of Talea de Castro obtained antennae, a base station and software that enabled them to build a fully functional mobile network with global reach. This article examines theoretical questions about the nature of innovation and the conditions that might help promote it. It also places the network in broad historical and social contexts. The article reviews the political, legal and technical processes by which villagers were able to create the network. For many years, Talea has been a centre of technological creativity and experimentation. The network might be seen as the village's latest innovation in a centuries‐long process in which creative problem‐solving is integrated with indigenous patterns of mutual aid, reciprocal labour and cooperativism. The article concludes with a discussion of the challenges facing the network and its users.
title_zh: 墨西哥村庄的萨波特克创新：建设自主移动网络
abstract_zh: 2013年，墨西哥瓦哈卡州的一个萨波特克村庄因其公民成功创建了一个自主移动电话网络而引起了国际关注。使用开源软件，并在一个非政府组织的技术协助下，Talea de Castro的村民获得了天线、基站和软件，使他们能够建立一个功能齐全、可全球连接的移动网络。本文探讨了关于创新本质及可能促进创新的条件的理论问题，并将该网络置于广泛的历史和社会背景中。文章回顾了村民创建网络所经历的政治、法律和技术过程。多年来，Talea一直是技术创造力和实验的中心。这个网络可以被视为该村庄在长达几个世纪的进程中最新的创新，在这一过程中，创造性的问题解决与土著互助、互惠劳动和合作主义模式相结合。文章最后讨论了该网络及其用户面临的挑战。

title: A great leap? Domestic market growth and local state support in the upgrading of China's LED lighting industry
journal_name: GLOBAL NETWORKS-A JOURNAL OF TRANSNATIONAL AFFAIRS
abstract: Abstract In this article we analyse the conditions for industrial upgrading in the Chinese LED industry, which proactive local state policies and expanding domestic markets have greatly facilitated. State initiatives provoked overinvestment, but eventually led to the emergence of competitive domestic enterprises. Simultaneously, firms benefited from a growing domestic market on which they outcompeted foreign companies in mid‐price segments. The combination of these factors accounts for the peculiarly Chinese upgrading experience. Neither the resources provided by a new version of the ‘developmental state’ nor domestic market growth alone can explain the Chinese players' success. Based on these results, and given that the emerging economies have become the most important markets for certain consumer goods – a development that (local) industrial policies for industrial upgrading can influence – we provide further proof that it is necessary to rethink the export‐led upgrading paradigm in theories of globally dispersed production.
title_zh: 大跃进？国内市场增长与地方政府支持在中国LED照明产业升级中的作用
abstract_zh: 本文分析了中国LED产业产业升级的条件，地方政府的积极政策与不断扩大的国内市场极大地促进了这一过程。政府的举措引发了过度投资，但最终催生了具有竞争力的国内企业。同时，企业受益于日益增长的国内市场，在中端价格区间击败了外国公司。这些因素的结合解释了中国特色升级经验。无论是新版本“发展型国家”提供的资源，还是国内市场增长本身，都不能单独解释中国参与者的成功。基于这些结果，考虑到新兴经济体已成为某些消费品最重要的市场——这一发展（地方）产业政策可以影响工业升级——我们进一步证明有必要重新思考全球分散生产理论中的出口导向型升级范式。

title: Corporate Mortality Files and Late Industrial Necropolitics
abstract: This article critically examines the corporate production, archival politics, and socio-legal dimensions of corporate mortality files (CMFs), the largest corporate archive developed by IBM to systematically document industrial exposures and occupational health outcomes for electronics workers. I first provide a history of IBM's CMF project, which amounts to a comprehensive mortality record for IBM employees over the past 40 years. Next, I explore a recent case in Endicott, New York, birthplace of IBM, where the U.S. National Institute for Occupational Safety and Health studied IBM's CMFs for workers at IBM's former Endicott plant. Tracking the production of the IBM CMF, the strategic avoidance of this source of big data as evidence for determining a recent legal settlement, alongside local critiques of the IBM CMF project, the article develops what I call "late industrial necropolitics."
title_zh: 企业死亡率档案与晚期工业死亡政治
abstract_zh: 本文批判性地审视了企业死亡率档案（CMFs）的企业生产、档案政治和社会法律维度，这是IBM为系统记录电子工人的工业暴露和职业健康结果而开发的最大的企业档案。我首先提供了IBM的CMF项目的历史，这相当于过去40年IBM员工的全面死亡率记录。接下来，我探讨了纽约州恩迪科特（IBM的诞生地）最近的一个案例，美国国家职业安全与健康研究所研究了IBM前恩迪科特工厂工人的CMFs。通过追踪IBM CMF的生产、这一大数据来源在决定最近法律和解中作为证据的战略性回避，以及当地对IBM CMF项目的批评，本文发展了我所谓的“晚期工业死亡政治”。

title: From smiling to smirking? 3D printing, upgrading and the restructuring of global value chains
journal_name: GLOBAL NETWORKS-A JOURNAL OF TRANSNATIONAL AFFAIRS
abstract: Abstract 3D printing (3DP) has been heralded as a revolutionary technology that can alter the way production is organized across time and space – with important redistributive effects on geography and size of production activities. In this article, we examine the impacts that a widespread adoption of 3DP could have on restructuring, upgrading and distributing value added along manufacturing global value chains (GVC) – with brief examples from the aerospace and automotive industries. We highlight two possible scenarios for GVCs – a complementarity scenario of 3DP and traditional manufacturing overlapping, which would reproduce power relations in GVCs and the current distribution of value added in a ‘smiling curve’; and a substitution scenario of 3DP partly or fully superseding traditional manufacturing, which would have more transformational effects in terms of ‘rebundling’ activities, regionalizing or localizing GVCs, and flattening the smiling curve into a ‘smirk’.
title_zh: 从微笑到假笑？3D打印、升级与全球价值链的重构
abstract_zh:
摘要
3D打印（3DP）被誉为一项革命性技术，可以改变生产在时间和空间上的组织方式——对生产活动的地理位置和规模产生重要的再分配效应。在本文中，我们考察了3DP广泛应用可能对制造业全球价值链（GVC）的重构、升级和价值分配产生的影响——并简要举例说明航空航天和汽车行业。我们强调了GVC的两种可能情景：一种互补情景，即3DP与传统制造重叠，这将再现GVC中的权力关系和当前“微笑曲线”中的价值分配；另一种替代情景，即3DP部分或完全取代传统制造，这将在“重新捆绑”活动、区域化或本地化GVC以及将微笑曲线扁平化为“假笑”方面产生更具变革性的影响。

title: Global Electronic Waste, Third Party Certification Standards, and Resisting the Undoing of Environmental Justice Politics
abstract: This article provides a critical assessment of a shift in discourse and political actions taken by the Basel Action Network (BAN), the primary non-governmental organization involved in overseeing and regulating the international trade in hazardous wastes in general and electronic waste (e-waste) in particular. First, we review recent scholarship focused on changes in social movement tactics that more directly target corporate practices, specifically the rise of voluntary third party certification standards. In particular, we attend to early efforts of the global environmental justice movement to address the trade in hazardous wastes, including e-waste. Next, we discuss our research findings on the changes in discourse, strategy, and political demands of environmental justice activists engaged in e-waste recycling. These findings support other recent case studies that suggest that the development of voluntary third party certifications adopt neoliberal market logics and corporate governance practices. In addition, our findings also more explicitly consider how changing discourse—in this case, a shift from exploitation to expertise—transforms political strategies and undercuts environmental justice approaches to global e-waste politics. As engaged social scientists and e-waste activists working against neoliberal intrusion, we argue that resistance to these transformations is a matter of de-economizing the systemic expansion and efficiency management practices conditioning the contemporary global e-waste trade and the strategic greenwashing of e-waste recycling. We further argue that developing interventions in e-waste management and policy based on ethical principles of global environmental justice is a critical step forward for applied social science engagements with emerging e-waste studies.
title_zh: 全球电子垃圾、第三方认证标准与抵制环境正义政治的解构
abstract_zh: 本文对巴塞尔行动网络（BAN）——主要负责监督和监管危险废物（尤其是电子垃圾）国际贸易的主要非政府组织——在话语和政治行动上的转变进行了批判性评估。首先，我们回顾了近期关于社会运动策略变化（更直接针对企业实践）的学术研究，特别是自愿性第三方认证标准的兴起。我们特别关注全球环境正义运动早期处理危险废物（包括电子垃圾）贸易的努力。接下来，我们讨论了关于参与电子垃圾回收的环境正义活动家在话语、策略和政治诉求方面变化的研究发现。这些发现支持了其他最近的案例研究，表明自愿性第三方认证的发展采纳了新自由主义的市场逻辑和公司治理实践。此外，我们的研究还更明确地考虑了话语变化——在此案例中，从剥削转向专业知识——如何转变政治策略并削弱全球电子垃圾政治中的环境正义方法。作为反对新自由主义侵入的介入型社会科学家和电子垃圾活动家，我们认为抵制这些转变是去经济化系统性扩张和效率管理实践（这些实践制约着当代全球电子垃圾贸易和电子垃圾回收的策略性漂绿）的问题。我们进一步主张，基于全球环境正义的伦理原则制定电子垃圾管理和政策干预措施，是应用社会科学介入新兴电子垃圾研究的关键一步。

title: Modal reasoning in Dar es Salaam's power network
abstract:
In Dar es Salaam, Tanzania, residents, electricians, and power-utility workers tolerate some unofficial forms of modifiying the electrical network, such as unsanctioned reconnections and extensions. These practices, which can also involve theft, bribery, and other illegal activities, both undermine and sustain an increasingly expensive public infrastructure that is in disrepair and subject to routine bureaucratic neglect. But such modifications also have their tacit limits, and people judge as foolish those who have exceeded them. The limits reveal a modal reasoning at work in the relationship among technical systems, urban ethics, and informal economic arrangements. In each of these domains, people use modal reasoning to simultaneously alter and preserve an emergent future. Such reasoning illustrates how infrastructures constitute wholes that emerge from, but are not reducible to, their constituent parts. [infrastructure, electricity, modality, reasoning, urbanism, Dar es Salaam, Tanzania]

Dar es salaam, Tanzania, wakazi, mafundi umeme, na wafanyakazi wanaosambaza umeme wanaendekeza kufanya aina za marekebisho ya mifumo ya umeme isiyo rasmi, kwa mfano kuongeza idadi ya watumiaji wa umeme na kuwarudishia huduma ya umeme wale waliokatiwa bila ya kuingia nao mikataba na bila ya idhini kutoka shirika la umeme. Lakini marekebisho haya pia yana ukomo wa ukimya na watu wanawaona wale ambao wamezidi kama vile hawana busara. Ukomo huu unadhihirisha aina ya fikra ya kimfumo katika mahusiano ya nyanja za kiufundi, maadili ya kazi, na mipangilio ya kiuchumi isiyo rasmi. Katika hali hizi nyanja, watu wanatumia fikra za kimfumo kwa wakati huo huo kubadili na kutunza wanachokusudia hapo mbeleni. Fikra hii inaonyesha kwamba miundombuni ni mjumuisho unaotokana na mahusiano ya vipengele mbalimbali na sio vipengele vilivyokaa kipekee. [miundombinu, umeme, mfumo, fikra, mjini, Dar es Salaam, Tanzania]
title_zh: 达累斯萨拉姆电力网络中的模态推理
abstract_zh: 在坦桑尼亚的达累斯萨拉姆，居民、电工和电力公司员工容忍某些非官方的电力网络修改形式，例如未经授权的重新连接和扩展。这些做法，可能还涉及盗窃、贿赂和其他非法活动，既破坏又维持着一个日益昂贵、失修且遭受日常官僚疏忽的公共基础设施。但此类修改也有其默认的限度，人们认为超出限度的人是愚蠢的。这些限度揭示了在技术系统、城市伦理和非正式经济安排之间关系中所运作的模态推理。在每个领域中，人们使用模态推理同时改变和保持一个新兴的未来。这种推理说明了基础设施如何构成从组成部分中涌现但不可还原为部分的整体。[基础设施，电力，模态，推理，城市化，达累斯萨拉姆，坦桑尼亚]

title: Petty commodities, serious business: the governance of fashion jewellery chains between China and Ghana
journal_name: GLOBAL NETWORKS-A JOURNAL OF TRANSNATIONAL AFFAIRS
abstract: Abstract In many parts of the world, people access consumer goods mainly via informal economic networks. In this article, I analyse the governance of petty commodity chains through a case study of Chinese fashion jewellery produced for the Ghanaian market. ‘Petty commodity chains’ denotes a particular type of global value chain, where production, trade, and distribution are carried out by small, unregistered businesses, between which personalized relationships and informal infrastructure enable transactions. These chains are neither controlled by lead firms at the production or distribution ends, nor made up of pure market linkages. Weak formal institutions and an intensely competitive commercial environment encourage business actors to establish enduring relationships. Credit relations run through long stretches of the chain and create mutual dependencies. The concept of ‘beholden value chains’ is introduced to describe the co‐dependency between business actors and the coordination of activities in petty commodity chains.
title_zh: 小商品，大生意：中国与加纳之间时尚首饰链的治理
abstract_zh: 在世界许多地方，人们主要通过非正规经济网络获取消费品。本文通过分析为加纳市场生产的中国时尚首饰案例，研究了小商品链的治理。'小商品链'指的是一种特定类型的全球价值链，其中生产、贸易和分销由小型未注册企业进行，这些企业之间通过个性化关系和非正规基础设施实现交易。这些链条既不受生产端或分销端的主导企业控制，也不完全由纯市场联系构成。薄弱的正式制度和激烈的商业环境促使商业参与者建立持久关系。信贷关系贯穿链条的较长环节，并产生相互依赖。引入'受恩价值链'这一概念来描述小商品链中商业行为者之间的相互依赖和活动协调。

title: Salero dir. by Mike Plunkett
abstract: Reviewed by: Salero dir. by Mike Plunkett Joshua Holst Salero, dir. Mike Plunkett New York: Cinema Guild, 2015. 76 min. Available at http://store.cinemaguild.com/nontheatrical/product/2541.html. Mike Plunkett's directorial debut, Salero, takes place in Bolivia's Salar de Uyuni, the largest salt flat in the world. The film's exquisite cinematography captures not only the haunting majesty of the Salar de Uyuni, but also the simple beauty of the innocuous elements of daily life in Colchani, the small town closest to the Salar. The film is both an astoundingly gorgeous piece of work and a richly detailed portrait of a dying way of life. Yet this portrait is incomplete. A full understanding of the dangers of the incoming mine are outside the scope of the film. Educators showing Salero should be prepared to add additional context to illustrate that the stakes are far deeper than what we see on screen. The film opens with the titular salero, Moises, as he recounts the tale of Armstrong, looking back on Earth from space and stunned by the sight of the Salar de Uyuni. The ethereal soundtrack and stunning footage captured by director Mike Plunkett and his Director of Photography Andrew David Watson convey a sense of awe throughout the film; it's hard not to humbled by its beauty along with Moises. "The Salar is my whole life. There's no other place like the Salar, and there never will be. It's the most peaceful place on earth." Carefully paced silences give the audience a sense of being alone with this immense natural wonder. Moises is an indigenous man who, like his father before him, traverses the Salar in his pickup truck to collect salt to sell in nearby markets. "Who wants to be a salero?" Moises asks his children as they help him sweep salt into piles in the back of his truck. "Me!" the children shout excitedly. Moises teaches them a song in Quechua about herding sheep. [End Page 831] However, the Salar de Uyuni is not only the world's largest salt flat but also the world's largest lithium reserve. With a new, booming market for lithium batteries, prospectors claim the Salar will make Bolivia the "Saudi Arabia of the 21st Century." Interviews with representatives of the mine are juxtaposed with thought provoking musings from Moises. While mining representatives celebrate technology and progress, Moises ruminates on humanity's ties to the land, the corruption of cities, and the falsehoods of progress. Yet, the film is often agnostic in its juxtaposition of the traditional and the modern. Moises's romantic attachment to the Salar is not shared by his wife, trapped in her house watching telenovelas about romance and wealth, who dreams of leaving the remote isolation of Colchani to work in a beauty salon. Unlike her husband, she believes there is a better life waiting for them in the city. Yet her dreams come at a tremendous price for Moises, who is facing serious economic problems. With the new road and infrastructure coming into the Salar, the price of salt drops, and Moises's livelihood slips through his fingers. When his brother and business partner leaves, Moises can no longer refine the salt he's collected all his life. "Everyone here is thinking about how to bring more activity, more tourism, more money….over time there will be larger buildings in Colchani, it will be like Uyuni. I think Moises is going to have a hard time not working anymore with a shovel and a pickaxe. And that's what he's used to, being out on the Salar, since the time of our grandfathers." There is little Moises can do but listen to television and radio reports on the wealth that will come to the Bolivian people as he gains less and less. "What do you want to do with your life?" Moises asks his son later in the film. His excited smile is gone. "To work in the Salar," his son replies softly, but Moises can no longer share his children's enthusiasm for a dying way of life. Many will find the otherworldly landscape of the Salar haunting long...
title_zh: 《Salero》导演：Mike Plunkett
abstract_zh: 书评：《Salero》，导演：Mike Plunkett，Joshua Holst。Salero，导演Mike Plunkett，纽约：Cinema Guild，2015年，76分钟。可在http://store.cinemaguild.com/nontheatrical/product/2541.html获取。Mike Plunkett的导演处女作《Salero》以玻利维亚的乌尤尼盐沼为背景，这是世界上最大的盐滩。影片精美的摄影不仅捕捉到了乌尤尼盐沼令人难忘的壮丽，也展现了靠近盐沼的小镇科尔查尼日常生活中无害元素的朴素之美。这部影片既是一部令人惊叹的美丽作品，也是一幅关于一种正在消亡的生活方式的丰富细节的肖像。然而，这幅肖像并不完整。对即将到来的矿场的危险性的全面理解超出了影片的范围。展示《Salero》的教育工作者应准备添加额外的背景，以说明其中的利害关系远比我们在屏幕上看到的更深。影片以主人公Salero，Moises开场，他讲述了阿姆斯特朗从太空回望地球的故事，被乌尤尼盐沼的景象所震撼。空灵的配乐和由导演Mike Plunkett及摄影指导Andrew David Watson拍摄的震撼镜头在整部影片中传达了一种敬畏感；很难不被它的美丽和Moises一起感到谦卑。“盐沼是我的全部生命。没有其他地方像盐沼，也永远不会有了。这是地球上最宁静的地方。”精心编排的沉默让观众感受到与这一巨大自然奇观独处的感觉。Moises是一个土著人，像他父亲之前一样，他开着皮卡车穿越盐沼收集盐，然后在附近的市场出售。“谁想当盐工？”Moises问他的孩子们，他们正在帮他把盐扫到卡车后面。“我！”孩子们兴奋地喊道。Moises教他们一首盖丘亚语的关于放羊的歌。[第831页]然而，乌尤尼盐沼不仅是世界上最大的盐滩，也是世界上最大的锂储量地。随着锂电池市场的新兴繁荣，勘探者声称盐沼将使玻利维亚成为“21世纪的沙特阿拉伯”。对矿场代表的采访与Moises发人深省的思考形成对比。当矿场代表庆祝技术和进步时，Moises思考着人类与土地的联系、城市的腐败以及进步的谎言。然而，影片在传统与现代的对比中常常持不可知论态度。Moises对盐沼的浪漫依恋并没有得到他妻子的共鸣，她被关在家里看关于浪漫和财富的电视剧，梦想着离开科尔查尼的偏远孤立，去美容院工作。与丈夫不同，她相信城市里有更好的生活在等着他们。然而，她的梦想对面临严重经济问题的Moises来说代价巨大。随着通往盐沼的新道路和基础设施的建设，盐的价格下跌，Moises的生计从指间溜走。当他的兄弟兼商业伙伴离开时，Moises再也无法精炼他一生收集的盐。“这里的每个人都在思考如何带来更多的活动、更多的旅游、更多的钱……随着时间的推移，科尔查尼会有更大的建筑，它会像乌尤尼一样。我想Moises很难再继续用铲子和镐头工作了。而这是他习惯的，在盐沼上，自祖父时代起。”Moises几乎无能为力，只能听着电视和广播关于即将带给玻利维亚人民的财富的报道，而他得到的却越来越少。“你的人生想做什么？”Moises后来问他的儿子。他兴奋的笑容消失了。“在盐沼工作。”他的儿子轻声回答，但Moises再也无法分享孩子们对一种正在消亡的生活方式的热情。许多人会发现这超现实的乌尤尼盐沼景观令人难以忘怀……

title: “We Are Sensemakers”: The (Anti-)politics of Smart City Co-creation
abstract: This empirical-critical study looks at the Air Quality Egg project, a Euro-American effort focused on the collaborative creation of a “smart” air quality sensor network. While widely celebrated as a “best practice” example of bottom-up smart city making, the involvement of a US software company that turned the data platform into a full-blown for-profit service suggests a very different reading. Yet why did the project’s serving both corporate and anticorporate agendas not cause significant conflict among participants themselves? Which practices, forms of imagination, discourses, and types of experiences enabled this collaboration against all odds? This article addresses these questions by looking at the ambiguous ways the group’s meetings mobilized the principles and practices of open source, prototyping, and a focus on doing, configuring the gatherings as spaces of transformational possibility, detached from the networks, roles, and institutions of daily life.
title_zh: “我们是意义创造者”：智慧城市共创的（反）政治
abstract_zh: 这项经验批判性研究关注的是“空气质量鸡蛋”项目，这是一个欧美合作的项目，专注于协作创建一个“智能”空气质量传感器网络。虽然该项目被广泛誉为自下而上建设智慧城市的“最佳实践”范例，但一家美国软件公司的参与将数据平台转变为完全盈利的服务，这暗示了一种截然不同的解读。然而，为什么该项目服务于企业反企业双重议程却没有在参与者之间引发重大冲突？哪些实践、想象形式、话语和体验类型使得这种合作在逆境中成为可能？本文通过考察该团体会议如何以模糊的方式动员开源、原型制作和专注于行动的原则和实践，将聚会配置为变革可能性的空间，脱离日常生活中的网络、角色和制度，来解决这些问题。

title: Apple, Foxconn, and Chinese workers’ struggles from a global labor perspective
abstract: To enrich the discussion of global labor, between 2010 and 2016, we studied Apple’s value chain, Foxconn’s mode of labor control, and Chinese workers’ struggles. Through our fieldwork in China we also examined Apple’s and Foxconn’s responses to the spate of worker suicides, workers’ resistance, the activism of scholar and student groups, and transnational justice campaigns. We conclude with reflection on global labor studies in light of the debates between Karl Polanyi’s counter movement and Karl Marx’s class-based struggle.
title_zh: 苹果、富士康与中国工人抗争：全球劳动视角
abstract_zh: 为丰富全球劳动的讨论，我们在2010年至2016年间研究了苹果公司的价值链、富士康的劳动控制模式以及中国工人的抗争。通过在中国的实地调研，我们还考察了苹果和富士康对一系列工人自杀事件的回应、工人的抵抗、学者和学生团体的行动主义以及跨国正义运动。最后，我们结合卡尔·波兰尼的反向运动与卡尔·马克思的阶级斗争之间的辩论，对全球劳动研究进行了反思。

title: Collecting Social Network Data from Mobile Phone SIM Cards
abstract: I used a subscriber identity module card reader to copy the lists of saved contacts from 170 mobile phones in Fiji. This approach has both advantages and disadvantages compared to other techniques for collecting telephone network data. Copying phone contacts avoids recall biases associated with survey-based name generators. It also obviates the need to obtain calling records from network service providers or to provide research subjects with specialized phones. In markets with multiple service providers, or in contexts in which mobile phones are shared extensively, the contents of contact lists may represent personal networks more accurately than actual calling records do. However, owners’ varying durations of phone ownership and varying tendencies to save and delete contacts are sources of error. Also, copying contacts from phones relies on self-reports of tie strength, which are frequently inaccurate. I analyze the data I collected in rural Fiji to evaluate these sources of error.
title_zh: 从手机SIM卡收集社交网络数据
abstract_zh: 我使用用户身份模块卡读卡器复制了斐济170部手机中保存的联系人列表。与其他收集电话网络数据的技术相比，这种方法既有优点也有缺点。复制手机联系人可以避免与基于调查的姓名生成器相关的回忆偏差。它也不需要从网络服务提供商处获取通话记录，也不需要为研究对象提供专门的手机。在有多家服务提供商的市场，或在手机被广泛共享的环境中，联系人列表的内容可能比实际通话记录更准确地代表个人网络。然而，手机拥有者持有手机的时间长短不同，以及保存和删除联系人的倾向不同，都是误差的来源。此外，从手机复制联系人依赖于对关系强度的自我报告，这些报告经常不准确。我分析了在斐济农村收集的数据，以评估这些误差来源。

title: Dead Media Objects and the Experience of the (Once) Modern. Ethnographic Perspectives from the Living Rooms of Kinshasa’s Old Aged
abstract: This article departs from the observation that in many living rooms of elderly Kinois (inhabitants of Kinshasa), old and defunctive radio and television sets are put on display. When their primary function, to inform, has been rendered obsolete, we are faced with the question why people continue to display these objects, often next to newer models, in their living rooms. The main argument is that Information and Communication Technologies (ICT) commodities, old and new, defective and repaired, are primarily social objects that are embedded in complex webs of practices and expectations which unsettle the taken-for-granted associations between technology and time. ICT objects are shown to be metonyms of dynamics in social relationships between owners of these ICT goods and others; and, although seemingly paradoxically, these same objects, even when damaged, inhabit promises for a better future. The article thus offers an alternative perspective on electronic modernity, and in particular, the role of Africa therein.
title_zh: 死亡媒体对象与（曾经的）现代体验：金沙萨老年人客厅的民族志视角
abstract_zh: 本文的出发点是观察到许多金沙萨（Kinshasa）老年居民的客厅里陈列着老旧且已失效的收音机和电视机。当其主要功能——信息传递——已经过时，我们面临的问题是，为什么人们会继续在客厅中展示这些物品，而且往往与新款式并置。主要论点是，信息与通信技术商品，无论新旧、破损或修复，主要是嵌入在复杂的实践和期望网络中的社会对象，这些网络动摇了技术与时间之间理所当然的联系。信息与通信技术对象被证明是这些商品所有者与他人之间社会关系动态的转喻；而且，尽管看似矛盾，这些相同的对象，即使损坏了，也承载着对更美好未来的承诺。因此，本文为电子现代性，特别是非洲在其中所扮演的角色，提供了一个替代性的视角。

title: Trading in broken things: Gendered performances and spatial practices in a northern Vietnamese rural‐urban waste economy

authors.name: Minh T. N. Nguyen
institutions: Max Planck Institute for Social Anthropology

abstract: ABSTRACT Through their deeply gendered performative and place‐making practices, migrant waste traders take part in regenerating and revaluing urban space in Hanoi, Vietnam. Ethnographic research in the city and in their native rural district suggests that these practices are simultaneously strategic and contingent on the waste traders’ gender and class positions. This positioning is defined by their marginalization as rural migrants and the social ambiguity of waste, which they creatively use for their own purposes. Alongside creating value for the waste they deal in, the traders turn marginality and ambiguity into social and economic spaces essential for communal life and economy, albeit with uncertain outcomes. These spaces are not locally bounded but part of shifting trajectories of power in the global market and the urban order of Vietnam. [ waste , rural migrants , performance , urban space , Vietnam ]
title_zh: 破物交易：越南北部城乡废弃物经济中的性别表现与空间实践
abstract_zh: 摘要：通过在河内城市空间中深刻性别化的表演性和地方制造实践，移民废弃物交易者参与再生和重估城市空间。在城市及其家乡农村地区的民族志研究表明，这些实践同时具有策略性，并取决于废弃物交易者的性别和阶级位置。这种定位由他们作为农村移民的边缘化地位以及废弃物的社会模糊性所定义，他们创造性地利用这些因素为自己谋利。除了为所交易的废弃物创造价值之外，交易者还将边缘性和模糊性转化为对社区生活和经济至关重要的社会和经济空间，尽管结果不确定。这些空间并非局限于地方，而是越南全球市场与城市秩序中权力变化轨迹的一部分。[废弃物，农村移民，表演，城市空间，越南]

title: ‘[Not] talking like a Motorola’: mobile phone practices and politics of masking and unmasking in postcolonial Kinshasa
journal_name: JOURNAL OF THE ROYAL ANTHROPOLOGICAL INSTITUTE
abstract: The expression ‘talking like a Motorola’ (koloba lokola Motorola) was long used during Mobutu’s reign to indicate the undesired disclosure of information. It manifests the perception of many Kinois (inhabitants of Kinshasa) that the Motorola handset was only deployed by Mobutu’s secret service agents in order to detect and report critics of the regime. Today, mobile phones are no longer the preserve of political agents. Nearly everybody can have one. The idiom is thus outdated. Yet other lines between ‘what can be said [over the phone]’ and ‘what cannot be said’ are being drawn in Kinshasa’s political society. Indeed, transformations in practices of secrecy, concealment, and, their counterpart, the divulging of information – all three significant axes of the production of power and contestation of authority – are key, both in state actions and in strategies of civil society. In this article, I attempt to locate the mobile phone within Kinshasa’s political society, and analyse how relations to the Congolese state are articulated through the politics of cellular technology and practices with the mobile phone.
title_zh: [不是]像摩托罗拉一样说话：后殖民金萨沙的手机使用与掩饰与揭露的政治
abstract_zh: “像摩托罗拉一样说话”（koloba lokola Motorola）这一表达在蒙博托统治时期长期用于指代不希望的信息泄露。它体现了许多金萨沙居民（Kinois）的认知，即摩托罗拉手机仅被蒙博托的秘密特工用于侦测和举报对政权的批评。如今，手机不再是政治特工的专属品。几乎每个人都拥有一部。因此，这一习语已经过时。然而，在金萨沙的政治社会中，关于“什么可以[在电话中]说”和“什么不能说”的新界限正在被划定。事实上，保密、隐藏及其对立面——信息泄露的实践转变——作为权力生产和权威挑战的重要轴线，在国家行动和公民社会策略中都是关键。在本文中，我试图将手机定位于金萨沙的政治社会中，并分析通过蜂窝技术的政治和手机使用实践，刚果国家的关系是如何被表达的。

title: Attuning to the Chemosphere: Domestic Formaldehyde, Bodily Reasoning, and the Chemical Sublime
abstract: Chronic domestic chemical exposures unfold over protracted timelines and with low velocity. In this article I argue that such microscopic encounters between bodies and toxicants are most readily sensed by less nameable and more diffuse sensory practices. The apprehension of conventionally insensible toxic exposures is informed by sustained attention to barely perceptible alterations of somatic function and atmosphere. Slight biochemical impressions, which at first appear simply meaningless or puzzling, accumulate in the bodies of the exposed and reorient them to the molecular constituents of the air and the domestic infrastructure from which such chemicals emanate. Through the articulation of these small corrosive happenings, residents of contaminated homes can accumulate minute changes to body and atmosphere across time and space in a process I call the “chemical sublime,” which elevates minor enfeebling encounters into events that stir ethical consideration and potential intervention. The chemical sublime is a late industrial experience that inverts an Enlightenment-era, yet still dominant, conception of the sublime. Across authoritative and questioned bodies, companion species and humans, this essay asks: in what ways do diffuse sensory practices generate knowledge of, attention to, and engagements with the chemical world?
title_zh: 调谐化学圈：室内甲醛、身体推理与化学崇高
abstract_zh: 慢性的家庭化学暴露发生在漫长的时间跨度内，且速度缓慢。本文认为，身体与有毒物质之间的这种微观接触最容易通过难以命名且更弥散的感官实践来感知。对通常不可感知的有毒暴露的理解，依赖于对体功能和大气中几乎不可察觉的变化的持续关注。微小的生化印痕最初看似毫无意义或令人困惑，但会在暴露者体内积累，并使他们重新转向空气的分子成分以及这些化学物质来源的室内基础设施。通过阐述这些微小的腐蚀性事件，受污染住宅的居民可以在时间和空间中积累身体和大气的微小变化，我称之为“化学崇高”，它将微弱的削弱性遭遇提升为引发伦理考量和潜在干预的事件。化学崇高是一种晚期工业体验，它颠覆了启蒙时代（但仍占主导）的崇高概念。本文跨过权威与受质疑的身体、伴侣物种与人类，提出疑问：弥散的感官实践以何种方式产生对化学世界的知识、关注和参与？

title: Cloaks and Veils: Countervisualizing Cigarette Factories In and Outside of China
abstract: In this article, I consider what a casual observer can see of a notorious product’s primary place of fabrication. Few products have been criticized in recent years more than cigarettes. Meanwhile, around the world, the factories manufacturing cigarettes rarely come under scrutiny. What have been the optics helping these key links in the cigarette supply chain to be overlooked? What has prompted such optics to be adopted and to what effect? I address these questions using a comparative approach and drawing upon new mapping techniques, fieldwork, and social theory. I argue that a corporate impulse to hide from public health measures, including those of tobacco control, is not the only force to be reckoned with here. Cigarette factory legibility has been coproduced by multiple processes inherent to many forms of manufacturing. Cigarette makers, moreover, do not always run from global tobacco control. Nor have they been avoiding all other manifestations of biopolitics. Rather, in various ways, cigarette makers have been embracing biopolitical logics, conditioning them, and even using them to manage factory legibility. Suggestive of maneuvers outlined by Butler (2009) and Povinelli (2011) such as “norms of recognizability” and “arts of disguise,” cigarette factory concealment foregrounds the role of infrastructural obfuscation in the making of what Berlant (2007) calls “slow death.” Special focus on manufacturing in China illustrates important variations in the public optics of cigarette factories. The terms cloak and veil connote these variations. Whereas tactics currently obscuring cigarette manufacturing facilities generally skew toward an aesthetic of the opaque cloak in much of the world, there are norms of recognizability and arts of disguise applied to many factories across China that are more akin to a diaphanous, playful veil. I conclude with a discussion of how this article’s focus on factory legibility gestures toward novel forms of intervention for advocates working at tackling tobacco today, offering them an alternative political imaginary in what is one of the world’s most important areas of public policy making.
title_zh: 斗篷与面纱：中国内外卷烟工厂的反视觉化
abstract_zh: 在本文中，我思考了一个偶然的观察者能够看到一种臭名昭著产品的主要制造场所的什么。近年来，很少有产品比香烟受到更多批评。与此同时，在世界各地，制造香烟的工厂很少受到审视。是什么光学手段使得香烟供应链中的这些关键环节被忽视？是什么促使采用这样的光学手段，又产生了什么效果？我采用比较方法，并利用新的绘图技术、田野调查和社会理论来探讨这些问题。我认为，企业逃避公共卫生措施（包括烟草控制）的冲动并不是这里唯一需要应对的力量。香烟工厂的可读性是由多种制造业固有的多重过程共同产生的。此外，香烟制造商并不总是逃避全球烟草控制。他们也没有回避生命政治的所有其他表现形式。相反，香烟制造商以各种方式接受生命政治逻辑，调节它们，甚至利用它们来管理工厂的可读性。暗示了巴特勒（2009）和波维内利（2011）概述的策略，如“可识别性规范”和“伪装艺术”，香烟工厂的隐蔽突显了基础设施模糊化在制造贝兰特（2007）所称的“缓慢死亡”中的作用。特别关注中国的制造业说明香烟工厂公共光学的重要差异。“斗篷”和“面纱”这两个术语暗示了这些差异。尽管目前模糊香烟制造设施的策略在世界大部分地区倾向于一种不透明的斗篷美学，但在中国各地许多工厂中应用的却是更像透明、嬉戏的面纱的可识别性规范和伪装艺术。最后，我讨论了本文对工厂可读性的关注如何为当今应对烟草的倡导者提供新颖的干预形式，为他们提供在这个世界上最重要的公共政策制定领域之一中的替代政治想象。

title: Practicing Tranquilidad: Domestic Technologies and Comfortable Homes in Southeastern Mexico
journal_name: Journal of Latin American and Caribbean Anthropology
abstract: Resumen Este artículo analiza cómo los mexicanos se manifiestan una ideología de la comodidad doméstica moderna—una ideología cuyo desarrollo hasta la fecha ha sido en su mayoría explorado con referencia a Gran Bretaña y Estados Unidos. Basado en la investigación etnográfica de la pequeña ciudad mexicana de Chetumal, en el sur de Quintana Roo, se argumenta que el concepto clave de la tranquilidad sustenta el montaje de casas que son cada vez más ricos en los aparatos electrónicos. Los televisores y acondicionadores de aire domésticos son tecnologías de trascendencia particular, cuya presencia en los hogares de las clases medias establecidas y emergentes posibilitan la materialización de hogares y vidas tranquilas. La economía y la historia de Chetumal ha creado una ciudad sumamente adecuada para construir una vida tranquila. Sin embargo, este ejemplo específico de las prácticas y experiencias de sus habitantes también nos ofrece información sobre un ideal nacional (cada vez más asequible) de la domesticidad en la clase media mexicana, y la función de las tecnologías domésticas en la realización de tal ideal.
title_zh: 实践宁静：墨西哥东南部家庭技术与舒适家居
abstract_zh: 摘要：本文分析了墨西哥人如何表达现代家庭舒适意识形态——这一意识形态的发展迄今为止主要在英美背景下探讨。基于对墨西哥南部金塔纳罗奥州小城切图马尔的民族志研究，本文认为关键概念“宁静”支撑了越来越多电子设备丰富的家庭组装。电视机和家用空调是特别具有超越意义的技术，它们在既有和新兴中产阶级家庭中的存在使得宁静的家庭和生活的实现成为可能。切图马尔的经济和历史创造了一个非常适合构建宁静生活的城市。然而，这一居民实践与经验的具体例子也让我们洞察到墨西哥中产阶级日益可得的国内生活理想，以及家庭技术在此理想实现中的作用。

title: Responsibility and neglect in global production networks: the uneven significance of codes of conduct in Indonesian factories
journal_name: GLOBAL NETWORKS-A JOURNAL OF TRANSNATIONAL AFFAIRS
abstract: Abstract In response to anti‐sweatshop activism, lead firms in global production networks (GPNs) have adopted voluntary corporate social responsibility commitments such as codes of conduct. Scholars have begun to examine whether and how these shape labour conditions at the point of production, but existing research either focuses on a small number of cases or lacks a control group of factories that are not exposed to codes of conduct. In addition, scholars have sometimes suggested that codes of conduct can only influence certain types of factory conditions, or that government labour inspection can accomplish as much or more than codes. These possibilities have rarely been assessed systematically. In this article, we analyse data on 192 electronics, apparel/textile and footwear factories in Indonesia and show how the significance of codes varies across issues. Our findings also suggest that codes and government labour inspection fill different niches, although neither guarantees decent factory conditions. The findings have implications for the study of ‘labour agency’ and the ‘complementarity’ of public and private governance in GPNs.
title_zh: 全球生产网络中的责任与忽视：行为准则在印尼工厂中的不均匀意义
abstract_zh: 摘要在反血汗工厂行动的压力下，全球生产网络中的主导企业已采纳自愿的企业社会责任承诺，如行为准则。学者们开始研究这些承诺是否以及在多大程度上影响了生产点的劳动条件，但现有研究要么聚焦于少数案例，要么缺乏未接触行为准则的工厂对照组。此外，学者们有时暗示行为准则只能影响某些类型的工厂条件，或者政府劳动监察能够达到与行为准则相同或更好的效果。这些可能性很少被系统评估。在本文中，我们分析了印度尼西亚192家电子、服装/纺织和鞋类工厂的数据，展示了行为准则的重要性如何因问题而异。我们的发现还表明，行为准则和政府劳动监察填补了不同的缺口，尽管两者都不能保证良好的工厂条件。这些发现对研究全球生产网络中的“劳动者能动性”以及公共治理与私人治理的“互补性”具有启示意义。

title: ‘Do you have a mobile?’ Mobile phone practices and the refashioning of social relationships in Port Vila Town
abstract: Mobile phones have quickly become an important part of young people's social relationships in Port Vila Vanuatu. In particular, young people embrace the new technology's capacity to broaden the breadth of their sociality. They use the mobile phone to facilitate private and secretive communication, engage in unsanctioned relationships, pre‐marital sexual relationships, and also multiple concurrent intimate relationships. Literature on mobile phone use often either takes the approach that mobile phone technology becomes purely incorporated into pre‐existing social practices, or that it dramatically reshapes social ontologies. The present article argues for an alternative view, one that takes into account the nuances between these two analytical poles. This article suggests that young people use the mobile phone in practices informed by previous models of social relationships, yet the specific materiality of the mobile phone technology is influencing the direction in which models of social relationships are changing. In demonstrating this point, I pay particular attention to two material aspects of the mobile phone technology ‐ the mobile phone as a repository of a particular kind of information ‐ ‘evidence’, and the capacity of the mobile phone to ‘disconnect’ people from their relationships by switching off the mobile. This article argues that these practices are influencing the emergence of a radically altered kinship and gender landscape in the urban context.
title_zh: “你有手机吗？”维拉港城镇中的手机实践与社会关系的重塑
abstract_zh: 手机迅速成为瓦努阿图维拉港年轻人社会关系的重要组成部分。年轻人尤其青睐这项新技术拓展其社会性广度的能力。他们利用手机进行私密和秘密的沟通，参与未经批准的关系、婚前性关系以及多重并发亲密关系。关于手机使用的文献通常采取两种观点：要么认为手机技术纯粹融入已有的社会实践中，要么认为它极大地重塑了社会本体论。本文主张一种替代性观点，即考虑到这两个分析极点之间的细微差别。文章提出，年轻人依据以往的社会关系模式进行手机实践，但手机技术的特定物质性正影响着社会关系模式变化的方向。为论证这一点，我特别关注手机技术的两个物质方面——手机作为特定信息（“证据”）的存储库，以及通过关机使人们与关系“断开”的能力。文章认为，这些实践正在推动城市背景下亲属关系和性别格局的急剧变化。

title: “Bring Joy to Your Home with the Real Frigidaire”: Advertising the Refrigerator to Belgian Female Consumers, 1955–1965
abstract: Advertisements provide a link between the symbolical, ideal, practical and informative notions of domesticity and technology and shed light on the material culture of the home and domesticity. In this article, I focus on the home as a material place where technological and consumerist trends develop, how these trends were linked to meanings of domesticity, and how they affected gendered identities, practices, labor, and ultimately tastes of home. I argue that in the normalization of the refrigerator, the promotion of a technology-based domestic life was not uniform in its meanings, entitlements, or strategies. First, the consumer was confronted not with uniformity but with a multitude of meanings, arguments and promises that came with the refrigerator. Second, gender roles and identities were less varied. Third, the hard sell–soft sell dichotomy did not prevail, and emotional or hedonistic appeals were often combined with directly spelled-out advantages. The refrigerator advertisements studied here appeared in a Belgian women's magazine between 1955 and 1965 and constructed family life and tastes of home around elevated standards of comfort, care, aesthetics, and choice, more so than around a scientific rationalization of household work and organization.
title_zh: “用真正的Frigidaire给您的家带来欢乐”：1955–1965年间向比利时女性消费者推销冰箱
abstract_zh: 广告连接了家庭生活与技术领域的象征性、理想性、实用性和信息性概念，并揭示了家庭与家庭生活的物质文化。在本文中，我聚焦于家庭作为一个物质场所，技术化和消费主义趋势在此发展，这些趋势如何与家庭生活的意义相关联，以及它们如何影响性别身份、实践、劳动，最终影响家庭品味。我认为，在冰箱的标准化过程中，基于技术的家庭生活的推广在意义、权利或策略上并非统一。首先，消费者面对的并不是一致性，而是冰箱所带来的多重意义、论点和承诺。其次，性别角色和身份的多样性较小。第三，硬销售与软销售的二分法并不占主导地位，情感或享乐诉求常常与直接阐明的优势相结合。本文研究的冰箱广告出现在1955年至1965年间的一本比利时女性杂志中，这些广告围绕舒适、关怀、美学和选择的更高标准构建家庭生活和家庭品味，而非围绕家庭工作和组织的科学理性化。
