title: Global production and local jobs: can global enterprise networks be used as levers for local development?

authors.name: Florence Palpacuer
institutions: Sewanee: The University of the South

journal_name: GLOBAL NETWORKS-A JOURNAL OF TRANSNATIONAL AFFAIRS
abstract: Abstract This article is developed out of a research project on ‘Global Production and Local Jobs’ launched by the International Institute for Labour Studies of the International Labour Organization (ILO). It identifies salient features of global production networks in the automobile, electronics and apparel industries, and discusses their implications for local industrial upgrading, jobs and development policy. The approach combines in novel forms complementary analytical frameworks such as the global value chain and industrial district perspectives, in order to highlight interactions between global and local forces in the operation of transnational production networks. Central issues revealed by this approach include: the rise of entry barriers into the most profitable, service‐intensive activities of global value chains, that reduce small firms' prospects for industrial upgrading; the uneven benefits derived from participation in global production networks at the local level; and the need for local institutions to devise policy responses through a flexible, network‐oriented approach involving a broad local constituency.
title_zh: 全球生产与地方就业：全球企业网络能否作为地方发展的杠杆？
abstract_zh: 本文源自国际劳工组织国际劳动研究所发起的一个研究项目“全球生产与地方就业”。它识别了汽车、电子和服装产业全球生产网络的显著特征，并讨论了它们对地方产业升级、就业和发展政策的影响。该方法以新颖的形式结合了互补的分析框架，如全球价值链和产业区视角，以突出跨国生产网络运作中全球和地方力量之间的互动。该方法揭示的核心问题包括：进入全球价值链中最有利可图、服务密集型活动门槛的提高，降低了小企业产业升级的前景；参与全球生产网络在地方层面带来的收益不均衡；以及地方机构需要通过灵活、网络导向的方法，涉及广泛的地方参与者来制定政策应对措施。

title: Wearable Technology Is the Wave of the Future: A Cornell Student Has Developed a "Smart Jacket" That Automatically Warms, Lights Up, and Monitors Heart Rate
title_zh: 可穿戴技术是未来潮流：康奈尔学生开发出能自动保暖、发光和监测心率的“智能夹克”

title: Reply to Walter
AI as pharmakon
abstract: Abstract In struggles for Indigenous sovereignty in Taiwan, artificial intelligence has emerged as a pharmakon—something that is both remedy and poison. This is evident in Taiwan's Trustworthy AI Dialogue Engine (TAIDE), a project that uses large language models to revitalize endangered Indigenous languages. Here, we can see the profoundly contradictory effects of AI as it enables cultural and political revitalization, thus contributing to Indigenous futurity, while intensifying the environmental degradation that forecloses that futurity. Expanding anthropological notions of authorship to encompass material world‐making, I draw on feminist and decolonial critiques to argue that debates on AI and authorship ought to encompass not only AI's textual production but also the way it underwrites extractive infrastructures and fragile futures. By holding these forces in the same analytical frame, this commentary challenges anthropologists to reckon with how AI simultaneously advances and undermines Indigenous sovereignty, troubling the purity of our categories.
title_zh: 人工智能作为药
abstract_zh: 在台湾原住民主权的斗争中，人工智能已成为一种“药”——既是解药也是毒药。这在台湾的“可信赖人工智能对话引擎”（TAIDE）项目中表现得很明显，该项目使用大型语言模型来振兴濒危原住民语言。在这里，我们可以看到人工智能深刻的矛盾效应：它促成了文化和政治复兴，从而为原住民的未来做出了贡献，同时加剧了环境退化，从而扼杀了这种未来。通过将人类学中的作者概念扩展为涵盖物质世界构建，我借鉴女性主义和去殖民批判，认为关于人工智能和作者的辩论不仅应涵盖人工智能的文本生产，还应涵盖其支撑采掘性基础设施和脆弱未来的方式。通过在同一分析框架中容纳这些力量，本文挑战人类学家去思考人工智能如何同时推进和破坏原住民主权，从而扰乱了我们对范畴的纯粹性理解。

title: Caterpillar's Spatial Metamorphosis: Heavy Equipment Manufacturing in the 21st Century
abstract: ABSTRACT Caterpillar Inc., the world's largest heavy equipment manufacturer, grew rapidly in the 20th century before a crisis of overproduction in the early 1980s threatened its survival. In response, it launched the $2.8 billion “Plant with a Future” (PWAF) program, a sweeping material and ideological overhaul that remade the firm for the post‐Fordist global economy. This article advances three interventions. First, it shows how post‐Fordism as a spatial and ideological project emphasized decentralization, accountability, and customer orientation, which helped legitimize and institutionalize corporate restructuring. Second, it demonstrates that flexibilization operated as a spatial strategy, implemented through four interrelated processes: bureaucratic restructuring, production reconfiguration, financialization, and vertical disintegration. Third, it argues that post‐Fordism was not a uniform paradigm, but a set of firm‐level projects interpreted and operationalized in distinct ways. By focusing on heavy machinery production—an overlooked but foundational sector for extractive and construction industries—the article shows how firm‐level transformations reverberate through the most environmentally consequential circuits of global capital.
title_zh: 卡特彼勒的空间变形：21世纪的重型设备制造
abstract_zh: 摘要 卡特彼勒公司，全球最大的重型设备制造商，在20世纪迅速增长，随后在1980年代初期的生产过剩危机威胁到其生存。作为回应，该公司启动了耗资28亿美元的“未来工厂”（PWAF）计划，这是一场全面的物质和意识形态改革，使公司为后福特主义全球经济重新塑造。本文提出了三项干预措施。首先，它展示了后福特主义作为空间和意识形态项目如何强调分权、问责制和客户导向，这有助于合法化和制度化企业重组。其次，它证明了灵活化作为一种空间策略，通过四个相互关联的过程实施：官僚重组、生产重构、金融化和垂直解体。第三，它认为后福特主义并非统一的范式，而是一系列以不同方式解释和运作的企业级项目。通过关注重型机械生产——一个被忽视但对采掘和建筑行业至关重要的基础部门——文章展示了企业层面的转型如何在全球资本最具环境影响的循环中产生回响。

title: Class Precarity, Latent Crisis and Caring Fathers
abstract: Abstract This article explores class precarity among male heavy industrial shopfloor workers in northern Vietnam. It brings Vietnamese understandings of crisis into a dialogue with the anthropology of crisis, arguing a crisis framework offers a helpful analytical entry to exploring gendered class precarity. Striving to provide quality healthcare and education for their children in Vietnam's ‘socialist-oriented market economy’, men working in global industry are reconceptualising stereotypical images of the masculine male factory worker and the role of fathers. As they aspire to become part of Vietnam's affluent middle class, low-income workers muster resilience to mitigate and cope with enduring financial challenges. Any added crisis not only fuels but also exacerbates an economic ‘latent crisis’ underpinning daily life, like a smouldering ember that could ignite at any time. Résumé Cet article explore la précarité de classe parmi les ouvriers de l'industrie lourd au Vietnam du nord. Nous mettons les connaissances vietnamiennes de crise en dialogue avec l'anthropologie de crise, et nous arguons qu'un cadre de crise offre une entrée analytique utile pour l'exploration de la précarité de classe genrée. En s'efforçant de fournir les soins et l’éducation de qualité pour leurs enfants dans ‘l’économie de marché orientée vers le socialisme’ au Vietnam, les ouvriers qui travaillent dans l'industrie mondiale sont en train de reconceptualiser les images stéréotypiques de l'ouvrier masculin à l'usine et le rôle des pères. Au fur et à mesure qu'ils aspirent de devenir membres de la haute bourgeoisie vietnamienne, les ouvriers pauvres activent la résilience afin de mitiger et de supporter les défis financiers pérennes. Toute crise supplémentaire alimente et aggrave une ‘crise latente’ économique dans la vie de tous les jours, comme des braises qui puissent s'enflammer à n'importe quel moment.
title_zh: 阶级不稳定、潜在危机与关爱型父亲
abstract_zh: 本文探讨越南北部重工业车间男性工人的阶级不稳定性。它将越南对危机的理解与危机人类学进行对话，认为危机框架为探索性别化的阶级不稳定性提供了有用的分析切入点。在越南的“社会主义导向市场经济”中，男性工人努力为子女提供优质医疗和教育，他们正在重新构造成人男性工厂工人和父亲角色的刻板印象。随着他们渴望成为越南富裕中产阶级的一部分，低收入工人调动韧性来缓解和应对持续的财务挑战。任何额外的危机不仅会加剧而且会恶化支撑日常生活的经济“潜在危机”，就像随时可能点燃的阴燃余烬。

title: Coal’s end
journal_name: Focaal-Journal of Global and Historical Anthropology
abstract: For more than a century, coal was central to the configuration of political relationships between citizens and the state in Asturias, Spain. However, since the 2010s, EU-wide energy transition policies have brought about the end of what was once a strategic coal enclave in northern Spain’s mining basins. Coal’s end has devalued the product and producers of coal and weakened tightly embedded networks of unions, political parties, and workers. Yet, while policy shifts have destroyed Spanish coal production, they have also repurposed coal infrastructure for the distribution of imported coal. This article analyzes the shifting claims, demands, and responsibilities that coal gave rise to and shows how the demise of coal citizenship has led to gendered, generational, and xenophobic fractures. It argues that, as the transition advances, mining ruins and discarded workforces are resignified within novel projects of political belonging, thus giving rise to new forms of energy citizenship.
title_zh: 煤炭的终结
abstract_zh: 一个多世纪以来，煤炭一直是西班牙阿斯图里亚斯地区公民与国家之间政治关系配置的核心。然而，自2010年代以来，欧盟范围内的能源转型政策结束了这个曾经是西班牙北部矿区战略煤炭飞地的历史。煤炭的终结使煤炭产品和生产者贬值，并削弱了工会、政党和工人紧密嵌入的网络。然而，尽管政策转变摧毁了西班牙的煤炭生产，但它们也重新利用了煤炭基础设施来分销进口煤炭。本文分析了煤炭引发的变化中的诉求、需求和责任，并展示了煤炭公民身份的消亡如何导致性别、代际和仇外分裂。文章认为，随着转型的推进，采矿废墟和废弃的劳动力在新的政治归属项目中被重新定义，从而产生了新的能源公民身份形式。

title: Corporate Futures, Energy Transition, and Natural Prosthetics in Colombia’s Cesar Mining Corridor
abstract: This essay examines the socioecological transformations of mining and post-mining landscapes in the mining corridor of the Cesar Department, northern Colombia. When an open pit mine is about to close or has recently closed, companies promote post-mining strategies framed as ecosystem restoration and social compensation. Yet daily practices reveal a contrasting reality: confinement, land and water grabbing, pollution, disregard for legal rulings, and large-scale ecological disruption. Drawing on ethnographic research conducted since 2018, I discuss how landscapes shaped by these specific forms of capitalist extraction configure transformed, fragmented, and reconstituted forms of nature suitable for future forms of extractive value production through rehabilitated yet toxic ecologies, agro-industrial projects, and energy transition initiatives. These processes generate prosthetic landscapes and ecologies where nature is simultaneously restored and destroyed. I argue that corporate narratives of restoration, responsibility, and compensation function as mirages, obscuring violent corporate practices while legitimizing emerging regimes of energy extractivism. Resumen Este ensayo analiza las transformaciones socioecológicas de los paisajes mineros y posmineros en el corredor minero del departamento del Cesar, en el norte de Colombia. Cuando una mina a cielo abierto está a punto de cerrarse o ha cerrado recientemente, las empresas implementan estrategias posmineras presentadas como restauración ecológica y compensación social. Sin embargo, las prácticas cotidianas muestran una realidad distinta: confinamiento, acaparamiento de tierras y aguas, contaminación, desconocimiento de fallos judiciales y una profunda alteración ecológica. A partir de una investigación etnográfica realizada desde 2018, examino cómo los paisajes configurados por estas formas específicas de extracción capitalista producen naturalezas transformadas, fragmentadas y reconstituídas, adecuadas para nuevas formas de producción de valor extractivo mediante ecologías rehabilitadas pero tóxicas, proyectos agroindustriales e iniciativas de transición energética. Estos procesos generan paisajes y ecologías prostéticas en los que la naturaleza es restaurada y destruida simultáneamente. Sostengo que las narrativas corporativas de restauración, responsabilidad y compensación funcionan como espejismos, al ocultar prácticas violentas y legitimar regímenes emergentes de extractivismo energético.
title_zh: 哥伦比亚塞萨尔矿业走廊的企业未来、能源转型与自然假体
abstract_zh: 本文考察了哥伦比亚北部塞萨尔省矿业走廊中采矿和采矿后景观的社会生态转型。当露天矿即将关闭或最近关闭时，企业会推广以生态系统恢复和社会补偿为框架的采矿后战略。然而，日常实践揭示了一个截然不同的现实：禁闭、土地和水资源掠夺、污染、无视法律裁决以及大规模的生态破坏。基于自2018年以来进行的民族志研究，我讨论了由这些特定形式的资本主义开采所塑造的景观如何通过修复但有毒的生态、农业工业项目和能源转型倡议，配置出适合未来形式开采价值生产的转变、碎片化和重组形式的自然。这些过程产生了假体景观和生态，其中自然同时被恢复和破坏。我认为，关于恢复、责任和补偿的企业叙事如同海市蜃楼，掩盖了暴力的企业实践，同时合法化了新兴的能源开采主义体制。Resumen Este ensayo analiza las transformaciones socioecológicas de los paisajes mineros y posmineros en el corredor minero del departamento del Cesar, en el norte de Colombia. Cuando una mina a cielo abierto está a punto de cerrarse o ha cerrado recientemente, las empresas implementan estrategias posmineras presentadas como restauración ecológica y compensación social. Sin embargo, las prácticas cotidianas muestran una realidad distinta: confinamiento, acaparamiento de tierras y aguas, contaminación, desconocimiento de fallos judiciales y una profunda alteración ecológica. A partir de una investigación etnográfica realizada desde 2018, examino cómo los paisajes configurados por estas formas específicas de extracción capitalista producen naturalezas transformadas, fragmentadas y reconstituídas, adecuadas para nuevas formas de producción de valor extractivo mediante ecologías rehabilitadas pero tóxicas, proyectos agroindustriales e iniciativas de transición energética. Estos procesos generan paisajes y ecologías prostéticas en los que la naturaleza es restaurada y destruida simultáneamente. Sostengo que las narrativas corporativas de restauración, responsabilidad y compensación funcionan como espejismos, al ocultar prácticas violentas y legitimar regímenes emergentes de extractivismo energético.

title: Custodians of Controversy: Navigating Stewardship Challenges With Non‐Consensual Anatomized Human Skeletonized Individuals in South Africa
abstract: South Africa, like many countries, holds collections of human skeletonized individuals historically acquired through anatomical dissection programs. This paper examines non-consensual anatomized and unclaimed (NCAU) state-directed skeletonized individuals, whose presence in collections pose significant legal, ethical, and professional challenges. Although the National Health Act (2003) outlines procedures for body donation, the inclusion of unclaimed and destitute persons obtained without consent raises ethical concerns. As curators and custodians, a perspective is provided, assessing the legal and ethical implications of retaining NCAU skeletonized individuals and highlighting inconsistencies between South African regulations and international standards that prioritize informed consent and dignity-in-death. The complexities surrounding the retention, use, or disposition of these decedent bodies, and parts thereof, are discussed, offering recommendations for institutional decision-making to navigate these complexities. A structured and multidisciplinary approach is provided we advocate for transparent and ethically responsible stewardship of NCAU collections. Furthermore, the pressure placed on curators is noted, who face potential personal and professional repercussions, and emphasizes the need for institutional support, training, and resources to guide ethical management and facilitate informed decision-making of these sensitive collections.
title_zh: 争议的守护者：南非非自愿解剖人体骨骼标本的保管挑战
abstract_zh: 南非与许多国家一样，收藏有历史上通过解剖项目获得的人体骨骼标本。本文考察了非自愿解剖和无人认领（NCAU）的国家主导的骨骼标本，这些标本在收藏中的存在带来了重大的法律、伦理和专业挑战。尽管《国家卫生法》（2003年）规定了遗体捐献的程序，但未经同意获得的无人认领和贫困个体引发了伦理问题。作为策展人和保管人，本文提供了一种视角，评估了保留NCAU骨骼标本的法律和伦理影响，并指出了南非法规与国际标准之间在优先考虑知情同意和死亡尊严方面的不一致。讨论了保留、使用或处置这些遗体及其部分的复杂性，为机构决策提供了应对这些复杂性的建议。我们提供了一种结构化的多学科方法，倡导对NCAU收藏进行透明和负责任的伦理管理。此外，指出了策展人面临的压力，他们可能面临个人和职业后果，并强调了机构支持、培训和资源的必要性，以指导伦理管理和促进对这些敏感收藏的知情决策。

title: Dust inside: Fighting and living with asbestos‐related disasters in Brazil By AgataMazzeo, New York: Berghahn Books. 2020. 202 pp.

authors.name: David Löher
institutions: Lucerne University of Applied Sciences and Arts

abstract: Industrial disasters often unfold silently and remain hidden from public attention.Events such as the Bhopal (India) disaster in 1984 or the Seveso (Italy) disaster in 1976 represent exceptions, where industrial catastrophes became visible and spectacular.The long-term consequences of industrial asbestos production on public health and environment belong to the first category of disasters; slow, creeping, and dispersed across decades.Agata Mazzeo's book Dust Inside.Fighting and Living with Asbestos-Related Disasters in Brazil studies these long-term effects, tracing the human, social, and political afterlives of industrial asbestos production in Osasco (Brazil).Once widely used in construction and other industries until it was banned in most industrialized countries in the 1990s, asbestos fibers are highly carcinogenic and responsible for various cancers; primarily mesothelioma and asbestosis.As asbestos-related diseases typically have latency periods of several decades, asbestos production continues to claim its tolls among those exposed to it.Osasco is an industrial town of 700'000 inhabitants at the outskirts of So Paolo, where thousands of workers were exposed to the asbestos fiber between 1941 and 1993 in one of the biggest asbestoscement factories in Latin America.Originally, most of these workers are from Brazil's rural areas.Dust Inside narrates the ethnographer's encounters with retired workers, anti-asbestos-activists, and their family members.Through interviews, it reconstructs local experiences of living with the embodied deadly legacy and studies health-based grassroot anti-asbestos activism.It explores how the community continues to live with the toxic legacy, decades after asbestos production ceased and the company disappeared.Through the narratives of her interlocutors, Mazzeo explores how toxic exposure becomes part of bodily experience and collective identity.The book revolves around the central question of how people come to inhabit a world where the effects of industrial pollution remain invisible yet constantly present.Mazzeo employs the notion of absence-presence to articulate how disappearance-absence through death-itself becomes the condition through which the enduring and latent reality of the industrial disaster attains visibility and meaning.As such, death, loss, and mourning exceed the realm of the personal and reveal their inherently political dimension.
title_zh: 内部尘埃：在巴西与石棉相关灾害的斗争和生活
abstract_zh: 工业灾难往往悄无声息地展开，并隐藏在公众视线之外。1984年印度博帕尔灾难或1976年意大利塞维索灾难等事件属于例外，这些工业灾难变得可见且引人注目。石棉工业生产的长期后果对公共健康和环境的影响属于第一类灾难：缓慢、蔓延且分散在数十年间。Agata Mazzeo的著作《内部尘埃：在巴西与石棉相关灾害的斗争和生活》研究了这些长期影响，追溯了巴西奥萨斯科工业石棉生产的人类、社会和政治后遗症。石棉纤维曾广泛用于建筑和其他行业，直到20世纪90年代大多数工业化国家禁止使用，它具有高度致癌性，是导致多种癌症（主要是间皮瘤和石棉肺）的元凶。由于石棉相关疾病通常有几十年的潜伏期，石棉生产仍在继续危害接触者。奥萨斯科是圣保罗郊区一个拥有70万居民的工业城镇，1941年至1993年间，数千名工人在拉丁美洲最大的石棉水泥厂之一接触了石棉纤维。最初，这些工人大多来自巴西农村。《内部尘埃》讲述了这位民族志学者与退休工人、反石棉活动家及其家人的相遇。通过访谈，它重构了当地人在与致命遗产共处的经历，并研究了基于健康的草根反石棉行动主义。它探讨了在石棉生产停止、公司消失数十年后，社区如何继续与毒害遗产共存。通过对话者的叙述，Mazzeo探讨了有毒暴露如何成为身体经验和集体身份的一部分。该书围绕一个核心问题展开：人们如何栖居在一个工业污染的影响无形却持续存在的世界？Mazzeo运用“缺席-在场”的概念来阐述消失-缺席（通过死亡）本身如何成为条件，使工业灾难的持久和潜在现实变得可见且有意义。因此，死亡、丧失和哀悼超越了个人领域，揭示了其固有的政治维度。

title: Extracting the future: Lithium in an era of energy transition By MarkGoodale. Oakland: University of California Press, 2025. 304 pp.
title_zh: 开采未来：能源转型时代的锂

title: Finding One's Footing: Hidden Abodes of Production in the Global Running Economy
abstract: ABSTRACT This article is part of the special issue ‘Racialization and The Gig Economy’ (AWR July 2026; 47(1)) edited by Shreya Subramani and Christien Tompkins. This article examines how Ethiopian women distance runners labor within—and reveal the contradictions of—the global running economy. Drawing on multi‐sited ethnographic research in Ethiopia, Europe, and the United States, I analyze how athletes navigate two intertwined value circuits: the mass consumer markets of the Global North, where running shoes become lucrative lifestyle commodities, and the elite competitive circuit, where a small number of East African athletes generate the spectacular performances that confer value on those commodities. Through attention to everyday struggles over access to “super shoes,” contract negotiations, prize structures, and the social life of footwear, I show how Ethiopian athletes' labor forms a hidden abode of production that is indispensable yet structurally obscured. Racialized discourses of “marketability,” gendered hierarchies of visibility, and the fetishization of African “natural ability” shape how value is extracted from athletes while limiting their ability to realize it as income, mobility, or security. By centering women's critiques, misapprehensions, and aspirations, the article demonstrates how gig‐like athletic labor in the transnational running economy is simultaneously empowering and precarious, illuminating broader dynamics of racial capitalism, technological change, and global inequality.
title_zh: 寻找立足之地：全球跑步经济中的隐藏生产领域
abstract_zh: 本文是特刊“种族化与零工经济”的一部分。文章考察了埃塞俄比亚女性长跑运动员如何在全球跑步经济中劳动，并揭示了其中的矛盾。基于在埃塞俄比亚、欧洲和美国的多点民族志研究，我分析了运动员如何驾驭两个相互交织的价值回路：全球北方的大众消费市场（跑鞋成为利润丰厚的生活方式商品）和精英竞技回路（少数东非运动员创造出赋予这些商品价值的壮观表现）。通过关注围绕“超级跑鞋”获取、合同谈判、奖金结构以及鞋类社会生活的日常斗争，我展示了埃塞俄比亚运动员的劳动如何构成一个不可或缺但在结构上被遮蔽的隐藏生产领域。关于“市场性”的种族化话语、性别化的可见性等级以及对非洲“自然能力”的物化，塑造了从运动员身上提取价值的方式，同时限制了他们将其转化为收入、流动性或安全的能力。通过聚焦女性的批判、误解和渴望，文章展示了跨国跑步经济中类似零工的运动劳动如何既是赋权的又是 precarious 的，揭示了种族资本主义、技术变革和全球不平等的更广泛动态。

title: Inclusion, exploitation or unfair advantage? The ambiguities of community participation in a South African special economic zone
abstract: Abstract This article examines the contradictory terms of ‘inclusion’ in market-led development through an ethnographic study of the Atlantis Special Economic Zone (SEZ) on the periphery of Cape Town, South Africa. Drawing on twelve months of fieldwork and over seventy interviews with zone officials, elected community representatives and residents, it traces how unemployed people are mobilized as ‘representatives’ in the SEZ’s community participation programme, which is meant to evidence the zone’s social licence to operate while providing little remuneration. Officials frame participation as shared value and market inclusion; participants experience it as unpaid labour and reputational risk; and residents often interpret it as an unfair channel to insider advantage. In a peripheral setting marked by chronic unemployment and long-delayed investment, these competing framings show how programmes promising inclusion demand new forms of labour – moral, affective and material work through which people seek recognition, belonging and livelihoods – yet often incur social and economic losses. Building on Africa-focused debates about market inclusion as adverse incorporation, and on the anthropology of volunteering, the article argues that contemporary inclusionary projects depend on the unwaged efforts of the poor and reproduce new forms of precarity – even as they sustain the fiction of the ‘inclusivity’ of markets on the continent.
title_zh: 包容、剥削还是不公平优势？南非特别经济区社区参与的模糊性
abstract_zh: 本文通过对开普敦周边亚特兰蒂斯特别经济区的民族志研究，审视了市场导向发展中“包容”的矛盾条件。基于12个月的田野调查和对园区官员、当选社区代表及居民的70多次访谈，本文追踪了失业人员如何被动员为特别经济区社区参与项目中的“代表”，该项目旨在证明园区的社会运营许可，但提供的报酬微薄。官员将参与视为共享价值和市场包容；参与者将其体验为无薪劳动和声誉风险；居民则常将其解读为不公平的内部优势渠道。在长期失业和投资长期拖延的边缘地带，这些相互竞争的框架表明，承诺包容的项目要求新的劳动形式——人们通过道德、情感和物质工作寻求认可、归属和生计——却常常招致社会和经济损失。本文借鉴非洲关于市场包容作为不利融入的讨论以及志愿工作人类学，认为当代包容项目依赖于穷人的无薪努力，并再生产新的不稳定形式——即使它们维持了非洲大陆市场“包容性”的假象。

title: Living with industrial glue by being sanay in a small‐scale shoemaking community in Marikina city, the Philippines
abstract: Dolores St. is an alley in Marikina City, the Philippines, where a small-scale pagawaan (shoemaking workshop) continues to stand among residential buildings and provides informal employment to its neighbors. Here, the shoemakers and other residents have a complex relationship with shoemaking, an industry embedded in their community for over a century. They are sanay (habituated) to toxic industrial glue. This paper offers perspectives into peoples' understanding and experiences of harm and health through participant observation, interviews, and focus group discussions, revealing how being sanay to the pandikit (industrial glue) is embodied and is an active process through how shoemakers sense, know, and act in response to living with chemicals.
title_zh: 在菲律宾马里基纳市小规模制鞋社区中通过成为“sanay”来适应工业胶水
abstract_zh: 多洛雷斯街是菲律宾马里基纳市的一条小巷，这里的一个小型pagawaan（制鞋作坊）仍然矗立在住宅楼之间，为附近的居民提供非正式就业。在这里，制鞋工人和其他居民与制鞋业有着复杂的关系，制鞋业已融入他们的社区一个多世纪。他们sanay（习惯）于有毒的工业胶水。本文通过参与观察、访谈和焦点小组讨论，提供了人们对伤害和健康的理解和体验的视角，揭示了制鞋工人如何通过感知、认识和行动来应对与化学品共存的生活，从而体现sanay于pandikit（工业胶水）的过程。

title: Modulaciones etnotécnicas: patrimonialización, extractivismo minero y economía política del pasado en el salar de Atacama (norte de Chile)
journal_name: Journal of Latin American and Caribbean Anthropology
abstract: ABSTRACT This article examines how Indigenous Atacameño Communities mobilize the past as a political and economic resource amid lithium extraction in northern Chile. Based on ethnographic research in the Salar de Atacama basin, as well as archival work on regional archaeology, it develops the concept of ethnotechnical modulation to describe how archaeological knowledge, heritage discourses, and narratives of deep historical continuity are articulated with contemporary Indigenous politics and extractive economies. Over the past decades, narratives of millennia‐long occupation of the desert—largely produced through archaeological research and museum practices—have become central to Atacameño territorial claims. Community leaders mobilize these historical narratives in negotiations with the Chilean state and lithium companies, particularly in agreements that channel financial transfers to Atacameño communities. These arrangements should not be understood simply as heritage politics or corporate compensation, but as a form of modulation of the past that articulates an Atacameño position at the limits of the state and its extractive political economy, one that is neither fully captured by governance nor adequately described as resistance.
title_zh: 民族技术调制：阿塔卡马盐沼（智利北部）的遗产化、采矿业与过去的政治经济学
abstract_zh: 摘要 本文考察了智利北部锂矿开采背景下，土著阿塔卡梅尼奥社区如何将过去作为政治和经济资源加以动员。基于在阿塔卡马盐沼盆地的民族志研究以及对区域考古学的档案工作，本文提出了“民族技术调制”的概念，用以描述考古学知识、遗产话语和深层历史连续性的叙事如何与当代土著政治和采掘经济相互关联。过去几十年来，主要通过考古研究和博物馆实践产生的关于沙漠千年居住的叙事已成为阿塔卡梅尼奥领土主张的核心。社区领袖在与智利国家和锂业公司的谈判中动员这些历史叙事，尤其是在推动向阿塔卡梅尼奥社区进行财政转移的协议中。这些安排不应仅仅被理解为遗产政治或企业补偿，而应被视为一种对过去的调制，它在国家及其采掘政治经济的极限处表达了阿塔卡梅尼奥的立场——既不完全被治理所捕获，也不足以被描述为抵抗。

title: Nuestra casa comienza en Chacao: ecoautoridades, burocracia y transición energética en torno a una carretera eléctrica en Chiloé, Chile
journal_name: Journal of Latin American and Caribbean Anthropology
abstract: ABSTRACT Latin America has experienced an increase in environmental conflicts related to the development of non‐conventional renewable energy sources. The result of militant research, this article analyzes the political mobilization of a group of people on Chiloé’s largest island in response to the environmental evaluation process of a transmission line in 2020. My interlocutors' points of disagreement with the project lie, on the one hand, in the realization of citizen participation processes under adverse sanitary conditions in the context of the pandemic. On the other hand, they are related to previous experiences with the impacts of electricity‐related infrastructure in other parts of Chiloé. I describe the opposing notions of anthropocenic ecoauthority pushed by both my interlocutors and state institutions. While the state institutions took a productivist perspective, focusing on the urgency of economic reactivation to address the impacts of the pandemic and the need to accelerate the construction of transmission infrastructure for decarbonization, my interlocutors' communication campaign argued for the politicization of energy and its broader impacts on the territory. Both perspectives are situated within the long history of the Chiloé archipelago as an internal frontier in relation to Chile.
title_zh: 我们的家始于查考：智利奇洛埃电力线路引发的生态权威、官僚主义与能源转型
abstract_zh: 摘要：拉丁美洲经历了许多与非传统可再生能源发展相关的环境冲突。作为激进行动研究的结果，本文分析了2020年奇洛埃最大岛屿上一群人对一条输电线路环境评估进程的政治动员。我的对话者对该项目的异议点在于，一方面是在疫情背景下不利的卫生条件下进行的公民参与过程，另一方面是与之前奇洛埃其他地区电力基础设施影响的经验有关。我描述了由我的对话者和国家机构推动的对人类世生态权威的相反概念。国家机构采取生产主义视角，关注经济复苏的紧迫性以应对疫情的影响，以及加速建设输电基础设施以实现脱碳的需要，而我的对话者的宣传运动则主张将能源政治化及其对领土的更广泛影响。这两种观点都置于奇洛埃群岛作为智利内部边疆的长期历史背景中。

title: Postfossil extractivism. A new lens on decarbonization's land and material intensity
abstract: The policies currently driving decarbonization generate additional demands for raw materials such as lithium, copper, rare earths, and biomass while also requiring huge amounts of energy. Since energy is to be generated predominantly or exclusively from renewable sources, and because renewables have a much lower energy density than coal or oil, decarbonization is accompanied by an immense demand for land and the transformation of rural landscapes. This article proposes a post-fossil lens on extractivism to grasp the contested and contradictory character of the ongoing transformation, which is expected to increase the valuation of territories in the Global South.
title_zh: 后化石开采主义：去碳化的土地与物质强度的新视角
abstract_zh: 当前推动去碳化的政策对锂、铜、稀土和生物质等原材料产生了额外需求，同时也需要大量能源。由于能源将主要或完全来自可再生能源，且可再生能源的能量密度远低于煤炭或石油，因此去碳化伴随着对土地的巨大需求以及农村景观的转变。本文提出一个后化石开采主义的视角来理解正在进行的转型的矛盾和争议特征，这一转型预计将增加全球南方地区的领土价值。

title: Scrap value: finders and keepers in Kenya’s scrap metal recovery chain
abstract: Scrap metal collecting in Nairobi spans the city both spatially and in terms of social class, linking precarious scrap pickers to some of the city's wealthiest elite. Processes of sorting and amassing scrap metal allow it to pass stepwise along a "recovery chain” from small, to medium, to large dealers. Through this work, scrap metal shifts from small, heterogenous (scrappy) collections of remainders in the initial stages of collection to large, homogenized accumulations of materials. Its value shifts accordingly, growing in price and perceived quality as it goes up the chain and transforms from indeterminate remainder to commodity. This shift reinforces a classed distinction between finders and accumulators: the largest dealers in the recovery chain accumulate the most while the roadside gatherers, who actually find scrap, don't accumulate at all. The vulnerability of those gatherers and the small dealers who buy from them is exacerbated by the trade's criminalization. Aggressive policing of scrap gatherers and small dealers encourages intentional opacity around the source of scrap, while scalar thresholds work to insulate the different scales from each other: large-scale scrap dealers don't know, and don't really want to know, where or how the smaller dealers and finders do their work. I argue that criminalization and scalar thresholds work to preserve and naturalize these hierarchies of accumulation, allowing scrap to move while keeping labor in its place.
title_zh: 废品价值：肯尼亚废金属回收链中的发现者与持有者
abstract_zh: 内罗比的废金属收集在空间和社会阶层上遍及全城，将不稳定的废品拾荒者与城市中最富有的精英联系起来。废金属的分拣和积累过程使其沿着一条“回收链”从小型、中型到大型经销商逐步传递。通过这项工作，废金属从收集初期的小规模、异质性（零碎）的剩余物集合转变为大规模、同质化的材料积累。其价值也随之变化，随着链条上升，价格和感知质量增加，并从不确定的剩余物转变为商品。这种转变强化了发现者与积累者之间的阶级区分：回收链中最大的经销商积累最多，而实际上发现废品的路边拾荒者却毫无积累。这些拾荒者和向他们购买的小经销商的脆弱性因贸易的刑事化而加剧。对废品拾荒者和小经销商的激进警务促使人们故意隐瞒废品来源，而规模阈值则有助于不同规模相互隔离：大型废品经销商不知道，也不太想知道小经销商和发现者在哪里或如何工作。我认为刑事化和规模阈值有助于维持并自然化这些积累的等级制度，使废品得以流动，同时将劳动限制在其位置。

title: Self-Sewn Clothing in Socialist Yugoslavia
journal_name: Etnoantropoloski Problemi-Issues in Ethnology and Anthropology
abstract: The paper examines the practice of self-sewn clothing in socialist Yugoslavia (1945-1991) in order to determine the conditions that enabled it, the extent of its spread, and the social strata where it was common. The spread of self-sewing practice was influenced by several factors: the availability of Bagat and other sewing machines; tailoring and sewing courses; the selling of Burda magazine with practical instructions on how to make fashion pieces using cutting sheets; the circulation of other domestic and foreign fashion magazines; the publication of Burda: Perfect Independent Tailoring and Sewing; an effort to improve the quality of the yardage, patterns and color spectrum produced by the Yugoslav textile industry; and the increased import of foreign fabrics. A change in attitude towards fashion also played a significant role. Following the Second World War, fashion was seen as a bourgeois practice in socialist Yugoslavia, but since the beginning of the 1950s, following fashion through self-sewn clothing regained social desirability. Unsatisfactory clothing offers in Yugoslav stores such as poor quality, limited colors and designs, inadequate ready-made sizes, and high prices, also led to the prevalence of this practice, as did the opportunities to earn income by sewing for others. The most common way of acquiring clothing was to purchase garments produced in Yugoslavia, with self-sewing as the second most frequent method. Workers and middle-class members were engaged in self-sewing most extensively, as it enabled access to clothing at lower costs and contributed to leading a lifestyle determined by social status and the resulting material position, thus functioning as a form of creative everyday activity of the ordinary people. Self-sewing represented subordinates’ art of coping with the available by creating their own popular culture using the resources, goods and materials given to them by the ruling system in socialist Yugoslavia.
title_zh: 南斯拉夫社会主义时期的自制服装
abstract_zh: 本文考察了南斯拉夫社会主义时期（1945-1991年）的自制服装实践，以确定其实现条件、普及程度及常见社会阶层。自制实践的推广受多种因素影响：Bagat及其他缝纫机的可得性；裁剪与缝纫课程；销售带有裁剪图样制作时装的Burda杂志；其他国内外时尚杂志的流通；出版《Burda：完美的独立裁剪与缝纫》；提升南斯拉夫纺织工业生产的布料、图案和色彩谱系质量；以及外国织物的进口增加。对时尚态度的转变也发挥了重要作用。二战后，时尚在南斯拉夫社会主义体系中被视为资产阶级行为，但自1950年代初起，通过自制服装追随时尚重新获得了社会认可。南斯拉夫商店中服装供应不足——如质量差、颜色和款式有限、成衣尺寸不合身以及价格高昂——也推动了这种实践的盛行，同时为他人缝制以赚取收入的机会也起到了作用。最常见的获取服装方式是购买南斯拉夫生产的成衣，自制服装是第二常见的方式。工人和中产阶级成员是自制服装的主要参与者，因为这使他们能够以较低成本获得服装，并有助于维持由社会地位及其物质条件决定的生活方式，从而成为一种普通人的创造性日常活动。自制服装代表了从属者利用社会主义南斯拉夫统治体系提供的资源、商品和材料，创造自身流行文化的应对艺术。

title: Social Media Warfare: Monetization and Materiality in the Ukrainian Armed Forces Since February 24, 2022
abstract: Throughout history, combatants in many conflicts have received support from families, diaspora communities, and sympathetic strangers worldwide. These combatants have also sought to increase that support by writing letters, sending photographs, or doing speaking tours. Today, however, both the methodology and the impact of encouraging support are different. This paper will use ethnographic interviews with both former and currently serving members of the Ukrainian Armed Forces to explore two inexorably linked developments in this space. Firstly, it will analyze the ever-expanding role of social media in this conflict. Secondly, it will explore the “feedback loop” wherein military units undertake combat operations that generate desirable social media content that can be monetized to support operations, both to make good their losses incurred during the events now being monetized, and to prove that donations are being well-used, thus simultaneously creating the expectation for future material on the basis of continued support.
title_zh: 社交媒体战争：2022年2月24日以来乌克兰武装部队的货币化与物质性
abstract_zh: 纵观历史，许多冲突中的战斗人员都得到了家人、散居社群和世界各地同情他们的陌生人的支持。这些战斗人员也通过写信、寄送照片或进行巡回演讲等方式寻求增加这种支持。然而，如今鼓励支持的方法和影响都不同了。本文将通过民族志访谈，采访前乌克兰武装部队成员和现役成员，探讨这一领域中两个不可分割的发展。首先，它将分析社交媒体在这场冲突中日益扩大的作用。其次，它将探讨“反馈循环”：军事单位执行战斗行动，生成可货币化的社交媒体内容以支持行动，既能弥补在现在被货币化的事件中遭受的损失，又能证明捐款被妥善使用，从而在持续支持的基础上同时创造对未来素材的期望。

title: Spiraling out in the Circular Economy: Movement and Belonging at a Malaysian Rare Earth Elements Refinery
journal_name: COMPARATIVE STUDIES IN SOCIETY AND HISTORY
abstract: Abstract The rise of “circular economy” discourse in the extractive industries has altered how researchers, laborers, activists, and consumers conceptualize movements of materials. To proponents, building a circular economy around rare earth elements (REE) production will “close the loop” around extraction, processing, design, manufacturing, and disposal practices to minimize and eventually eliminate all “waste” produced through technology development. Articulated through utopian imaginaries projecting environmental and technological futures far beyond mining, however, these conceptualizations of movement also carry far-ranging entailments for the movements of specific groups of people, including their place in future social and political orders and their capacity to plan for multi-generational futures. This article follows activists and university researchers brought into conflict through a REE processing facility in Malaysia, where research on commercial applications for post-processing wastes has been treated alternately as pathways to economic diversification and as threats to minoritized communities’ welfare and senses of national belonging. Both groups correlate “responsible” waste management to mismanaged flows of people: prospective experts drawn overseas for more sophisticated work; children emigrating for university education or middle-class jobs after struggling to find positions in Malaysia. While explicitly offering future stability and a broadened ethics of responsible attention, the visions of circularity undergirding these debates effectively collapse the many forms of movement at stake in industrial transition into a promise of transcendence, obscuring the racialized patterns of exclusion and migration that invariably accompany the extractive industries.
title_zh: 在循环经济中螺旋上升：马来西亚稀土精炼厂中的流动与归属
abstract_zh: 采掘业中“循环经济”话语的兴起改变了研究人员、劳动者、活动家和消费者对物质流动的构想方式。对于支持者来说，围绕稀土元素生产构建循环经济将“闭合”开采、加工、设计、制造和处置实践的循环，以最小化并最终消除技术发展产生的所有“废物”。然而，这些通过描绘远超出采矿范围的环境和技术未来的乌托邦想象来阐述的流动概念，也对特定人群的流动产生了深远的影响，包括他们在未来社会和政治秩序中的地位以及规划多代未来的能力。本文追踪了因马来西亚一个稀土加工设施而发生冲突的活动家和大学研究人员，在该设施中，对后加工废料商业应用的研究被交替视为经济多元化的途径和对少数族裔社区福利及国家归属感的威胁。两个群体都将“负责任”的废物管理与人员流动管理不善联系起来：潜在的专家被吸引到海外从事更复杂的工作；孩子在难以在马来西亚找到职位后移民到国外接受大学教育或寻找中产阶级工作。尽管明确提供了未来的稳定性和扩大的负责任关注伦理，但这些辩论背后的循环性愿景实际上将工业转型中涉及的多种流动形式归结为一种超越的承诺，掩盖了采掘业中伴随的种族化排斥和移民模式。

title: The making of style: On the entanglement of algorithms and aesthetics
abstract: Abstract The global fashion industry is changing with the integration of digital technologies. Designers now employ digital design software, tools and technology to develop innovative designs, purchase fabrics and materials and market their new designs. Digital media and technology have also contributed to the growth of influencers and personal stylists who use social media and apps to offer reviews and advice, including personal devices that leverage machine learning and algorithmic recommendation systems. This article brings together design anthropology and digital anthropology to understand the ways in which algorithms are increasingly entangled with notions of aesthetics and style. Comparing the ways in which style is created through ‘feeding’ and ‘reading’ the algorithm, the article draws upon Seaver’s notion of algorithmic cultures to explore two examples of the ways algorithms are made meaningful in people’s lives. The first example was carried out with professional women who experimented with a commercially available personal stylist device that provides algorithm‐based style recommendations. The second case study turns to the ways different fashion designers use and interpret social media algorithms to develop brands locally in Fiji and globally. By exploring the ways in which fashion and style‐oriented algorithms are used by different individuals and communities across the fashion value chain, the article examines how algorithmic technologies become enlivened as different people act, engage and interact with them and change over time.
title_zh: 风格的制造：论算法与美学的纠缠
abstract_zh: 摘要 全球时尚产业正在随着数字技术的整合而改变。设计师现在使用数字设计软件、工具和技术来开发创新设计、购买面料和材料并营销他们的新设计。数字媒体和技术也促进了影响者和个人造型师的成长，他们使用社交媒体和应用程序提供评论和建议，包括利用机器学习和算法推荐系统的个人设备。本文结合设计人类学和数字人类学，理解算法如何日益与美学和风格概念纠缠在一起。通过比较通过“喂养”和“阅读”算法创造风格的方式，文章借鉴了Seaver的算法文化概念，探索了两个例子，展示了算法如何在人们的生活中被赋予意义。第一个例子是与职业女性进行的，她们尝试了一种商用个人造型师设备，该设备提供基于算法的风格推荐。第二个案例研究转向了不同的时装设计师如何在不同地方和全球范围内使用和解释社交媒体算法来发展品牌。通过探索时尚和价值链中不同个体和社区如何使用时尚和风格导向的算法，文章考察了算法技术如何随着不同的人行动、参与和互动而变得生动，并随时间变化。

title: The patchwork city: scrap metal gleaning and the production of anthropological knowledge from the margins
abstract: Drawing on the local agrarian ethics of gleaning or momtsvreva in Georgian, this article examines gleaning as a lens for rethinking not only urban repair but also the methodological possibilities of anthropological knowledge production. Moving through the salvaged landscapes of post-Soviet Tbilisi, it follows the improvised labors of scrap-metal gatherers who navigate the Soviet imperial ruins that still shape the city's material and moral worlds. The article traces how collapsed Soviet heating systems and other infrastructural remnants become affectively charged substances, indexing anxieties about national dispossession of metallurgical knowledge while enabling creative acts of world-making. Drawing on long-term ethnographic research and collaborative multimodal artwork, the article conceptualizes both an emergent post-Soviet city and ensuing ethnographic knowledge as a patchwork, assembled from fragments, accidents, and the improvisational aesthetics of repair. Gleaning, and the poor images that document it, thus becomes an analytic and a method for inhabiting and understanding broken urban worlds.
title_zh: 拼凑之城：废金属拾荒与边缘人类学知识的产生
abstract_zh: 本文借鉴格鲁吉亚当地农业伦理中的拾穗（momtsvreva）概念，探讨拾荒作为重新思考城市修复以及人类学知识生产方法论可能性的透镜。文章穿越后苏联第比利斯的废墟景观，跟随废金属拾荒者的即兴劳动，他们穿行于仍塑造城市物质与道德世界的苏联帝国遗迹之中。文章追溯了倒塌的苏联供暖系统及其他基础设施残余如何成为情感负荷的物质，既指向国家在冶金知识方面被剥夺的焦虑，又促成创造性的世界营造行为。基于长期民族志研究与协作性多模态艺术作品，文章将新兴的后苏联城市及其民族志知识概念化为拼凑之物，由碎片、意外和修复的即兴美学组装而成。拾荒以及记录它的劣质图像，因此成为栖居与理解破碎城市世界的分析与方法。

title: The Pilfered material base of community: Toward a general theory of homers

authors.name: Xenia Cherkaev
institutions: Max Planck Institute for Social Anthropology

abstract: Throughout the history of industrial labour relations, workers have used the scraps of production to make useful things to take home. This essay gathers stories of such ‘self-made’ things from many different places and times: from early modern England to Fordist, state-socialist, and present day factories. Across these disparate settings, people tell similar stories: downplaying private profit and market sake, they speak not of resistance and justified theft, but of their right to the material scraps by virtue of social belonging. Drawing on Marx’s thoughts on the ‘Theft of Wood’ I argue that such narratives open a sort of commons, bringing speakers out of liberal property relations into a form of ownership that – as EP Thompson writes of the parish – is also a form of belonging. A right to the scraps entails a stake in the enterprise.
title_zh: 被窃取的社区物质基础：走向一种通用的“私拿”理论
abstract_zh: 在整个工业劳动关系的历史中，工人一直利用生产废料制作有用的东西带回家。本文收集了来自不同时代和地点的这种“自制”物品的故事：从早期现代英格兰到福特主义、国家社会主义和现今的工厂。在这些截然不同的环境中，人们讲述着相似的故事：淡化私人利润和市场利益，他们谈论的不是抵抗和正当的盗窃，而是他们基于社会归属感而对材料废料享有的权利。借鉴马克思关于“木材盗窃”的思考，我认为这样的叙事开辟了一种公共领域，使说话者从自由财产关系中走出来，进入一种所有权形式——正如EP·汤普森在描述教区时所说——也是一种归属形式。对废料的权利意味着对企业的参与。

title: Time with No Time
abstract: Time, especially the modern clock, was elemental in setting social relationships in modernity, in particular as regards the rationales and praxis of wage labor. However, this central framework of time has fallen from grace in the neoliberal workplace. Based on ethnography in the high-tech centers of Tel Aviv and Toronto, this article asks what temporal understandings are used to coordinate, in light of the rejection of modernist standardized time in favor of neoliberal ideologies of individual freedom and responsibility. Building on Evans-Pritchard’s foundational work on Nuer time, I argue that new temporalities of labor tend to be organized around shared tasks and offer that a new clock is being used in the contemporary workplace that sets task parameters, not hours or minutes, as the basic units of time. This new logic transforms time from a prime source of alienation into a mechanism to harness individual will in the workplace. Therefore, it has significant consequences for the ways in which work relationships are shaped in the tech industry and beyond.
title_zh: 没有时间的时间
abstract_zh: 时间，尤其是现代时钟，在塑造现代社会关系（特别是工资劳动的理性和实践）中起到了基础性作用。然而，这一核心时间框架在新自由主义的工作场所中已失宠。基于在特拉维夫和多伦多高科技中心的民族志研究，本文探讨了在摒弃现代标准化时间、转而推崇个体自由和责任的新自由主义意识形态的背景下，何种时间理解被用于协调工作。借鉴埃文斯-普里查德关于努尔人时间的奠基性研究，我认为劳动的新时间性倾向于围绕共享任务组织，并提出当代工作场所正在使用一种新的时钟，将任务参数（而非小时或分钟）设定为基本时间单位。这种新逻辑将时间从异化的主要来源转变为在工作中利用个体意志的机制。因此，它对科技行业及其他领域工作关系的塑造方式产生了重要影响。

title: Undoing Cambodia’s Cosmopolitical Fix: Forests, Sweatshops, and Possibilities for Uncommon Alliances
abstract: The Cambodian regime depends on large-scale extraction of natural resources. However, the regime also acknowledges that Cambodian territories are potent landscapes protected by extra-human beings. Hence, it must accomplish seemingly contradictory objectives: pleasing the land-protectors while ruining the lands they protect. We characterise this effort as Cambodia’s cosmopolitical fix. To elucidate the cosmopolitical fix and speculate about ways of undoing it, we draw connections between disparate cases. Forest cosmopolitics brings predatory state bodies and international conservationists into contact with Indigenous people and powerful extra-humans. Sweatshop cosmopolitics refers to mass faintings and spirit possession in factories where global commodity chains, toxic conditions, and the trauma of violence intermingle with restless ghosts. We use these cases to explore the potential for uncommon alliances between vulnerable humans and extra-humans to loosen the cosmopolitical fix. By interweaving worlds under threat, such alliances could lead to a more open-ended and less disruptive Cambodian cosmopolitics of the future.
title_zh: 解除柬埔寨的宇宙政治困境：森林、血汗工厂与非常规联盟的可能性
abstract_zh: 柬埔寨政权依赖于大规模开采自然资源。然而，该政权也承认柬埔寨领土是受超人类生物保护的强大景观。因此，它必须实现看似矛盾的目标：取悦土地保护者，同时破坏他们所保护的土地。我们将这种努力描述为柬埔寨的宇宙政治困境。为了阐明宇宙政治困境并思考解除它的方法，我们在不同的案例之间建立联系。森林宇宙政治学使掠夺性的国家机构与国际保护主义者与土著人民和强大的超人类接触。血汗工厂宇宙政治学指的是工厂中的大规模昏厥和灵魂附体现象，在那里，全球商品链、有毒条件和暴力创伤与不安的幽灵交织在一起。我们利用这些案例来探索脆弱人类与超人类之间非常规联盟的潜力，以放松宇宙政治困境。通过交织受到威胁的世界，这样的联盟可能导致一个更加开放、破坏性更小的未来柬埔寨宇宙政治学。

title: Unearthing extraction: media infrastructure and the more-than planetary mine
abstract: Media infrastructures sustain the evolving cultures of extraction. Their unfolding propels the quest for raw materials across the bounty of the natural and social world, from the excavations of coal and gold to wind and server farming, data and cryptocurrency mining and varied other exploitative approaches to resource-taking and value-making. To highlight how the strategic development of media infrastructures aligns the drive for extraction around emergent domains, we focus on their deployment into outer space. Over the decades of space exploration, elaborate media infrastructures have entangled celestial bodies and regions in processes of imaging, mapping, sampling and various data collections and surveillance, gradually revealing their features and assets and paving the way to a new gold rush as governmental and private space sectors invest in developing infrastructure for launching extractive industries and services off Earth. While the possibilities of traditional mining in space remain speculative, the logistical strategies of datafication and visualisation already envelop its remote environments within the extractive operations of high-tech capitalism and its pursuits of power, knowledge and wealth. We focus on this preparatory stage of off-Earth mining, approaching the capture of space into infrastructures and processes of media as pivotal for its transformation into an extraction frontier. Exploring the formation of the ‘more-than-planetary mine’, we suggest that media infrastructure condition the extent, expressions and effects of extraction, configuring its frontiers and empires at large.
title_zh: 挖掘开采：媒体基础设施与超越行星的矿场
abstract_zh: 媒体基础设施支撑着不断演变的开采文化。它们的发展推动了对自然和社会世界中丰富资源的追求，从煤炭和黄金的开采到风能和服务器农场、数据和加密货币挖矿，以及各种其他剥削性的资源获取和价值创造方式。为突出媒体基础设施的战略发展如何围绕新兴领域推动开采动力，我们重点关注其向太空的部署。经过数十年的太空探索，精密的媒体基础设施已将天体及其区域卷入成像、测绘、采样以及各种数据收集和监视的过程中，逐渐揭示其特征和资产，并为新的淘金热铺平道路，因为政府和私营太空部门正在投资开发基础设施，以在地球以外启动采掘工业和服务。虽然太空传统采矿的可能性仍属推测，但数据化和可视化的后勤战略已将其远程环境纳入高科技资本主义及其对权力、知识和财富追求的开采运营中。我们将重点放在地球外采矿的这一准备阶段，认为将太空捕获到媒体基础设施和过程中是其转变为开采前沿的关键。通过探索'超越行星矿场'的形成，我们提出媒体基础设施制约着开采的范围、表现形式和效果，并总体上配置了其前沿和帝国。

title: ‘With gold, it’s never over’. Remainders and the moral economy of artisanal mining in Burkina Faso

authors.name: Cristiano Lanzano
institutions: French Institute for Research in Africa

abstract: This article focuses on the work and sharing practices of gold miners in Burkina Faso as a case to highlight the importance of remainders in the artisanal mining economy. Through a continuous process of identifying valuable ores and discarding leftovers, miners create opportunities for the future reprocessing of remainders from past mining activities. This act of (re)processing remainders can become central, especially when specific techniques – in the case described here, the use of cyanide – enable the extraction of profits from matter that would otherwise be considered marginal. In small-scale mining, informal patterns in the organization of work and production, of profit sharing, and of economic transactions, tend to coalesce into moral economies that legitimize the participation of different actors, and that shape their interactions and mutual obligations. However, these moral economies are unstable and subject to change and contestation. The article describes how the introduction of cyanide-based processing transformed pre-existing practices and hierarchies of value, and how these transformations were closely associated with controversies over the ownership and use of gold ‘remainders’.
title_zh: “黄金永无止境”：剩余物与布基纳法索手工采矿的道德经济
abstract_zh: 本文以布基纳法索金矿工人的工作和分享实践为例，强调剩余物在手工艺采矿经济中的重要性。通过持续识别有价值矿石和丢弃剩余物的过程，矿工为未来重新处理过去采矿活动产生的剩余物创造了机会。这种（重新）处理剩余物的行为可能成为核心，尤其是在特定技术——本例中为使用氰化物——能够从原本被视为边缘的物质中提取利润时。在小规模采矿中，工作和生产组织、利润分享以及经济交易的非正式模式往往汇聚成道德经济，使不同参与者的参与合法化，并塑造他们的互动和相互义务。然而，这些道德经济是不稳定的，容易发生变化和争议。文章描述了基于氰化物的处理如何转变已有的实践和价值等级，以及这些转变如何与黄金“剩余物”的所有权和使用争议密切相关。

title: 5G Specters
abstract: Abstract This article attends to spectral experiences surrounding 5G infrastructure and risks associated with electromagnetic fields through ethnographic fieldwork in Germany and the UK, exploring them in their specificity as a spectral manner of being. Drawing on Jacques Derrida's figuring of the specter as a ‘structural opening’ and Isabelle Stengers's concept of ‘disclosure’, we trace three spectral moments—attunements to an equivocal spectrum, dis/possessed bodies, and a ghosted public—that disturb modern ontologies and epistemologies, disclosing an Otherworld within. The article, moreover, contributes to anthropological discussions on unstable ontologies in the context of climate change. It argues that spectrality is a useful analytic for tending to ontological uncertainties, sensitizing us to exposures that are imperceptible within the logics of technoscientific knowledge.
title_zh: 5G幽灵
abstract_zh: 本文通过德国和英国的民族志田野调查，关注围绕着5G基础设施和与电磁场相关的风险的幽灵体验，将其作为幽灵般的存在方式探索其特殊性。借鉴雅克·德里达对幽灵作为“结构性开口”的构想和伊莎贝尔·斯滕格斯的“揭露”概念，我们追踪了三个幽灵时刻——对模糊频谱的调谐、被剥夺/占据的身体，以及一个被鬼魂化的公众——这些时刻扰乱了现代本体论和认识论，揭露了一个内在的异世界。此外，本文还在气候变化的背景下为本体论不稳定性的人类学讨论做出了贡献。文章认为，幽灵性是一个有用的分析工具，用于处理本体论不确定性，使我们意识到在技术科学知识的逻辑中无法感知的暴露。

title: America's secret police
abstract: This guest editorial examines the emergence of ICE (Immigration and Customs Enforcement) as a secret police force in the United States, drawing parallels to authoritarian regimes of the past. Through a personal narrative about explaining ICE raids to young children in Oakland, it analyzes how AI‐powered surveillance technologies developed by venture capital‐funded startups enable mass deportation operations. Companies such as Clearview AI, Palantir Technologies and Flock Safety provide facial recognition, data integration and licence plate tracking tools that facilitate pre‐emptive repression. The editorial traces connections between Silicon Valley investors, including Peter Thiel, Marc Andreessen and Elon Musk, and neo‐reactionary ideologies that reject democratic governance. It concludes by asking what roles anthropologists might play in response to the erosion of democracy, ranging from advocacy and civil disobedience to more drastic forms of resistance.
title_zh: 美国的秘密警察
abstract_zh: 这篇客座社论审视了ICE（移民和海关执法局）作为美国秘密警察力量的出现，将其与过去的威权政权相类比。通过一个关于向奥克兰幼童解释ICE突袭行动的个人叙述，它分析了由风险投资支持的初创公司开发的AI驱动监控技术如何使大规模驱逐行动成为可能。Clearview AI、Palantir Technologies和Flock Safety等公司提供面部识别、数据集成和车牌追踪工具，以促进预防性压制。社论追溯了硅谷投资者（包括Peter Thiel、Marc Andreessen和Elon Musk）与新反动意识形态之间的联系，这些意识形态拒绝民主治理。最后，它提出了人类学家在应对民主侵蚀方面可能扮演的角色，从倡导和公民不服从到更激烈的抵抗形式。

title: A Season for Plastics
abstract: Abstract This article examines the temporal complexity of polyethylene plastics in Blantyre, Malawi. As the location of the country's main plastic manufacturers, all kinds of plastics flow through the city. However, various non-plastic times intersect with these flows, from rainy seasons to the sowing of maize, the ongoing cost-of-living crisis, and the availability of fertilizer. Movements of local plastics thereby fluctuate according to other times and rhythms. Recycled plastics, for example, are harvested, washed, dried, crushed, packed, and resold at some times of the year and not others, depending on various economic, political, social, and cultural factors. The resulting seasonality of plastics underlines that they are deeply embedded in the ever-changing complexities of social life, co-constituting contested socio-economic presents with their unique temporal and material qualities.
title_zh: 塑料的季节性
abstract_zh: 摘要本文考察了马拉维布兰太尔聚乙烯塑料的时间复杂性。作为该国主要塑料制造商的所在地，各种塑料流经该城市。然而，各种非塑料时间与这些流交织在一起，从雨季到玉米播种、持续的生活成本危机以及肥料的可用性。因此，当地塑料的流动根据其他时间和节奏波动。例如，再生塑料在一年中的某些时间被收割、清洗、干燥、压碎、包装和转售，而在其他时间则不然，这取决于各种经济、政治、社会和文化因素。由此产生的塑料季节性强调它们深深嵌入社会生活的不断变化的复杂性中，以其独特的时间和物质品质共同构成有争议的社会经济现状。

title: A Semiotics of Coziness and Disappearing Night
abstract: Abstract This essay explores the Danish concept of hygge , commonly glossed as “coziness,” as a structure of feeling attuned to particular qualities of light. It draws from an ethnographic study of Copenhagen Municipality’s Climate Plan to build the world’s first carbon-neutral capital. Homing in on one of the Climate Plan’s inaugural initiatives—the LED (light-emitting diode) conversion of street lighting—it tracks how ambient intensities of hygge are swept up with both changing lightscapes and changing national demographics. Via a semiotics of social difference, I examine how changing qualities of artificial light are experienced as eroding culturally configured sensory comforts, and how this erosion is grafted onto a fear of the city’s potentially diminishing “Danishness.” This semiotic process is evidenced in the lamination of racialized anxieties about “non-Western immigrants” onto discomforts derived from energy-efficient lighting technologies, and the apparent intrusion of both into habit worlds of hygge . In Copenhagen, I show how a semiotic account of atmosphere illuminates the fault lines of the Danish racial imagination.
title_zh: 舒适感与消失之夜的符号学
abstract_zh: 本文探讨了丹麦的“hygge”（通常译为“舒适感”）概念，将其视为一种关注特定光线品质的感受结构。本文基于哥本哈根市建设全球首个碳中和首都的气候规划的田野研究。聚焦该气候规划的首批举措之一——街道照明的LED（发光二极管）改造——追踪环境中的舒适感强度如何既随着光景变化，又随着国家人口结构变化而波动。通过社会差异的符号学，我考察了人造光线品质的变化如何被体验为侵蚀了文化上建构的感觉舒适，以及这种侵蚀如何被嫁接在对城市可能逐渐丧失“丹麦性”的恐惧之上。这一符号学过程体现在：关于“非西方移民”的种族化焦虑与节能照明技术带来的不适相互叠加，以及两者共同侵入舒适感习惯世界。在哥本哈根，我展示了氛围的符号学分析如何揭示丹麦种族想象的断层线。

title: Built-in smartphone LiDAR for archaeological and speleological research
abstract: LiDAR technology is reshaping cave surveying by providing detailed 3D models that enhance the accuracy of morphological and rock art digitisation and reduce subjective interpretation. This technology, in its varied forms and solely or combined with other remote sensing techniques such as photogrammetry, enriches the documentation and supports multidisciplinary research by enabling spatial analyses and virtual exploration, thus opening new possibilities in various fields such as archaeology, geology, speleology, tourism or education. In this sense, this research aimed to democratise the use of low-cost mobile LiDAR (Light Detection and Ranging) 3D scanning, subjected to fewer accessibility limitations than tripod-mounted Terrestrial Laser Scanners (TLS), in cave archaeology and speleology. For this purpose, La Pileta Cave in Málaga (Spain) was chosen as a case study. Declared a Spanish National Monument in 1924, the cave boasts one of the greatest collections of prehistoric art in Europe and, therefore, a reference in South Iberia, and outstands out for its varied karstic morphologies. The research methodology involved a systematic process to ensure clarity and accuracy. First, the main itinerary in La Pileta was scanned using the smartphone LiDAR technique. This was followed by a Terrestrial Laser Scanning (TLS) survey of a specific sector within the same itinerary, with numerous morphological details of its karstic environment and important Palaeolithic rock art samples. Both the smartphone LiDAR and TLS spatial data were then validated against a Ground Control Points (GCPs) network previously established using a total station. Given the higher accuracy of TLS for graphical documentation, it was further employed as a benchmark to validate the accuracy of smartphone LiDAR. Despite its limitations, this research revealed smartphone LiDAR as a suitable technique for geometric data recording in cave archaeology and speleology. Solely or combined with TLS, mobile LiDAR can be used to document rock art panels in karstic environments, surpassing the latter technique in terms of texture quality. In addition to the accurate graphic documentation carried out in the cave sector, this research broke down the advantages and disadvantages of the smartphone LiDAR technique and provided a series of recommendations for its use in this context.
title_zh: 内置智能手机激光雷达在考古和洞穴研究中的应用
abstract_zh: 激光雷达技术正在重塑洞穴勘探，通过提供详细的三维模型，增强了形态和岩石艺术数字化的准确性，减少了主观解释。该技术以其多种形式，单独或与摄影测量等其他遥感技术结合，丰富了文献记录，并通过支持空间分析和虚拟探索促进多学科研究，从而在考古学、地质学、洞穴学、旅游或教育等各个领域开辟了新的可能性。在此意义上，本研究旨在普及低成本移动激光雷达（Light Detection and Ranging）三维扫描在洞穴考古和洞穴学中的应用，该技术比三脚架式地面激光扫描仪（TLS）受限于更少的可达性限制。为此，选择了西班牙马拉加的La Pileta洞穴作为案例研究。该洞穴于1924年被宣布为西班牙国家纪念碑，拥有欧洲最丰富的史前艺术收藏之一，因此是南伊比利亚的参考点，并以其多样的喀斯特形态而著称。研究方法包括一个系统过程以确保清晰度和准确性。首先，使用智能手机激光雷达技术扫描了La Pileta的主要路线。随后，在同一路线的特定区域进行了地面激光扫描（TLS）调查，该区域具有众多喀斯特环境的形态细节和重要的旧石器时代岩石艺术样本。然后，将智能手机激光雷达和TLS的空间数据与先前使用全站仪建立的地面控制点（GCP）网络进行验证。鉴于TLS在图形文档方面具有更高的准确性，它被进一步用作基准来验证智能手机激光雷达的准确性。尽管有其局限性，本研究揭示了智能手机激光雷达在洞穴考古和洞穴学中进行几何数据记录的适用性。单独或与TLS结合，移动激光雷达可用于记录喀斯特环境中的岩石艺术面板，在纹理质量方面超越后者。除了在洞穴区域进行的精确图形文档外，本研究还分析了智能手机激光雷达技术的优缺点，并为其在此背景下的使用提供了一系列建议。

title: Extractive rhythms of “energy dependence” in the Soma basin: reshaping the flows of migration, cash, and debt via underground minework

authors.name: Ferda Nur Demirci
institutions: Max Planck Institute for Social Anthropology

abstract: Abstract Over the past few decades, Soma, a once-thriving agricultural town in Turkey’s North-Aegean region, has been transformed into a critical frontier for extractive industries, fuelled by the Turkish state’s ambitious energy independence policies. Soma’s abundant but low-efficiency lignite coal deposits have become central to a nationally designed strategy maximizing domestic energy production, giving rise to new forms of labour, cycles of internal migration, and intensified rhythms of resource extraction. This article examines how Soma’s migrant miner families navigate the interplay between labour, debt, and family obligations in the context of accelerated resource extraction. It focuses on the strategies of migrant miner households who increasingly rely on small, easily accessible bank loans to meet the demands of marriage traditions and emerging gendered expectations. I explore how state-backed financial inclusion policies, along with nationally designed resource extraction models, have created new temporalities and moral economies within mining households. These financial instruments reshape the rhythms of social expenses, family obligations, and regionally specific family expectations that align with the rhythms of extractive industries. Accordingly, this article demonstrates how the extractive economy in Soma operates not only through material resource extraction but also through the production of new forms of moral values at the regional and household levels.
title_zh: 索马盆地“能源依赖”的采掘节奏：通过地下采矿重塑移民、现金和债务的流动
abstract_zh: 摘要：在过去的几十年里，土耳其北爱琴海地区曾经繁荣的农业城镇索马，在土耳其国家雄心勃勃的能源独立政策推动下，已被转变为采掘业的关键前沿。索马丰富但低效的褐煤矿床成为国家设计的最大化国内能源生产战略的核心，催生了新的劳动形式、内部移民周期以及资源开采的加速节奏。本文考察了索马的移民矿工家庭如何在加速资源开采的背景下应对劳动、债务和家庭义务之间的相互作用。文章聚焦于移民矿工家庭的策略，这些家庭越来越依赖小额、易获得的银行贷款来满足婚姻传统和新兴的性别期望。我探讨了国家支持的金融包容性政策以及国家设计的资源开采模式如何在矿工家庭内部创造新的时间性和道德经济。这些金融工具重塑了社会支出、家庭义务和地区特定家庭期望的节奏，使其与采掘业的节奏相一致。因此，本文展示了索马的采掘经济不仅通过物质资源开采运作，还通过区域和家庭层面新的道德价值的生产来运作。

title: Fibreglass and steel: De-imagineering AI value claims for Danish SMEs
abstract: ‘Artificial intelligence (AI) creates value’ is a phrase that circulates through Danish policy documents and consultancy reports, across conference stages and appears in opinion pieces and political speeches. Through ethnographic fieldwork with small- and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) and AI experts involved in AI pilot projects, as well as observations at AI promotional events, we trace how SMEs are enrolled in AI adoption as vehicles for accessing this value on a national level. Drawing on anthropological theories of value, we show that there are in fact multiple meanings of value in operation: value for society, value as revenue, value as cost-saving. We build on the concept of imagineering to describe the affective process by which promotional actors semantically transmute these forms of value, thereby enabling a neoliberal stabilisation of ‘societal value’ as a reduction in public-sector employment. Therefore, we propose the concept of de-imagineering as an analytic that helps us unblur the semantic slippage of what AI might, can and will do, and, not least, for whom it will do those things. As an analytic device, we argue that de-imagineering enables us to challenge deterministic narratives of the value accruing from technology more broadly, and thus shift the focal plane towards those who stand to benefit from this affective promotion.
title_zh: 玻璃纤维与钢铁：为丹麦中小企业祛魅AI价值主张
abstract_zh: “人工智能（AI）创造价值”这一表述在丹麦政策文件和咨询报告中流传，跨越会议舞台，出现在评论文章和政治演讲中。通过对参与人工智能试点项目的中小企业和人工智能专家进行民族志田野调查，以及在人工智能推广活动中的观察，我们追溯了中小企业如何在国家层面上被纳入人工智能采纳，作为获取这种价值的工具。借鉴人类学的价值理论，我们展示了实际上存在多种运作中的价值含义：社会价值、收入价值、成本节约价值。我们基于想象工程（imagineering）的概念，描述了推广行动者通过语义转化这些价值形式的感性过程，从而将“社会价值”作为一种公共部门就业减少的新自由主义稳定化。因此，我们提出了祛魅工程（de-imagineering）的概念，作为一种分析工具，帮助厘清人工智能可能、能够和将要做什么，以及尤其是为谁做这些事的语义滑动。作为一种分析手段，我们认为祛魅工程使我们能够挑战更广泛的技术所积累价值的决定性叙事，从而将关注焦点转向那些受益于这种感性推广的人群。

title: From translocalization to commuterization: Chinese migrant factory workers’ changing arrangements of welfare and care
abstract: Based on a 10-month fieldwork in central China and 60 in-depth interviews, I explore in this paper a paradoxical phenomenon where the expansion of institutional provision of welfare fails to reach its goal of safeguarding people's well-being but intensifies the condition of insecurity experienced by migrant factory workers and their families. Recent developments in metropolitanizing spaces through land-for-welfare policies, in-migration of capital, and industrial rezoning have incorporated those at the urban fringes into the Chinese state's regional development plan. Due to land expropriation, villagers living at the urban edges are gradually replacing the rural land with cash compensation, resettlement housing, residence-based social insurances, and factory employment to secure their livelihoods and maintain social relations. As the factory is located in the neighborhood, former peasants' trajectories of travel oscillate more frequently between work and home. This creates a new mix of care wherein thin social protection provided by the state allows deeper penetration of market actors. In response to the changing welfare landscape, peasants-turned-urbanites constantly have to make trade-offs between hypermobility and stability: they follow the seasonal hiring rhythm of the factory that provides flexible wages and discourages welfare participation; or they adhere to the rules of the welfare system which requires long-term stay in the factory with low pay. As a result, workers and their families either rely on unstable income to secure their future or participate in social protection schemes in combination with speculative financial activities such as utilizing the Housing Provident Fund together with reduced-interest mortgages. People's response to the deepening commodification of land, labor, and money therefore emerges from their everyday practices and arrangement of care. In other words, how people react to the conditions of insecurity remain entangled with the welfare structures that create them.
title_zh: 从跨地迁移到通勤化：中国农民工工厂工人的福利与照料安排变迁
abstract_zh: 基于在中国中部为期10个月的田野调查和60次深度访谈，本文探讨了一个悖论现象：机构性福利供给的扩张未能实现保障人民福祉的目标，反而加剧了农民工及其家庭所经历的不安全感。近年来，通过土地换福利政策、资本流入和产业重新布局推动的城市化空间发展，将城市边缘地带纳入了中国国家区域发展规划。由于土地征用，城市边缘的村民逐渐用现金补偿、安置住房、基于户籍的社会保险和工厂就业来替代农村土地，以保障生计并维持社会关系。由于工厂位于社区内，前农民的通勤轨迹在工作与家庭之间更加频繁地摆动。这创造了一种新的照料组合，其中国家提供的薄弱社会保护允许市场参与者更深地渗透。面对不断变化的福利格局，从农民转变而来的城市居民不得不在超流动性与稳定性之间做出权衡：他们要么追随工厂的季节性招聘节奏，工厂提供灵活工资且不鼓励参与福利；要么遵循福利体系规则，要求长期在工厂工作但工资较低。结果，工人及其家庭要么依赖不稳定的收入来保障未来，要么参与社会保护计划，同时结合投机性金融活动，例如利用住房公积金和低息抵押贷款。人们对土地、劳动力和货币日益商品化的反应因此源于他们的日常实践和照料安排。换言之，人们如何应对不安全感的条件仍然与创造这些条件的福利结构纠缠在一起。

title: Game design as multimodal intervention: Exploring Cuban media reality through the ethnographic video game PakeTown
abstract: Abstract The mobile video game PakeTown presents an ethnographic depiction of the history of alternative media distribution in Cuba. It is a joint project between a multimodal anthropologist and a Cuban media artist working with ConWiro, an independent Cuban game studio. We discuss our game as a multimodal intervention that generated new conversations with our research participants, new modes of collaboration, as well as new knowledge about our field that we wouldn't have been able to gather through traditional (non‐interventionist) fieldwork methods such as interviews and participant observation. Developing PakeTown in conjunction with one of the initial video game companies in Cuba's still tightly regulated private sector provided a valuable understanding of how its founders, as key figures in the islands' emergent digital culture, overcame complex technological and political constraints at a time of profound social change. Moreover, the process of designing and marketing the game to resonate with local audiences offered us intriguing new insights into Cubans' everyday media consumption patterns. A supplemental guide to teaching this article is available at visualanthropologyreview.org/var411‐suppl‐koehn.
title_zh: 游戏设计作为多模态干预：通过民族志视频游戏《PakeTown》探索古巴媒体现实
abstract_zh: 移动视频游戏《PakeTown》以民族志的方式描绘了古巴替代媒体分发历史。这是一个多模态人类学家与一位古巴媒体艺术家合作的项目，合作方是独立的古巴游戏工作室ConWiro。我们讨论我们的游戏作为一种多模态干预，它引发了与研究参与者的新对话、新的合作模式，以及我们通过传统（非干预性）田野调查方法（如访谈和参与观察）无法收集到的关于我们领域的新知识。与古巴仍严格监管的私营部门中最早的视频游戏公司之一联合开发《PakeTown》，使我们得以了解其创始人作为该岛新兴数字文化的关键人物，如何在社会深刻变革时期克服复杂的技术和政治限制。此外，设计与营销游戏以引起当地观众共鸣的过程，为我们提供了关于古巴人日常媒体消费模式的有趣新见解。本文的教学辅助指南可在visualanthropologyreview.org/var411‐suppl‐koehn获取。

title: Garbography: Tracing waste as material data
abstract: This article reconsiders the relation between ethnographic accounts and non-human inscriptions by tracing waste as material data. It engages with the dynamism of residual matter at the epistemic level while aiming at expanding the range of possibilities of research on waste. What we call garbography unsettles the predominant meaning-centric understanding of our methods by paying attention to the expressiveness of residual matter as an asemic inscription or graphein of sorts: in its propensity to leak, rot, grow, mould, tarnish, and stink, waste ‘writes’ by leaving marks. To practice garbography is thus to be involved in exercises of tracing material inscriptions that might not be directly translatable to verbal language. After providing a series of examples from fieldwork in post-industrial settings of Estonia, we conclude that by thinking with traces and approaching waste in the writing, we can better understand non-human socialities and how the organic, the symbolic, and matter are entangled.
title_zh: 垃圾书写：追踪作为物质数据的废弃物
abstract_zh: 本文通过将废弃物追踪为物质数据，重新思考民族志记述与非人类铭文之间的关系。它在认识论层面上参与残留物的动态性，同时旨在扩展废弃物研究的可能性范围。我们所谓的垃圾书写通过关注残留物作为某种无意义铭文或书写的表现力——在其易于泄漏、腐烂、生长、发霉、失去光泽和发臭的倾向中，废弃物通过留下痕迹来“书写”——动摇了我们方法中以意义为中心的主流理解。因此，进行垃圾书写就是参与追踪可能无法直接转化为口头语言的物质铭文的实践。在提供了来自爱沙尼亚后工业背景的田野调查系列实例后，我们得出结论：通过思考痕迹并在书写中接近废弃物，我们可以更好地理解非人类的社会性以及有机、象征和物质是如何纠缠在一起的。
