We further analyze the multiple subject positions of Chinese Internet workers into hegemonic position, negotiated position, and oppositional position to discover the complexity of labor subjectivity which may create discrepancy or sometimes even challenge the Chinese Internet as an ideology. This study sheds light on how subject positions could disrupt a homogenous process of merging nationalism with populist sentiments, a conservative ideology that is prevalent in today’s China.
title_zh: 作为意识形态的互联网：中国互联网工人的民族主义话语与多重主体位置
abstract_zh: 意识形态起作用。本文考察了作为资本行动者的互联网如何在中国成为一种民族主义意识形态。通过揭示在信息资本主义时代民族主义如何服务于促进中国互联网平台的扩张，我们直面作为意识形态装置的中国互联网，它服务于资本和领土权力的双重逻辑。本文对三类中国互联网工人——程序员、白领员工（不包括程序员）和流水线工人——进行了研究，重点关注民族主义话语如何被创造，这些话语吸引着同时也被不同的工人质疑，他们既制造民族主义又挑战它。我们将威胁的位点和集体化的指涉策略概念化为文化和媒体策略，这些策略由作为中国用户“常识”一部分的民族主义情绪驱动。我们进一步将中国互联网工人的多重主体位置分为霸权位置、协商位置和反对位置，以揭示劳动主体性的复杂性，这种复杂性可能产生差异，有时甚至挑战作为意识形态的中国互联网。这项研究揭示了主体位置如何可能打破民族主义与民粹主义情绪同质化的过程，这是一种在当今中国盛行的保守意识形态。

title: Make me a test and I will save the world: towards an anthropology of the possible in global health
journal_name: JOURNAL OF THE ROYAL ANTHROPOLOGICAL INSTITUTE
abstract: Abstract What is deemed possible in the wake of failure? The global biotech industry's failure to develop affordable diagnostic devices for use in low‐ and middle‐income countries (LMICs) has inspired a generation of humanitarian entrepreneurs to launch their own diagnostic start‐up companies. This essay traces the rise and fall of one such start‐up in Boston in the United States, Daktari, which developed a portable HIV testing device in the 2010s. I show how the alignment of humanitarian and economic valuations in a single diagnostic device depended on the ability of the start‐up's founders and employees to synchronize the distinct tempos of financial capital, humanitarian design, and global health standards. Yet their failure to achieve this synchronization does not simply offer another story of biotech hype and speculation, the generation of promissory value at the expense of actual things. Instead, the essay examines the hopes and expectations that the firm's employees invested in the device's material qualities, manufacture, and distribution. What, I ask, is the meaning of failure, and its material remains, when it is measured against humanitarian rather than solely commercial expectations? The essay concludes with some reflections on the aftermath of failure in humanitarian entrepreneurship, examining the questions that Daktari's demise poses for understandings of what is possible and desirable in global health.
title_zh: 给我一个测试，我将拯救世界：迈向全球健康中可能的人类学
abstract_zh: 在失败之后，什么被认为是可能的？全球生物技术行业未能开发出适用于低收入和中等收入国家的负担得起的诊断设备，这激发了一代人道主义企业家创办自己的诊断初创公司。本文追溯了美国波士顿一家名为Daktari的初创公司的兴衰历程，该公司在2010年代开发了便携式HIV检测设备。我展示了人道主义和经济评估在单一诊断设备中的一致性如何依赖于初创公司创始人和员工协调金融资本、人道主义设计和全球健康标准不同节奏的能力。然而，他们未能实现这种同步，这不仅仅是另一个生物技术炒作和投机、以实际事物为代价产生承诺价值的故事。相反，本文考察了公司员工对设备物质特性、制造和分销所投入的希望和期望。我问，当失败以人道主义而非仅仅商业期望来衡量时，失败及其物质遗存意味着什么？文章最后对人道主义创业中失败的后果进行了一些反思，探讨了Daktari的消亡对理解全球健康中什么是可能的和可取的所提出的问题。

title: Micron engagements, macro histories: Machines and the agency of labor in a worker-owned company
abstract: Focusing on ITAS, a Croatian metalworking company with a turbulent past characterized by various property arrangements and varying degrees of success in the market for machine tools, I sketch out a shop-floor history of the ways in which the materiality of production continues to matter in contemporary capitalism. Control over machines allowed ITAS workers to negotiate their precarious position in the market. I show how collective and individual decisions of workers as economic agents contribute to shaping the geographical unevenness of capitalism. Industrial machines can serve as an ethnographic object that connects analytical scales, allowing scholars to provide a relational and historically situated understanding of how workers are incorporated into political economic systems as well as the degree to which they can influence those systems.
title_zh: 微观接触，宏观历史：工人所有公司中的机器与劳动能动性
abstract_zh: 本文聚焦于ITAS公司，这是一家克罗地亚金属加工企业，经历了动荡的过去，其特点包括各种产权安排以及机床市场上不同程度成功。我勾勒出车间层面的历史，探讨生产物质性在当代资本主义中如何继续发挥作用。对机器的控制使ITAS工人能够协商他们在市场中的不稳定地位。我展示了工人作为经济主体的集体和个体决策如何有助于塑造资本主义的地理不平衡性。工业机器可以作为连接分析尺度的人类学对象，使学者能够提供一种关系性和历史情境化的理解，即工人如何被纳入政治经济体系，以及他们能在多大程度上影响这些体系。

title: Mining Rituals in Vital Spaces: The Cosmopolitics of Gold and the Precarity of Mine Closure in Ghana
abstract: Recent spiritual contests swirling around a five-year shutdown of the Obuasi gold mine in Ghana, one of the world’s largest, have thrown into high relief key features of improvisational labour and cosmopolitical assemblages in de-industrialising settings. People are turning more intensely toward novel mining rituals in pursuits of gold, which spirits animate. These phenomena urge a reconsideration of the theoretical and conceptual terms of analysis for moral economies of labour and neoliberal mining politics. Building upon recent work on cosmopolitics, copresences, and cultures of casual labour, this piece argues for a concept of vital spaces – interior and exterior zones of life and death, of enlivening and deadening – with assemblages of spiritual reciprocity. These multivalent spiritual contests over the vitalities of gold provide a prime context for a retheorization of moral economies and mining politics as cosmopolitics, with implications for understanding labour, politics, and value across the neoliberal world.
title_zh: 生命空间的采矿仪式：黄金的宇宙政治与加纳矿井关闭的不稳定性
abstract_zh: 近年来，围绕加纳奥布阿西金矿（世界最大金矿之一）五年关闭期间的精神争夺，凸显了去工业化背景下即兴劳动和宇宙政治组合的关键特征。人们越来越强烈地转向新的采矿仪式来追求黄金，而精神体赋予这些仪式生命力。这些现象促使我们重新思考劳动道德经济和新自由主义采矿政治的理论和概念分析术语。本文基于近期关于宇宙政治、共存和临时劳动文化的研究，提出了生命空间的概念——内部和外部生与死、活力与死寂的区域，以及精神互惠的组合。这些关于黄金活力的多价精神争夺为将道德经济和采矿政治重新理论化为宇宙政治提供了主要背景，对整个新自由主义世界中的劳动、政治和价值理解具有启示意义。

title: Monkey King’s Golden Headband: Domestic Surveillance Technology as a Moral Journey in Chinese Urban Families
abstract: This research investigates domestic surveillance technology (DST) in Chinese urban families, engaging with anthropological studies on morality/ethics and technology. In contemporary China, ambivalent child-rearing values make parental surveillance a subject of ethical reflections and negotiations. Interrogating the result-oriented perspective that prevails in studies on surveillance technologies, I demonstrate the complicated relevance between DST and two reconfiguring virtues: guan (to control/care) and zijue (self-consciousness). With a focus on two devices – the smart home camera and the brain–machine-interface headband monitoring the concentration level – my ethnography conducted alongside middle-class families in Shanghai reveals that living with DST constitutes a moral journey towards becoming a good parent and child, albeit unknown and possibly arduous. This research illustrates one possibility of ethical-technological assemblage under the condition of moral friction that it can become one material embodiment of endeavours to meet moral expectations or surpass dilemmas.
title_zh: 金箍棒：中国城市家庭中的家庭监控技术作为道德旅程
abstract_zh: 本研究调查中国城市家庭中的家庭监控技术（DST），涉及道德/伦理与技术的人类学研究。在当代中国，矛盾的育儿价值观使得父母监控成为伦理反思和协商的主题。通过审视监控技术研究中盛行的结果导向视角，我展示了DST与两种重构美德——guan（控制/关心）和zijue（自觉）之间的复杂关联。聚焦于两种设备——智能家居摄像头和监测专注度的脑机接口头带——我与上海中产家庭进行的民族志研究揭示了，与DST共处构成了一场成为好父母和好孩子的道德旅程，尽管未知且可能艰辛。这项研究说明了在道德摩擦条件下伦理-技术组合的一种可能性：它可以成为满足道德期望或超越困境的物质体现。

title: Participatory design of a smart forest in the Brazilian Amazon using smartphones, algorithms, and ethnographic methods
abstract: Abstract This article reports on the participatory design of a smart forest project in a state forest reserve in the Brazilian Amazon in collaboration primarily with local community residents and secondarily with forest reserve managers and environmental scientists. The Smart Forest project was collectively proposed to use low‐cost digital technologies for forest‐carbon monitoring and sustainable development. Our research includes a feasibility test and impact assessment of the proposed components of the Smart Forest. It combines ethnographic fieldwork methods, such as interviews and focus groups on using recycled smartphones and sound‐recognition algorithms to remotely detect illegal logging, with innovative methods, such as field experiments using an open‐source smartphone app for participatory mapping of local traditional ecological knowledge (TEK). Our research findings, including unexpected ones, are helpful for community development, continuous participatory design, and academic research. This research was developed based on the first author Zhang's multiyear ethnographic field research in Amazonia and on the second author de Silva's local life experiences and action‐research interests.
title_zh: 巴西亚马孙地区利用智能手机、算法和民族志方法参与式设计智慧森林
abstract_zh: 本文报告了在巴西亚马孙的一个州立森林保护区，主要与当地社区居民合作，其次与森林保护区管理人员和环境科学家合作，参与式设计智慧森林项目的情况。智慧森林项目被共同提议使用低成本的数字技术进行森林碳监测和可持续发展。我们的研究包括智慧森林拟议组件的可行性测试和影响评估。它结合了民族志田野调查方法，如关于使用回收智能手机和声音识别算法远程检测非法伐木的访谈和焦点小组，以及创新方法，如使用开源智能手机应用程序进行参与式制图以记录当地传统生态知识的现场实验。我们的研究结果，包括意外发现，有助于社区发展、持续参与式设计和学术研究。这项研究是基于第一作者张在亚马孙多年的民族志田野研究以及第二作者德席尔瓦的当地生活经历和行动研究兴趣开展的。

title: Peasant traders, migrant workers and “supermarkets”: Low‐cost provisions and the reproduction of migrant labor in China
abstract: Abstract This article analyzes the social and spatial dynamics of the mobile trade in low‐cost goods by rural people from a mountainous region of China's Zhejiang province and how these interact with the mobility and social reproductive patterns of the rural–urban migrant workers they cater to. Also formally categorized as peasants, the traders not only supply the goods necessary for the maintenance of the workers but also of their spatially divided household, thus contributing to the reproduction of migrant labor power more generally. In doing so, they assume mobility trajectories that align with those of factory production and experience familial trade‐offs commonly experienced by migrant workers. Meanwhile, the provision of low‐cost goods to migrant workers has enabled a thriving economy employing peasant families for whom agricultural livelihoods slowly disappear. These dynamics indicate the mutual connection between waged and self‐employed labor that works in the interest of capital accumulation at the same time with the differentiation of migrant labor. As in other comparable Asian contexts, their connection lies at the heart of the state‐sponsored production regime premised on the low‐cost reproduction of flexible migrant labor.
title_zh: 农民商人、农民工与“超市”：低成本供应与中国农民工劳动力的再生产
abstract_zh: 本文分析了来自中国浙江省山区农村人口在低成本商品流动贸易中的社会与空间动态，以及这些如何与他们所服务的城乡农民工的流动性和社会再生产模式相互作用。这些商人同样被正式归类为农民，不仅供应维持工人生活所必需的物品，还供应他们空间分割的家庭所需，从而更普遍地促进了农民工劳动力的再生产。在此过程中，他们承担了与工厂生产轨迹一致的流动性轨迹，并经历了农民工常见的生活权衡。同时，向农民工提供低成本商品催生了一个繁荣的经济体，雇佣了那些农业生计逐渐消失的农民家庭。这些动态表明，雇佣劳动和自雇劳动之间的相互联系有利于资本积累，同时农民工劳动也在分化。与其他亚洲情境类似，这种联系是国家主导的生产体制的核心，该体制以灵活农民工劳动力的低成本再生产为前提。

title: Power in consensus: Legitimacy, global value chains and inequality in telecommunications standard‐setting
journal_name: GLOBAL NETWORKS-A JOURNAL OF TRANSNATIONAL AFFAIRS
abstract: Abstract Power is central to GVC research, but the concept is usually restricted to ‘direct’ market power that generates rents. This paper examines ‘diffuse’ conceptualizations of power in GVCs that focus on social construction, arguing that they exist along a continuum from ‘fractured’ to ‘encompassing’. Then, empirically, it shows how different types of power intermix in telecommunications standard‐setting from 1999 to 2021, using a comprehensive dataset of every finalized work item in 3GPP. Given powerful network effects in telecommunications, the industry is ripe for monopolistic rents and unequal value capture on a global scale. However, these are attenuated by a layering of power relations, and particularly, an intermediary form of social construction – legitimacy – which is the primary driver of telecommunications standard‐setting, and a new type of constitutive power in GVCs, alongside governmentality and hegemony. This is illustrated by focusing on two major shifts in legitimacy in 3GPP – the rise of Huawei and network operators. The paper shows how power becomes layered with collective forms of power partially neutralizing inter‐firm forms of dyadic power, which attenuates monopolistic value capture.
title_zh: 共识中的权力：电信标准制定中的合法性、全球价值链与不平等
abstract_zh: 摘要在全球价值链（GVC）研究中，权力是一个核心概念，但通常被局限于产生租金的“直接”市场权力。本文考察了GVC中关注社会建构的“扩散性”权力概念，认为它们存在于从“碎片化”到“包容性”的连续统中。然后，本文利用3GPP中所有最终确定的工作项目的综合数据集，实证展示了1999年至2021年间电信标准制定中不同类型权力如何混合。鉴于电信领域强大的网络效应，该行业容易出现全球范围内的垄断租金和不平等的价值捕获。然而，这些效应被权力的分层所削弱，特别是社会建构的一种中介形式——合法性，它是电信标准制定的主要驱动力，也是GVC中一种新型的构成性权力，与治理性和霸权并列。本文通过聚焦3GPP中合法性的两个重大转变——华为和网络运营商的崛起来说明这一点。本文展示了权力如何分层，集体形式的权力部分中和了企业间的二元权力形式，从而削弱了垄断价值捕获。

title: Real-Time Mapping With Global Positioning Systems Devices in a Mixed Methods Toolkit for Studying Social and Environmental Change
abstract: To explore the process through which people develop knowledge about socioecological change, this article describes a mixed-methods toolkit containing a technique for making maps in real time while moving through landscapes. The quantitative component of the toolkit is grounded in ethnobiologists’ embeddedness in place-based communities and harnesses the power of global positioning systems (GPS). As GPS-wielding ethnobiologists engage in participatory mapping by moving through landscapes with their research collaborators, we can use handheld devices and simultaneously communicate with satellites in outer space to produce maps in real time. Within the existing, large inventory of ethnobiological methods, using handheld GPS devices can be combined with other types of data-collecting techniques to enhance studies of interactions in more-than-human landscapes. Moreover, mapmaking implements movement trace, a tactic for interpreting space-time cultures and documenting grounded experiences with socioecological change. By bringing together interests in the disciplines of ethnobiology and qualitative geographic information systems (GIS), this article describes methods that make it possible to explain the space-time culture that guides people to move through their homelands and to communicate about their experiences even as they work toward integrating and directing the changing circumstances of their lives.
title_zh: 利用全球定位系统设备在混合方法工具箱中实时测绘研究社会与环境变化
abstract_zh: 为了探索人们如何发展关于社会生态变化的知识，本文描述了一个混合方法工具箱，其中包含一种在穿越景观时实时绘制地图的技术。该工具箱的定量部分基于民族生物学家在地方社区中的嵌入性，并利用了全球定位系统（GPS）的力量。当携带GPS的民族生物学家与研究合作者一起穿越景观进行参与式绘图时，我们可以使用手持设备同时与外太空的卫星通信，实时生成地图。在现有的大量民族生物学方法中，使用手持GPS设备可以与其他类型的数据收集技术相结合，以增强对超越人类景观中相互作用的研究。此外，地图制作引入了移动轨迹，这是一种解释时空文化并记录社会生态变化扎根经历的策略。通过结合民族生物学和定性地理信息系统（GIS）学科的兴趣，本文描述了能够解释引导人们穿越家园的时空文化的方法，并沟通他们的经历，即使他们在努力整合和引导生活中变化的环境。

title: Rethinking the dynamic of global production networks: Integrate the influence of suppliers and towards a flexible strategy making causal mechanism

authors.name: Zhi Zheng
institutions: Institute of Geographic Sciences and Natural Resources Research

journal_name: GLOBAL NETWORKS-A JOURNAL OF TRANSNATIONAL AFFAIRS
abstract: Abstract The global production network (GPN) 2.0 framework mainly considers the organizational capabilities of lead firms, neglecting the influence of supplier capabilities on the strategic making of lead firms. I argue that the GPN 2.0 framework must integrate the influence of supplier capabilities (both industrial and individual firm levels) to better explain the organization of the global economy. Industrial‐level capability determines the possible strategic choices that firms may make under certain dynamic combinations, whereas the individual firm level determines the geographic extension direction of GPNs. Therefore, this study incorporates the influence of suppliers and builds a more flexible strategy‐making causal mechanism other than the definitive and limiting causal mechanism in GPN 2.0. I hope this article can promote the further development of GPN 2.0 and convey some valuable concepts to make it perform better in deconstructing the organization of the global economy in the real world.
title_zh: 重新思考全球生产网络的动态：整合供应商影响并构建灵活的战略制定因果机制
abstract_zh: 摘要 全球生产网络（GPN）2.0框架主要考虑领先企业的组织能力，而忽略了供应商能力对领先企业战略制定的影响。我认为，GPN 2.0框架必须整合供应商能力（产业层面和个体企业层面）的影响，以更好地解释全球经济的组织。产业层面的能力决定了企业在特定动态组合下可能做出的战略选择，而个体企业层面则决定了GPN的地理扩展方向。因此，本研究整合了供应商的影响，并构建了一个比GPN 2.0中确定性和限制性的因果机制更为灵活的战略制定因果机制。我希望本文能够促进GPN 2.0的进一步发展，并传达一些有价值的理念，使其在解构现实世界中全球经济的组织时表现更佳。

title: Southern politics, southern power prices: Race, utility regulation, and the value of energy
abstract: Abstract For many middle‐income households, paying the electricity bill is a mundane, even mindless, act. But for an ever‐increasing number of low‐income families, the electricity bill—filtered through the racialized materiality of poor‐quality housing stock and antidemocratic price regulation—represents something more ominous: looming disconnection, eviction, and a deep spin of vulnerabilities. This article explores the materiality of race in the US South through the prism of southern utilities and maps the political landscape on which contestations over the value of energy are taking place. I ask, how do different conceptualizations of value by utilities, regulators, and energy justice advocates figure into the price of energy and racialized dispossession in the Deep South? I draw attention to the highly elaborated narrative politics of the value of Georgia Power's energy. In conversation with recent anthropological debates about value and “the just price,” I argue that Georgia Power's monopoly on public power engages and reinforces the racialized political economy of the South to produce high home energy prices for low‐income families. But it also provokes a decryption of these energy prices by energy justice advocates that connects the silent violence of energy injustice to people's everyday experiences of extractive utility bills.
title_zh: 南方政治，南方电价：种族、公用事业监管与能源价值
abstract_zh: 摘要 对于许多中等收入家庭来说，支付电费是一项平凡甚至无意识的行为。但对于越来越多的低收入家庭来说，电费——通过种族化的劣质住房存量和不民主的价格监管过滤——代表着更不祥的事情：即将断电、驱逐和一系列脆弱性的深渊。本文通过南方公用事业的棱镜探讨了美国南方种族的物质性，并描绘了围绕能源价值争夺所展开的政治图景。我问道，公用事业公司、监管机构和能源正义倡导者对价值的不同概念化如何体现深南地区的能源价格和种族化剥夺？我关注佐治亚电力能源价值的极具精细的叙事政治。与近期关于价值和“公正价格”的人类学辩论对话，我认为佐治亚电力对公共电力的垄断参与并强化了南方的种族化政治经济，从而为低收入家庭带来高昂的家庭能源价格。但它也促使能源正义倡导者对这些能源价格进行解密，将能源不公的无声暴力与人们对剥削性电费账单的日常体验联系起来。

title: Strategic coupling, cross‐scalar tension and local upgrading in the globalizing automotive industry in Guangzhou, China
journal_name: GLOBAL NETWORKS-A JOURNAL OF TRANSNATIONAL AFFAIRS
abstract: Abstract This paper examines how latecomer firms manage to achieve industrial upgrading through strategic coupling with global lead firms in automotive production networks. Drawing upon the example of the Guangzhou Automotive Corporation in southern China, this paper theorizes ‘cross‐scalar tension’ as a key factor to explain why the four cases of strategic coupling between lead firms, the same domestic firm and state ended in different results, from decoupling to a sustainable coupling with local upgrading. This paper contributes to the pertinent literature by demonstrating that cross‐scalar tension is inherent to the nature of global production networks, and unreconciled tension concerning different corporate strategies on technological transfer, localization and product development could lead to decoupling. Importantly, good coordination and matching on corporate strategies between lead and domestic firms could relieve cross‐scalar tensions, thus fostering local industrial upgrading and sustainable strategic coupling.
title_zh: 中国广州全球化汽车产业中的战略耦合、跨尺度张力与地方产业升级
abstract_zh: 本文探讨后发企业如何通过与全球汽车生产网络中的领先企业进行战略耦合来实现产业升级。以中国南方的广州汽车集团为例，本文理论化‘跨尺度张力’作为关键因素，解释领先企业、同一国内企业与国家之间的四种战略耦合案例为何产生不同结果，从解耦到可持续耦合并实现本地升级。本文通过证明跨尺度张力是全球生产网络固有的性质，以及关于技术转让、本地化和产品开发的不同企业战略未解决的张力可能导致解耦，为相关文献做出贡献。重要的是，领先企业与国内企业之间在企业战略上的良好协调与匹配可以缓解跨尺度张力，从而促进本地产业升级和可持续的战略耦合。

title: Technologies of care and the engineering imaginary: Two approaches to assistive device design for the Global South

authors.name: Vaia Y. Sigounas
institutions: University of North Carolina at Chapel Hill

abstract: Assistive devices serve as vectors for the ideals, judgments, and goals that their society of origin has towards people with disabilities. For some Ugandan inventors and prosthetists, familiarity with sociocultural norms and consistent feedback allow them to design prosthetic limbs as technologies of care that specifically meet the needs of Ugandans using these devices. In contrast, many biomedical engineers living in the United States rely on what I call the "engineering imaginary" to produce universalized forms of assistive technology intended for people living in an essentialized Global South. Drawing on research with engineers, prosthetists, and people living with limb loss in Uganda and the United States, I investigate the social and cultural aspects of prosthetic limb design and argue that there is a cross-cultural mismatch about what a prosthetic device does and what kinds of limbs it should fit. This mismatch becomes inscribed in the prosthetic device itself.
title_zh: 关怀技术与工程想象：两种面向全球南方的辅助设备设计方法
abstract_zh: 辅助设备作为其起源社会对残疾人的理想、判断和目标的载体。对于乌干达的一些发明家和假肢矫形师来说，对社会文化规范的熟悉和持续的反馈使他们能够设计出作为关怀技术的假肢，专门满足使用这些设备的乌干达人的需求。相比之下，许多居住在美国的生物医学工程师依赖我称之为“工程想象”的方法，为想象中的本质化的全球南方人群生产通用化的辅助技术。基于对乌干达和美国的工程师、假肢矫形师和肢体缺失者的研究，我探讨了假肢设计的社会和文化方面，并认为关于假肢的功能以及它应该适配哪种肢体，存在跨文化的不匹配。这种不匹配被刻写在假肢设备本身中。

title: Textures of value: Tactility, experience, and exclusion in the cashmere commodity chain
abstract: ABSTRACT Cashmere provides an ideal material for examining how humans co‐opt tangible and intangible qualities into their ascription of value. The fiber's relative worth lies at the intersection of its tangible qualities (e.g., softness, lightness, strength) and intangible qualities (e.g., rarity, history, authenticity, sustainability). Mediating the relationship between those qualities are actors with very different stakes: the families of Mongolian herders who comb goats together each spring, the brokers and buyers who weigh it and feel it to adjudicate it for fashion houses, and the advertisers and marketers who decide what is desirable in global markets of end consumers. This article examines three nodes in the production and circulation of Mongolian cashmere to show how different forms of value—economic, social, linguistic, moral—accrue to material goods and travel, or not, from one context to another. I focus on interactions as moments of qualic evaluation. Here embodied, tactile experiences of qualia—which might seem to be immune to perceptual difference and “outside culture”—in fact differ. The example shows how valuation in a transnational commodity chain depends on both exploiting semiotic gaps in the chain and nonetheless meeting a threshold of commensurability, neither of which is divorceable from physicality.
title_zh: 价值的纹理：羊绒商品链中的触感、体验与排斥
abstract_zh: 摘要：羊绒为研究人类如何将有形和无形品质纳入价值归属提供了理想材料。该纤维的相对价值在于其有形品质（如柔软、轻盈、强度）与无形品质（如稀有性、历史、真实性、可持续性）的交汇。调解这些品质之间关系的是具有不同利益的行动者：每年春天一起梳理山羊的蒙古牧民家庭；为时尚品牌称重、触摸并评判羊绒的经纪人和买家；以及决定全球终端消费者市场中何为理想商品的广告商和营销人员。本文考察了蒙古羊绒生产和流通中的三个节点，以展示不同形式的价值——经济的、社会的、语言的、道德的——如何附着于物质商品，并在不同语境之间流动或不流动。我关注互动作为特性质评价的时刻。在此，具身的、触觉的特质性体验——看似对感知差异免疫且“超越文化”——实际上存在差异。该例子表明，跨国商品链中的估值既依赖于利用链中的符号差距，又需要达到可通约性的阈值，这两者都无法与物质性分离。

title: The Intimate Infopolitics of Township Sociality in Cape Town: Mobile Phones, Mothers, and Respectability

authors.name: Nanna Schneidermann
institutions: Kyiv National University of Culture and Arts

abstract: ABSTRACT: How are young women’s access to and the use of mobile media technologies negotiated and distributed at the urban margins of the tech revolution? This article explores questions and contestations of the legitimate use of phones among women living in township areas on the outskirts of Cape Town, South Africa. I introduce the concept of “intimate infopolitics” to highlight how mobile phones are given meaning and negotiated by and through intimate relations and gendered ideals of knowledge and spatial belonging, condensed in the idea of ordentlikheid (respectability). Paying attention to historical political processes and scale in the gendered access and use of digital media invites researchers to recognize questions of sovereignty and power beyond tech-optimistic discourses on gendered empowerment, and to follow the fraught, partial, and ambiguous processes of managing information and knowledge through media. Hoe word jong vroue se toegang tot en die gebruik van mobiele mediategnologieë onderhandel en versprei by die stedelike grense van die tegnologierevolusie? Hierdie artikel ondersoek vrae en betwistings oor die wettige gebruik van telefone onder vroue wat in township-gebiede aan die buitewyke van Kaapstad, Suid-Afrika woon. Ek stel die konsep van “intieme infopolitiek” bekend om uit te lig hoe selfone betekenis gegee word en onderhandel word deur en deur intieme verhoudings en geslagsideale van kennis en ruimtelike behoort, saamgevat in die idee van ordentlikheid. Aandag te gee aan historiese politieke prosesse en skaal in die geslagtelike toegang en gebruik van digitale media nooi navorsers uit om vrae oor soewereiniteit en mag buite tegnologie-optimistiese diskoerse oor geslagsbemagtiging te erken, en om die belaaide, gedeeltelike en dubbelsinnige prosesse van die bestuur van inligting en kennis deur middel van media.
title_zh: 开普敦乡镇社会性的亲密信息政治：手机、母亲与体面
abstract_zh: 摘要：在科技革命的边缘地带，年轻女性获取和使用移动媒体技术的方式是如何被协商和分配的？本文探讨了南非开普敦郊区乡镇地区女性使用手机的合法性问题。我引入了“亲密信息政治”概念，以强调手机如何通过亲密关系和性别化的知识与空间归属理想（凝结在“体面”观念中）被赋予意义和协商。关注性别化获取和使用数字媒体中的历史政治过程与尺度，邀请研究者超越关于性别赋权的科技乐观主义话语，认识到主权与权力的问题，并追踪通过媒体管理信息和知识的充满争议、片面和模糊的过程。

title: The Sustainability Myth: Environmental Gentrification and the Politics of Justice By MelissaChecker, New York: NYU Press. 2020. 280 pp.
abstract: The Sustainability Myth: Environmental Gentrification and the Politics of Justice showcases the paradoxes that emerge as New York City attempts to reinvent itself as one of the world's most sustainable metropolitan areas.Drawing on over 20 years of research on environmental racism, Melissa Checker takes readers on a historical tour de force of three forms of gentrification -green, industrial, and brown.Checker traces how "environmental gentrification" leads to the uneven distribution of environmental benefits and burdens, and how environmental justice activists, despite their own racial, political, and economic divides, come together to resist sustainability's false promises.Checker employs the concept of "sustainaphrenia" to capture the hidden costs that emerge with heightened attention to sustainability in urban spaces, including the false notion that urban development polices can stimulate economic growth and mitigate climate change, all the while attending to the social justice arm of sustainable development via civic engagement.Much to the contrary, Checker's close analysis of the programs and policies behind Mayor Bloomberg's promises to reinvent NYC through sustainable redevelopment and grant New Yorkers access to a greener, healthier lifestyle and amenities instead had a much more predictable outcome, resulting in the consolidation of wealth and access to green spaces for some and dispossession and environmental inequities for others, which track along racial and economic lines.For the anthropologist-reader, it is important to note that The Sustainability Myth is not a traditional ethnography.Rather, Checker considers the book "an ethnographic approach to a particular trend and moment in time" and "less of an ethnography of a particular place or group" (46).Methodologically, the book draws on archival research (from historical records, policy documents, zoning laws, websites, social media, and the like), combined with ethnographic description from Checker's work, and friendship, with environmental justice activists during public meetings, workshops, collaborative grantwriting, and other social interactions.This approach allows the book to speak to a wide audience, from academics focused on urban studies and environmental justice to lay audiences with interest in the history and transformation of New York City.The Sustainability Myth is comprised of two parts.The first set of chapters are a historical account of the unfolding of the three forms of environmental gentrification: the relationship between public green space and rising property values ("green gentrification"); use of zoning policies to locate "heavy" industrial facilities within marginalized communities ("industrial gentrification"); and incentivizing private developers to clean up and repurpose brownfields to encourage further high-end, luxury development
title_zh: 可持续性神话：环境绅士化与正义政治
abstract_zh: 《可持续性神话：环境绅士化与正义政治》展示了纽约市试图将自己重塑为世界上最具可持续性的大都市区之一时出现的悖论。梅丽莎·查克利用20多年对环境种族主义的研究，带领读者经历三种绅士化形式——绿色、工业和棕色——的历史之旅。查克追溯了“环境绅士化”如何导致环境利益和负担的不均匀分配，以及环境正义活动家尽管存在种族、政治和经济分歧，但仍联合起来抵制可持续性的虚假承诺。查克运用“可持续性精神分裂症”的概念来捕捉城市空间对可持续性高度关注所带来的隐藏成本，包括城市发展政策可以刺激经济增长和缓解气候变化的错误观念，同时通过公民参与来关注可持续发展的社会正义分支。相反，查克对布隆伯格市长承诺通过可持续重建重塑纽约市并让纽约人获得更绿色、更健康的生活方式和便利设施的计划和政策的仔细分析，却得到了一个更可预测的结果：导致财富和绿色空间对某些人的集中，以及对其他人的剥夺和环境不平等，这些沿着种族和经济线追踪。对于人类学读者来说，重要的是要注意《可持续性神话》不是传统的民族志。相反，查克认为这本书是“对特定趋势和时刻的民族志方法”，并且“较少是关于特定地点或群体的民族志”（第46页）。在方法上，这本书借鉴了档案研究（来自历史记录、政策文件、分区法、网站、社交媒体等），并结合了查克在公共会议、研讨会、合作撰写拨款申请和其他社会互动中与环境正义活动家的工作和友谊中的民族志描述。这种方法使这本书能够面向广泛的读者，从专注于城市研究和环境正义的学者到对纽约市历史和转型感兴趣的普通读者。《可持续性神话》由两部分组成。第一章是一组历史叙述，讲述了环境绅士化的三种形式：公共绿地和房地产升值之间的关系（“绿色绅士化”）；利用分区政策将“重”工业设施定位在边缘化社区内（“工业绅士化”）；以及激励私人开发商清理和再利用棕地，以鼓励进一步的高端豪华开发。

title: Trust as affective infrastructure
abstract: Abstract What is trust to a mining company? This article interrogates the effects of conceptualising trust as essential infrastructure for large-scale extractive operations. Although sentiments like trust are typically imagined to fall outside the firm's purview, mining companies actively blur distinctions between economic-material and social-emotional realms when they draw on intimate social forms like kin networks and communal authority to mould trust into an expendable factor of mineral production. But rather than transforming trust into a discrete, predictable input, firms have unexpectedly manufactured its opposite: desconfianza , or distrust. My study shows how residents affected by mining navigate this distrust by attempting to construct clear boundaries between themselves and the mine. In the process, they reveal the unruly sentiments underlying the operations of extractive capitalism.
title_zh: 信任作为情感基础设施
abstract_zh: 摘要信任对采矿公司意味着什么？本文探讨了将信任概念化为大规模开采作业的基本基础设施的影响。尽管像信任这样的情感通常被认为超出企业的范围，但采矿公司积极模糊经济-物质和社会-情感领域之间的界限，利用亲属网络和社区权威等亲密的社会形式，将信任塑造成矿产生产中的一种可消耗因素。然而，企业非但没有将信任转变为一种离散的、可预测的投入，反而意外地制造了它的对立面：不信任。我的研究展示了受采矿影响的居民如何通过试图在自己与矿山之间建立清晰的界限来应对这种不信任。在此过程中，他们揭示了开采资本主义运作背后难以驾驭的情感。

title: Une gouvernance sanitaire agile ? L’expérience des drones médicaux dans la gestion de la pandémie du Covid-19 au Ghana

authors.name: Georges Macaire Eyenga
institutions: Institute for Social and Economic Research

abstract: En 2020, le Ghana devient le premier pays au monde à utiliser les drones de Zipline pour livrer des échantillons de test Covid-19 au Noguchi Memorial Institute, le plus grand laboratoire d’analyse médicale du pays. Les entités qui participent à cette expérimentation veulent trouver rapidement des solutions logistiques et managériales pour contrôler la pandémie. Sur le plan de la recherche, les études menées à cette période abordent de nombreux aspects de la crise, mais ignorent les laboratoires qui produisent des données sur la pandémie et qui de ce fait, se retrouvent au cœur des politiques d’urgence sanitaire. L’exemple du Noguchi Memorial Institute permet pourtant de déceler le développement en cours de pratiques agiles au fondement de la gouvernance de la santé aujourd’hui. À partir d’une ethnographie menée un an après la pandémie à Accra, et qui s’appuie sur les récentes recherches sur la santé globale, les infrastructures et les expérimentations technologiques en Afrique, cet article rend compte de la manière dont la logistique instantanée des drones transforme l’expérience de la recherche biomédicale dans des contextes d’urgence. Il montre que l’adoption des drones fait émerger une gouvernance agile avec, pour conséquences, la redéfinition de la vie de laboratoire et l’émergence d’imaginaires de meilleurs soins de santé.
title_zh: 敏捷的卫生治理？加纳应对新冠疫情期间医疗无人机的经验
keywords_zh: 严重急性呼吸综合征冠状病毒2(SARS-CoV-2)
abstract_zh: 2020年，加纳成为世界上第一个使用Zipline无人机向该国最大的医学分析实验室Noguchi纪念研究所运送Covid-19检测样本的国家。参与这一实验的实体希望快速找到物流和管理解决方案以控制疫情。在研究层面，这一时期开展的研究涉及危机的许多方面，但忽略了生产流行病数据的实验室，而这些实验室因此处于紧急卫生政策的核心。然而，Noguchi纪念研究所的例子揭示了当今健康治理基础中敏捷实践的发展。基于疫情一年后在阿克拉进行的民族志研究，并借鉴近期关于全球健康、基础设施和非洲技术实验的研究，本文阐述了无人机的即时物流如何在紧急情况下改变生物医学研究的体验。文章表明，无人机的采用催生了一种敏捷治理，其后果是重新定义了实验室生活，并催生了对更好医疗保健的想象。

title: ‘We deserve new things’: (anti-)bricolage in Lomé’s makerspaces
abstract: Abstract This article traces bricolage in the city of Lomé, Togo, as it is given meaning, practised and resisted by the ‘makers’ involved in the city’s makerspaces. While the Lévi-Straussian definition of bricolage as ‘making do’ given limited resources is heralded as an innovative practice in the Euro-American Maker Movement, Lomé’s makers appear to distance themselves from the concept due to its perceived stigmatization in both Lomé and Francophone Africa as a devalued survival practice through improvisation. Through their identification as ‘makers but not bricoleurs ’, and their expression ‘we deserve new things’, I unpack the ambiguous relationship Lomé’s makers have with bricolage, and how their disavowal of the concept reveals more about the global infrastructural inequalities that surround it. By foregrounding the critical self-awareness of Lomé’s makers, I explore how ethnography allows for the de-centring and decolonization of foundational concepts and ideologies, as the makers challenge and reclaim bricolage to arrive at a future where it is no longer a necessity but a choice.
title_zh: “我们值得拥有新东西”：洛美创客空间中的（反）拼装实践
abstract_zh: 本文追踪了多哥洛美市中“创客”如何赋予“拼装”以意义、实践并抵制这一概念。尽管列维-斯特劳斯定义的拼装（即用有限资源“凑合”）在欧美创客运动中被视为一种创新实践，但洛美的创客似乎与此概念保持距离，因为在洛美和法语非洲，拼装常被视为一种通过即兴创作维持生存的贬低性做法。通过他们自认为“创客而非拼装者”的身份认同，以及“我们值得拥有新东西”的表达，我揭示了洛美创客对拼装的矛盾关系，以及他们否认这一概念如何揭示出围绕它的全球基础设施不平等。通过突显洛美创客的批判性自我意识，我探讨了民族志如何允许对基础概念和意识形态的去中心化和去殖民化，因为创客们挑战并重新定义拼装，以期达到一个拼装不再是必需品而是选择的未来。

title: Digicel! Topap long ples ia! An international telecommunications company making itself at home in the urban landscapes of Vanuatu, Samoa and Tonga

authors.name: Tereise Vaifale
institutions: University of the South Pacific - Samoa Campus

abstract: Abstract Mobile phone usage has increased at an unprecedented rate across the Pacific over the past 10–15 years, radically transforming the way communication takes place. The catalyst for this transformation is generally attributed to the breakdown of monopolies previously held by national telecom corporations over their own domestic markets, and the entrance of one particular new provider, Digicel. This paper examines the strategies through which Digicel has managed to insert itself into the visual landscape of the urban spaces of Vanuatu, Samoa and Tonga. Through multimodal analysis of digital photographs from the landscapes of these countries' capital cities, the paper shows how the global company makes use of a range of techniques to establish its own place and identity as a local network. These techniques include the demonstration of largesse and dominance over competitors, slogans that stake a claim to belonging, and the use of local language terms and images that juxtapose the local with the global. Through these techniques, Digicel manages to position itself simultaneously as the provider both of fast and reliable global communication technologies and of a truly local, national service, while also radically transforming the physical spaces of our cities as it has made itself at home here.
title_zh: Digicel！在这里安家！一家国际电信公司在瓦努阿图、萨摩亚和汤加的城市景观中打造本地归属
abstract_zh: 摘要 在过去的10-15年间，太平洋地区的手机使用率以前所未有的速度增长，彻底改变了通信方式。这一转变通常归因于国家电信公司此前在国内市场垄断的瓦解，以及一家特定新供应商Digicel的进入。本文考察了Digicel成功融入瓦努阿图、萨摩亚和汤加城市空间视觉景观的策略。通过对这些国家首都城市景观数字照片的多模态分析，本文展示了这家全球公司如何利用一系列技术来建立自己作为本地网络的地位和身份。这些技术包括展示慷慨和对竞争对手的主导地位、宣称归属感的口号，以及使用当地语言术语和将本地与全球并置的图像。通过这些技术，Digicel成功地同时将自己定位为快速可靠的全球通信技术的提供商和真正本地化的国家服务商，同时随着它在此处安家，也彻底改变了我们城市的物理空间。

title: Chinese goods and mass consumption in Africa: cultural appropriation of Chinese motorcycles in Burkina Faso
abstract: This paper deals with the arrival of Chinese-made goods as one of the main vectors of African societies’ entrance into mass consumption logics. However, it proposes going beyond the dominant monocausal approach, which only relates the consumption of these goods to their low price. To do so, this paper emphasizes a careful observation of consumer practices to unveil the complex process of ‘domestication’ that African consumers carry out on these goods daily (Sahlins, M. D. 1993. “Goodbye to Tristes Tropes: Ethnography in the Context of Modern World History.” The Journal of Modern History 65 (1): 1–25; Warnier, J.-P. 1994. Le paradoxe de la marchandise authentique: Imaginaire et consommation de masse. Paris: L’Harmattan). To this end, we focus our attention on the case of Chinese motorcycles in Burkina Faso. Historically the most imported Chinese good in Burkina Faso, motorcycles are at the centre of a multitude of practices and social representations. After placing the arrival of these bikes in the historicity of the cyclo-distinction, this paper presents the many ways in which Chinese motorcycles – though less expensive – are socially and symbolically valued by Burkinabe consumers. Initially considered symbols of a new ‘modernity’, the aesthetic and technical characteristics of Chinese motorcycles gradually became a standard shared by all imported models. The multiplication of importers and models accompanied a growing complexity of symbolic values and distinction logics, in which the growing role of the ‘new figures of success’ (Banégas, R., and J.-P. Warnier. 2001. “Nouvelles figures de la réussite et du pouvoir.” Politique Africaine 82 (2): 5–23) was expressed. In the context of mounting uncertainty surrounding the new distinctive codes and an acceleration of the symbolic obsolescence of motorcycles, ‘novelty’ became the new reference value and frequently replacing possessions a key element of social value, and therefore a central rule of distinction. Thus, a focus on the process of ‘cultural appropriation’ of Chinese goods allows us to distance ourselves from a financially captive interpretation of African consumption to unveil the social determinants of Africa’s entry into mass consumption logics.
title_zh: 中国商品与非洲的大众消费：布基纳法索中国摩托车的文化挪用
abstract_zh: 本文探讨中国制造商品作为非洲社会进入大众消费逻辑的主要载体之一。然而，本文主张超越仅将此类商品的消费与其低价联系起来的单一因果主导方法。为此，本文强调仔细观察消费者的实践，以揭示非洲消费者日常对这些商品进行的复杂‘驯化’过程（Sahlins, M. D. 1993. “Goodbye to Tristes Tropes: Ethnography in the Context of Modern World History.” The Journal of Modern History 65 (1): 1–25; Warnier, J.-P. 1994. Le paradoxe de la marchandise authentique: Imaginaire et consommation de masse. Paris: L’Harmattan）。为此，我们将关注点聚焦于布基纳法索的中国摩托车案例。作为布基纳法索历史上进口最多的中国商品，摩托车处于众多实践和社会表征的中心。在将这些摩托车的到来置于循环区分的史实中后，本文介绍了布基纳法索消费者如何在社交和象征上赋予中国摩托车（尽管价格较低）价值。最初被视为新‘现代性’的象征，中国摩托车的美学和技术特征逐渐成为所有进口型号共享的标准。进口商和型号的增多伴随着象征价值和区分逻辑的日益复杂，其中‘新兴成功人物’的作用日益凸显（Banégas, R., and J.-P. Warnier. 2001. “Nouvelles figures de la réussite et du pouvoir.” Politique Africaine 82 (2): 5–23）。在围绕新的区分符号的不确定性加剧以及摩托车象征性淘汰加速的背景下，‘新奇’成为新的参考价值，频繁更换财产成为社会价值的关键要素，因此也成为区分的核心规则。因此，关注中国商品‘文化挪用’的过程使我们能够摆脱对非洲消费的金钱至上解释，从而揭示非洲进入大众消费逻辑的社会决定因素。

title: Co-constructing fashion in a South–South context: selling Chinese-made garments and textiles in Mozambique
abstract: Based on ethnographic fieldwork in Mozambique (in 2017 and 2019) and China (in 2019), this paper looks at the ways that Chinese garments and textiles are presented and promoted as being fashionable in everyday business interactions in Mozambique. It explores how fashion is mediated in informal, South–South contexts that are largely detached from Euro–American fashion systems. Several different groups make use of their own specific strengths and advantages – be it access to capital and networks, long-term trading experience, business expertise, or an intimate knowledge of local tastes and trends – to sell Chinese-made clothes, shoes, and fabrics in Mozambique. These groups include Indian traders, West African individual traders, Chinese entrepreneurs, Chinese textile companies, and since recently, young Mozambicans, including women, who see the availability and affordability of Chinese-made products as an opportunity to start their own businesses. These diverse actors partly complement and partly contradict each other in mediating the fashionability of Chinese-made products, while jointly constructing them as fashion. Through this unintentional co-construction, the groups selling Chinese-made garments and textiles in Mozambique carve out market niches for themselves, stimulate local dress culture, and diversify the way fashion mediation is understood, adding a South–South perspective to it.
title_zh: 在南南背景下共同构建时尚：在莫桑比克销售中国制造的服装和纺织品
abstract_zh: 基于在莫桑比克（2017年和2019年）和中国（2019年）的民族志田野调查，本文考察了在莫桑比克的日常商业互动中，中国服装和纺织品如何被呈现和推广为时尚。它探讨了时尚如何在很大程度上脱离欧美时尚体系的南南非正式背景下被中介。多个不同的群体利用各自特定的优势和长处——无论是资本和网络渠道、长期贸易经验、商业专业知识，还是对当地品味和趋势的深入了解——在莫桑比克销售中国制造的服装、鞋子和面料。这些群体包括印度商人、西非个体商人、中国企业家、中国纺织公司，以及最近加入的年轻莫桑比克人，包括女性，她们将中国制造产品的可获得性和可负担性视为创业的机会。这些多样化的行动者在中介中国制造产品的时尚性方面部分互补、部分矛盾，同时共同将其构建为时尚。通过这种无意的共同构建，在莫桑比克销售中国服装和纺织品的群体为自己开辟了市场利基，激发了当地着装文化，并使时尚中介的理解方式多样化，为其增加了南南视角。

title: Confronting global infrastructural capitalism: the triple logic of the 'vanguard' and its inevitable spatial and class contradictions in China's high-speed rail program
abstract: We take infrastructure as a ‘keyword’ in foregrounding the production and the reproduction of contemporary capitalism as well as its complexities and contradictions. To tease out the capitalist dynamics of the contemporary moment as infrastructural capitalism, this paper moves beyond a dichotomous constellation of the logic of capital and the territorial logic of power, to argue how a triple logic- capital, power, and culture informs the cultural politics, attempting to simultaneously resolve the economic crisis and glorify China’s fast-speed capitalism. As the vanguard of Chinese infrastructural politics, the high-speed rail spearheads the Chinese spatial economic system towards one that is not an alternative to capitalism but, at best, a variegated form of moving capitalism, which we call infrastructural capitalism. Illuminating the political role of the infrastructural projects in creating invisible social contradictions, this article highlights a wide array of affected working-class masses who take individual and collective actions that result in the reversion of ‘the vanguard’, dissolving the condensation of the materiality of infrastructural capitalism into the global assemblage of unpredictable but inescapable contradictions driving China into global imperial rivalries and class conflicts. (178 words)
title_zh: 对抗全球基础设施资本主义：中国高铁项目中“先锋”的三重逻辑及其不可避免的空间和阶级矛盾
abstract_zh: 我们将基础设施视为一个“关键词”，用以凸显当代资本主义的生产与再生产及其复杂性和矛盾。为了揭示当代时刻的资本主义动力即基础设施资本主义，本文超越了资本逻辑与权力领土逻辑的二元对立，提出一种三重逻辑——资本、权力和文化——如何影响文化政治，试图同时解决经济危机并美化中国的快速资本主义。作为中国基础设施政治的先锋，高铁引领中国的空间经济体系走向一种并非资本主义的替代方案，而最多是移动资本主义的变体形式，我们称之为基础设施资本主义。通过阐明基础设施项目在制造隐形社会矛盾中的政治作用，本文强调了受影响的工人阶级大众采取个人和集体行动，导致“先锋”的逆转，将基础设施资本主义物质性的凝结消解为全球拼凑中不可预测但不可避免的矛盾，推动中国进入全球帝国竞争和阶级冲突之中。

title: Disrupting ‘a man's world’: gender, technology, and class in Vietnam's global heavy industry
journal_name: JOURNAL OF THE ROYAL ANTHROPOLOGICAL INSTITUTE
abstract: Abstract Only rarely is Vietnam's global heavy industry studied from an anthropological perspective in either its gender or its class dimensions. This article contributes new insights into the ways in which the interagential dynamics of gender and technology from shopfloor to engineer offices coproduce social orders in contesting and perpetuating essentializing notions of femininity and masculinity. Blue‐collar and white‐collar women working in heavy industrial workplaces represent a minority in ‘a man's world’, ambiguously both disidentifying and identifying with notions of a typical ‘female character’ vis‐à‐vis ‘male character’. Women working in heavy industry, the article shows, generate ‘disruption’ by reconfiguring conventions regarding gendered occupation, redefining gendered engagement with technology, and recalibrating images of femininity and masculinity. Doing so means carving out new opportunities and/or provoking crisis in a patrilineal universe. The article analyses the intricate ways in which women's engagement with technology is empowering while simultaneously reinforcing gender‐ and class‐specific inequalities in socialist Vietnam's global market economy.
title_zh: 颠覆“男人的世界”：越南全球重工业中的性别、技术与阶级
abstract_zh: 摘要：越南的全球重工业很少从人类学的视角研究其性别或阶级维度。本文提供了新的见解，探讨了从车间到工程师办公室的性别与技术的互动动力如何在社会秩序中共同产生，并在竞争和延续本质化的女性气质和男性气质观念中发挥作用。在重工业工作场所中，蓝领和白领女性在“男人的世界”中属于少数，她们既与典型的“女性特征”相对“男性特征”的观念存在不认同又存在认同。本文表明，在重工业工作的女性通过重新配置关于性别职业的惯例、重新定义与技术相关的性别参与以及重新调整女性气质和男性气质的形象，制造了“颠覆”。这样做意味着在父系世界中开辟新的机会和/或引发危机。本文分析了女性与技术接触的复杂方式，这些方式既赋予女性权力，同时又加强了社会主义越南全球市场经济中特定的性别和阶级不平等。

title: Emerging positions of German firms in the industrial internet of things: A global technological ecosystem perspective
journal_name: GLOBAL NETWORKS-A JOURNAL OF TRANSNATIONAL AFFAIRS
abstract: Abstract The industrial internet of things (IIoT) has created entirely new inter‐firm competitive and collaborative dynamics that focus on the supply of digital infrastructures, services and platforms for industrial users. These dynamics typically involve machinery builders, information technology suppliers and traditional technology buyers from various asset‐intensive sectors. Given the global character of IIoT technology, transnationally relevant inter‐firm arrangements have emerged for which we still lack a conceptually grounded understanding. This study addresses this research gap from the German perspective by combining the concepts of global value chains and complex technical systems. Empirically, we develop a multiple case study of established German firms that have provided IIoT technologies in the domain of ‘smart manufacturing.’ We investigate the firms’ evolving positions within the multi‐layered IIoT stack and explore their technological dependency on global cloud‐infrastructure suppliers. Second, we put the case study into the context of the recent German industrial‐policy initiatives related to the discourse of ‘digital sovereignty’, which attempt to improve the positions of domestic actors vis‐à‐vis the multi‐national tech companies. Conceptually, this study offers the framework of global technological ecosystems as a new perspective on the transnational platform economy, which highlights the enabling character of global‐scale digital infrastructures and acknowledges active involvement of non‐firm actors in ecosystem governance.
title_zh: 德国企业在工业物联网中的新兴定位：全球技术生态系统视角
abstract_zh: 摘要：工业物联网（IIoT）创造了全新的企业间竞争与合作动态，这些动态聚焦于为工业用户提供数字基础设施、服务和平台。这些动态通常涉及机械制造商、信息技术供应商以及来自各种资产密集型行业的传统技术买家。鉴于IIoT技术的全球性，出现了跨国相关的企业间安排，而我们对此仍缺乏概念上的理解。本研究从德国视角出发，结合全球价值链和复杂技术系统的概念，填补了这一研究空白。实证上，我们针对在“智能制造”领域提供IIoT技术的成熟德国企业开展了多案例研究。我们调查了企业在多层IIoT堆栈中不断变化的定位，并探讨了它们对全球云基础设施供应商的技术依赖。其次，我们将案例研究置于近期与“数字主权”话语相关的德国产业政策倡议背景下，这些倡议试图提升国内行为体相对于跨国科技公司的地位。概念上，本研究提供了全球技术生态系统框架作为跨国平台经济的新视角，该框架突显了全球规模数字基础设施的使能特性，并承认非企业行为体在生态系统治理中的积极参与。

title: Feral Atlas: The More-Than-Human Anthropocene ed. by Anna L. Tsing et al.
abstract: Reviewed by: Feral Atlas: The More-Than-Human Anthropocene ed. by Anna L. Tsing et al. Elexis Trinity Williams Tsing, Anna L., Jennifer Deger, Alder Keleman Saxena, and Feifei Zhou, eds. Feral Atlas: The More-Than-Human Anthropocene. Redwood City, CA: Stanford University Press, 2021. Playful disorientation is perhaps your first hint: this is not scholarship as usual. A white page opens on the cluttered desktop landscape of the computer screen, populated by colorful illustrations of fire, kudzu, and an emerald ash borer. One is compelled by the visual sensuality of the experience to sit with it for a moment, to "stay with the trouble," as Donna Haraway (2016) might say, of exploring the patchy problematics of the Anthropocene. Attending to the materiality of land, water, and atmosphere-transforming projects, this transdisciplinary anthology centers four historical concurrences at the intersection of human and nonhuman activity, described as "Anthropocene Detonators": invasion, empire, capital, and acceleration. Here there be monsters, certainly, but perhaps also opportunities for responsiveness and responsibility. One encounters, mingling on the landing page, a host of feral entities in motion: toxic fog, antibiotics, comb jellies, anti-fouling paint, bee villains. Each is associated with one of the four detonators that structure the project. These focal points are accompanied by one of 79 field reports representing a window into a different multispecies ecology that proliferates in the intermingling trails of human infrastructures and nonhuman entities. In the upper left-hand corner, an illustrated master key directs the reader to an index of related cases and concepts. It is a feature which contributes to the sense in which the project registers as an atlas, further articulating its virtual spatiality by introducing a reading room in which texts and other [End Page 719] media are organized by type and conceptual analytic. Among these analytic frames, one finds Tippers—described as "modes of infrastructure-mediated state change"1—and Feral Qualities, which identify ecologies and entities that flourish in the context of human disturbance, proliferating in toxic environments or stowing away in industrial infrastructures. Such qualities are identified by their compatibility and potential for imagining otherwise, with rather than against the realities of the Anthropocene. Click on the mobile icon of dry, cracking ground titled "ghost water," for example, and you will be drawn deeper into iterations of the linked concepts of smoothness and speed in relationship to empire. These elements of change are used to structure explorations of the myriad processes by which the "smooth surfaces of land and water have enabled colonial governance and industrial development [sponsoring]…more than human invasions" and accelerating processes which open "portals for feral effects, and [block] the healing of local ecologies by denying them time" for more subtle adaptations.2 Drawing together transport infrastructure, water, and state power within the framework of the non-innocent but potential-bearing effects of technoscientific acceleration in this one strand, the reader moves beyond the analytic limitations of the "entity" itself toward a layered, polyphonic inquiry of the relations which occur among human projects, living, and nonliving beings. This, we are to understand as a function of reading the dynamic intersection of smoothness and speed as a Tipper. Grounded in a particular time and place, each of the Tippers represents analytic meditations on the relational processes by which infrastructural efforts shape change. Like the choose-your-own-adventure novels of the 1980s, Feral Atlas teases its possibilities and structures its interactive experience so that you may play with its pieces however you choose, but the concepts are all embedded in rich relations of multispecies complexity and transformation. As both readers and players in this visual entanglement, we are invited to explore what it means to map, interpret, or intervene in the ruination and the promise of the Anthropocene—its infrastructural effects and the opportunities for imagining otherwise that lay deep in the weeds (or the semi-wilds) where human tracks are everywhere evident but do not dominate the landscape of the possible. Beyond its layered interface and the hypertextual user experience, one finds in Feral Atlas something of a guide to the places, processes, and interactions by which feral ecologies spring up. It is an accessible tool for disciplining...
title_zh: 《野性地图集：超越人类的人类世》
abstract_zh: 评论：Anna L. Tsing等人编辑的《野性地图集：超越人类的人类世》。Elexis Trinity Williams Tsing, Anna L., Jennifer Deger, Alder Keleman Saxena, 和 Feifei Zhou 编。《野性地图集：超越人类的人类世》。Redwood City, CA: Stanford University Press, 2021。也许你的第一印象是俏皮的迷失感：这不是普通的学术作品。白色的页面上打开了一个杂乱无章的电脑桌面景观，充满了火、葛藤和绿灰虫的彩色插图。视觉上的感官体验迫使你稍作停留，正如Donna Haraway（2016）可能会说的那样，“与麻烦共处”，探索人类世杂乱无章的问题。关注土地、水和大气改造项目的物质性，这个跨学科文集聚焦于人类与非人类活动交叉点的四个历史并发事件，被称为“人类世引爆器”：入侵、帝国、资本和加速。这里当然有怪物，但也许也有响应和责任的机会。在登陆页面上，你会遇到一群流动的野性实体：有毒雾、抗生素、栉水母、防污漆、蜜蜂恶棍。每个都与构建该项目的四个引爆器之一相关联。这些焦点伴随着79份田野报告中的一份，代表了一扇窗，可以看到在人类基础设施和非人类实体交织轨迹中繁衍的不同多物种生态。左上角，一个插图的万能钥匙引导读者进入相关案例和概念的索引。这个功能有助于该项目作为一个地图集的整体感，通过引入一个按类型和概念分析组织文本和其他媒体的阅览室，进一步阐明了其虚拟空间性。在这些分析框架中，人们发现了“倾覆者”——被描述为“基础设施介导的状态改变模式”——以及“野性特质”，它们识别出在人类干扰背景下繁荣的生态和实体，在有毒环境中繁殖或藏身于工业基础设施中。这些特质通过其兼容性和想象其他可能性的潜力被识别，与人类世的现实共生而非对抗。例如，点击标有“幽灵水”的干裂地面图标，你将被吸引到与帝国相关的平滑性和速度概念的迭代中。这些变化的元素被用来探索各种过程，通过这些过程，“土地和水面的平滑表面使殖民治理和工业发展成为可能，……促进了非人类入侵”，并加速了过程，打开了“野性效应的门户，并通过否认它们进行更微妙适应的时间来阻碍当地生态的恢复”。在这一线索中，将交通基础设施、水与国家权力结合在一起，置于技术科学加速的非天真但具有潜力的效应框架内，读者超越了“实体”本身的分析局限，走向了对人类项目、有生命和无生命存在之间关系的多层次、复调探究。这应被理解为阅读平滑性和速度作为“倾覆者”的动态交叉点的功能。每个“倾覆者”都植根于特定的时间和地点，代表了关于基础设施努力如何塑造变化的关系过程的分析沉思。像1980年代的自行选择冒险小说一样，《野性地图集》挑逗其可能性，并构建其互动体验，以便你可以随意组合其碎片，但概念都嵌入在多物种复杂性和转变的丰富关系中。作为这种视觉纠缠中的读者和玩家，我们被邀请探索在人类世的破坏和承诺——其基础设施效应和深藏在杂草（或半野生）中人类痕迹随处可见但并未主宰可能景观的想象其他可能性的机会——中绘图、解释或干预意味着什么。在其分层界面和超文本用户体验之外，人们在《野性地图集》中找到了某种指南，指向野性生态涌现的地方、过程和互动。这是一个易于使用的工具，用于训练……

title: Fragile connections: Community computer networks, human infrastructures, and the consequences of their breakdown in Havana
abstract: Abstract To compensate for their lack of internet access, Cuban video game enthusiasts and programmers have built vast grassroots computer networks, the biggest of which, SNET (Street Network), at one point connected tens of thousands of households across Havana. This vernacular infrastructure generated not only new means of access but also new relations between people and fostered new political subjectivities. SNET is heavily shaped by a local cultural ideology of resolver , of collectively navigating resources and limitations in a context of scarcity. Using the metaphor of modding (modifying), a communal practice within gaming cultures that describes alterations by players or fans that change the look or functionality of a video game, we show how SNET makers were forced to constantly adapt to the shifting technical, political, and social frameworks in Cuba. Expanding anthropological theory on infrastructures that shows how breakdown in many parts of the world is a constitutive part of how people experience them, we argue that makers of human infrastructures such as SNET must not only deal with material breakdown but also navigate the breakdown of social relationships.
title_zh: 脆弱的连接：哈瓦那的社区计算机网络、人力基础设施及其崩溃的后果
abstract_zh: 为了弥补互联网接入的匮乏，古巴电子游戏爱好者和程序员建立了庞大的草根计算机网络，其中最大的SNET（街道网络）曾一度连接了哈瓦那数万户家庭。这种本土基础设施不仅创造了新的接入方式，还产生了人与人之间的新关系，并培养了新的政治主体性。SNET深受当地解决（resolver）文化意识形态的影响，即在资源匮乏的背景下集体调配资源和克服局限。借助改装（modding）的隐喻——一种游戏文化中的集体实践，指玩家或粉丝改动电子游戏外观或功能的行为——我们展示了SNET制造者如何被迫不断适应古巴不断变化的技术、政治和社会框架。通过扩展人类学基础设施理论（该理论表明在世界许多地方，崩溃是人们体验基础设施的组成部分），我们认为，像SNET这样的人力基础设施的制造者不仅必须应对物质性的崩溃，还必须应对社会关系的破裂。

title: La instalación de la minería de litio en el Salar de Atacama y su relación inicial con las comunidades atacameñas: obreros, campamentos y asistencialismo (Chile, 1962-1998)

authors.name: Rodrigo Azócar
institutions: Centre de Recherche et de Documentation sur les Amériques

abstract: The Salar de Atacama lithium deposit was South America's first brine mining site. The arrival of non-metallic mining in the 1980s and 1990s interrupted the diverse cultural practices that the Atacameño communities had previously established around this shared asset. This article aims to understand this territorial transformation by analyzing the ties between the local communities and the Salar de Atacama ecosystem prior to the arrival of lithium mining, the installation process and the industry’s early relationship with the Atacameño people. It proposes a periodization that spans from 1962 to 1998 and includes the discovery of the deposit, exploration, mine construction and the initial production phase. Theoretically, the phenomenon is interpreted through the concepts of commons and extractivism. In methodological terms, a review of press archives, ethnography and secondary sources form the basis for this qualitative research. We conclude that the meta-narrative of progress and development through mining did not materialize in this initial stage. However, the communities did have to face the first socio-environmental consequences of mining based on dispossession.
title_zh: 阿塔卡马盐沼锂矿开采的建立及其与阿塔卡梅尼奥社区的最初关系：工人、营地与福利主义（智利，1962-1998）
abstract_zh: 阿塔卡马盐沼锂矿床是南美洲第一个卤水开采矿场。20世纪80年代和90年代非金属采矿的到来，中断了阿塔卡梅尼奥社区此前围绕这一共享资产建立的多样化文化实践。本文旨在通过分析当地社区在锂矿开采前与阿塔卡马盐沼生态系统的联系、采矿设施的建立过程以及该行业与阿塔卡梅尼奥人的早期关系，来理解这一领土转型。它提出一个从1962年至1998年的分期，包括矿床发现、勘探、矿山建设和初始生产阶段。理论上，通过公地和采掘主义概念来解读这一现象。在方法上，对新闻档案、民族志和二手资料的回顾构成了这项定性研究的基础。我们得出结论：通过采矿实现进步与发展的元叙事在这一初始阶段并未实现。然而，社区确实不得不面对基于剥夺的采矿所带来的首批社会环境影响。

title: Labour, Incorporated: Dependent Contracting and Wageless Work in Africa’s “Responsible” Mines

authors.name: Filipe Calvão
institutions: Graduate Institute of International and Development Studies

abstract: This article examines the growing corporate reliance on artisanal labour in the cobalt mines of the Democratic Republic of Congo. This shift from autonomous miners to corporate contractors, we suggest, holds historical significance and augurs a radical break with contemporary modes of extractive production. Under the banner of “responsible mining,” this form of dependent contracting fosters wageless relations in exchange for legal access to mining sites and corporate monopoly over artisanal production. By analysing the roots and mechanisms underlying these cooperative-corporate partnerships, we describe this emergent relation between labour and capital around three key features: the role of cooperatives as labour platforms, corporate control over local markets, and the deployment of discursive and technological regimes of responsibility and traceability.
title_zh: 劳动公司：非洲“负责任”矿山中的依赖承包与无工资劳动
abstract_zh: 本文考察了企业日益依赖刚果民主共和国钴矿中的手工劳动的现象。我们认为，这种从自主矿工到企业承包商的转变具有历史意义，并预示着当代开采生产模式的根本性断裂。在“负责任采矿”的旗帜下，这种形式的依赖承包以获取矿场法律准入和企业对手工生产的垄断为交换，培育了无工资关系。通过分析这些合作-企业伙伴关系的根源和机制，我们围绕三个关键特征描述了这种劳动与资本之间的新兴关系：合作社作为劳动平台的作用、企业对当地市场的控制，以及责任与可追溯性的话语和技术机制的部署。

title: Language in Medical Worlds: Hearing Technology for Deaf Jordanian Children
abstract: Bringing together medical and linguistic anthropology, I examine the provision of hearing technology, such as cochlear implants, to deaf Jordanian children, a project animated by an imperative to make deaf children speak. Drawing upon ethnographic fieldwork at a cochlear implantation initiative and an audiology department in Amman, I argue that this imperative must be understood in relation to anxieties about the status of Arabic in Jordan and the historical value of orality in the Middle East. This case shows that more attention must be paid to the role of language ideologies in co-constituting medical encounters between clinicians, parents, and patients.[Formula: see text].
title_zh: 医疗世界中的语言：约旦失聪儿童听觉技术
abstract_zh: 结合医学人类学和语言人类学，我考察了向约旦失聪儿童提供听觉技术（如人工耳蜗植入）的情况，该项目的动力是让失聪儿童说话。基于在安曼一个人工耳蜗植入项目和一个听力学科室的民族志田野调查，我认为这种必需性必须联系到对阿拉伯语在约旦地位的焦虑以及口述性在中东的历史价值来理解。这个案例表明，必须更加关注语言意识形态在共同构成临床医生、父母和患者之间医疗遭遇中的作用。[公式: 见原文]。

title: Linking power and inequality in global value chains
journal_name: GLOBAL NETWORKS-A JOURNAL OF TRANSNATIONAL AFFAIRS
abstract: Abstract There is increasing interest in the study of globalization on whether the emergence and consolidation of global value chains (GVCs) have exacerbated inequalities within and across nations and/or how GVCs may be leveraged to mitigate them. Although power asymmetries have been identified as a central factor shaping (un)successful GVC participation, dominant discourses still disregard the links between power and inequality or use these concepts interchangeably. In this article, we provide an analytical approach to GVC‐related inequalities ( within , along and through value chains) and examine how they may co‐evolve with different types of power (bargaining, demonstrative, institutional and constitutive). We apply this approach to the case study of the hake value chain in South Africa to illustrate how existing inequalities are manifested, challenged, mitigated or exacerbated—and draw an agenda for future research.
title_zh: 连接全球价值链中的权力与不平等
abstract_zh: 摘要：关于全球化的研究中，越来越关注全球价值链的出现和巩固是否加剧了国家内部和国家之间的不平等，以及/或者如何利用全球价值链来减轻不平等。尽管权力不对称已被确定为塑造（不）成功的全球价值链参与的核心因素，但主流话语仍然忽视权力与不平等之间的联系，或将这些概念互换使用。在本文中，我们提供了一种分析全球价值链相关不平等（价值链内、沿着价值链和通过价值链）的方法，并考察它们如何与不同类型的权力（谈判权、示范权、制度权和构成权）共同演化。我们将这种方法应用于南非鳕鱼价值链的案例研究，以说明现有不平等如何被体现、挑战、减轻或加剧，并描绘了未来研究的议程。

title: Low-cost Chinese goods in Tanzania: the rise of transnational trade routes’ peripheral branches
abstract: This article illustrates how rural margins and urban-rural relations in southwest Tanzania join up with transnational trade routes for Chinese goods. It examines the trade of low-cost imported goods from China (plastic sandals, cheap jewellery, various fashion accessories, cheap clothing, etc.) that are widely spread in Tanzania, up into the peripheral countryside. By examining the concept of trade routes, the article contributes to the literature on urban-rural relations in African Studies and ‘inconspicuous globalisation’ by proposing a contrary perspective, where rural areas viewed as areas of consumption of imported products. It then rescales the globalization analysis by situating urban-rural relations at the heart of local and global interconnections. The article demonstrates that geographically peripheral places and actors have a capacity to influence the direction of the global trade route as they combine complementarities between the urban-rural continuum and topological continuity of networks from local to global. The global trade geography is profoundly influenced by what goes on in its inconspicuous tentacles in upcountry regions, such as the Uporoto Mountains, where the global trade route relies on the dynamism of local agriculture, which is increasingly merging with other livelihoods. This is exemplified by the complementarities between trade and agriculture in terms of livelihood, circulation of capital, urban-rural mobility, and links to global scales, which highlight the de-agrarianization process and the development of a mass consumption society.
title_zh: 坦桑尼亚的低成本中国商品：跨国贸易路线边缘分支的兴起
abstract_zh: 本文阐述了坦桑尼亚西南部的农村边缘地带和城乡关系如何与中国商品的跨国贸易路线连接起来。它考察了来自中国的低成本进口商品（塑料凉鞋、廉价珠宝、各种时尚配饰、廉价服装等）在坦桑尼亚广泛流通，并进入偏远乡村的贸易情况。通过考察贸易路线的概念，本文为非洲研究中的城乡关系文献和“不显眼的全球化”提供了贡献，提出了一个相反的视角，即农村地区被视为进口产品的消费区域。然后，它将城乡关系置于地方与全球互联互动的核心，重新调整了全球化分析。文章表明，地理上的边缘地区和行动者有能力影响全球贸易路线的方向，因为他们将城乡连续体的互补性与从地方到全球网络的拓扑连续性结合起来。全球贸易地理深受其偏远的乡村地区（如乌普罗托山脉）中不显眼的触角的影响，在那里，全球贸易路线依赖于当地农业的动力，而农业正日益与其他生计融合。这体现在贸易与农业在生计、资本流通、城乡流动以及与全球尺度的联系方面的互补性，突显了去农业化进程和大众消费社会的发展。

title: Merchants of the north: Infrastructure and indebtedness along Brazil's Amazon estuary
abstract: Drawing on fieldwork with riverine householders in the Amazonian municipality of Abaetetuba, this article recounts an ongoing struggle against the construction of a fluvial grain terminal by Cargill, the global grain‐trading giant. Over the past two decades, grain‐trading firms have engaged in a publicly subsidized bidding war to expand export infrastructure in the Amazon, harnessing the world's largest river system to flush agricultural commodities on the global market. The so‐called Northern Arc consists of a regional network of private grain terminals, ports, roads, and railways connecting disparate places within a broader landscape of value. This article overlays ethnography with historical analysis to examine the confrontation between a regional project of commodity chain integration and a set of valuations derived from the long‐standing role of commodity exchange in the Amazon. I suggest that the Northern Arc articulates with the sociological legacy of the aviamento : a system of debt‐peonage that structured the circulation of commodities in the basin during the nineteenth and twentieth centuries. By connecting local understandings of power, circulation, and authority to a new structural position within the global food system, the Northern Arc has galvanized old antagonisms and reflects the history of social conflict along the Amazon estuary.
title_zh: 北方的商人：巴西亚马逊河口的基建与负债
abstract_zh: 基于对亚马逊河畔阿巴埃特图巴市河岸居民的田野调查，本文记述了全球粮食贸易巨头嘉吉公司（Cargill）在此修建谷物水运终端所引发的持续抗争。过去二十年，粮食贸易公司纷纷参与公共补贴的竞价战，以扩大亚马逊地区的出口基础设施，利用世界最大的河流系统将农产品输往全球市场。所谓的“北方弧”由区域性的私人谷物终端、港口、公路和铁路网络构成，将不同地点连接到一个更广阔的价值景观中。本文通过民族志与历史分析相结合，审视了区域性的商品链整合项目与亚马逊地区长期存在的商品交换价值体系之间的对抗。我认为，“北方弧”与“aviamento”（一种在19和20世纪塑造亚马逊流域商品流通的债务奴役制度）的社会学遗产相衔接。通过将当地对权力、流通和权威的理解与全球粮食体系中的新结构性位置联系起来，“北方弧”激化了旧有的对抗，并反映了亚马逊河口社会冲突的历史。

title: National Retro and the Re-mattering of History in Twenty-First-Century Hungary
journal_name: COMPARATIVE STUDIES IN SOCIETY AND HISTORY
abstract: Abstract This article investigates the international genre of “retro” and how it is used in Hungary to re-matter the nation’s modern past, repositioning the country within a twentieth-century European history where it was never cut off by an “Iron Curtain” from the modern West. It does this by selecting for modern consumer goods and popular culture from both East and West that fit international criteria for retro. For both young and old, retro “matters” the past in a way that affirms contemporary market sensibilities, infusing it with value through assertions of market equivalence in the past and new value as commodities in the present. If Hungarian Retro works as a form of nostalgia for some, it is for an era of perceived national prestige, value, and economic sovereignty relative to the demoralized present. While distinct from right-wing nationalist politics, Hungarian Retro nonetheless shares in the project of erasing a stigmatized state socialism from national history. This article builds on scholarship on the role of the material in producing the nation in everyday life. It contributes a perspective that brings together: (a) the domestication of international commercial and popular trends; (b) the global hierarchy of prestige based on national exports and imports; and (c) the constitution of value in citizens via the qualities of consumer goods both produced and consumed.
title_zh: 二十一世纪匈牙利的民族复古与历史再物质化
abstract_zh: 摘要本文研究了“复古”这一国际类型及其在匈牙利用于重新物质化国家现代历史的方式，通过选择符合国际复古标准的东西方现代消费品和流行文化，将匈牙利重新定位在一个从未被“铁幕”与西方现代性割裂的二十世纪欧洲历史中。对于年轻人和老年人来说，复古以肯定当代市场感性的方式“物质化”过去，通过强调过去市场等价物和当前商品的新价值来赋予其价值。如果匈牙利复古对某些人而言是一种怀旧形式，那么它针对的是一个相对于士气低落的现在而言具有国家威望、价值和经济主权的时代。虽然与右翼民族主义政治不同，匈牙利复古仍参与了将受污蔑的国家社会主义从民族历史中抹去的工程。本文建立在关于物质在日常生活中的民族生产作用的学术基础上。它提出了一种视角，将以下方面结合起来：（a）国际商业和流行趋势的本土化；（b）基于国家进出口的全球声望等级体系；以及（c）通过生产和消费的消费品品质对公民价值的构成。

title: Optimal Linear Estimation (OLE) Modeling Supports Early Holocene (9000–8000 RCYBP) Copper Tool Production in North America
abstract: The discovery and development of metal as a tool medium is a topic of global interest. A fundamental research goal involves establishing the timing of human experimentation with naturally occurring copper ore, which is commonly associated with sedentary, agrarian-based societies. However, in North America, there is well-documented millennia-scale exploitation of copper as tool media by small, seasonally mobile hunter-gatherer groups in the western Great Lakes. Archaeologists have suggested that Late Paleoindian groups may have begun using copper as a tool medium almost immediately after they entered the Lake Superior basin. However, only a few radiocarbon dates support such early use of copper. Here, we use optimal linear estimation modeling to infer the origin date for copper tool production in North America. Our results show that the invention of copper as a tool media likely occurred shortly after the first pioneering populations encountered copper ore during the Pleistocene-Holocene transition. The origin dates modeled here (ca. 8100 RCYBP) reveal several important features about the behavior of pioneering hunter-gatherer populations. Moreover, our results suggest that this phenomenon represents the earliest known use of metal for utilitarian copper tool production.
title_zh: 最优线性估计模型支持北美早全新世（9000–8000放射性碳年）铜器生产
abstract_zh: 金属作为工具材料的发现和开发是一个全球关注的话题。一个基本的研究目标是确定人类对天然铜矿进行实验的时间，这通常与定居的农业社会相关联。然而，在北美，西大湖地区的小型季节性迁徙狩猎采集群体有文献记载的、长达千年的将铜作为工具材料的利用。考古学家提出，晚古印第安人群体可能在进入苏必利尔湖盆地后几乎立即开始使用铜作为工具材料。然而，只有少数放射性碳日期支持铜的如此早期使用。这里，我们使用最优线性估计模型来推断北美铜器生产的起源日期。我们的结果表明，铜作为工具材料的发明很可能发生在第一批开拓性种群在更新世-全新世过渡期间遇到铜矿后不久。这里模拟的起源日期（约8100放射性碳年）揭示了关于开拓性狩猎采集群体行为的几个重要特征。此外，我们的结果表明，这一现象代表了已知最早的实用铜器生产的金属使用。

title: Squeezing mind out of metal: combining textual evidence with scientific data for metallurgy in early dynastic China
abstract: Abstract Since one of the aims of modern archaeometallurgy is to understand the processes carried out by ancient metalworkers, then ideally, we need to go beyond the traditional sources of evidence for such processes — physical investigation and chemical analysis of the objects themselves, and associated manufacturing debris. In order to understand the intentionality behind the decisions taken by these metalworkers (the ‘why’, in addition to the ‘how’), then we need to ‘see the world’ as the metalworkers themselves did. The key issue is how to traverse the gulf between ancient and modern perceptions of the natural world. Using ancient Chinese bronze metalwork as an example, we argue that many interesting glimpses of this world can be drawn from the contemporary and later literary sources. But it is crucial to note that these insights have to be supported by independent evidence, such as scientific data or archaeological information. Once verified, these findings can significantly improve our knowledge of the metaphysical perception of metal in the past and offer a heuristic and powerful tool to interpret the relationship between metallurgy and society. For the Chinese Bronze Age, metallurgy performed a crucial part in the political and ritual world. In particular, the different colours of metal objects provide important indicators of the social hierarchy as evidenced by burial practice.
title_zh: 从金属中榨取思想：结合文本证据与科学数据的中国古代冶金研究
abstract_zh: 摘要 现代考古冶金学的目标之一是理解古代金属工匠所进行的工艺过程，因此理想情况下，我们需要超越这些过程的传统证据来源——即对器物本身及相关制造碎片的物理检测和化学分析。为了理解这些金属工匠决策背后的意图（除了“如何”之外，还有“为什么”），我们需要像金属工匠自身那样“看待世界”。关键问题是如何跨越古代与现代对自然世界认知之间的鸿沟。以中国古代青铜金属制品为例，我们认为可以从当时及后来的文学资料中获取许多关于这个世界的有趣线索。但必须注意，这些见解需要得到独立证据的支持，例如科学数据或考古信息。一旦得到验证，这些发现可以显著提高我们对过去金属形而上认知的理解，并提供一种启发式的强大工具，用于解读冶金术与社会之间的关系。对于中国青铜时代，冶金术在政治和仪式世界中发挥着关键作用。特别是，金属器物不同的颜色提供了社会等级的重要指示，正如埋葬习俗所证明的那样。

title: Tech-Colonialism: Gentrification, Resistance, and Belonging in San Francisco's Colonial Present
abstract: This article theorizes tech-led gentrification in San Francisco as a form of what I call, "tech-colonialism." Drawing on my ethnographic work with movements organizing against eviction and displacement, this article grapples with the critique from activists and protestors that gentrification and the tech-industry are "colonizing" the city. Taking this seriously, I argue that the analytic of "colonialism" provided San Francisco residents and activists with an important framework for political organizing, identity-making, solidarity-work, and forging belonging amidst the city's on-going "eviction epidemic." Beyond the discursive deployment by activists of "colonialism" as a concept, I also trace the material continuities between historical forms of colonial dispossession and present-day tech-colonialism, in which technology companies enclose the "commons," operate above laws, invest surplus capital in speculative urban racialized property regimes, and treat governments themselves as outdated and archaic institutions to be "disrupted." Ultimately, I define tech-colonialism as the social and spatial strategies of the technology industry that operate through colonial logics of racialized dispossession and materially extend and reproduce the colonial present.
title_zh: 技术殖民主义：旧金山殖民当下的绅士化、抵抗与归属
abstract_zh: 本文将旧金山的科技主导的绅士化理论化，称之为“技术殖民主义”。基于我对抵制驱逐和流离失所的运动的民族志研究，本文探讨了活动家和抗议者的批评，即绅士化和科技产业正在“殖民”这座城市。我认为，“殖民主义”的分析框架为旧金山居民和活动家提供了重要的政治组织、身份建构、团结工作以及在持续的“驱逐流行病”中营造归属感的框架。除了活动家对“殖民主义”概念的话语运用之外，我还追溯了历史上的殖民剥夺形式与当今技术殖民主义之间的物质连续性，其中科技公司圈占“公共资源”、凌驾于法律之上、将剩余资本投资于投机性的城市种族化财产制度，并将政府本身视为过时古老的机构而加以“颠覆”。最终，我将技术殖民主义定义为科技产业的社会和空间策略，这些策略通过种族化剥夺的殖民逻辑运作，并在物质上延伸和再生产殖民当下。

title: The invisible lives of cobalt miners and green traceability discourses
abstract: The mobilization for greenhouse gas reduction has significantly boosted our interest in electric cars and green mobility. E‐powered technology and lithium‐ion (Li‐ion) batteries are now cornerstones of our green tech discourse. These technologies rest on the fast‐growing demand for rare metals such as cobalt, an essential component in Li‐ion batteries. This article focuses on the invisible lives of the artisanal diggers who mine much of the world's cobalt in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC). Their lives in Katanga fade behind the ore they produce. In the dominant green energy discourse, these workers become invisible actors whose corporeality, work and struggle are concealed and denied. We risk smothering cobalt miners’ human rights under an ecologically friendly banner.
title_zh: 钴矿工人的隐形生活与绿色可追溯性话语
abstract_zh: 减少温室气体的行动极大地提升了我们对电动汽车和绿色出行的兴趣。电力驱动技术和锂离子电池现在是我们绿色科技话语的基石。这些技术依赖于对钴等稀有金属的快速增长的需求，钴是锂离子电池的重要组成部分。本文聚焦于在刚果民主共和国开采世界大部分钴的手工挖掘者的隐形生活。他们在加丹加省的生活因他们所开采的矿石而黯然失色。在占主导地位的绿色能源话语中，这些工人成为隐形行动者，其肉体性、工作和斗争被掩盖和否认。我们冒着在生态友好旗帜下扼杀钴矿工人人权的风险。

title: The mechanical Turk: a short history of ‘artificial artificial intelligence’
abstract: This paper undertakes a comparative analysis of the famous eighteenth-century chess-playing automaton known as Mechanical Turk and the Amazon microwork platform of the same name. The original Mechanical Turk was a life-sized automaton made in 1770 and publicly exhibited until the mid-1800s, and which played games of chess with the audience. Its movements were fully mechanical, but even more remarkably, it was promoted as the world’s first ‘thinking machine,’ deciding each move of the chess pieces for itself. From the outset, it was widely assumed that the Mechanical Turk was a hoax, and that a human must be hidden inside the machine, directing the game. But it was a clever hoax whose trick was never discovered, and widely admired as such. Amazon’s Mechanical Turk job platform functions in a similarly open way, this paper argues, as a sort of open technological hoax. Mechanical Turk provides a source of human cognitive labour that can be used to invisibly operate digital systems and programs that are widely assumed to be fully automated. Artificial intelligence is a twenty-first century thinking machine, it requires a human brain to make it work. Amazon’s Mechanical Turk is a marketplace in which companies can hire piecemeal cognitive labour to patch gaps and train programs to keep those systems functioning. Providing what Jeff Bezos has called ‘artificial artificial intelligence,’ Amazon’s Mechanical Turk, like Kempelen’s automaton, both draws attention to and obfuscates the limits of automation and artificial intelligence. Taking the two iterations of the Mechanical Turk as rich cultural figures of automation for their respective periods, this paper will argue that the open secret of their artificial artificial intelligence is itself a form of misdirection that hides other, more successfully guarded secrets: the true extent of that labour, and the conditions in which it is performed.
title_zh: 机械土耳其人：'人工人工智能'简史
abstract_zh: 本文对著名的18世纪国际象棋自动机“机械土耳其人”与同名的亚马逊微工作平台进行了比较分析。最初的机械土耳其人是一个真人大小的自动机，于1770年制造，直到19世纪中期公开展出，并与观众下棋。它完全机械运动，但更引人注目的是，它被宣传为世界上第一个“思维机器”，能够自行决定每一步棋。从一开始，人们普遍认为机械土耳其人是一个骗局，机器内部必定藏有一个人来指导游戏。但这是一个聪明的骗局，其把戏从未被揭穿，并因此广受赞赏。本文认为，亚马逊的机械土耳其人工作平台以类似公开的方式运作，作为一种公开的技术骗局。机械土耳其人提供了人类认知劳动的来源，可用于隐形地操作那些被广泛认为是完全自动化的数字系统和程序。人工智能是21世纪的思维机器，它需要人脑才能工作。亚马逊的机械土耳其人是一个市场，公司可以在其中雇佣零碎的认知劳动来修补漏洞并训练程序以维持这些系统运行。提供杰夫·贝佐斯所谓的“人工人工智能”，亚马逊的机械土耳其人像肯佩伦的自动机一样，既引起人们对自动化和人工智能极限的关注，又掩盖了这些极限。本文将两个版本的机械土耳其人作为各自时代丰富的自动化文化形象，论证其人工人工智能的公开秘密本身是一种误导形式，隐藏着其他更成功保守的秘密：这种劳动的真实程度及其执行条件。

title: The problem of power: Partial electrification in Northern Uganda
abstract: This article considers the relation between infrastructural development and precarious work in the context of the electrification of a village in Northern Uganda. The case of a welder illustrates how partial electrification creates precarious conditions for work and how flexibility and creativity are used to mitigate its effects. In looking beyond precarity at the strategies employed by small‐scale business owners in Northern Uganda, this article aims to shed light on how people relate to infrastructural realities and play an active role in shaping the affordances and impact of infrastructures in the Global South.
title_zh: 电力问题：乌干达北部的部分电气化
abstract_zh: 本文探讨了乌干达北部一个村庄电气化背景下基础设施发展与不稳定工作之间的关系。一个焊工的案例说明了部分电气化如何为工作创造不稳定条件，以及如何利用灵活性和创造力来减轻其影响。通过审视乌干达北部小企业主在不稳定性之外所采用的策略，本文旨在揭示人们如何与基础设施现实相关联，并在塑造全球南方基础设施的可供性和影响方面发挥积极作用。

title: The ship
abstract: When Ever Given, one of the world’s largest container ships, ran aground and blocked the Suez Canal for six days in March 2021, it dramatically brought to light the fragile dependency of global trade on maritime infrastructures. It also drew attention to ships as actors within this global system of mobility. In this article, I centre on the figure of the ship to reflect on maritime passages and blockages and the particular forms of sociality that emerge through them. Drawing on ethnography from onboard container ships, I explore how crews interact with various actors, such as authorities, pilots, boatmen and peddlers, who, at times facilitate, at times obstruct, ships’ passages. Through this ethnographic lens, I make visible the intersecting dynamics of mobility and immobility, flow and friction, and connection and isolation that permeate the Suez Canal and the contemporary maritime, and which shape the social worlds on and around ships.
title_zh: 船只
abstract_zh: 2021年3月，当世界上最大的集装箱船之一“Ever Given”搁浅并堵塞苏伊士运河六天时，它戏剧性地揭示了全球贸易对海洋基础设施的脆弱依赖。它也引起了人们对船作为这一全球流动系统内行动者的关注。在本文中，我以船的形象为中心，反思海上通道和阻塞以及由此产生的特殊社会性形式。借鉴在集装箱船上的民族志研究，我探索船员如何与各种行动者（如当局、引航员、船工和小贩）互动，这些行动者有时促进、有时阻碍船只的通行。通过这种民族志视角，我揭示了贯穿苏伊士运河和当代海洋的流动与停滞、流通与摩擦、连接与隔离的交织动态，这些动态塑造了船上及周围的社会世界。

title: The shipping container
abstract: When the Ever Given became stuck in the Suez Canal, the megaship was carrying 18,300 rectangular, steel boxes on her back. In the weeks and months after the incident, the concealed contents of the shipping containers – stuck in legal limbo – captured global attention. Technologically developed in the years after the Second World War, the standardized shipping container has featured as one of the protagonists of the transformations in international trade. But the container’s logic of concealment and transaction has made ‘the box’ a common figure also in popular culture and social theory. This essay interrogates the shipping container’s multiple repertoires by focussing on containers at work. By tracing how the shipping container moves through the port infrastructure this essay takes us from the Suez Canal towards another central maritime passageway: the Strait of Gibraltar. This essay reflects on the different scales at which the shipping container functions in the port: from heavy materiality to abstracted codes and units of measurement.
title_zh: 航运集装箱
abstract_zh: 当“长赐”号搁浅在苏伊士运河时，这艘巨轮装载了18300个矩形钢制集装箱。在事件发生后的数周和数月里，这些处于法律困境的集装箱内隐藏的货物引起了全球关注。标准化集装箱在二战后技术发展，成为国际贸易转型的主角之一。但集装箱的隐藏和交易逻辑也使“盒子”成为流行文化和社会理论中的常见形象。本文通过聚焦工作中的集装箱，探讨航运集装箱的多重功能。通过追踪集装箱如何穿越港口基础设施，本文从苏伊士运河带领我们前往另一个重要的海上通道：直布罗陀海峡。本文反思了集装箱在港口中发挥作用的不同尺度：从沉重的物质性到抽象代码和计量单位。

title: To Fail at Scale!
abstract: English Abstract: Humanitarian entrepreneurs seek to do well and do good by developing goods and services that directly address the world’s most intractable problems. In this article we explore the expectations built into two of their products: a point-of-care diagnostic device and a solar-powered lantern.
