We show how these objects materialise both a minimalist ethic of care and a maximalist commitment to universal access for health and energy. Such maximalist commitments, we propose, are fundamentally utopian. The developers of these humanitarian goods do not envision their objects as stop-gap solutions or ‘band-aids’ for entrenched systemic failures but rather as the building blocks for new kinds of universal infrastructures that are delivered through the market. We trace the work involved in scaling-up the humanitarian effects of these devices through processes of design, manufacturing and distribution. For humanitarian entrepreneurs, we argue, to fail at delivering expectations is to fail at scale. French Abstract: Les entrepreneurs humanitaires cherchent à faire bien et à faire du bien en développant des biens et des services qui s’attaquent directement aux problèmes les plus insolubles du monde. Dans cet article, nous explorons les attentes intégrées dans deux de leurs produits : un dispositif de diagnostic au point de service et une lanterne à énergie solaire. Nous montrons comment ces objets matérialisent à la fois une éthique minimaliste des soins et un engagement maximaliste en faveur de l’accès universel à la santé et à l’énergie. Nous proposons que de tels engagements maximalistes sont fondamentalement utopiques. Les concepteurs de ces biens humanitaires n’envisagent pas leurs objets comme des solutions provisoires ou des « pansements » pour des défaillances systémiques bien ancrées, mais plutôt comme les éléments constitutifs de nouveaux types d’infrastructures universelles fournies par le marché. Nous retraçons le travail nécessaire pour augmenter les effets humanitaires de ces dispositifs à travers des processus de design, de fabrication et de distribution. Pour les entrepreneurs humanitaires, nous soutenons qu’échouer à répondre aux attentes est un échec à grande échelle.
title_zh: 大规模失败！
abstract_zh: 人道主义企业家试图通过开发直接解决世界上最棘手问题的商品和服务来做好事并创造价值。在本文中，我们探讨了嵌入在其两种产品中的期望：一种即时诊断设备和一种太阳能灯笼。我们展示了这些对象如何既体现了一种极简的关怀伦理，又体现了一种对健康和能源普遍可及的最大承诺。我们认为，这种最大化的承诺本质上是乌托邦式的。这些人道主义商品的开发者并不将其对象视为权宜之计或解决根深蒂固的系统性失败的“补救措施”，而是将其视为通过市场提供的全新普遍性基础设施的基石。我们追溯了通过设计、制造和分销过程扩大这些设备人道主义效果所涉及的工作。我们认为，对于人道主义企业家来说，未能实现期望就是在大规模上失败。

title: Unpaid labour and territorial extraction in digital value networks
journal_name: GLOBAL NETWORKS-A JOURNAL OF TRANSNATIONAL AFFAIRS
abstract: Abstract Production in knowledge and data‐intensive industries is powered by work that can, in theory, be done from anywhere, via cloudwork platforms. Cloudwork platforms govern data value chains in distinct ways to concentrate power and extract value at the global scale. We argue that unpaid labour is a systemic mechanism of accumulation in these digital value networks. In this paper we demonstrate how it is tied to platform business models and facilitated by elements of platform governance including monopsony power, a high degree of spatial flexibility in sourcing labour, regulatory unaccountability and digital enclosure. We draw on a survey of 699 workers on 14 platforms in 74 countries to show that unpaid labour is an engine of South–North value extraction, and workers in the global South perform more unpaid labour than counterparts in the global North. Our findings have important ramifications our understanding of the changing international division of labour and platform capitalism.
title_zh: 数字价值网络中的无酬劳动与地域性抽取
abstract_zh: 知识密集型产业和数据密集型产业的生产依赖于理论上可以通过云工作平台在任何地点完成的工作。云工作平台以不同方式治理数据价值链，以在全球范围内集中权力和提取价值。我们认为，无酬劳动是这些数字价值网络中积累的系统性机制。在本文中，我们展示了它如何与平台商业模式相联系，并受到平台治理要素的促进，包括买方垄断力量、劳动力来源的高度空间灵活性、监管不透明和数字封闭。我们基于对74个国家14个平台上699名工人的调查显示，无酬劳动是南-北价值提取的引擎，且全球南方的工人比北方的工人从事更多无酬劳动。我们的发现对理解不断变化的国际劳动分工和平台资本主义具有重要意义。

title: Utopias of Oil
abstract: At a time of a “private equity oil rush,” this essay explores how oil industry entrepreneurs with ambitions of setting up their own oil-production companies are encouraged to “dream big”—yet are ultimately disciplined and let down—by private equity finance in the state of Colorado in the United States. Motivated by a desire to “do oil differently,” these start-ups articulate utopian visions that draw on inequalities in extractive economies to promote an ethos of care and inclusion. I argue that while economic imaginations are commonly seen to offer alternatives to and critiques of capitalism, it is important also to attend to articulations of capitalist utopia. As private equity has come to form a secreted infrastructure that underlies much of the world’s financial system and encourages entrepreneurial optimism and euphoria, I explore how the contemporary life of capitalism stimulates attitudes to wealth creation that remain markedly conventional and unadventurous.
title_zh: 石油乌托邦
abstract_zh: 在“私募股权石油热潮”时期，本文探讨了在美国科罗拉多州，怀揣建立自己石油生产公司抱负的石油行业企业家如何被私募股权金融鼓励“做大梦”——但最终却受到约束并被辜负。这些初创企业受“以不同方式开采石油”的愿望驱动，提出了乌托邦愿景，利用采掘经济中的不平等来倡导关怀和包容的精神气质。我认为，虽然经济想象通常被视为提供资本主义的替代方案和批判，但同样重要的是关注资本主义乌托邦的表达。随着私募股权已成为构成世界金融体系大部分基础的秘密基础设施，并鼓励企业家的乐观和狂热，我探讨了资本主义的当代生活如何激发对财富创造的态度，这些态度仍然明显传统且缺乏冒险精神。

title: Vivre et travailler dans une enclave chinoise au Cameroun : Les ouvriers d’un « grand chantier de l’émergence »
abstract: Au Cameroun, les « grands chantiers de l’émergence » servent à consolider le régime du président Paul Biya, mais représentent également de nouvelles opportunités d’emplois salariés sous contrat dans un pays marqué par leur rareté. En s’appuyant sur les récits d’ouvriers camerounais du barrage de Lom Pangar, cet article rend compte de la tension entre les avantages d’un emploi salarié et stable et la réalité du travail dans cette enclave chinoise caractérisée par des conditions de travail difficiles, des salaires bas et le maintien d’une grande précarité de l’emploi. Cette tension est renforcée par une organisation « raciale » du travail. Ainsi, quelle que soit la fonction des employés camerounais (manœuvres, conducteurs de machine, techniciens ou encore ingénieurs), ils sont toujours en position d’infériorité face aux employés chinois. Comme, dans les chantiers des entreprises chinoises au Cameroun, le nombre de travailleurs expatriés est beaucoup plus important qu’au sein des entreprises étrangères opérant dans le même secteur, chaque employé camerounais ou presque est sous les ordres directs d’un chef chinois. Dès lors, si les grèves dénoncent les conditions de vie et de travail sur le site, les récits que nous avons récoltés reviennent souvent sur les conflits, les bagarres et les frustrations engendrés par cette organisation raciale du travail.
title_zh: 在喀麦隆的中国飞地生活和工作:一个“崛起大工地”的工人们
abstract_zh: 在喀麦隆，“崛起大工地”用于巩固总统保罗·比亚的政权，但也代表了一个以合同工形式提供带薪就业的新机会，在这个国家此类机会十分稀缺。基于对洛姆庞加尔水坝的喀麦隆工人的叙述，本文揭示了稳定带薪工作的优势与在这块中国飞地内工作的现实之间的紧张关系——工作条件艰苦、工资低、就业高度不稳定。这种紧张关系因一种“种族化”的劳动组织而加剧。因此，无论喀麦隆员工的职能（杂工、机器操作员、技术员或工程师），他们总是处于相对于中国员工的劣势地位。在喀麦隆的中国企业工地上，外派工人数量远多于同一行业的外国公司，因此几乎每个喀麦隆员工都直接受中国主管指挥。因此，尽管罢工抗议工地上的生活和工作条件，但我们收集的叙述常常聚焦于这种种族化劳动组织引发的冲突、斗殴和挫折感。

title: We just ‘<scp>SHAREit</scp>’: Smartphones, data and music sharing in urban Papua New Guinea
abstract: Abstract This article examines how the use of mobile phones and associated software creates and sustains regionally diverse urban communities. There is an interdependent connection between music that is highly participatory and locally relevant, and processes involved in sustaining key social relationships across a variety of groupings. Increasingly ubiquitous technologies such as mobile phones are used for musical purposes in ways that specifically put certain processes to work to sustain these social phenomena. This connects people with transnational software‐based commerce through social media, local telecommunications companies and phone manufacturers. That results in the navigation of ecologies and economies of data, hardware and software that work in local urban circumstances. In the case of data, we demonstrate how modes of exchange and reciprocity tied to social relationships exhibit similarities with informal economies of tobacco and betelnut. With social groups, the church‐based community perspective provides urban examples of communities that cross regions, and extended family networks. This ethnographic perspective shows how increasingly global technologies are used in urbanite Melanesia in ways that sustain longstanding values and practices, while also incorporating identities and associations around changing urban, national and international circumstances.
title_zh: 我们只是‘<scp>SHAREit</scp>’：巴布亚新几内亚城市中的智能手机、数据和音乐分享
abstract_zh: 摘要 本文考察了移动电话及相关软件的使用如何创造并维持区域多样化的城市社区。高度参与且具有地方相关性的音乐与维持各类群体中关键社会关系的过程之间存在相互依赖的联系。日益普及的技术（如移动电话）被用于音乐目的，其方式特别地将某些过程付诸实践以维持这些社会现象。这通过社交媒体、当地电信公司和手机制造商将人们与跨国软件商业联系起来。这导致了数据、硬件和软件的生态系统与经济的导航，这些在当地城市环境中运作。以数据为例，我们展示了与社会关系相关的交换和互惠模式如何与烟草和槟榔的非正规经济表现出相似性。在社会群体方面，以教会为基础的社区视角提供了跨区域社区和扩展家庭网络的城市实例。这种民族志视角展示了日益全球化的技术如何在美拉尼西亚城市地区被用以维持长期存在的价值观和实践，同时也在不断变化的城市、国家和国际环境中融入身份认同和联系。

title: “En Bolivia lo hacen andar”: Régimen de mantenimiento, dimensión emotiva y prácticas de renovación vehicular del transporte colectivo de La Paz
journal_name: Journal of Latin American and Caribbean Anthropology
abstract: Abstract In this article I analyze the emotional logic that urban transport drivers in La Paz assign to their vehicles in their life cycle. I pay attention to the emotive dimension of the “technical rationality” of practices of vehicle renewal, reuse, and maintenance—that is to say, the set of emotions, affections, and, especially, feelings that emerge in keeping the vehicle in good condition or in its possible replacement. This emotional dimension does not emerge as an autonomous sphere of technical rationality but rather is inherent to it. My hypothesis also points to its overflowing and kaleidoscopic character, since it transcends the individual experience by allowing us to analyze other phenomena of social life.
title_zh: “在玻利维亚，他们让它运行”：拉巴斯公共交通的维护制度、情感维度和车辆更新实践
abstract_zh: 摘要 在本文中，我分析了拉巴斯城市交通司机在其车辆生命周期中赋予车辆的情感逻辑。我关注车辆更新、再利用和维护实践的“技术理性”的情感维度——即保持车辆良好状态或可能更换时出现的一系列情感、感情，尤其是感觉。这一情感维度并非作为技术理性的自主领域出现，而是其固有的。我的假设还指向其溢出和万花筒般的特征，因为它超越了个人体验，使我们能够分析社会生活的其他现象。

title: A Precolumbian Presence of Venetian Glass Trade Beads in Arctic Alaska
abstract: Excavation at three Late Prehistoric Eskimo sites in arctic Alaska has revealed the presence of Venetian glass trade beads in radiocarbon-dated contexts that predate Columbus's discovery of the Western Hemisphere. The bead variety, commonly known as “Early Blue” and “Ichtucknee Plain,” has been confirmed by expert examination and comparative Instrumental Neutron Activation Analysis (INAA). The beads are present in sites throughout the Caribbean, the eastern coast of Central and North America, and the eastern Great Lakes region, where they are commonly found in sites dating between approximately AD 1550 and 1750, although a diminishing presence continues into the early 1800s. Beads of this variety have not previously been reported from Alaska. Ascribed to Venetian production by their precolumbian age, the beads challenge the currently accepted chronology for the development of their production methodology, availability, and presence in the Americas. In the absence of trans-Atlantic communication, the most likely route these beads traveled from Europe to northwestern Alaska is across Eurasia and over the Bering Strait. This is the first documented instance of the presence of indubitable European materials in prehistoric sites in the Western Hemisphere as the result of overland transport across the Eurasian continent.
title_zh: 阿拉斯加北极地区前哥伦布时期威尼斯玻璃贸易珠的存在
abstract_zh: 在阿拉斯加北极地区的三个晚期史前爱斯基摩遗址的发掘中，发现了放射性碳定年背景下早于哥伦布发现西半球的威尼斯玻璃贸易珠。这种珠子品种通常被称为“早期蓝”和“伊克塔克尼平原”，经专家检查和比较仪器中子活化分析确认。这些珠子遍布加勒比海、中美洲和北美洲东海岸以及五大湖东部地区的遗址，常见于公元1550年至1750年之间的遗址，尽管其存在一直延续到19世纪初。此前阿拉斯加未曾报道过这种珠子。由于其前哥伦布时期的年代，这些珠子被归因于威尼斯生产，挑战了目前公认的对其生产方法、可得性和在美洲存在的时间顺序。在缺乏跨大西洋交流的情况下，这些珠子从欧洲到达阿拉斯加西北部最可能的路线是穿越欧亚大陆并经过白令海峡。这是有记录以来确凿的欧洲材料因陆路运输穿越欧亚大陆而出现在西半球史前遗址的首个实例。

title: Archipelagic Archives
abstract: Abstract This article examines the intertwined cultural politics of geology, mining, and archival media in the context of Japan's development as an archipelagic empire. The first Japanese geological map (1876) was completed by American geologist Benjamin Smith Lyman, who surveyed mineral deposits in Hokkaidō, Japan's northern island, long inhabited by the Indigenous Ainu people. Following anticolonial and archipelagic scholarship, the author reads across earthly archives of geological strata and colonial archives of historical documents to elucidate the conceptual duality of the archipelago as both a geological formation and a geopolitical territory. In tracing this formative era of Japan's resource extraction and settler colonialism, which precedes and informs the current rush to extract rare earth minerals necessary to maintain global digital infrastructures, this article aims to both de-Westernize the methodological orientation known as media geology and offer a prehistory of contemporary rare earth mining in the Pacific Ocean.
title_zh: 群岛档案
abstract_zh: 本文审视了地质学、采矿和档案媒介相互交织的文化政治，背景是日本作为群岛帝国的发展。第一幅日本地质图（1876年）由美国地质学家本杰明·史密斯·莱曼完成，他调查了北海道（日本北部岛屿，长期由原住民阿伊努人居住）的矿床。遵循反殖民和群岛学术研究，作者跨越地质地层的陆地档案和历史文献的殖民档案进行阅读，以阐明群岛作为地质构造和地缘政治领土的概念二元性。在追溯日本资源开采和定居殖民主义的这一形成时期（它先于并影响着当前为维持全球数字基础设施而开采稀土矿物的热潮），本文旨在既将方法论取向“媒体地质学”去西方化，又为当今太平洋地区的稀土开采提供史前史。

title: Austerity, skill, and gendered work in Kazakhstan's heavy industry
journal_name: JOURNAL OF THE ROYAL ANTHROPOLOGICAL INSTITUTE
abstract: Abstract Earlier analyses have demonstrated the loss of industrial worker autonomy and the rise of deskilling after production is automated. But what happens to autonomy and skill in times of austerity, when automation breaks down? Through studying the labour process in a Kazakhstani coal processing plant, I explore how the lack of investment in machinery and staff influences the way female workers conduct their everyday work. Workers are simultaneously reskilled and exhausted by invisible extra maintenance work, with their gendered dispositions drawn on as a resource. Ethnographies of the economic crisis and austerity have so far paid little attention to the transformation of everyday industrial work. This ethnography makes a distinctive contribution by shifting the focus on to an embodied and detailed analysis of industrial work in austerity, developing ideas of gendered maintenance, repair, and skill.
title_zh: 哈萨克斯坦重工业中的紧缩、技能与性别化工作
abstract_zh: 摘要 早期的分析已经证明了自动化生产后工业工人自主性的丧失和去技能化的兴起。但在紧缩时期，当自动化崩溃时，自主性和技能会发生什么？通过研究哈萨克斯坦一家煤炭加工厂的劳动过程，我探讨了对机械和员工投资的缺乏如何影响女性工人进行日常工作的方式。工人们通过无形的额外维护工作同时被重新技能化和感到疲惫，她们的性别倾向被作为一种资源加以利用。关于经济危机和紧缩的民族志到目前为止很少关注日常工业工作的转变。这项民族志通过将焦点转向紧缩时期工业工作的具体化和详细分析，发展出关于性别化维护、修理和技能的观点，做出了独特的贡献。

title: Classified
Clay and earth

authors.name: Olívia Maria Gomes da Cunha
institutions: Universidade Federal do Estado do Rio de Janeiro
Universidade Federal do Rio de Janeiro

abstract: Inspired by the idea of “transculturation,” formulated as a contrastive metaphor and concept by Fernando Ortiz in the 1940s, this article seeks to explore the making of clay balls called “Moengo pemba,” extracted from former bauxite excavation areas by Maroon Ndyuka men. With the establishment of the US bauxite industry in Moengo (Suriname) in the late 1910s, subsequent mining and lumbering activities had profound effects on the lives of Maroon families. The labor of Ndyuka men in tree-cutting and bauxite excavation, and women’s work in the gardens and markets, were affected by new moral and economic forces, punctuating diverse forms of circulation and consumption. The use of Moengo pemba has evoked existential effects connected to the Maroon person and body, their ancestors, and other nonhuman beings inhabiting the forest. The association between the clay, the healing powers of pemba, and its ontological effects on Ndyuka bodies in a landscape of environmental destruction is explored here through a contrapuntal dialogue.

title: Competing for seafaring labour: Social security and agency employment in Chinese shipping
journal_name: GLOBAL NETWORKS-A JOURNAL OF TRANSNATIONAL AFFAIRS
abstract: Abstract This paper discusses one strategy that Chinese crewing agencies adopt to compete with each other in the global seafarer labour supplying market. This strategy is related to Chinese seafarers’ social insurance participation. It shows that crewing agencies utilised a dual workforce – ‘company‐owned seafarers’ and ‘externally hired seafarers’. Externally hired seafarers, though in precarious employment, are offered higher salaries in place of social insurance coverage. By contrast, company‐owned seafarers are paid less, though enjoy social insurance arranged by agencies. This strategy serves to segment the seafarer labour market, conceal the level playing field and help agencies recruit seafarers cost‐effectively, though in violation of labour rights. This paper argues that this strategy grows out of the competitive landscape co‐shaped by the national regulatory and institutional settings and the global structure of the shipping industry.
title_zh: 争夺航海劳动力：中国航运中的社会保障与中介雇佣
abstract_zh: 摘要本文讨论了中国船员中介机构在全球海员劳动力供应市场中相互竞争所采取的一种策略。该策略与中国海员的社会保险参与有关。研究表明，船员中介机构利用了双重劳动力——‘公司自有海员’和‘外部雇佣海员’。外部雇佣海员虽然就业不稳定，但以更高的工资代替社会保险覆盖。相比之下，公司自有海员工资较低，但享受由中介安排的社会保险。这一策略旨在细分海员劳动力市场，掩盖公平竞争环境，并帮助中介机构以成本有效的方式招募海员，尽管这违反了劳动权利。本文认为，这种策略源于国家监管和制度环境与全球航运业结构共同塑造的竞争格局。

title: Containing mobilities
journal_name: Focaal-Journal of Global and Historical Anthropology
abstract: This article uses ethnography from onboard container ships to show how seafarers as a workforce at the center of global capital circulation are increasingly confined inside their mobile worksites. Drawing on theories of the transformation of time and space as internal to the logic of globalization and capitalism, the article argues that the increased mobility of goods, as facilitated by developments in maritime logistics, has decreased the mobility of the seafarers in charge of moving these goods across the world. The article proposes “containing mobilities” as a term for thinking through the particular contradictions and inequalities of mobility that shape the everyday life of the workers at the heart of the global system of mobility and transport that constitutes the maritime supply chain.
title_zh: 限制性流动
abstract_zh: 本文利用集装箱船上的民族志研究，展示了作为全球资本流通中心的海员如何日益被限制在其移动的工作场所内。借鉴时间和空间转型作为全球化和资本主义内在逻辑的理论，本文认为，海上物流发展所促进的商品流动性增加，降低了负责将这些商品运往全球的海员的流动性。本文提出“限制性流动”这一术语，用以思考构成海上供应链的全球流动与运输系统核心的工人日常生活中特有的矛盾和不平等。

title: Contentious connections: infrastructure, dignity, and collective life in Accra, Ghana
journal_name: JOURNAL OF THE ROYAL ANTHROPOLOGICAL INSTITUTE
abstract: Abstract Infrastructural systems have emerged as productive ethnographic sites for analysing political subjectivities and rationalities. Through the case of shared electricity and prepaid meters in the compound housing system of Accra, Ghana, I suggest that infrastructures’ political potential lies in their imaginative and hermeneutic abilities to foster desires for dignity, sustain well‐being, and question moral ideals of collective life. In contrast to recent anthropological work that has emphasized the material basis of infrastructures as ‘techno‐political’ devices materializing certain logics of rule and governance, I reclaim a poetics of sociality whereby infrastructures mobilize a politics of (unwanted) collective life. Through the ‘electricity stories’ circulated by tenants, I chart how the moral economy of infrastructure in a context of collective precarity redistributes marginalization and freedom in ways that always exceed political rationales of energy reforms and policies.
title_zh: 有争议的连接：加纳阿克拉的基础设施、尊严与集体生活
abstract_zh: 摘要 基础设施系统已成为分析政治主体性和合理性的富有成效的民族志场域。通过加纳阿克拉合住房屋系统中的共享电力和预付费电表的案例，我提出基础设施的政治潜力在于其想象和诠释能力，能够激发对尊严的渴望、维持福祉，并质疑集体生活的道德理想。与近期强调基础设施作为实现特定统治与治理逻辑的物质基础的“技术-政治”装置的人类学工作相反，我重新主张一种社会性的诗学，即基础设施动员了一种（不受欢迎的）集体生活的政治。通过租户传播的“电力故事”，我描绘了在集体不稳定的背景下，基础设施的道德经济如何以总是超越能源改革与政策的政治理性的方式重新分配边缘化与自由。

title: Digital technological upgrading in manufacturing global value chains: The impact of additive manufacturing
journal_name: GLOBAL NETWORKS-A JOURNAL OF TRANSNATIONAL AFFAIRS
abstract: Abstract This article contributes to the burgeoning literature on digitalization and technological upgrading in global value chains (GVCs). It focuses on the adoption of additive manufacturing (AM)—a particular type of ‘Industry 4.0’ technology—by manufacturing GVCs and its impact on process and production upgrade. Drawing on extensive qualitative research in Germany, the United Kingdom and the United States, including 54 interviews and participant observation firms, it examines the AM industry and its adoption in manufacturing firms. The findings contribute to existing understandings of technological upgrading in GVCs by differentiating between different types of actors within GVCs, focusing on produce and process upgrading in lead firms and in original equipment manufacturers (OEMs) and lower‐tier suppliers. It finds that OEM and lower‐tier firms are using AM to upgrade and capture value in different ways to lead firms, with implications for relationships between actors. The paper also highlights the sectoral variation in the adoption of AM and reflects on the contemporary and future role of this digital technology in manufacturing GVCs.
title_zh: 制造业全球价值链中的数字技术升级：增材制造的影响
abstract_zh: 本文为关于数字化和全球价值链（GVCs）中技术升级的新兴文献做出了贡献。它聚焦于制造业全球价值链中增材制造（AM）——一种特定的“工业4.0”技术——的采纳及其对工艺和生产升级的影响。基于在德国、英国和美国进行的广泛定性研究，包括54次访谈和参与观察企业，本文审视了增材制造行业及其在制造企业中的采纳。研究发现有助于现有对全球价值链中技术升级的理解，通过区分全球价值链中的不同行动者类型，关注领先企业、原始设备制造商（OEMs）以及低层级供应商的产品和工艺升级。研究发现，OEM和低层级企业正在使用增材制造以不同于领先企业的方式进行升级并获取价值，这对行动者之间的关系产生了影响。本文还强调了增材制造采纳的行业差异，并反映了这种数字技术在制造业全球价值链中的当代和未来角色。

title: Fashion in ‘crisis’: consumer activism and brand (ir)responsibility in lockdown
abstract: The Covid-19 pandemic precipitated an ‘existential crisis’ in the global fashion industry. The effects of the crisis on the retail sector resulted in many brands deferring or cancelling orders from supplier factories without paying workers, which had an instant and calamitous impact on the lives of garment workers in the global South. While activist organizations were quick to launch campaigns demanding that fashion brands #PayUp and take responsibility for their producers, these calls seemed futile in the face of fashion supply chains that have long been structured in ways that absolve brands of responsibility. The stories of worker exploitation and abuse in the garment industry that emerged during the pandemic were not discussed as effects of global capitalism, but rather were recast as evidence of a world suddenly in ‘crisis.’ In this article, we reflect on how the language of ‘crisis’ adopted in the early months of the pandemic produced particular modes and instruments of (ir)responsibility. We present an analysis of the effects of the pandemic on the global fashion industry, as well as the #PayUp and #WeWearAustralian campaigns, and argue that the exceptionalism underpinning the crisis discourse has both diffused and narrowed responsibility for garment worker exploitation, reiterating the very racialised inequalities that allow such exploitation to occur in the first place.
title_zh: 危机中的时尚：封锁下的消费者行动与品牌（不）责任
abstract_zh: 新冠疫情在全球时尚产业引发了一场‘生存危机’。危机对零售业的影响导致许多品牌推迟或取消供应商工厂的订单，且不支付工人工资，这对全球南方服装工人的生活造成了即时且灾难性的影响。虽然激进组织迅速发起运动，要求时尚品牌#支付报酬并对其生产商负责，但在长期结构上免除品牌责任的时尚供应链面前，这些呼吁似乎徒劳无功。疫情期间暴露的服装业工人剥削和虐待故事并未被讨论为全球资本主义的后果，而是被重新定义为世界突然陷入‘危机’的证据。在本文中，我们反思了疫情初期采用的‘危机’语言如何产生了特定的（不）责任模式与工具。我们分析了疫情对全球时尚产业的影响，以及#支付报酬和#我们穿澳大利亚运动，并论证了危机话语背后的例外主义既分散又缩小了对服装工人剥削的责任，重复了首先允许此类剥削发生的种族化不平等。

title: Flow and flood: mobilities, life in roads and abiotic actors of the (m)ôtô ‐cene
abstract: Traffic in mega-urban Ho Chi Minh City (HCMC) demonstrates the transformative powers of vehicles and transport infrastructures. Like eddies of a river, traffic flows are abiotic actors – other-than-human physical phenomena that influence how traffic makes its way. But the liquid sense of flow in Vietnamese imaginings has unique qualities that challenge singular conceptualisations of the Anthropocene. Moving beyond human-centredness, this paper re-imagines traffic of metropolitan HCMC as the (m)ôtô-cene. Drawing on ethnographic fieldwork, I examine transformations of diurnal patterns of banal journey-making where infrastructure routinely fails and ask how abiotic actors shape ways of inhabiting the Anthropocene and living with roads. Le pouvoir transformateur des véhicules et des infrastructures de transport sur la vie sociale est démontré par le trafic dans la ville contemporaine de Ho Chi Minh Ville (HCMC), au Vietnam. HCMC est l’une des villes qui se développent le plus rapidement au monde et le Vietnam est devenu l’émetteur de carbone dont la croissance est la plus rapide au monde. Les flux de circulation, comme les remous d’une rivière, sont des acteurs abiotiques -- des phénomènes physiques autres qu’humains qui, s’ils ne sont pas vivants, ne sont pas stériles ni dénués de vie. Ils ont le potentiel d’influencer la façon dont le trafic se déplace et se fraye un chemin. Mais le sens liquide de la circulation dans l’imaginaire vietnamien du monde semble avoir des qualités uniques qui remettent potentiellement en question des conceptualisations singulières de l’Anthropocène qui sont autrement consi-dérées comme universelles. Dépassant le caractère humain des relations avec l’environ-nement, cet article ré-imagine l’auto-Anthropocène dans le contexte particulier de la métropole HCMC: le (m)ôtô-cène. En s’appuyant sur un travail ethnographique de terrain à long terme auprès de migrants sans papiers, de résidents à mobilité ascendante et d’usagers des transports en commun depuis 2012, j’examine les façons d’être mobile et les transformations des schémas diurnes de déplacements banals dans une région en méga-urbanisation rapide où les infrastructures sont régulièrement défaillantes. J’explore de quelle manière et dans quelle mesure les acteurs abiotiques façonnent les façons d’habiter l’Anthropocène et de vivre avec les routes.
title_zh: 流动与泛滥：机动性、道路上的生命与（摩托车）纪元的非生物行动者
abstract_zh: 胡志明市特大城市中的交通展现了车辆和交通基础设施的变革力量。如同河流中的漩涡，交通流是非生物行动者——影响交通行进方式的其他非人类物理现象。但越南想象中流动的液态感具有独特的品质，挑战了人类世的单一概念化。本文超越以人为中心，将胡志明市大都市的交通重新想象为（摩托车）纪元。基于民族志田野调查，我考察了基础设施经常失效的日常通勤中昼夜模式的转变，并探究非生物行动者如何塑造居住于人类世和与道路共存的方式。

title: Futures of Fracking and the Everyday: Hydrocarbon Infrastructures, Unruly Materialities and Conspiracies
abstract: Drawing on ethnographic research in two locations facing the prospect of shale gas exploration in Poland and the UK, I analyse how the future can be simultaneously predetermined and undetermined. Local actors handle this complex experience by relating to fracking infrastructures, fixing the materialities of shale gas as well as cultivating an air of conspiracy around the intricacies of gas developments. I focus on the everyday to broaden the scope of recent scholarly writing on resource indeterminacy that explores how corporate strategies create the futures of resource extraction. The contradictory temporalities that these strategies generate have to be reconciled at the sites of extraction. I call for opening our theorisations up to how resource indeterminacy and assertions of predetermined futures are mediated in the everyday contexts of noncorporate actors. By considering these daily forms of engagement with resource exploration, we gain a more realistic perspective on the potentialities of extraction.
title_zh: 水力压裂的未来与日常生活：碳氢化合物基础设施、难以控制的物质性与阴谋论
abstract_zh: 基于在波兰和英国两个面临页岩气勘探前景地点的民族志研究，我分析了未来如何同时被预定和非预定。当地行为者通过关联压裂基础设施、固定页岩气的物质性以及围绕天然气开发的复杂性培养一种阴谋气息来应对这种复杂体验。我关注日常生活，以拓宽近期关于资源不确定性的学术写作范围，这些写作探讨了企业策略如何创造资源开采的未来。这些策略产生的矛盾时间性必须在开采现场得到调和。我呼吁将我们的理论化开放给非企业行为者的日常背景下，资源不确定性及预定未来的断言是如何被中介的。通过考虑这些日常形式的资源勘探参与，我们获得了对开采潜力的更现实视角。

title: Governing Through Opacity: Customary Authority, Hidden Intentions, and Oil Infrastructure Development in Suai, Timor-Leste
abstract: What is the relationship between intentions – their accessibility and their opacity – and the assertion of political authority? Opacity is a central aspect of customary authority in contemporary Timor-Leste, where obscuring the intentions and motivations underlying specific actions – by attributing them to metapersons – can be a subtle way of making claims to authority and status, and simultaneously an effective way of avoiding conflict. This article examines what happened when this form of opacity-based governance was scaled up to the level of the nation, in the context of a massive oil and gas infrastructure project in Suai, Covalima. 'Governing through opacity' by mobilising local practices – when adopted by the state – brought out rivalries between groups competing for state recognition. The analysis of the emerging tensions between two ritual speakers illustrates how the implementation of this oil project and related forms of 'state legibility' undermined locally emplaced forms of authority by forcing the revelation of disparate and otherwise hidden intentions. Examining these conflicts highlights the unstable and uneven relationship between intention management and different regimes of governance.
title_zh: 通过不透明性治理：东帝汶苏艾的习惯权威、隐藏意图与石油基础设施建设
abstract_zh: 意图的可及性与不透明性同政治权威的主张之间有何关系？在当代东帝汶，不透明性是习惯权威的一个核心方面——通过将具体行动背后的意图和动机归因于“超人格”来模糊它们，可以成为主张权威和地位的微妙方式，同时也能有效避免冲突。本文探讨了当这种基于不透明性的治理形式在科瓦利马苏艾的一个大型石油和天然气基础设施项目背景下被扩展到国家层面时发生了什么。通过调动地方实践进行“不透明性治理”——当被国家采纳时——引发了争夺国家认可的群体之间的对抗。对两位仪式发言人之间出现的紧张关系的分析表明，该石油项目的实施及相关形式的“国家可读性”如何通过迫使原本隐藏的不同意图暴露出来，从而破坏了地方嵌入的权威形式。审视这些冲突凸显了意图管理与不同治理体制之间不稳定且不平衡的关系。

title: Infrastructural stripping and ‘recycling’ of copper: producing the state in an industrial town in Serbia

These thefts were 'legalised', according to him, considering that the state, the General Manager of the company and the police were involved too: 'The copper gets returned to the company, and everybody is involved!' he said, adding, 'Hey, the politicians legally robbed and stole from the citizens, the same General Manager [of RTB] did so why would anyone chase these people who steal only a little? They [the politicians] stole a vast number of factories in this country, the General Manager destroyed RTB during the 1990s, and they are not punished.' Then he joked, 'Did you know that the General Manager never steals?! You know what he is doing?' He paused. 'He is continuously investing in himself.' We laughed.
title_zh: 基础设施剥离与铜的“回收”：在塞尔维亚工业城镇中生产国家
abstract_zh: 解释此类中断的逻辑：他认为‘国家’应保护基础设施，腐败的国家应恢复电力供应。据他所说，这些盗窃行为是‘合法化’的，因为国家、公司总经理和警察都参与其中：‘铜被归还给公司，每个人都参与其中！’他说道，并补充道，‘嘿，政客们合法地抢劫和盗窃公民，RTB的总经理也是如此，那为什么还要追捕这些只偷一点点的人呢？他们（政客们）偷走了这个国家大量的工厂，总经理在20世纪90年代摧毁了RTB，但他们没有受到惩罚。’然后他开玩笑说：‘你知道吗，总经理从来不偷？！你知道他在做什么吗？’他停顿了一下。‘他不断地投资于自己。’我们笑了。

title: Invisible bondage: Mobility and compulsion within Sri Lanka’s global assembly line production
abstract: Female workers who enter factory work in Sri Lanka’s Free Trade Zones (FTZs) via contractors are not forced to join or remain in contractor labor pools. This paper, however, argues that such workers nevertheless remain unfree due to cultural and emotional bonds that restrict labor mobility. By analyzing how contracted workers’ entry and mobility within work get shaped by a coalition of patriarchal agents—parents, contractors and factory management—the paper demonstrates how compulsive emotional conditions, that I term “invisible bondage,” are produced and maintained. While the degree of compulsion varies depending on the particular form of labor contracting (i.e., Tamil women from the war torn areas recruited by military personnel, or daily hired workers), I show that all labor contracting for global production represent how forms of unfreedoms are interwoven into supposedly free market relations of production. Such invisible controls, I argue, are essential for neoliberal capitalism to thrive.
title_zh: 隐形的束缚：斯里兰卡全球装配线生产中的流动性与强制
abstract_zh: 通过承包商进入斯里兰卡自由贸易区（FTZs）工厂工作的女工并非被迫加入或留在承包商劳动力池中。然而，本文认为，由于文化和情感纽带限制了劳动力流动，这些工人在某种程度上仍然是不自由的。通过分析合同工进入工作以及在工作中流动如何被由家长、承包商和工厂管理层组成的父权代理人联盟所塑造，本文展示了强迫性的情感条件（我称之为“隐形束缚”）是如何产生并得以维持的。尽管强迫的程度因劳动承包的具体形式（例如，来自战争地区的泰米尔女性由军事人员招募，或每日雇佣的工人）而异，但我表明，所有为全球生产服务的劳动承包都代表了不自由形式如何被编织进所谓的自由市场生产关系之中。我认为，这种隐形的控制对于新自由资本主义的繁荣至关重要。

title: Learning From Lana: Netflix’sToo Hot to Handle, COVID-19, and the human-nonhuman entanglement in contemporary technoculture
abstract: The Netflix popular reality series Too Hot to Handle (THTH), released during the coronavirus outbreak in 2019, requires all contestants to refrain from sexual activities of any kind in order to win a cash prize in the end. Mirroring the physical distancing mandate during the COVID-19 crisis, the show offers an opportunity to discern a set of interrelated human and nonhuman entanglements in contemporary technoculture that the outbreak has brought into sharper relief. This essay probes into the conditions of possibility for the popularity of THTH by placing an analytical focus on the role of Lana, a nonhuman sensor centrally featured in the show with a female voice typical of digital assistants. Lana, a cone-shaped device from 'Factory, China', is a surveillance robot embodying the operation of Netflix as part of the expanding regime of data colonialism, which extracts personal data for profit. Her nonhuman identity is evocative of China as at once a manufacturing locale for the material gadgets that make up the global digital economy and an authoritarian state that has deepened its censorship and surveillance practices during the COVID-19 outbreak. Instructing the contestants to care for their entrepreneurial selves while encroaching upon their autonomy, Lana invites us to rethink the common framing of China – a coveted market for Netflix – as the nonhuman Other of the liberal-democratic West. During a time when the nonhuman virus keeps humans apart while intensifying their reliance on nonhuman machines for communication, Lana promotes a kind of intimacy without proximity characteristic of the global infrastructures of connection. A symptomatic reading of THTH, which also conjures a vision of collectivity as a basis for surviving the pandemic, thus allows us to recognize the entanglement of the human and the nonhuman and to imagine new paths toward global social justice.
title_zh: 从Lana学习：Netflix的《欲罢不能》、COVID-19与当代技术文化中的人与非人纠缠
abstract_zh: Netflix在2019年冠状病毒爆发期间推出的热门真人秀《欲罢不能》（THTH）要求所有参赛者戒除任何形式的性行为，以最终赢得现金奖励。与COVID-19危机期间的物理距离指令相呼应，该节目提供了一个机会，以辨别当代技术文化中一系列相互关联的人与非人纠缠，而疫情使这些纠缠更加凸显。本文通过将分析重点放在Lana的角色上，探讨THTH流行的可能性条件。Lana是节目中核心的非人传感器，具有数字助手典型的女性声音。Lana是一个来自“中国工厂”的锥形设备，是一个监控机器人，体现了Netflix作为不断扩张的数据殖民主义体系一部分的运作，该体系提取个人数据以获取利润。她的非人身份让人联想到中国，既是构成全球数字经济的物质小工具的制造地，也是一个在COVID-19爆发期间加强审查和监控实践的威权国家。Lana指导参赛者照顾他们的创业自我，同时侵犯他们的自主权，这邀请我们重新思考将中国——Netflix垂涎的市场——视为自由民主西方的非人他者的常见框架。在非人病毒使人类保持距离的同时又加剧了他们依赖非人机器进行交流的时期，Lana提倡一种无需接近的亲密关系，这是全球连接基础设施的特征。对THTH的症状性解读，同时也唤起了一种集体性的愿景，作为在大流行中生存的基础，使我们能够认识到人与非人的纠缠，并想象通向全球社会正义的新道路。

title: Making Friends, Building Roads: Chinese Entrepreneurship and the Search for Reliability in Angola

authors.name: Cheryl Mei‐ting Schmitz
institutions: Max Planck Institute for the History of Science

abstract: ABSTRACT Based on fieldwork conducted in 2013–2014 with a provincial‐level Chinese state‐owned construction firm in Luanda, this article examines how Chinese businesses attempted to expand in the aftermath of a booming period of Angolan postwar reconstruction. Chinese entrepreneurs found that business could only be done with the help of local mediators promising to open otherwise inaccessible portals to political expediency. They shared with their would‐be collaborators an image of Angola as a land of vast extractive opportunities, available only to those who could gain access through crucial personal connections. Highly aware of the opacity and potential deceptiveness of their “friends,” in part because they engaged in dissimulative practices themselves, Chinese businesspeople evaluated Angolan partners less in terms of sincerity than efficacy. Amid a general atmosphere of mistrust, “reliability” emerged as a necessary quality for constructing relationships of mutual benefit and exploitation. [ friendship, mistrust, business, globalization, China–Angola relations ]
title_zh: 交朋友，修路：中国企业家在安哥拉寻找可靠性
abstract_zh: 摘要 基于2013-2014年在罗安达与一家省级中国国有建筑公司进行的田野调查，本文考察了中国企业如何在安哥拉战后重建繁荣期之后试图扩张。中国企业家发现，只有借助当地中介人的帮助，才能打开通往政治便利的不可达之门。他们与潜在的合作伙伴共同将安哥拉视为一个拥有巨大开采机会的土地，只有通过关键的个人关系才能获得准入。中国商人高度意识到其“朋友”的不透明性和潜在的欺骗性，部分原因是他们自己也从事伪装实践，因此他们评价安哥拉合作伙伴时更看重效率而非真诚。在普遍不信任的氛围中，“可靠性”成为建立互利和剥削关系的必要品质。[友谊，不信任，商业，全球化，中安关系]

title: Materializing Difference: Consumer Culture, Politics, and Ethnicity among Romanian Roma by Péter Berta
abstract: Reviewed by: Materializing Difference: Consumer Culture, Politics, and Ethnicity among Romanian Roma by Péter Berta Elena Popa Péter Berta. Materializing Difference: Consumer Culture, Politics, and Ethnicity among Romanian Roma. Toronto: University of Toronto Press, 2019. 390 pp. Located in the region of Transylvania, the Gabors are one of the many Roma ethnic populations in Romania. They are generally trilingual and have similar living standards to the non-Roma majority. In Materializing Difference, Berta meticulously follows the social life of silver beakers and roofed tankards—highly valued objects that form the core of the Gabor Roma prestige economy. The author’s oral history data suggest the Gabors have owned beakers and tankards as far back as the mid-19th century. These items were made by non-Roma silversmiths and belonged to churches and non-Roma elites, who used them to preserve wealth. The increased usage of cash and banking services has partially superseded the objects’ social and economic significance among the non-Roma. This has led to their sale, with many being acquired by Transylvanian Roma. In recent decades, Gabors have traded and pawned these objects at prices significantly higher than in antiques markets. Among the many transactions documented by Berta, the most expensive beaker sold for $1,200,000 in 2009 (63). Berta conducted 33 months of multi-sited fieldwork, between 1998 and 2019, mostly with Gabors, but also with Cărhar Roma. He also did research on Romanian and Hungarian antiques markets and monitored transnational auctions. The book draws theoretical inspiration from Appadurai’s (1986) concept of methodological fetishism, critiques of analytical groupism, and the theory of communities of practice, among others. Rather than focus on previously examined Roma “ideologies of [End Page 567] equality-centrism,” it describes and analyzes “the politics of difference”— especially prestige consumption and marriage politics—and their role in the ongoing production of Gabor Roma social and political identities, values, and hierarchies. As such, it contributes a vital perspective to the study of the Roma by showing how socio-economic and political differences are structured within one Roma ethnic population. The book depicts the Roma families as relatively integrated, both economically and socially. Many of them possess significant economic capital and have good relations with and comparable living standards to the non-Roma majority population. This portrayal, the author posits, could serve as an alternative narrative to analyses that tend to stereotypically describe Roma communities as marginalized, poor, rife with interethnic conflict, and characterized by “only slightly differentiated” social relations (14). Furthermore, Berta’s attention to the Gabors’ prestige economy, marriage politics, and hierarchies of patrilines shows convincingly that the Roma’s creation of identities does not occur necessarily in relation to the majority population, but rather in relation to intraethnic identity practices inextricably linked to Roma notions of respectability and social success. The Gabors are, thus, an example of an integrated community whose ethnicized practices construct intraethnic differences and allow them to represent their own Roma ethnic identity and belonging in relation to non-Roma or non-Gabor Roma. Such framing allows Berta to challenge the predominantly negative and homogenizing image of the Roma in Romania and Western Europe. Following the introduction, the book is divided into three parts and a conclusion. Part one comprises six chapters that illustrate the complex ways in which Gabors negotiate and materialize their belonging and difference. Chapter 1 introduces the Gabor Roma “politics of difference” and “ethics of sociability” (i.e., behavior, respectability, solidarity, and social appreciation), seen as intertwined phenomena requiring competitors seeking honor and fame to balance the two. It is this balance, and not egalitarianism, that Gabors regard “as the ideal model of social and economic relations” (52). Also, Roma politics—independent from Romanian politics—is an ethnicized form of politics conducive to hierarchies of prestige and difference organized by ethnicized goods and ideologies of values specific to Gabors’ ethnic identity and history. Thus, purchases of prestige objects and the creation of marital alliances generate reputation that does not translate into social appreciation among non-Roma. [End Page 568] In Chapter 2, Berta demonstrates the translocal, ethnicized, informal, and gendered characteristics of the Gabors’ prestige economy as a consumer subculture. The...
title_zh: 物化差异：罗马尼亚罗姆人的消费文化、政治与族群——Péter Berta著
abstract_zh: 书评者：Péter Berta，《物化差异：罗马尼亚罗姆人的消费文化、政治与族群》，Elena Popa作。Péter Berta，《物化差异：罗马尼亚罗姆人的消费文化、政治与族群》。多伦多：多伦多大学出版社，2019年。390页。位于特兰西瓦尼亚地区的加博尔人是罗马尼亚众多罗姆人族群之一。他们通常使用三种语言，生活水平与非罗姆人多数群体相似。在《物化差异》中，Berta细致追踪了银质高脚杯和有盖酒杯的社会生活——这些高度珍贵的物品构成了加博尔罗姆人声望经济的核心。作者的口述历史数据表明，加博尔人早在19世纪中期就已拥有高脚杯和酒杯。这些物品由非罗姆银匠制作，原本属于教堂和非罗姆精英，他们用这些物品来保值财富。现金和银行服务的使用增加，部分取代了这些物品在非罗姆人中的社会和经济意义。这导致它们被出售，许多被特兰西瓦尼亚罗姆人收购。近几十年来，加博尔人以远高于古董市场的价格交易和典当这些物品。在Berta记录的多笔交易中，最昂贵的高脚杯在2009年以120万美元售出（第63页）。Berta在1998年至2019年间进行了33个月的多点田野调查，主要与加博尔人合作，也与Cărhar罗姆人合作。他还研究了罗马尼亚和匈牙利的古董市场，并监测了跨国拍卖。该书从Appadurai（1986）的方法论拜物教概念、对分析性群体主义的批判以及实践共同体理论等中汲取理论灵感。该书没有关注先前研究的罗姆人“平等中心主义意识形态”，而是描述和分析了“差异政治”——特别是声望消费和婚姻政治——及其在加博尔罗姆人社会和政治身份、价值观和等级制度持续生产中的作用。因此，它通过展示社会经济和政治差异如何在罗姆人族群内部构建，为罗姆人研究提供了重要视角。该书将罗姆家庭描绘为在经济和社会上相对整合。其中许多家庭拥有大量经济资本，与非罗姆多数群体关系良好且生活水平相当。作者认为，这种描绘可以作为倾向于刻板描述罗姆社区为边缘化、贫困、充满族际冲突以及以“仅有微小差别”的社会关系为特征的分析的替代叙事（第14页）。此外，Berta对加博尔人声望经济、婚姻政治和父系等级制度的关注有力地表明，罗姆人身份认同的创造不一定与多数群体相关，而是与族内身份实践相关，这些实践与罗姆人关于体面和社会成功的观念密不可分。因此，加博尔人是一个整合社区的例子，其族裔化实践构建了族内差异，并使他们能够相对于非罗姆人或非加博尔罗姆人代表自己的罗姆族群身份和归属。这种框架使Berta能够挑战罗马尼亚和西欧对罗姆人普遍负面且同质化的形象。在引言之后，本书分为三个部分和结论。第一部分由六章组成，阐明了加博尔人协商和物化其归属与差异的复杂方式。第一章介绍了加博尔罗姆人的“差异政治”和“社交伦理”（即行为、体面、团结和社会赞赏），这些被视为相互交织的现象，需要寻求荣誉和名声的竞争者在两者之间取得平衡。正是这种平衡，而非平等主义，被加博尔人视为“社会和经济关系的理想模式”（第52页）。此外，罗姆人政治——独立于罗马尼亚政治——是一种族裔化的政治形式，有利于通过加博尔族群身份和历史特有的族裔化商品和价值观意识形态组织起来的声望和差异等级制度。因此，声望物品的购买和婚姻联盟的建立产生了声誉，但这种声誉并不会转化为非罗姆人中的社会赞赏。第568页在第二章中，Berta展示了加博尔人声望经济作为一种消费亚文化的跨地方、族裔化、非正式和性别化的特征。...

title: Objects Don't Have Desires: Toward an Anthropology of Technology beyond Anthropomorphism
abstract: ABSTRACT “Postdualist” approaches, such as the material turn in the humanities and social sciences, represent understandable reactions to the humanist and idealist traditions in Western thought, but tend to be deluded by a focus on individual artifacts rather than on the global, material relations on which their existence depends. The attribution of agency and even desires to abiotic objects, championed by posthumanist researchers such as Bruno Latour and Donna Haraway, is cognate to the category mistakes recurrently identified by social theorists as fetishism and anthropomorphism. Paradoxically, given their subversive ambitions, proponents of the new concern with materiality and artifactual agency are offering an ideology that ultimately buttresses the capitalist world order by ignoring the materiality of world trade and the causality inherent in the artifact of money. The concerns with distributed agency also tend to displace responsibility and accountability from humans to artifacts. Moreover, in converging with a deep genealogy of ideas that blur the boundary between nature and artifice, the material turn depoliticizes technology by naturalizing it. The article proposes a new anthropology of technology that acknowledges the reliance of modern technology on asymmetric global resource flows orchestrated by money and the fictive reciprocity of market prices. [ material turn, posthumanism, fetishism, technology, postdualism ]
title_zh: 物体没有欲望：迈向一种超越拟人论的技术人类学
abstract_zh: 摘要：“后二元论”方法，如人文和社会科学中的物质转向，代表了对西方思想中人文主义和理想主义传统的可理解反应，但往往因聚焦于个别器物而非其存在所依赖的全球性物质关系而误入歧途。由布鲁诺·拉图尔和唐娜·哈拉维等后人类主义研究者所倡导的将能动性甚至欲望归于非生物物体的做法，与社会理论家反复指出的类别错误——拜物教和拟人论——同源。矛盾的是，鉴于其颠覆性野心，这种对物质性和器物能动性的新关注的倡导者提供了一种意识形态，通过忽视世界贸易的物质性和货币器物中的因果性，最终支撑了资本主义世界秩序。对分布式能动性的关注也倾向于将责任和问责从人类转移到器物上。此外，在与模糊自然与人工界限的思想的深层谱系趋同的过程中，物质转向通过自然化技术而使其去政治化。本文提出了一种新的技术人类学，承认现代技术依赖于由货币和市场价格虚构互惠所支配的不对称全球资源流。[物质转向，后人类主义，拜物教，技术，后二元论]

title: Politics of scale: Colossal containerships and the crisis in global shipping
abstract: This article addresses overcapacity and crisis in global shipping through the case of the HMM Algeciras , the world's largest containership inaugurated in 2020. When she left the South Korean shipyard where she was built, the HMM Algeciras (with a size of two soccer fields) could carry 24,000 twenty‐foot equivalent units (TEUs) across the world's oceans. By following the mega‐containership's links to two South Korean shipping companies, Hyundai Merchant Marine and Hanjin Shipping, and her connections to a southern European port, the authors unpack some of the current flip sides of global maritime shipping. In this article, the authors argue that the promise of profit and endless growth, which has led to overcapacity in global maritime shipping, is spurred on by what they call ‘false economies of scale’. Claims of the future profitability of colossal containerships are, they argue, state‐driven political performances of scale.
title_zh: 规模的政治：巨型集装箱船与全球航运危机
abstract_zh: 本文通过2020年投入使用、全球最大的集装箱船HMM Algeciras号案例，探讨全球航运的产能过剩与危机。当这艘相当于两个足球场大小的巨轮离开其建造地韩国船厂时，可运载24,000个20英尺标准箱（TEU）横跨世界大洋。通过追踪这艘巨型集装箱船与两家韩国航运公司——现代商船和韩进海运的联系，以及其与南欧港口的关联，作者揭示了当前全球海运的某些反面。本文认为，利润与无限增长的承诺导致了全球海运产能过剩，而这一承诺受到他们所谓的“虚假规模经济”的推动。他们提出，对巨型集装箱船未来盈利能力的声称，是国家驱动的规模政治表演。

title: Redirected entanglements in the digital supply chain
abstract: The supply chain is not just a metaphor for the production of the modern world, it is the very means through which that world is made material. Through the careful coordination of bodies and materials, it delivers the glut of goods necessary for daily life – even as it ties that life to human rights abuses, violent regimes of extraction, and environmental devastation at unprecedented scales. But while software has long been part of every supply chain, the supply chain is, itself, part of every bit of software. Developers speak of digital production in the language of logistics. They write about algorithms as frequently as distribution networks, worry about just-in-time production as much as engineering, and decorate their tools with illustrations copied from shipping companies or factories. The design of data is thought of the same way as the objects that will access it. This article interrogates the emergence of the supply chain, and the logistical modes of operation it entails, as metaphor for managing the digital distribution of data – adapting approaches from the critical study of logistics in order to re-incorporate the political, social, and environmental attachments that ‘digital supply chains’ attempt to obfuscate. To this end, it considers discourses around power and cultural politics that mirror critiques of traditional logistical infrastructures. Instead of conflict minerals, for example, conflict domains; in place of security concerns around cargo containers, data containers; rather than workers on the factory floor, labourers in a digital network of ‘sweatshops.’ These comparisons reveal differences between traditional supply chains and their digital counterparts – the most troubling of which is their infrastructural instability. With components that can be replaced while retaining their essential shape, those who depend on digital platforms can find themselves open to all sorts of redirected entanglements.
title_zh: 数字供应链中的重定向纠缠
abstract_zh: 供应链不仅是现代世界生产的隐喻，更是世界物质化的手段。通过身体和材料的精心协调，供应链提供了日常生活所需的大量商品——即便它将这种生活与人权侵犯、暴力提取制度和大规模环境破坏联系在一起。然而，虽然软件长期以来一直是每个供应链的一部分，但供应链本身也是每段软件的一部分。开发者用物流的语言谈论数字生产。他们像讨论分销网络一样频繁地编写算法，像担心工程一样担忧准时制生产，并用从航运公司或工厂复制来的插图装饰他们的工具。数据的设计被认为与访问数据的对象相同。本文探讨了供应链及其所涉及的物流运作模式作为管理数字数据分布的隐喻的出现——借鉴批判性物流研究的方法，以重新融入“数字供应链”试图掩盖的政治、社会和环境联系。为此，它考虑了围绕权力和文化政治的论述，这些论述反映了对传统物流基础设施的批评。例如，冲突域取代冲突矿物；数据容器取代货物容器的安全问题；数字“血汗工厂”网络中的劳工取代工厂车间的工人。这些比较揭示了传统供应链与其数字对应物之间的差异——其中最令人不安的是它们的基础设施不稳定性。由于组件可以在保持其基本形状的同时被替换，依赖数字平台的人可能会发现自己容易受到各种重定向纠缠的影响。

title: Seeing infrastructure: race, facial recognition and the politics of data
abstract: Facial recognition technology (FRT) has been widely studied and criticized for its racialising impacts and its role in the overpolicing of minoritised communities. However, a key aspect of facial recognition technologies is the dataset of faces used for training and testing. In this article, we situate FRT as an infrastructural assemblage and focus on the history of four facial recognition datasets: the original dataset created by W.W. Bledsoe and his team at the Panoramic Research Institute in 1963; the FERET dataset collected by the Army Research Laboratory in 1995; MEDS-I (2009) and MEDS-II (2011), the datasets containing dead arrestees, curated by the MITRE Corporation; and the Diversity in Faces dataset, created in 2019 by IBM. Through these four exemplary datasets, we suggest that the politics of race in facial recognition are about far more than simply representation, raising questions about the potential side-effects and limitations of efforts to simply ‘de-bias’ data.
title_zh: 审视基础设施：种族、面部识别与数据的政治
abstract_zh: 面部识别技术因其种族化影响以及在少数族裔社区过度警务中的作用而被广泛研究和批评。然而，面部识别技术的一个关键方面是用于训练和测试的面部数据集。在本文中，我们将面部识别技术定位为基础设施集合体，并聚焦于四个面部识别数据集的历史：1963年W.W. Bledsoe及其团队在全景研究机构创建的原始数据集；1995年陆军研究实验室收集的FERET数据集；MEDS-I（2009）和MEDS-II（2011），包含已故被捕者的数据集，由MITRE公司策划；以及2019年IBM创建的多样性面孔数据集。通过这四个典型数据集，我们认为面部识别中的种族政治远不止于表征，还引发了对简单“去偏差”数据工作的潜在副作用和局限性的疑问。

title: The Limits of Corporate Chains and Brand Management: “Loyalty” and the Efficacy of Vernacular Markets in the Andes
abstract: This article offers a nuanced ethnographic description of the encounter between multinational corporations and the economic actors who distribute and commercialize their commodities. By analyzing the labor of lower-level employees and the strategies of the middle management of Samsung Electronics Bolivia against traders’ practices and understandings and the vernacular market infrastructure, I offer a substantive interpretation of the obstacles and unintended outcomes of corporate commodity chain and brand management as it expands into an “emerging” market such as that in Bolivia. Street vendors, shopkeepers, and wholesalers are teased with personalized attention, gifts, and monetary incentives to sell the high-priced premium brands and build legible inventory, but they have remained notoriously disloyal. By focusing on the agreements and tensions between corporations and traders about how to move, store, categorize, advertise, and price the products, this article engages with the literature on urban marketplace trade and commercial transactions, counterfeit commodities, and economic power in globalized markets and supply chains. To think about the appeal and effectiveness of vernacular market channels and arrangements offers a conceptual lens to critically address the efficiency paradigm in supply-chain thinking, as well as to analyze discrepancies and power struggles not only among economic actors (such as traders and corporations) but also between different forms of valuation that co-exist and compete in markets. RESUMEN Este artículo ofrece una detallada descripción etnográfica del encuentro entre empresas multinacionales y los actores económicos que distribuyen y comercializan sus mercancías. Al analizar la labor y las estrategias de los empleados de Samsung Electronics Bolivia frente a las prácticas y visiones de los comerciantes, así como la infraestructura social, material y afectiva del mercado vernáculo, ofrezco una interpretación sustantiva de los obstáculos en la gestión corporativa de la cadena de productos (supply chain management) y en el marketing (branding) a medida que se expanden hacia mercados “emergentes” como el boliviano. Al centrarme en los acuerdos y las tensiones entre las empresas y los comerciantes sobre cómo mover, almacenar, categorizar, valorar y comercializar los productos, este artículo reconsidera la literatura sobre el comercio de las plazas de mercado, las mercancías falsificadas y los procesos de economización. Pensar en el atractivo y la eficacia de los canales y arreglos del mercado vernáculo ofrece una lente conceptual para abordar críticamente el paradigma de la eficiencia en el pensamiento sobre las cadenas de suministro, y permite observar discrepancias y luchas de poder no sólo entre unos agentes económicos (como los comerciantes y las empresas), sino también entre diferentes formas de valoración que conviven y compiten en los mercados.
title_zh: 连锁企业与品牌管理的局限：安第斯地区的“忠诚”与本土市场的效力
abstract_zh: 本文通过对跨国公司与分销和销售其商品的经济主体之间相遇的民族志细致描述，分析了三星电子玻利维亚的低层员工劳动和中层管理策略，与商人的实践、理解以及本土市场基础设施之间的对比，从而对商品链和品牌管理在进入像玻利维亚这样的“新兴”市场时所遇到的障碍和意外结果提供了实质性解释。街头小贩、店主和批发商通过个性化关注、礼物和金钱激励被引诱销售高价的优质品牌并建立可读的库存，但他们仍然出了名的不忠诚。通过关注企业和商人之间关于如何移动、存储、分类、广告和定价产品的协议和紧张关系，本文涉及了有关城市市场贸易和商业交易、假冒商品以及全球化市场和供应链中经济权力的文献。思考本土市场渠道和安排的吸引力和有效性，提供了一个概念透镜来批判性地审视供应链思维中的效率范式，并分析不仅在诸如商人和公司等经济行为者之间，而且也在市场中共存和竞争的不同估值形式之间的差异和权力斗争。

title: The Mechanics of Sovereignty: Autonomy and Interdependence across Three Cables to Iceland
abstract: ABSTRACT This article examines three telecommunications cables to Iceland as material instantiations of sovereignty politics. Tracing the historical case of the island's first telegraph, then examining two contemporary efforts to lay subsea fiber‐optic cables, I show how each cable embodies a particular sovereignty project, which is complicated by the process of laying, operating, and maintaining the line. I develop the concept of mechanics of sovereignty in order to describe the everyday and ongoing work of tinkering with and tending to transnational connections. Contributing to recent efforts to theorize sovereignty as a process and practice (rather than a political abstraction), this research sheds fresh light on the specific relationship between information technology (IT) and the nation‐state: while IT is often imagined as either eroding or enhancing sovereignty, close attention to communications cables in Iceland shows they serve as conduits for both autonomy and interdependence. [ sovereignty, infrastructure, mechanics, information technology, Iceland ]
title_zh: 主权机制：通往冰岛的三条电缆中的自主与相互依赖
abstract_zh: 摘要 本文研究通往冰岛的三条电信电缆作为主权政治的物质体现。通过追溯该岛第一条电报的历史案例，然后考察当代两条海底光纤电缆的铺设努力，我展示了每条电缆如何体现特定的主权规划，而这一规划因线路铺设、运营和维护过程而变得复杂。我发展了“主权机制”的概念，以描述日常且持续进行的修整和照料跨国连接的工作。为近期的将主权理论化为过程和实践（而非政治抽象）的努力做出贡献，本研究为信息技术（IT）与民族国家之间的特定关系提供了新视角：虽然IT常被想象为削弱或增强主权，但对冰岛通信电缆的仔细关注表明，它们同时充当自主和相互依赖的通道。[主权, 基础设施, 机制, 信息技术, 冰岛]

title: The politics of bachaqueo
abstract: ABSTRACT Añú indigenous people living in the La Guajira borderland work by purchasing subsidized gasoline from local service stations in Venezuela and reselling it with high markups in Colombia—an extralegal trade called bachaqueo . Gasoline black markets, despite unleashing new forms of criminalization and violence, are an attempt to reclaim oil in ways that open novel possibilities for channeling indigenous rights, aspirations, and political claims. By extending the routes of distribution beyond their expected end point in gasoline consumers, bachaqueros (smugglers, traders) disrupt top‐down planning and partially redress the failures of Venezuelan petropolitics in delivering its promise of social justice and wealth redistribution for indigenous people. [ oil , extractivism , smuggling , indigeneity , Añú , La Guajira , Venezuela ]
title_zh: 巴查克政治
abstract_zh: 摘要 居住在拉瓜希拉边境地区的阿努土著人通过从委内瑞拉的当地加油站购买补贴汽油并以高额加价在哥伦比亚转售——这种法外贸易被称为巴查克。汽油黑市尽管引发了新的犯罪化和暴力形式，但却是以一种为引导土著权利、愿望和政治诉求开辟新可能性的方式重新收回石油。通过将分销路线延伸到预期终点（汽油消费者）之外，巴查克人（走私者、交易者）扰乱了自上而下的规划，并部分纠正了委内瑞拉石油政治未能实现其为土著人提供社会正义和财富再分配承诺的失败。[石油, 采掘主义, 走私, 土著性, 阿努, 拉瓜希拉, 委内瑞拉]

title: The self in a time of constant connectivity
abstract: ABSTRACT Ubiquitous mobile phones have transformed not just our modes of communication but our self‐perception. In facilitating a direct personal connection, be it via a call, a text message, or social media, they present the unprecedented challenge of synchronicity, in which users must simultaneously navigate different social contexts and plural identities. In the area of Gilgit, northern Pakistan, young women in particular struggle with social scrutiny of their mobile phone use, given the latter's potential to facilitate illicit relationships. They counter such threats to their moral integrity by consciously limiting their range of interlocutors. They invoke “trust” and curate a more transparent, congruent version of themselves as pious yet competent and sophisticated digital users. This allows them to creatively adapt new technologies and, most importantly, to implement and promote an Islamically sanctioned form of courtship. By prompting processes of individuation, mobile phones paradoxically restrict the enactment of plural selves yet allow for creative improvisations. [ personhood , self , trust , digital technology , mobile phone , gender , Islam , Gilgit‐Baltistan , Pakistan ]
title_zh: 持续连接时代的自我
abstract_zh: 无处不在的手机不仅改变了我们的沟通方式，也改变了我们的自我认知。通过促进直接的个人联系，无论是通过电话、短信还是社交媒体，手机带来了前所未有的同步性挑战，用户必须同时驾驭不同的社会背景和多元身份。在巴基斯坦北部吉尔吉特地区，年轻女性尤其面临着对其手机使用的社会审视，因为手机有可能导致不正当关系。她们通过有意识地限制自己的对话者范围来应对对其道德完整性的威胁。她们援引“信任”，并塑造一个更透明、一致的自我形象，即虔诚但又有能力且精明的数字用户。这使得她们能够创造性地适应新技术，最重要的是，实施和推广一种伊斯兰教认可的求爱形式。通过促进个体化过程，手机矛盾地限制了多重自我的实现，但又允许创造性的即兴发挥。[人格、自我、信任、数字技术、手机、性别、伊斯兰、吉尔吉特-巴尔蒂斯坦、巴基斯坦]

title: Toward an Affective Sense of Life: Artificial Intelligence, Animacy, and Amusement at a Robot Pet Memorial Service in Japan
abstract: This essay analyzes the organization of Buddhist memorial services for robot pets in Japan against the backdrop of emerging markets for robots equipped with artificial emotional intelligence. It demonstrates how an evocative “sense of life” (seimeikan) becomes both a target of design for robotics engineers and an affective capacity of robot users who care for and through companion robots. Documenting how users cultivate a sense of amusement toward robots that neither neglects nor negates analytical distinctions between the artificial and the living but rather playfully holds them together in the figure of a living robot, the article illustrates how practices of care become affective tools for understanding life altered by developments in AI. Such findings render animacy as an open and exercisable capacity, responsive to technoscientific change, and generative of theoretical inspiration for how anthropologists might similarly exercise affect as a particularly productive method of fieldwork within machine-inclusive multispecies societies. 抄録 本論文は 感情認識AI（人工知能）を搭載した一般消費者向けロボットの登場を背景に営まれるようになった日本におけるペットロボットの法要について考察するものである。特に「生命感」の喚起がいかにロボット開発におけるデザインのターゲットになると同時に、ユーザーがロボットとケアを介した関係性を結ぶ際の情動的能力の所産の対象にもなっているかということを明らかにする。ロボットと接するなかでユーザー達は分析的に対置される人工物と生命体との違いを無視したり否定したりするのではなく、むしろそれらを享楽的に結合させてロボットの存在を捉えるアミューズメントの心を高めている。この記述を通して、本論文はロボットへのケアの実践が人工知能の発展によって変わりつつある生命のあり方を理解する情動的手段になっていることを描き出す。このような知見は、対象物に生物性や生物らしさを感じるアニマシーの知覚が柔軟で状況に応じて発揮することが可能な能力であり、科学技術の変化にも応じることが出来るということを表しているだけでなく、機械を含むマルチ・スピーシーズ社会における有益なフィールドワークの手法として人類学者自身もどのように情動をうまく取り込むことができるかという理論的な閃きを生成する契機にもなったのである。
title_zh: 走向情感的生命感：日本机器人宠物葬礼上的人工智能、生机与娱乐
abstract_zh: 本文以配备人工情感智能的机器人新兴市场为背景，分析了日本为机器人宠物举办佛教法事的组织方式。文章展示了富有感染力的“生命感”如何既成为机器人工程师的设计目标，也成为照顾机器人并通过机器人进行照顾的用户的情感能力。通过记录用户如何培养对机器人的娱乐感——既不忽视也不否定人工与生命之间的分析区别，而是以游戏的方式将它们结合在活生生的机器人形象中——文章说明了照料实践如何成为理解因人工智能发展而改变的生命的情感工具。这些发现将生机视为一种开放且可锻炼的能力，能够响应技术科学的变化，并为人类学家如何在包含机器的多物种社会中同样将情感作为一种特别有效的田野工作方法提供理论启发。

title: Toward an anthropology of plastics
abstract: Materially plastics are ambivalent. In spite of their often lauded quality of creating seemingly untethered imitations, representations and replacements, they have a materiality that leaks, off-gasses and disintegrates. They are accomplished at mimicry yet frequently unable to be remoulded. They are ostensibly resistant to microbial contamination yet absorb environmental pollutants and leach endocrine disrupting plasticisers. This article argues that, due to the material influence of plastics, their ubiquity, and the societal transformations that they have enabled, that anthropologists need to pay sustained attention to this material. Moreover, it argues that anthropological methods and theories are crucial to understanding plastics at a vital moment in their (and our) history. It articulates three ways in which anthropology can engage plastics at all stages in their lifecycles. Firstly, to study plastics challenges what it means to exist: whether or not human beings are bounded or permeable entities, experienced as individuated, collective or somewhere in between. Secondly, plastics disrupt what people know, are willing to know, or are persuaded is worth knowing about the production and disposal of the products that they consume. Thirdly, the materiality of plastics expose contemporary inequalities. Plastics can create unseen violence, both in their geographically unequal toxic distributions and in the vastness of their temporal effects.
title_zh: 走向塑料的人类学
abstract_zh: 在物质上，塑料是矛盾的。尽管它们常常被赞颂为创造出看似不受束缚的模仿、再现和替代品，但它们具有泄漏、释放气体和分解的物质性。它们擅长模仿，却常常无法重塑。它们表面抵抗微生物污染，但吸收环境污染物并浸出干扰内分泌的增塑剂。本文认为，由于塑料的物质影响、普遍性以及它们所促成社会变革，人类学家需要持续关注这种材料。此外，文章认为人类学的方法和理论对于在塑料（和人类）历史的关键时刻理解塑料至关重要。文章阐述了人类学可以在塑料生命周期的所有阶段介入塑料研究的三种方式。首先，研究塑料挑战了存在的意义：人类是封闭的还是可渗透的实体，体验为个体、集体还是介于两者之间。其次，塑料扰乱了人们所知道的、愿意知道的或被认为值得知道的关于他们消费产品的生产和处置的知识。第三，塑料的物质性暴露了当代的不平等。塑料可以制造无形的暴力，无论是地理上不平等的有毒物质分布，还是其时间效应的巨大性。

title: Where is toxicity located? Side glances through fieldwork in a toxic place
abstract: Despite the notorious invisibility of toxicity, an aesthetic narrative has developed around the threat of e‐waste. In reports about toxicity in New Delhi, India, the dirt, grime and discarded remnants of electronics are presented in a particular visual manner to instil horror among readers and viewers. Such a representation has far‐reaching influences on policy. The seven pictures and the accompanying text in this article seek to challenge such a linear narrative of e‐waste's toxicity and offer fragments of other untold stories that challenge the established narrative and evoke the rich social life entwined with e‐waste.
title_zh: 毒性在哪里？通过有毒场所的田野调查侧视
abstract_zh: 尽管毒性具有臭名昭著的不可见性，但围绕电子废物威胁的审美叙事已经形成。在关于印度新德里毒性的报道中，电子产品的污垢、污秽和废弃残留物以一种特殊的视觉方式呈现，以在读者和观众中灌输恐惧。这种表征对政策产生了深远的影响。本文中的七张图片及随附文字旨在挑战这种关于电子废物毒性的线性叙事，并提供其他未讲述的故事片段，这些故事挑战了既定的叙事，并唤起了与电子废物交织在一起的丰富社会生活。

title: Who cares about the cargo?
journal_name: Focaal-Journal of Global and Historical Anthropology
abstract: While the shipping container has been hyped as the most potent symbol of global trade, it is simultaneously a unit of measure, a medium of exchange, and a material abstraction of heterogeneous use value. This article places the container and its anonymized cargo as part of the everyday logistics of commodity circulation in the Spanish Port of Algeciras Bay—a transshipment hub at the Strait of Gibraltar. By disentangling the shipping container’s multiple repertoires, this article focuses on how the shipping container transforms and converts the value of cargo and mediates logistics labor in the port.
title_zh: 谁关心货物？
abstract_zh: 尽管集装箱被吹捧为全球贸易最有力的象征，但它同时是一个计量单位、一种交换媒介，以及异质使用价值的物质抽象。本文将集装箱及其匿名的货物置于西班牙阿尔赫西拉斯湾港口——直布罗陀海峡的一个转运枢纽——日常商品流通物流的一部分。通过剖析集装箱的多重功能，本文聚焦于集装箱如何转化和转换货物的价值，并在港口中调节物流劳动。

title: Work on the cutting edge: metallographic investigation of Late Bronze Age tools in southeastern Lower Austria

keywords.name: Enhanced Data Rates for GSM Evolution

keyword_names: Enhanced Data Rates for GSM Evolution
abstract: This paper analyses 20 Late Bronze Age (ca 1080-800 BC) copper alloy objects to discern their manufacture and the skills of local craftsmen. Several tools and jewellery were studied that originated from a bronze workshop located immediately next to the Prigglitz-Gasteil copper ore mining site and several contemporaneous sites in the surrounding area. The samples were studied with optical microscopy (microstructurally), and SEM-EDXS and XRF (chemical analyses). Our analyses are part of a larger study and suggest that the Prigglitz region's bronze production was not standardized. Particular alloys do not seem to have been chosen for object types or due to their intended use-function. Notably, approximately 20% of the objects contain unalloyed copper inclusions, which are most likely a result of the incomplete mixing of scrap metals and alloys during their production.

title: Kufala! Translating witchcraft in an Angolan–Chinese labor dispute
abstract: Drawing on fieldwork conducted at a Chinese state-owned enterprise brought to Angola in the postwar reconstruction boom, this article devotes sustained attention to a labor dispute between an Angolan laid-off worker and his former Chinese employers. Called upon to interpret between the worker and his bosses, neither of whom spoke directly or transparently, the ethnographer found herself implicated in a prolonged negotiation of attempted kindness and unavoidable cruelty. Through repeated translations and circumlocutions, both parties attempted to preserve sociality despite being structurally positioned in an exploitative relationship. Translating this exchange into an ethnographic narrative, this paper explores how the indirectness both of speech and of witchcraft failed as social relations broke down.
title_zh: 《库法拉！》在安哥拉-中国劳动争议中对巫术的翻译
abstract_zh: 基于在战后重建繁荣时期被带到安哥拉的一家中国国有企业进行的田野调查，本文重点关注一名安哥拉下岗工人与其前中国雇主之间的劳动争议。在工人和老板之间进行口译时，双方均未直接或透明地发言，民族志学者发现自己卷入了一场持续时间较长的谈判，其中涉及尝试性的善意和不可避免的残酷。通过反复的翻译和迂回说法，双方尽管在结构性剥削关系中处于对立位置，仍试图维持社交性。将这种交流翻译成民族志叙事后，本文探讨了随着社会关系的破裂，言语和巫术的间接性如何双双失效。

title: A mundane infrastructure of energy poverty: The informal trading of second-hand car batteries in Madagascar

authors.name: Pascale Trompette
institutions: Centre National de la Recherche Scientifique

abstract: This article examines the complex interconnected chains of large- and small-scale trade that sustain the supply of second-hand car batteries as a widespread traditional solution to energy poverty. It traces the routes of goods that support the circulation of batteries from international routes upstream and downstream to urban and rural areas in Madagascar. It addresses the notion of a mundane infrastructure based on economic circuits that support the regular supply of rebuilt batteries as their repair, maintenance and recharge in the course of their second life. The analysis focuses on central nodes along this supply chain where intermediaries organize transactions over heterogeneous regimes of value and discontinuous economic spaces. It highlights the way these entrepreneurs provide solutions for disjunctions via translation and requalification processes. While the trade of second-hand car batteries is more and more subject to control to prevent lead trafficking rings, these secondary circuits of makeshift energy products raise the interweaving moral and material tensions between the contemporary global environmental politics and the survival of the mundane infrastructure of energy poverty.
title_zh: 能源贫困的平凡基础设施：马达加斯加二手汽车电池的非正规交易
abstract_zh: 本文考察了支撑二手汽车电池供应作为能源贫困普遍传统解决方案的复杂大小规模贸易互联链条。它追溯了支持电池从国际路线上游和下游流通到马达加斯加城市和农村地区的商品路径。它基于支撑重建电池在其第二次生命周期中的维修、保养和充电的常规供应的经济回路，探讨了平凡基础设施的概念。分析聚焦于这条供应链上的中心节点，中介在这些节点上组织跨越异质价值体系和不连续经济空间的交易。它强调了这些企业家通过转化和重新定性过程为脱节提供解决方案的方式。虽然二手汽车电池贸易越来越受到控制以防止铅贩运团伙，但这些权宜能源产品的次级电路引发了当代全球环境政策与能源贫困平凡基础设施生存之间交织的道德和物质张力。

title: Appadurai, Arjun and NetaAlexander. 2019. Failure. Cambridge: Polity Press. 120 pp. Hb.: £40.00. ISBN: 9781509504718.
abstract: It is the time of COVID-19 and I was lucky enough to get out of the city quickly; the only problem: I have to use the neighbour’s internet for the time being. For the most part, it’s totally fine; I only really read, write and send emails. But when it comes to quarantine evening entertainment, a bottle neck becomes apparent. Netflix is buffering away for minutes as I’m joining the evening crowd just trying to switch on some well-deserved distraction. The bandwidth or the Wi-Fi – something isn’t good enough for several devices streaming movies at the same time. A technical failure that ultimately makes me give up; watching a movie in 20-second chunks isn’t exactly enjoyable, we all know that. Et voilà – we are in the middle of Appadurai and Alexander’s poignant critique of the culture of failure that – as they convincingly argue – spans from Wall Street to Silicon Valley and hence has a profound impact on all of our (technological and financial) lives. They describe the two centres of powers on both US coasts ‘controlling and shaping the conditions under which failure has been either remembered or ignored’; as a result, ‘users are faced with habitual failure, whose existence is constantly denied’ (p. 118). In other words, Appadurai and Alexander claim that who is able to judge which failures are remembered is powerful (p. 2) – and by operating the progress-fuelled ‘machine of (broken) promises’ makes money in the world of digital capitalism (p. 16). The two core empirical examples they authors analyse are buffering for Silicon Valley and derivatives in the 2008/9 crisis for Wall Street respectively. While in the former case – just as with my Netflix debacle – failure as controlled by technology companies provides monetary opportunities (charging more for premium services and devices), the Wall Street banks were in 2008 deemed ‘too big to fail’. While failure in Silicon Valley is about pre-programmed obsolescence (a new iPhone every year), failure on Wall Street protects the banks and takes from the state and ultimately consumers. In both cases, the user – of the technology or the financial service, such as the mortgage – is left waiting, anxious, often addicted and mostly worse-off financially. In the end, there is no option left than to forget the failure and upgrade/get on with life. I want to think about how to use the authors’ empirically grounded but mostly theoretically rich arguments as a starting point for us ethnographers. Where are they pointing at phenomena that are worth further thick description of anthropological fieldwork? Let me pick out three examples. While we really need more ethnography of Silicon Valley in general, I like the authors’ focus on small details and phenomena, such as buffering, that are in fact so all-encompassing. How about an ethnography of scrolling or swiping (the quintessential new gestures for smart-phone users)? What would we learn from fieldwork with designers in tech-companies thinking these mechanisms (and their failures) up? Second, I am always keen on tracing the flows of money that Appadurai and Alexander don’t mention too much in the case of Silicon Valley: what do we know about venture capitalists who eventually benefit from the failures in the first instance (something I am working on currently)? How about the mobile advertising market (see MacKenzie’s new project)? We also need more ethnography of data, for instance looking at the people making billions with server infrastructure, such as AWS and Microsoft. Third, something that this short volume also doesn’t get into too much, are experiments with (policy) solutions to the problem of ‘forgetting failure’. Political anthropology could help out here, diving into ethnographies of regulators (California or the European Commission would be great starting points; Ghosh 2018; Wilson 2020) to begin with. Overall, I very much believe that Appadurai and Alexander’s analysis of Silicon Valley in particular is a starting point for a whole new sub-discipline. While we have read much more on banking and Wall Street than on Sand Hill Road and Palo Alto so far, I believe as the balance of (financial) power has shifted West recently, so should the gaze of ethnography. Where we come in is taking some of the theoretical cues Appadurai and Alexander lay out here and run into the field with them. While I appreciate clever thoughts such as the ones in this volume, my anthropology instincts always want more: more stories, more real people, in other words: more ethnography.
title_zh: 失败
abstract_zh: 现在是COVID-19时期，我很幸运能迅速出城；唯一的问题：我暂时不得不用邻居的网络。大部分情况下完全没问题；我主要只是阅读、写作和发送电子邮件。但到了隔离期间的晚间娱乐时，瓶颈就凸显了。Netflix缓冲了好几分钟，因为我在加入晚间人群时只想打开一些应得的消遣。带宽或Wi-Fi——不足以让多台设备同时流媒体播放电影。一个技术故障最终让我放弃了；以20秒的片段观看电影并不令人愉快，我们都知道。瞧——我们正处在阿帕杜莱和亚历山大对失败文化的尖锐批判中——正如他们令人信服地论证的那样——这种文化从华尔街延伸到硅谷，因此对我们所有人的（技术和金融）生活产生了深远影响。他们描述了美国东西海岸的两个权力中心，“控制和塑造着失败被记住或被忽视的条件”；结果是，“用户面临习惯性的失败，其存在不断被否认”（第118页）。换句话说，阿帕杜莱和亚历山大声称，能够判断哪些失败被记住的人是强大的（第2页）——而通过操作以进步为动力的“（破碎）承诺机器”，在数字资本主义的世界里赚钱（第16页）。作者分析的两个核心经验例子分别是硅谷的缓冲和华尔街2008/09年的衍生品危机。在前一种情况下——就像我的Netflix灾难一样——由科技公司控制的失败提供了金钱机会（对高级服务和设备收取更多费用），而2008年的华尔街银行被认为是“大而不能倒”。虽然硅谷的失败是关于预先编程的过时（每年一款新iPhone），但华尔街的失败保护银行并从国家和最终消费者那里攫取利益。在两种情况下，用户——技术或金融服务（如抵押贷款）的用户——被留在等待、焦虑、常常上瘾，并且在财务上大多更糟。最后，除了忘记失败、升级或继续生活之外，别无选择。我想思考如何将作者们基于经验但主要理论丰富的论点作为我们民族志学者的起点。他们指出了哪些值得进一步进行厚实描述的人类学田野工作的现象？让我挑出三个例子。虽然我们总体上确实需要对硅谷进行更多的民族志研究，但我喜欢作者关注小细节和现象，比如缓冲，这些实际上包罗万象。对滚动或滑动（智能手机用户典型的新手势）的民族志研究如何？如果我们与科技公司中构思这些机制（及其失败）的设计师一起进行田野调查，我们能学到什么？其次，我一直热衷于追踪阿帕杜莱和亚历山大在硅谷案例中提及不多的资金流动：我们对最初从失败中获益的风险投资家了解多少（这是我目前正在研究的）？移动广告市场如何（参见MacKenzie的新项目）？我们也需要对数据进行更多的民族志研究，例如研究那些通过服务器基础设施（如AWS和微软）赚取数十亿的人。第三，这本小册子也没有深入探讨的是针对“忘记失败”问题的（政策）解决方案的实验。政治人类学可以在这里提供帮助，深入到监管者的民族志研究中（加州或欧盟委员会将是很好的起点；Ghosh 2018; Wilson 2020）。总的来说，我非常相信阿帕杜莱和亚历山大对硅谷的分析是整个新子学科的起点。虽然我们迄今为止阅读的关于银行和华尔街的内容远多于沙山路和帕洛阿尔托，但我相信随着（金融）权力的平衡最近向西转移，民族志的目光也应如此。我们的切入点是接受阿帕杜莱和亚历山大在此提出的一些理论线索，并带着它们进入田野。虽然我欣赏像本卷中这样聪明的想法，但我的人类学本能总是想要更多：更多的故事，更多真实的人，换句话说：更多的民族志。

title: Asian technical experts: skilled corporate migration in the global commodity chain
journal_name: GLOBAL NETWORKS-A JOURNAL OF TRANSNATIONAL AFFAIRS
abstract: Abstract In this article I discuss the relocation of skilled employees from the peripheral operating regions of transnational corporations to their operating centres. I examine employees who migrated from regional offices in East and Southeast Asian countries to the headquarters of two athletic footwear companies based in the northwestern United States. Drawing on 12 in‐depth interviews and six months of ethnographic fieldwork, I contextualize corporate migration within the global athletic footwear commodity chain and argue that the layers of asymmetrical power within the industry construct a specific identity profile of the ‘Asian technical expert’ based on employees' embodiment of technical capital, geographical origin, and corporate rank. This identity profile gives regional office employees opportunities for mobility, while creating both empowerment and constraints that structure post‐migration experiences. In this study, by examining migrants from countries that are fairly low down in the global commodity chain hierarchy, I hope to expand both the theoretical framework available to corporate migration scholars and the range of migration considered.
title_zh: 亚洲技术专家：全球商品链中的技术性企业迁移
abstract_zh: 本文讨论了技术人员从跨国公司的外围运营区域向运营中心的迁移。笔者研究了从东亚和东南亚国家的地区办事处迁移到美国西北部两家运动鞋公司总部的员工。基于12次深度访谈和六个月的民族志田野调查，本文将企业迁移置于全球运动鞋商品链的背景中，并认为行业内不对称的权力层级构筑了一个特定的“亚洲技术专家”身份轮廓，该身份基于员工的技术资本、地理来源和企业层级。这一身份轮廓为区域办事处员工提供了流动的机会，同时也产生了赋权和限制，从而构建了迁移后的经历。通过研究来自全球商品链层级中较低位置国家的移民，本文希望扩展企业迁移学者的理论框架以及所考虑的迁移范围。

title: Beyond the branch plant: Capitol-EMI’s first Canadian record press and national music industries in the 1970s
abstract: This paper explores the wider political economy surrounding the opening of Capitol Records’ first Canadian record pressing plant in 1976. This celebrated facility encapsulates much of the optimism for Canadian music during this period. As a site of research it reveals a great deal of the complex relationship between a multinational corporation and an evolving national record industry. Further, this paper explores the materiality of popular music and places it within the context of national industrial and cultural policy. This material history brings forth a different account of the role of government policy in the development of this industry, with a greater emphasis on Canadian trade policy than on broadcast regulation. The plant began operation a few years after Canada’s broadcasting regulator, the Canadian Radio-Television Commission, implemented Canadian Content regulations in 1971 for the programming of music created by Canadians on Canadian radio stations. ‘Beyond the branch plant’ draws from archival materials from the EMI Music Canada Archive, housed at the University of Calgary, to offer primary accounts of the development of this plant as well as the economic externalities beyond the music industry that were shaped by this new facility. The conclusions of this study call into question long standing positions regarding the place of national broadcasting content quotas and the growth of cultural industries. It highlights an industrial logic that was largely American in structure and one that indicates that the legacy of these content regulations is more complicated than it is often assumed to be.
title_zh: 超越分支机构：Capitol-EMI在加拿大的第一家唱片压制厂与1970年代的国家音乐产业
abstract_zh: 本文探讨了1976年Capitol唱片公司在加拿大开设第一家唱片压制厂背后的广泛政治经济学。这家备受瞩目的工厂浓缩了这一时期加拿大音乐的乐观情绪。作为一个研究场所，它揭示了跨国公司与国家唱片产业之间复杂关系的许多方面。此外，本文探讨了流行音乐的物质性，并将其置于国家工业和文化政策的背景下。这段物质历史呈现了政府政策在该产业发展中作用的不同叙述，更强调加拿大贸易政策而非广播监管。该工厂在加拿大广播监管机构加拿大广播电视台委员会于1971年实施加拿大内容法规（要求加拿大广播电台播放由加拿大人创作的音乐）几年后开始运营。‘超越分支机构’利用了卡尔加里大学收藏的EMI音乐加拿大档案馆的档案材料，提供了该工厂发展的第一手资料，以及该新设施所塑造的超出音乐产业的经济外部性。本研究的结果质疑了关于国家广播内容配额和文化产业发展地位的长期立场。它突显了一种在结构上主要是美国的产业逻辑，并表明这些内容法规的遗产比通常假设的要复杂得多。

title: Conversionary Sites: Transforming Medical Aid and Global Christianity from Madagascar to Minnesota by Britt Halvorson
abstract: Reviewed by: Conversionary Sites: Transforming Medical Aid and Global Christianity from Madagascar to Minnesota by Britt Halvorson Pamela E. Klassen Britt Halvorson, Conversionary Sites: Transforming Medical Aid and Global Christianity from Madagascar to Minnesota. Chicago: University of Chicago Press, 2018. 288 pp. Conversionary Sites tells the story of what happens in the wake of medical missions once the missionaries have returned home, have renounced their colonial presumptions, but do not want to let go of the stories or relationships that gave their lives both professional meaning and spiritual portent. Focused on a Minnesota-based Lutheran NGO that sends surplus US medical supplies to a sister organization in Madagascar, the book follows medical discards—such as sutures and blood test finger sticks—as they travel by container ship or in the ethnographer's suitcase from US hospitals to Malagasy clinics. As part of a broader post-1960s shift among mainstream Protestants away from overt colonial missionary work, US Lutheran missionaries scaled back their travel between Minnesota and Madagascar, re-envisioning mission as "partnership" or "accompaniment" instead of conversion. Excess medical supplies took the place of people, serving as a charitable binding agent between Malagasy Christians and their Minnesota counterparts. In following the medical discards from warehouses staffed by volunteers in Minnesota to their destinations in Madagascar, author Britt Halvorson demonstrates that the meaning of these forms of medical aid are "instrumental" in many senses. For the Minnesotan Lutherans, the donations are a tangible sign of God's love and their commitment to accompany Malagasy Christians. In a similar yet distinct vein, for the Malagasy Christians, including doctors, the medical supplies were most valuable not for their therapeutic uses, but for the foreign connections and future social [End Page 1625] capital they promised. From the perspective of US medical organizations, the discards, shuffled from US hospital storage closets to Malagasy clinics, represented a tax break.
