abstract_zh: 卷34期3封面说明：封面：黎巴嫩的未成年劳工。黎巴嫩的废金属产业——该国最大出口之一——严重依赖于从叙利亚流离失所的边缘化男童。在当期文章中，Elizabeth Saleh和Adrien Zakar聚焦于Harun，一个14岁的捡拾者，被他的社区从新手提升为废品场师傅（muallim）。他们跟随他，他推着一辆由回收塑料篮子和垃圾桶制成的车，在贝鲁特的垃圾堆中谨慎翻找。未成年捡拾者不应该工作，然而这是他们在黎巴嫩存在的唯一合法理由。在穿越贝鲁特的行程中，这些未成年捡拾者收集铁、铜和汽水罐。他们在工作中掩饰玩耍，以此在城市中穿行。通过这些回收游戏，他们培养了一个共谋的社区，该社区按年龄等级运作，并涉及成人礼和行为准则。尽管还只是个孩子，Harun正在掌握muallim——字面意思是“知道的人”——学习非正式交易的艺术，同时通过掌握掩饰和讽刺来面对他的社会排斥。封底：探水术是否“不科学”？在当期，Jonathan Woolley关注了媒体报道中关于英国水务公司使用探水术的当代争议。他深入探讨了这一实践的背景。探水术是一种寻找隐藏水、物体或矿藏的惯用方法，在许多欧洲或欧洲裔定居社会中实践。尽管科学家和怀疑论者坚持认为它完全无效，但至今仍有许多从业者信任探水术，认为它能准确预知周围世界的信息。尽管批评者常将其描述为“伪科学”，但探水术实际上比科学革命早几个世纪。因此，将其描述为一种“伪科学”是不准确的，因为探水术基于具身认知方式，与科学方法截然不同。关于探水术效能的伪科学理论——例如将棒的运动归因于地磁力——是19世纪末对此实践的评论，许多当代探水者拒绝接受。在他16世纪关于采矿和矿石冶炼的论述中，阿格里科拉的《论金属》中包含了关于用探水术寻找金属矿石的详细描述。图片来源：阿格里科拉《论金属》第7卷，1556年。

title: Front and Back Covers, Volume 34, Number 4. August 2018
abstract: Cover caption, volume 34 issue 4 Front Cover: INNOVATION IN A MEXICAN VILLAGE When Mexico's largest telecom companies refused to provide mobile phone service to the remote Zapotec mountain village of Talea de Castro, Oaxaca, residents responded with astonishing creativity: in March 2013, they built the world's first autonomous mobile phone network. The community‐owned network uses open‐source software to link mobile phones globally over the Internet using VoIP (Voice over Internet Protocol). It was developed in collaboration with a non‐profit organization, hackers and sympathetic activists committed to the idea of mobile access as a human right. Centuries‐old practices, including tequio (communal work party) and the asamblea (citizens' ‘assembly’ or town hall meeting), played a central role in enabling Zapotec citizens to give life to the network. Today residents of nearly 20 Zapotec, Mixtec and Mixe villages throughout Oaxaca can send and receive calls and texts within their communities for free, while long‐distance and international calls cost a small fraction of what commercial companies charge throughout the country. The network has provided villagers with an affordable and reliable system for maintaining family relationships and cultural continuity across national borders. However, Talea de Castro's community‐owned network is now under threat because Movistar, a giant telecom corporation based in Spain, has aggressively moved into the community. The case of Talea de Castro raises important questions about the roots of innovation, creative problem‐solving and the existential threats facing autonomous technological systems. Image source: DANIELA PARRA/REDES AC Back Cover: NORTH KOREA North Korean students against the backdrop of a statue of Kim Il‐sung (1912–1994) in Mansudae, central Pyongyang, 2007. Kim was the founding leader of North Korea and commanded the country's People's Army during the Korean War (1950–1953). For a decade after the war, his charismatic leadership contributed to turning the war‐torn society into a strong industrial economy. The importance of the last legacy is strongly propagated by the country's current leadership. In his guest editorial in this issue, Heonik Kwon considers the possibilities of a rapprochment between North Korea and the USA. Image source: (STEPHAN) / CC BY‐SA 2.0C
title_zh: 第34卷第4期封面与封底，2018年8月
abstract_zh: 封面说明，第34卷第4期 封面：墨西哥村庄的创新 当墨西哥最大的电信公司拒绝为瓦哈卡偏远萨波特克山区村庄Talea de Castro提供移动电话服务时，居民们以惊人的创造力回应：2013年3月，他们建立了世界上第一个自主移动电话网络。这个社区拥有的网络使用开源软件，通过VoIP（互联网语音协议）将手机全球连接到互联网。该网络是与一个非营利组织、黑客和同情活动家合作开发的，他们坚信移动接入是一项人权。几个世纪以来的传统，包括tequio（集体劳动聚会）和asamblea（公民“集会”或市政会议），在使萨波特克公民能够赋予网络生命方面发挥了核心作用。如今，瓦哈卡近20个萨波特克、米斯特克和米克斯村庄的居民可以免费在社区内发送和接收电话和短信，而长途和国际通话的费用仅为全国商业公司收费的一小部分。该网络为村民提供了一种负担得起且可靠的方式，以维持跨国界的家庭关系和文化连续性。然而，Talea de Castro的社区网络现在面临威胁，因为总部位于西班牙的电信巨头Movistar已积极进入该社区。Talea de Castro的案例引发了关于创新根源、创造性解决问题以及自主技术系统所面临的生存威胁的重要问题。图片来源：DANIELA PARRA/REDES AC 封底：朝鲜 朝鲜学生在平壤中心万寿台的Kim Il‐sung（1912–1994）雕像背景下，2007年。Kim是朝鲜的开国领导人，在朝鲜战争（1950–1953）期间指挥了该国的人民军。战后十年，他的魅力领导有助于将这个饱受战争蹂躏的社会转变为一个强大的工业经济体。最后遗产的重要性由该国现任领导层大力宣传。在本期的客座社论中，Heonik Kwon考虑了朝鲜与美国之间缓和的可能性。图片来源：(STEPHAN) / CC BY‐SA 2.0

title: Industrious Landscaping: The Making and Managing of Natural Resources at Søby Brown Coal Beds
abstract: This article has a twofold ambition. It offers a history of landscaping at Søby brown coal beds—a former mining site in western Denmark—and a methodological discussion of how to write such a study. Exploring this specific industrial landscape through a series of projects that have made different natural resources appear, we show that even what is recognized as resources shifts over time according to radically different and unpredictable agendas. This indicates that the Søby landscape is fundamentally volatile, as its resourcefulness has been seen interchangeably to shift between the brown coal business, inexpensive estates for practically savvy people, pasture for grazing, and recreational forest, among other things. We discuss these rifts in landscape history, motivated by what we refer to as industriousness, to show that, at sites such as Søby, both natural resources and historical developments are made through particular ad hoc perspectives, providing their own means and ends. This view of natural resources and development processes calls for a detailed analysis of shifting landscape projects and has an essential methodological corollary, namely that fieldwork must be improvisational, situated, open-ended, and somewhat random. We thus develop a method of “dustballing,” which implies being blown here and there, combining historical records and ethnographic description in an associative kind of fieldwork that somehow navigates itself. Our aim is thus to let methodology and our story of a ruined landscape mirror one another to attempt a novel kind of natural history suitable for the Anthropocene.
title_zh: 勤勉的地景塑造：索比褐煤层的自然资源制造与管理
abstract_zh: 本文有双重目标。它提供了丹麦西部前采矿场索比褐煤层的地景塑造史，以及关于如何撰写此类研究的方法论讨论。通过一系列使不同自然资源显现的项目探索这一特定的工业景观，我们表明，即使是公认的资源也会随着时间的推移而根据完全不同的、不可预知的议程发生变化。这表明索比景观从根本上是不稳定的，其资源性可以在褐煤业务、为实用人士提供的廉价地产、放牧草地和休闲森林等之间交替变化。我们讨论了这些景观历史中的裂痕，受我们所称的勤勉精神驱动，以显示在索比这样的地方，自然资源和历史发展都是通过特定的即时视角制造出来的，各有其手段和目的。这种对自然资源和发展过程的看法要求对不断变化的景观项目进行详细分析，并有一个基本的方法论推论，即田野工作必须是即兴的、情境化的、开放式的，且有些随机。因此，我们发展了一种“尘埃球”方法，意味着被风吹来吹去，结合历史记录和民族志描述，进行一种联想式的田野工作，以某种方式自行导航。我们的目标是让方法论和我们关于废墟景观的故事相互映照，从而尝试一种适合人类世的新型自然史。

title: Infrastructure and Colonial Difference in Puerto Rico after Hurricane María

authors.name: Rosa E. Ficek
institutions: University of Puerto Rico at Cayey

abstract: Hurricane María wiped out the infrastructures that helped sustain modern life in Puerto Rico. As communities, organizations, and the government responded to the disaster, the politics of infrastructure took on a central and urgent role in debates about colonialism, debt, life, and death. This paper describes everyday life in the days and weeks that followed María, focusing on the strategies people used to obtain essential services such as power and water. People mobilized family and community networks, along with material objects including buckets and gas tanks, into improvised infrastructures that compensated, however inadequately, for what was destroyed. This article considers how state and corporate forms of governance shape day to day survival through people's entanglements with these emergency infrastructures. It argues that the experience of obtaining food, water, power, and other necessities in the aftermath of María revealed, in an embodied way, the racialization of Puerto Ricans as colonial subjects.
title_zh: 飓风玛丽亚后波多黎各的基础设施与殖民差异
abstract_zh: 飓风玛丽亚摧毁了波多黎各维持现代生活的基础设施。随着社区、组织和政府对灾难作出反应，基础设施政治在关于殖民主义、债务、生命和死亡的辩论中占据了核心和紧迫的角色。本文描述了玛丽亚过后数日乃至数周内的日常生活，重点关注人们获取电力和水等基本服务所使用的策略。人们动员家庭和社区网络，连同水桶和煤气罐等物质对象，构建出临时的基础设施，以弥补被摧毁之物，尽管这种弥补并不充分。本文考虑了国家和公司治理形式如何通过人们与这些应急基础设施的纠缠来塑造日常生存。文章认为，在玛丽亚之后获取食物、水、电力和其他必需品的经历，以一种具身化的方式揭示了波多黎各人作为殖民主体的种族化。

title: Interscalar Vehicles for an African Anthropocene: On Waste, Temporality, and Violence
abstract: How can we incorporate humanist critiques of the Anthropocene while harnessing the notion’s potential for challenging political imagination? Placing the Anthropocene offers one way forward; the notion of an African Anthropocene offers a productive paradox that holds planetary temporality and specific human lives in a single frame. Navigating the Anthropocene from Africa requires attending to scale both as an analytic and an actor category. In order to do so, this essay proposes the notion of interscalar vehicles: objects and modes of analysis that permit scholars and their subjects to move simultaneously through deep time and human time, through geological space and political space. This essay discusses the creation and destruction of value/waste and pasts/futures around a uranium mine in Mounana, Gabon, to unpack the political, ethical, epistemological, and affective dimensions of interscalar vehicles and their violent Anthropocenic implications.
title_zh: 非洲人类世的尺度间载体：论废弃物、时间性与暴力
abstract_zh: 我们如何在对人类世的人文主义批判与利用这一概念挑战政治想象力的潜力之间取得平衡？定位人类世提供了一条前进的道路；非洲人类世的概念提供了一个富有成效的悖论，将行星时间性和特定人类生活置于一个框架中。从非洲出发导航人类世需要将尺度同时作为一个分析范畴和一个行动者范畴来关注。为此，本文提出了尺度间载体的概念：允许学者及其研究对象同时在深时间和人类时间、地质空间和政治空间中移动的对象和分析模式。本文讨论了加蓬穆纳纳铀矿周围价值/废弃物和过去/未来的创造与毁灭，以揭示尺度间载体的政治、伦理、认识论和情感维度及其暴力的人类世含义。

title: Land grab/data grab: precision agriculture and its new horizons
abstract: Developments in the area of ‘precision agriculture’ are creating new data points (about flows, soils, pests, climate) that agricultural technology providers ‘grab’, aggregate, compute and/or sell. Food producers now churn out food and, increasingly, data. ‘Land grabs’ on the horizon in the global south are bound up with the dynamics of data grabbing, although hitherto researchers have not revealed enough about the people and projects at issue. Against this backdrop, this paper examines some key issues taking shape, while highlighting new frontiers for research and introducing the concept ‘data sovereignty’, which food sovereignty practitioners (and others) need to begin considering.
title_zh: 土地争夺/数据争夺：精准农业及其新视野
abstract_zh: 在“精准农业”领域的发展正在创造新的数据点（关于流量、土壤、病虫害、气候），农业技术提供商“夺取”、聚合、计算和/或出售这些数据。食品生产者现在不仅生产食品，还越来越多地生产数据。全球南方即将出现的“土地争夺”与数据争夺的动态密切相关，尽管迄今为止研究人员尚未充分揭示相关人员和项目。在此背景下，本文审视了一些正在形成的关键问题，同时强调了新的研究前沿，并引入了“数据主权”这一概念，粮食主权实践者（及其他人士）需要开始考虑这一概念。

title: Patterns in Circulation: Cloth, Gender, and Materiality in West Africa by Nina Sylvanus
abstract: Reviewed by: Patterns in Circulation: Cloth, Gender, and Materiality in West Africa by Nina Sylvanus Kelly Kirby Nina Sylvanus, Patterns in Circulation: Cloth, Gender, and Materiality in West Africa. Chicago: University of Chicago Press, 2016. 224 pp. In Patterns in Circulation: Cloth, Gender, and Materiality in West Africa, anthropologist Nina Sylvanus builds on 30 months of fieldwork carried out in Togo between 2000–2016. She explores historical and contemporary consumptions and productions of wax print cloth, the females who trade the cloth, the materiality of the cloth itself, and the post-colonial and imperial powers that influenced traders’ marketing adaptation abilities. Sylvanus suggests that wax print tells a story about patterns of exchange over time. Additionally, she demonstrates how influential female cloth traders were in this process during colonial and post-colonial eras. This richly descriptive ethnography synthesizes the complex interconnections between female Togolese cloth traders, nation, and capitalism in a globalized world. The theoretical argument rests within what Sylvanus describes as the “dense materiality” of the cloth itself: visuality and materiality between people and institutions intersecting with ever-changing semiotic patterns of meaning through time. Sylvanus first reveals that the very history of wax print production in Europe for West African consumption was the result of a copy of a copy. Dutch wax was introduced by Europeans in West Africa during the late 19th century; however, African traders often refused to buy the cloth because they were not fond of its colors, patterns, or textures. Beginning in the 1950s, Vlisco—the Dutch mass manufacturer of cloth—produced copies of Javanese batik to sell to their colonial subjects in Southeast Asia for less expensive prices than the original batik. The strategy did not [End Page 1435] work, since the Indonesians recognized the copies as fakes. At the advice of Togolese female cloth traders, Vlisco subsequently manufactured a spackled and textured cloth that appealed to West African customers. The female cloth traders, in turn, became successful businesswomen who controlled the largest market—Le Grand Marché de Lomé, or Assigamé (“women’s place”)—of wax print trade in West Africa. Building on this historical context, Sylvanus delves deeper into the dense materiality of wax print and the complexities associated with alliances that were formed between people, things, and the government after Togo declared independence from France in 1960. Powerful female traders became known as the Nana Benz, a name created by the press to reference the material and social wealth they accumulated as a result of their success—for example, the Mercedes Benz vehicles some drove, their large homes on the sea, their property in other countries, and their expensive clothing and jewels. The Nana Benz subsequently forged links with the new government and dictator, Gnassingbé Eyadèma, and became part of a nationalist narrative, which made them mascots of the new government and celebrated Togo’s political, social, and economic prosperity after colonialism. Those ties created co-dependent relationships that did not always work in favor of the Nana Benz. However, they were able to maintain their prestige in the wake of an oppressive regime until the Togolese economy crashed in the 1980s due to World Bank Structural Adjustment Programs and the privatization of the state. The devaluation of the CFA franc and ongoing political crises in the 1990s left the cloth traders in dire straits. They were no longer able to secure credit lines with the manufacturers, and their customers could no longer afford the cloth. The middle class in Togo was gone, as were the prosperous livelihoods of the Nana Benz. In Chapter 4, Sylvanus explores new dense patterns of materiality through relations between people, things, and imperialism beginning in the 1990s, this time through an analysis of Chinese influence in Togo. Togo needed assistance with economic development and the Chinese were willing to help by taking over the market place with copies of the wax print and many other commodities. The first copies were not well received. However, as had occurred with Vlisco, a new generation of young women traders—who became know as Nanettes—strategized and collaborated with Chinese companies to brand textures, patterns, and color to eventually create a wax print that was affordable and...
title_zh: 流通模式：西非的布料、性别与物质性
abstract_zh: 《流通模式：西非的布料、性别与物质性》（Nina Sylvanus 著，芝加哥大学出版社，2016年，224页）。人类学家Nina Sylvanus基于2000年至2016年间在多哥进行的30个月田野调查，探讨了蜡染布的历史与当代消费及生产、从事布料交易的女性、布料本身的物质性，以及影响交易者营销适应能力的后殖民和帝国权力。Sylvanus认为蜡染布讲述了一个关于随时间变化的交换模式的故事。此外，她展示了殖民地及后殖民时期有影响力的女性布料交易者在这一过程中的作用。这部描述丰富的民族志综合了全球化世界中多哥女性布料交易者、国家和资本主义之间的复杂联系。理论论证建立在Sylvanus所称的布料“密集物质性”之上：人与机构之间的视觉性和物质性，与随时间变化的符号意义模式相交织。Sylvanus首先揭示，欧洲为西非消费生产的蜡染布历史本身就是复制品的复制品。荷兰蜡染布于19世纪末由欧洲人引入西非；然而，非洲交易者常常拒绝购买，因为他们不喜欢其颜色、图案或质地。从20世纪50年代开始，荷兰布料批量生产商Vlisco生产了爪哇蜡染布的复制品，以比原版更便宜的价格卖给其在东南亚的殖民臣民。这一策略并未奏效，因为印度尼西亚人认出复制品是假的。在多哥女性布料交易者的建议下，Vlisco随后生产了一种带有斑点纹理的布料，吸引了西非顾客。这些女性布料交易者随后成为成功的商人，控制了西非最大的蜡染布市场——洛梅大市场（Assigamé，“女人的地方”）。基于这一历史背景，Sylvanus深入探讨了蜡染布的密集物质性，以及1960年多哥从法国独立后，人、物与政府之间形成的联盟的复杂性。强大的女性交易者被称为“Nana Benz”，这一名称由媒体创造，指代她们因成功积累的物质和社会财富——例如她们驾驶的梅赛德斯奔驰汽车、海边的豪宅、在其他国家的财产以及昂贵的服装和珠宝。Nana Benz随后与新政府和独裁者纳辛贝·埃亚德马建立了联系，成为民族主义叙事的一部分，这使她们成为新政府的吉祥物，并颂扬多哥在殖民后的政治、社会和经济繁荣。这些关系形成了相互依赖，并不总是对Nana Benz有利。然而，她们在压迫政权下维持了声望，直到20世纪80年代多哥经济因世界银行的结构调整计划和国有私有化而崩溃。非洲法郎贬值和90年代持续的政治危机使布料交易者陷入绝境。她们无法再从制造商那里获得信贷额度，顾客也买不起布料。多哥的中产阶级消失了，Nana Benz的繁荣生计也随之消失。在第四章中，Sylvanus通过分析中国在多哥的影响，探讨了自20世纪90年代以来，通过人、物与帝国主义之间的关系形成的新的密集物质性模式。多哥需要经济发展援助，中国愿意通过用蜡染布和许多其他商品的复制品占据市场来提供帮助。最初的复制品并不受欢迎。然而，正如Vlisco所发生的那样，新一代年轻女性交易者（被称为Nanettes）与中国公司合作，制定纹理、图案和颜色的品牌策略，最终创造出一种价格实惠且……

title: Reconfiguring labour value and the capital/labour relation in Italian global fashion
journal_name: JOURNAL OF THE ROYAL ANTHROPOLOGICAL INSTITUTE
abstract: Abstract This essay draws on ethnographic research conducted from 2004 to 2012 among Italian firms involved in the manufacture and distribution of textiles and clothing in China to argue that the boundary between labour and capital cannot be assumed as fixed and stable, but rather is continually remade through particular, situated historical processes. I show how the Italian national legacy of capital/labour relations both set the stage for the outsourcing of manufacturing to China and shaped Italian firms’ investment and labour management strategies. As Chinese consumers became increasingly crucial to the European fashion industry, Italian firms reorganized their production and distribution processes to live up to the prestige value of ‘Made in Italy’. This brought about an ironic twist in the fetishism of commodities in which the proclaimed immaterial value of Italian commodities was appropriated by Italian managers, enhancing their labour value. At the same time, however, the dislocation of Italian managers impeded the process through which labour had been converted into capital in Italian industrial districts, hardening the boundary between capital and labour and altering the dynamic structure of capital/labour relations.
title_zh: 重新配置意大利全球时尚中的劳动价值与资本/劳动关系
abstract_zh: 本文基于2004年至2012年间在意大利公司中进行的民族志研究，这些公司参与了中国纺织服装的制造和分销，论证劳动与资本之间的边界不能被假定为固定和稳定的，而是通过特定的、历史的过程不断重塑。我展示了意大利国家资本/劳动关系的遗产既为制造业外包到中国奠定了基础，也塑造了意大利公司的投资和劳动力管理策略。随着中国消费者对欧洲时尚产业日益重要，意大利公司重组其生产和分销过程，以符合“意大利制造”的声望价值。这带来了商品拜物教的讽刺转折，其中意大利商品所宣称的非物质价值被意大利管理者挪用，提高了他们的劳动价值。然而，与此同时，意大利管理者的位置错乱阻碍了劳动在意大利工业区转化为资本的过程，硬化了资本与劳动之间的边界，并改变了资本/劳动关系的动态结构。

title: Rethinking the informal and criminal economy from a global commodity chain perspective: China–Paraguay–Brazil
journal_name: GLOBAL NETWORKS-A JOURNAL OF TRANSNATIONAL AFFAIRS
abstract: Abstract The criminalization of Chinese counterfeit goods in the global market calls for a fresh approach to understanding well‐established binary distinctions such as legal/illegal, licit/illicit, and formal/informal. Based on a multi‐sited ethnography in China, Paraguay and Brazil, I examine five commodity chains of two products – toys and watches – and their regulatory frameworks in terms of merchandise status, business formality, and international transaction legality. Certain merchandise produced in the formal economy has no legal definition a priori, but legal variability starts when goods leave the factory. A great interchangeability of a product's legal status existed along its chain according to governance structures, legal cultures, geographical domains, and power relations. These findings suggest that the illicit is a relational category and the so‐called criminal economy is not a segmented market, but part of a global process integrated with formality and marked by great legal variability within and between nations.
title_zh: 从全球商品链视角重新思考非正规经济和犯罪经济：中国—巴拉圭—巴西
abstract_zh: 摘要 中国假冒商品在全球市场中的刑事化要求一种新的方法来理解既定的二元区分，如合法/非法、合规/违规和正式/非正式。基于在中国、巴拉圭和巴西的多地点民族志研究，我考察了两种产品（玩具和手表）的五条商品链及其监管框架，涉及商品状态、商业形式和国际交易合法性。部分在正规经济中生产的产品在事前没有法律定义，但法律可变性始于商品离开工厂时。根据治理结构、法律文化、地理领域和权力关系，产品法律状态在其链上存在很大的可互换性。这些发现表明，违规是一个关系性范畴，所谓的犯罪经济并非一个分割的市场，而是与正规性相结合且在国家内部和国家之间具有巨大法律可变性的全球过程的一部分。

title: Shock Humor: Zaniness and the Freedom of Permanent Improvisation in Urban Tanzania
abstract: This essay explores scenes of zany comedy in Dar es Salaam, Tanzania, across three sites: a television sketch about repeated electrical shock; the careers of freelance electricians known as vishoka; and encounters between residents and power utility inspectors. Drawing on the work of Sianne Ngai, as well as long-term ethnographic research, the essay argues that zaniness manifests the structural paradoxes of entrepreneurial populations that have alternately been described as the lumpen, the informal, or simply the urban poor. Specifically, it argues that such populations are often consigned to permanent improvisation and that this engenders a social freedom that, in some respects, remains indistinguishable from constraint. The zany can thus critically nuance portraits of livelihood and citizenship practices in urban Africa by bringing their freedoms and constraints into the same frame.
title_zh: 震惊幽默：坦桑尼亚城市中的滑稽与永久即兴的自由
abstract_zh: 本文探讨了坦桑尼亚达累斯萨拉姆三个场景中的滑稽喜剧：关于反复电击的电视短剧；被称为vishoka的自由电工的职业；以及居民与电力公司检查员之间的遭遇。借鉴Sianne Ngai的著作以及长期的民族志研究，本文认为滑稽表现了被描述为流氓无产者、非正规经济或仅仅是城市贫困人口的创业人群的结构性悖论。具体来说，本文认为这些人常常被置于永久即兴之中，这产生了一种社会自由，在某些方面仍与约束难以区分。因此，滑稽可以通过将自由和约束置于同一框架中，对非洲城市生计和公民实践的描绘进行批判性细化。

title: The Archaeology of Precarious Lives: Chinese Railroad Workers in Nineteenth-Century North America
abstract: How can archaeologists, whose research is typically anchored in place-based sites and landscapes, apprehend the scale of mobility and pace of transformation inherent to immigration, industrialization, capitalism, and settler colonialism? Through a focus on the lived experiences of nineteenth-century Chinese railroad workers, this study advances a multisited, polytemporal methodology that interprets archaeological evidence through lenses of precarity and futurity. The artifacts and features excavated at railroad work camps provide evidence of laborers’ efforts to care for themselves under extreme conditions. This evidence also reveals workers’ dependencies on commodity chains that constrained laborers’ abilities to resist exploitation. Attending to the temporal dimensions of risk and hope requires stretching archaeological methodologies beyond the work camps themselves to the workers’ childhood villages in China’s Pearl River Delta, to railroad section houses and station towns throughout the North American West, and to urban Chinatowns in major coastal cities. There is no inherent outer limit to the archaeology of futurity, a point illustrated by a closing reflection about connections between the author’s own positionality and the historical exploitation of Chinese railroad workers.
title_zh: 不稳定的生命考古学：十九世纪北美华工铁路工人
abstract_zh: 考古学家的研究通常以特定地点的遗址和景观为基础，他们如何理解移民、工业化、资本主义和殖民定居所固有的流动规模和变革速度？通过聚焦十九世纪华工铁路工人的生活经历，本研究提出了一种多地点、多时间的方法论，通过不稳定性和未来性的视角解释考古证据。铁路工营出土的文物和特征提供了工人在极端条件下照顾自己的证据。这些证据也揭示了工人对商品链的依赖，这限制了工人抵抗剥削的能力。关注风险与希望的时间维度需要将考古学方法论扩展到工营之外，延伸到工人在中国珠江三角洲的童年村庄、北美西部的铁路工棚和车站小镇，以及沿海主要城市的唐人街。未来性的考古学没有固有的外部界限，这一点通过关于作者自身立场与华工铁路工人历史剥削之间联系的结尾反思得以说明。

title: The architecture of cigarette circulation: marketing work on Indonesia's retail infrastructure
journal_name: JOURNAL OF THE ROYAL ANTHROPOLOGICAL INSTITUTE
abstract: Abstract The cigarette industry mobilizes independent retail as the scaffolding for ubiquitous cigarette advertising and sales in Indonesia, forming an expansive semiotic and material architecture of cigarette circulation in a country with limited tobacco regulations. As impending regulations threaten to curb cigarette advertising, and independent retailers face stiff competition from mushrooming chain convenience stores, Philip Morris International's Indonesian subsidiary has developed a retail community programme to recruit and ‘modernize’ select retailers. The programme has intensified the quotidian labour of marketers who use knowledge, persons, and things to inhabit and renovate independent retail. I show how fashioning cigarette markets entails fashioning retail infrastructure, and is embedded in intimate relations of power, care, and violence.
title_zh: 香烟流通的建筑：印度尼西亚零售基础设施上的营销工作
abstract_zh: 摘要 印尼的烟草行业动员独立零售作为无处不在的香烟广告和销售的支架，在一个烟草法规有限的国家形成了香烟流通的广泛符号和物质建筑。随着即将出台的法规威胁到香烟广告，且独立零售商面临来自连锁便利店激增的激烈竞争，菲利普莫里斯国际公司（Philip Morris International）的印尼子公司开发了一个零售社区计划，以招募和“现代化”选定的零售商。该计划强化了营销人员的日常劳动，他们利用知识、人员和物品来占据和改造独立零售。我展示了塑造香烟市场如何涉及塑造零售基础设施，并嵌入在权力、关怀和暴力的亲密关系中。

title: Unearthing Conflict: Corporate Mining, Activism, and Expertise in Peru
abstract: A great deal has been written about environmental politics, neoliberalism, political mobilization, and resource extraction in South America. In Unearthing Conflict, Fabiana Li synthesizes these themes while providing a detailed history of mining in Peru’s central highlands. Li centers her discussion on the conflicts associated with mining and how transformations in mining technologies and practices shape collective knowledge about nature. In doing so, she suggests that conflicts are related to a hegemonic economic structure that emphasizes resource extraction as a means of progress and development. Li does a commendable job of integrating relevant literature and making connections to previous scholarship while writing in a manner that is accessible to a broad audience.Fieldwork for Unearthing Conflict took place in Peru’s central highlands. It was multi-sited with most of the research having been conducted in La Oroya and Cajamarca. While a couple of maps are provided in the text, a more detailed map would help readers to identify the multiple sites of fieldwork and their relationship to one another. Li is forthcoming about the fact that she has a personal connection to Peru and to La Oroya. She was born in Peru, and her maternal grandfather, the son of Chinese immigrants, was born in La Oroya and lived there for most of his youth. This connection lends credibility to Li’s writing and serves to affirm her position as a scholar with a deeply personal interest in La Oroya and its residents and history.Unearthing Conflict is organized into three parts that come together in a fluid manner and without any discontinuity. Li begins by tracing changes in Peru’s mining industry from the early 1900s to state control in the 1970s and 1980s and then to privatization in the 1990s. She brings together content from multiple mining sites while analyzing the conflicts associated with mining and pollution, and how pollution “came to matter” (37). She strikes an eloquent balance between historical depth and ethnographic detail while analyzing how neoliberal policies promoted mining expansion as well as the development of a network of NGOs and advocacy groups that made pollution relevant. Li promotes a view of nature as an active entity that shapes the decisions that people make. She does so in part by asking the question, “What does it mean to say that a mountain must give its consent to be mined?” (108). In asking this question, and what follows, Li emphasizes the interactions between humans and nature and how alternative forms of activism and protest underscore nature (water) as fundamental to human life. Without being heavy handed, she calls into question a nature/culture dichotomy and instead emphasizes how water, livelihood, landscape, and identity are interwoven. Li’s discussion of accountability is particularly keen. She emphasizes how private corporations establish relations with the state as well as a sense of shared responsibility with citizens, state organizations, and NGOs through the production of an Environmental Impact Assessment (EIA). Li argues that the inclusion of citizens and NGOs in environmental monitoring and assessment creates a sense of shared responsibility while defining spaces for opposition.Writing style and ethnographic depth are the strengths of Li’s work. If there is any area of weakness, it is that she establishes a theoretical framework based on three core concepts: practices of accountability, audit cultures, and equivalence, but the themes do not receive equal treatment throughout the text. Unearthing Conflict is engaging and detailed. It is especially relevant given the current prominence of mining in Peru, and it is a welcome addition to anthropological literature on environmental politics and resource extraction. The text is suitable for students, and it provides ample information on environmental politics and activism as well as on Andean worldview and culture. Scholars and students interested in Andean South America will find Unearthing Conflict to be an insightful and enjoyable read.
title_zh: 发掘冲突：秘鲁的企业采矿、行动主义与专业知识
abstract_zh: 关于南美洲的环境政治、新自由主义、政治动员和资源开采已有大量文献。在《发掘冲突》一书中，Fabiana Li综合了这些主题，同时提供了秘鲁中部高地采矿业的详细历史。Li的讨论围绕与采矿相关的冲突以及采矿技术和实践的变化如何塑造关于自然的集体知识。她认为冲突与一种强调资源开采作为进步和发展手段的霸权经济结构有关。Li在整合相关文献并与先前研究建立联系方面做得很好，同时以易于广大读者理解的方式写作。《发掘冲突》的田野工作在秘鲁中部高地展开，是多地点研究，大部分研究在拉奥罗亚和卡哈马卡进行。书中虽然提供了几幅地图，但更详细的地图有助于读者识别多个田野点及其相互关系。Li坦诚她与秘鲁和拉奥罗亚有个人联系。她出生在秘鲁，她的外祖父是华裔移民的儿子，出生在拉奥罗亚并在那里度过了大部分青年时期。这种联系为Li的写作增添了可信度，并确立了她作为对拉奥罗亚及其居民和历史有深切个人兴趣的学者的地位。《发掘冲突》分为三个部分，流畅地结合在一起，没有任何断裂。Li首先追溯了从20世纪初到1970-80年代国家控制再到1990年代私有化的秘鲁采矿业变迁。她汇集了多个采矿点的内容，同时分析了与采矿和污染相关的冲突，以及污染如何“变得重要”（37页）。她在分析新自由主义政策如何促进采矿扩张以及发展使污染变得相关的NGO和倡导组织网络之间，取得了历史深度与民族志细节之间的优雅平衡。Li将自然视为一种主动实体，塑造人们做出的决定。她部分地通过提问“说一座山必须同意被开采意味着什么？”（108页）来做到这一点。在提出这个问题及其后续讨论中，Li强调了人与自然的互动，以及替代形式的行动主义和抗议如何强调自然（水）是人类生活的基础。她毫不生硬地质疑了自然/文化二分法，而是强调水、生计、景观和身份如何交织在一起。Li关于责任的讨论尤为敏锐。她强调了私营公司如何通过环境影响评估（EIA）的生产与国家建立关系，并与公民、国家组织和NGO建立共同责任感。Li认为，将公民和NGO纳入环境监测和评估创造了共同责任感，同时定义了反对的空间。写作风格和民族志深度是Li作品的优点。如果有什么弱点的话，那就是她建立了一个基于三个核心概念的理论框架：责任实践、审计文化和等价性，但这些主题在文本中并未得到平等对待。《发掘冲突》引人入胜且详细。鉴于当前采矿在秘鲁的突出地位，它尤其相关，并且是环境政治和资源开采人类学文献的可喜补充。文本适合学生，并提供了关于环境政治和行动主义以及安第斯世界观和文化的丰富信息。对安第斯南美洲感兴趣的学生和学者会发现《发掘冲突》是一本富有洞察力和愉快的读物。

title: What's a Cellular Public?
abstract: This article argues that the forms of "public" subjectivity associated with cellular phones are defined as much by the positive valuations of cellular technology as by the negative ones. Furthermore, cellular publics depend upon a critique of a previous era's fixed-line telephony. All of this suggests that the material affordances of the devices which mediate public subjectivity are important. It also suggests that "publics" are inherently historical; users of "publics" have a sense of that public's natural history which, if undermined, create anxieties. This argument, based in part on material gathered in Brazil, facilitates the selection of four attributes of cellular publics which are grounded in concepts of time, space, and person: 1) the reduction of response time; 2) the transcendence of space; 3) the unification of communicative and mediating capacities into a single device; and 4) the increased portability of that device, making for its ubiquity in social and professional settings. It is the unity of these four attributes which, I argue, make cellular publics unique.
title_zh: 什么是蜂窝公共？
abstract_zh: 本文认为，与手机相关的“公共”主体性形式既由对蜂窝技术的积极评价定义，也由消极评价定义。此外，蜂窝公共依赖于对前一个时代的固定电话的批判。所有这些都表明，调解公共主体性的设备的物质可供性很重要。这也表明“公共”本质上是历史性的；“公共”的用户对该公共的自然历史有一种感觉，这种感觉如果被破坏，会产生焦虑。这一论证部分基于在巴西收集的材料，有助于选择蜂窝公共的四个属性，这些属性植根于时间、空间和人的概念：1）响应时间的缩短；2）空间的超越；3）将通信和调解能力统一到单个设备中；4）该设备便携性的增强，使其在社交和专业环境中无处不在。我认为，正是这四个属性的统一使蜂窝公共具有独特性。

title: Aeroponic gardens and their magic: Plants/persons/ethics in suspension
abstract: Out of the fire bombed ruins and food deprivation of the Second World War came one innovator’s prototype for growing edible plants, suspended above earth and requiring a minimum of water. His aeroponic apparatus would later be referred to as The Genesis Machine, from the movie Star Trek II. This paper travels with roots in air into different spheres where the relations of persons, plants, and technology conspire to place future – growing into ethical suspension. The aim is to open questions for an anthropocenic future: Are plants ‘for’ persons or persons ‘for’ plants? Is it ethical to separate growing plants from earth/Earth and from earthlings? Where might ‘responsible innovation’ and ‘innovative eclecticism’ find a place in post-genomic discourse? And might a commitment to a dividual ethics guide lives in co-becoming to devise (as Latour recognizes in like terms) a scitech-diplomacy capable of resisting the programmatic pressures of new climatic regimes?
title_zh: 气雾栽培花园及其魔力：悬浮中的植物/人/伦理
abstract_zh: 从二战火海废墟和食物匮乏中，一位创新者研制出了种植可食用植物的原型装置，将植物悬浮于土壤之上且只需极少水分。他的气雾栽培设备后来被称作《星际迷航II》中的“创世纪机器”。本文随空中的根系进入不同领域，在这些领域中，人、植物与技术的关系共同将未来置于伦理的悬浮中。目的是为人类世未来提出一些问题：植物是“为了”人还是人是“为了”植物？将植物与土地/地球及地球生物分离是否合乎伦理？在基因组后话语中，“负责任创新”与“创新折衷主义”可能在哪里找到一席之地？对分块伦理的承诺能否引导共同生成的个体设计出一种（如拉图尔以类似术语所认识的）科学技术外交，足以抵抗新气候体制的程序性压力？

title: Authenticity, alterations and museum objects: A close encounter with 2LO, the BBC’s first radio transmitter
abstract: In 1922, the BBC broadcast its first radio programme using a hastily improved transmitter with the call sign 2LO. Over 90 years later, this transmitter was acquired by the Science Museum and moved to its storerooms in Kensington. There is no dispute that this is the same transmitter, an ‘icon of broadcasting history’, but under closer inspection it was clear that it had also changed in many ways. Through a close encounter with the 2LO transmitter, this article engages with the materiality of museum objects, and particularly heritage technology collections. By taking note of wear and tear, the missing pieces and later alterations, this article considers authenticity and the relationship between meaning and materiality. It also considers the value of museum objects as sources and how material evidence can enrich a historical narrative.
title_zh: 真实性、改造与博物馆物品：与2LO——BBC首台无线电发射机的近距离接触
abstract_zh: 1922年，BBC使用一台匆忙改进的发射机播出了首个广播节目，呼号为2LO。90多年后，这台发射机被科学博物馆收购，并移至其位于肯辛顿的储藏室。毫无疑问，这是同一台发射机，是“广播史上的标志”，但仔细检查后发现，它在许多方面也发生了变化。通过与2LO发射机的近距离接触，本文探讨了博物馆物品的物质性，特别是遗产技术藏品。通过注意磨损、缺失部件和后来的改造，本文思考了真实性以及意义与物质性之间的关系。它还考虑了博物馆物品作为资料的价值，以及物质证据如何丰富历史叙事。

title: Fossilized Futures: Topologies and Topographies of Crisis Experience in Central Greece
abstract: Drawing on ethnography from western Thessaly, this article reassesses notions of time and temporality in the Greek economic crisis. People experience the past as a folded assemblage of linearly distant and sometimes contradictory moments that help them make sense of a period of social change. Anthropologists should embrace the paradoxes of (poly)temporality and address the topological/topographical experience of time and history. During an era of severe uncertainty, in Greece temporality is discussed through material objects such as photovoltaic panels and fossils as people articulate their situation vis-à-vis the past, present, and future. Multiple moments of the past are woven together to explain the current crisis experience, provoking fear that times of hardship are returning or instilling hope that the turmoil can be overcome.
title_zh: 化石化的未来：希腊中部危机经验的拓扑与地形学
abstract_zh: 基于西色萨利的民族志，本文重新评估了希腊经济危机中的时间与时间性概念。人们将过去体验为一个由线性遥远且有时矛盾的时刻组成的折叠组合，这些时刻帮助他们理解社会变革时期。人类学家应拥抱（多元）时间性的悖论，并处理时间与历史的地形学/拓扑学经验。在严重不确定的时代，希腊的时间性通过物质对象如光伏板和化石进行讨论，因为人们相对于过去、现在和未来阐明自己的处境。过去的多个时刻交织在一起以解释当前的危机体验，引发了对困难时期回归的恐惧，或激发了克服动荡的希望。

title: From standard takers to standard makers? The role of knowledge‐intensive intermediaries in setting global sustainability standards
journal_name: GLOBAL NETWORKS-A JOURNAL OF TRANSNATIONAL AFFAIRS
abstract: Abstract Standards are increasingly being geared towards addressing social and ecological concerns in global production networks, but to facilitate sustainable development locally, global standards need to integrate the context‐specific needs of actors in developing countries. However, most standards are still developed in the Global North, while the inclusion of actors from developing countries remains limited. Nonetheless, there is recent evidence of some countries from the Global South proactively influencing transnational and global standard setting and, in these processes, knowledge is a decisive factor. Accordingly, in this article we argue that a dynamic and knowledge‐based perspective can provide more detailed insights into how actors from developing countries contribute to standard setting processes. In this respect, special types of organizations – namely knowledge‐intensive intermediaries (KIIs) – play an essential, yet unrecognized, role. Here, to illustrate the strategies that KIIs use to influence global standard setting, we investigate the South African organization ‘Fair Trade in Tourism’.
title_zh: 从标准接受者到标准制定者？知识密集型中介在设定全球可持续标准中的作用
abstract_zh: 摘要标准越来越多地旨在解决全球生产网络中的社会与生态问题，但为了促进当地的可持续发展，全球标准需要整合发展中国家行动者的具体情境需求。然而，大多数标准仍在全球北方制定，而发展中国家行动者的参与仍然有限。尽管如此，近期有证据表明一些全球南方国家正在积极影响跨国和全球标准的制定，在此过程中，知识是一个决定性因素。因此，在本文中，我们认为动态且基于知识的视角可以提供更详细的见解，说明发展中国家行动者如何参与标准制定过程。在这方面，特殊类型的组织——即知识密集型中介——发挥着至关重要但尚未被认识的作用。这里，为了说明知识密集型中介用来影响全球标准制定的策略，我们调查了南非组织“旅游公平贸易”。

title: Gaharu King – Family Queen: material gendered political ecology of the eaglewood boom in Kalimantan, Indonesia
abstract: Framed with the concepts of material gendered political ecology and the Wirkmacht (agentive force) of gaharu (eaglewood), I give empirical insights into the intertwinement of power, marginality, identity and gender linked to natural resource governance in Central Kalimantan, Indonesia. Wirkmacht comprises the properties and functionalities of the resource, and includes gendered roles and identity formation connected to it. Material gendered political ecology therefore analyzes gender-specific governance and power structures by taking socio-natures and the materiality of resources into account. Currently, the extraction of gaharu as a boom commodity provides material gain, enhances prestige and functions as a marker for a specific masculine indigenous identity. Eaglewood is extracted without state regulations, meaning high autonomy and the uncontested control of the resource by villagers. Young male adults of marginalized Punan Murung communities thereby turn their spatial marginality into an advantage as their geographic location offers them control and access to wild gaharu. They counter their political, economic and social exclusion with the establishment of a niche in the margins, thereby twisting and reformulating marginality. Punan Murung thus could change the derogatory identity of a formerly isolated community towards positively connoted indigenous people.
title_zh: 加哈鲁王——家族女王：印度尼西亚加里曼丹沉香热潮的物质性别政治生态学
abstract_zh: 以物质性别政治生态学和加哈鲁（沉香）的Wirkmacht（能动力量）概念为框架，我对印度尼西亚中加里曼丹与自然资源治理相关的权力、边缘性、身份和性别的交织提供了实证见解。Wirkmacht包括资源的属性和功能，并涵盖与其相关的性别角色和身份形成。因此，物质性别政治生态学通过考虑社会自然和资源的物质性来分析特定性别的治理和权力结构。目前，作为繁荣商品的沉香开采提供了物质收益，提高了声望，并作为特定男性原住民身份的标记。沉香是在没有国家监管的情况下开采的，这意味着村民对资源的自主权很高且毫无争议。边缘化的Punan Murung社区的年轻男性成年人因此将其空间边缘性转化为优势，因为他们地理位置提供了对野生沉香的获取和控制。他们通过在边缘建立利基来对抗政治、经济和社会排斥，从而扭曲和重新定义边缘性。因此，Punan Murung能够将以前孤立社区的贬义身份转变为正面意义的原住民身份。

title: Governing three-wheeled motorcycle taxis in urban Ethiopia: States, markets, and moral discourses of infrastructure
abstract: Taxi drivers in Hawassa, Ethiopia, have come into conflict with government administrators over the strict regulation of their three-wheeled motorcycle taxis, known as Bajaj. Their conflict with the government is best conceptualized not through a state-market binary but in relation to competing moral discourses concerning modernity, reciprocity, and the right to a livelihood. Such discourses are mediated by the particular characteristics of the Bajaj, an inexpensive, flexible, and labor-dependent transportation technology. These discourses have emerged in a context in which urban Ethiopians and their social networks act as the infrastructure that enables cities to function. The encounter between these social networks and vital technologies such as the Bajaj is fundamental to the politics of infrastructure.
title_zh: 治理埃塞俄比亚城市的三轮摩托车出租车：国家、市场与基础设施的道德话语
abstract_zh: 埃塞俄比亚哈瓦萨市的出租车司机与政府管理人员因对三轮摩托车出租车（称为Bajaj）的严格监管而发生冲突。他们与政府的冲突最好不是通过国家-市场的二元对立来概念化，而是与关于现代性、互惠和生计权利的相互竞争的道德话语相关。这些话语受到Bajaj（一种廉价、灵活且依赖劳动力的交通技术）特定特征的中介。这些话语出现在这样一个背景下：城市埃塞俄比亚人及其社会网络充当了使城市运转的基础设施。这些社会网络与Bajaj等关键技术的相遇是基础设施政治的基础。

title: Guitar Makers: The Endurance of Artisanal Values in North America. Kathryn MarieDudley. Chicago; London: University of Chicago Press, 2014.
title_zh: 吉他制造者：北美手工价值的持久性。凯瑟琳·玛丽·达德利。芝加哥；伦敦：芝加哥大学出版社，2014年。

title: Islamic cosmopolitanism out of Muslim Asia: Hindu–Muslim business co-operation between Odessa and Yiwu
abstract: This article explores the forms of cosmopolitanism that form an important element of the identities and activities of long-distance Muslim merchants involved in the global trade in Chinese commodities. It focuses on two nodes that are central for this type of trade: Odessa on Ukraine’s Black Sea coast and Yiwu in China’s Zhejiang Province. Ethnographically, the paper focuses on the commercial and social ties that exist between Muslim traders from Afghanistan and those who identify with the country’s dispersed Hindu ethno-religious minority. It argues that the ability to manage heterogeneous social and religious relationships is of critical significance to the activities and identities of these commodity traders.
title_zh: 来自穆斯林亚洲的伊斯兰世界主义：敖德萨与义乌之间的印度教-穆斯林商业合作
abstract_zh: 本文探讨了参与中国商品全球贸易的远距离穆斯林商人身份与活动中的重要元素——世界主义的形式。它聚焦于这类贸易的两个核心节点：乌克兰黑海沿岸的敖德萨和中国浙江省的义乌。人种学上，本文关注来自阿富汗的穆斯林商人与认同该国分散的印度教民族宗教少数群体的商人之间的商业和社会联系。文章认为，管理异质社会与宗教关系的能力对这些商品商人的活动和身份至关重要。

title: Michezo Video: Nairobi’s gamers and the developers who are promoting local content
abstract: In Kenya, the rise of digital technologies and related new media, and an infrastructure able to support them, has seen the emergence of a growing local video games industry and a new generation of Kenyan video game developers, players and promoters. This article focuses on the particular design strategies employed by young producers of creative digital content for games and the current networks of practice, play and support unfolding around these new gaming technologies. Interviewees for this paper span industry experts and independent artists operating in and beyond the capital city of Nairobi.The article will examine: Strategies employed by these developers and promoters looking to create and advocate local content, i.e., visual and narrative game environments referencing histories and folklore specific to their cultural context.Real or virtual spaces of interaction and networks these games developers, promoters and players operate within – including gaming studios, entertainment parlours, technology hubs, gaming conventions and online SNS interest groups and video channels – and the ways in which these spaces might support the emergence, development and increased distribution of Kenyan games that incorporate local cultural context and regional folklore.Utilizing anthropological models of ethnographic interviews and visual culture methodologies informed by design research methods and trends analysis, we examine the characteristics of gaming in Kenya (whether aesthetic, cultural or organizational) that are distinctive in relation to the more mainstream and dominant Western formats.
title_zh: Michezo视频：内罗毕的游戏玩家与推广本地内容的开发者
abstract_zh: 在肯尼亚，数字技术和相关新媒体以及支持它们的基础设施的兴起，催生了一个日益增长的本地视频游戏产业和一代新的肯尼亚视频游戏开发者、玩家和推广者。本文聚焦于年轻创意数字内容生产者针对游戏所采用的特殊设计策略，以及围绕这些新游戏技术展开的当前实践、游戏和支持网络。本文的受访者包括行业专家和在内罗毕首都及其以外地区运营的独立艺术家。本文将考察：这些开发者和推广者创造和倡导本地内容所采用的策略，即参考其文化背景下的历史和民间传说的视觉和叙事游戏环境；这些游戏开发者、推广者和玩家在其中运作的真实或虚拟互动空间和网络——包括游戏工作室、娱乐场所、技术中心、游戏大会和在线SNS兴趣小组及视频频道——以及这些空间可能如何支持包含本地文化背景和区域民间传说的肯尼亚游戏的出现、发展和更广泛传播。利用基于设计研究方法和趋势分析的民族志访谈和视觉文化方法论的人类学模型，我们考察了肯尼亚游戏（无论是美学、文化还是组织方面）相对于更为主流和占主导地位的西方形式所具有的独特性。

title: Precarious entrepreneurship: mobile phones, work and kinship in neoliberal Peru
abstract: In the first decade of the 21st century, a new niche opened up in the street economy of Cusco, a city in the Southern Peruvian Andes: the sale of calls between mobile phones. This article shows that the neoliberal policies of deregulation that enabled the mobile phone call business have also produced new regulatory spaces that small‐scale entrepreneurs have to manage in their relationships to the authorities. Through the story of a family business, the author discusses the relationships between precariousness, informality, uncertainty and ambiguity, and focuses on the tensions that arise in kinship relationships that are affective and supportive, yet also exploitative. The main argument is that there are different modes of precarity, and that kinship, which mostly has been thought of as security in an uncertain world, in fact can exacerbate a precarious condition.
title_zh: 不稳定的创业：新自由主义秘鲁的手机、工作与亲属关系
abstract_zh: 在21世纪的第一个十年，秘鲁安第斯山脉南部城市库斯科的街头经济中出现了一个新的利基市场：手机通话的销售。本文表明，使得手机通话业务成为可能的新自由主义放松管制政策也产生了新的监管空间，小规模企业家必须在其与当局的关系中管理这些空间。通过一个家族企业的故事，作者讨论了不稳定性、非正式性、不确定性和模糊性之间的关系，并重点关注在情感和支持却又剥削的亲属关系中产生的张力。主要论点是存在不同的不稳定性模式，而亲属关系——在不确定世界中通常被视为安全——实际上可能加剧不稳定的状况。

title: Recognition through reconnaissance? Using drones for counter-mapping in Indonesia
abstract: Indonesia has a long history of land grabs before this term was coined, reaching from colonial occupation to cleptocratic rule. The most recent wave of enclosures across the archipelago builds on large-scale, market-oriented spatial planning. This paper shares our experience of using unmanned aerial vehicles (drones) to produce high-quality community controlled maps in order to challenge some of the official spatial planning processes in West Kalimantan. Developed at first as a component of action research looking at the political ecology of the Kapuas River, the drone mapping soon developed its own dynamics and delivered quite impressive results in bolstering legal and political claims of Non-Governmental Organisations (NGOs) and Dayak communities. We argue that relatively simple and accessible drone technology has some potential for furthering the recognition of local and indigenous people and their territorial claims. Such a view, however, stands in contrast to recent debates that have highlighted the limits and even detrimental social and political effects of counter-mapping. Drawing on our experience with ‘community drones’, we compare ‘traditional’ and drone counter-mapping in key dimensions of production, distribution and use. This comparison helps to delimit more clearly the occasions and conditions under which drone-based counter-mapping may be a politically useful tool.
title_zh: 通过侦察获得认可？在印度尼西亚使用无人机进行反制测绘
abstract_zh: 印度尼西亚在“土地掠夺”这一术语被创造之前就有着悠久的历史，从殖民占领到盗贼统治。最近一轮横跨群岛的土地圈占基于大规模、市场导向的空间规划。本文分享了我们在西加里曼丹使用无人机（UAV）制作高质量社区控制地图的经验，以挑战一些官方的空间规划过程。最初，无人机测绘是作为研究卡普阿斯河政治生态的行动研究的一部分而开发的，但它很快发展出自己的动力，并在支持非政府组织和达雅克社区的法律与政治主张方面取得了相当令人瞩目的成果。我们认为，相对简单且易得的无人机技术有潜力促进对当地和原住民及其领土主张的认可。然而，这种观点与最近的辩论形成对比，这些辩论强调了反制测绘的局限性甚至有害的社会和政治影响。借鉴我们使用“社区无人机”的经验，我们比较了“传统”和无人机反制测绘在生产、分发和使用等关键维度上的差异。这种比较有助于更清晰地界定无人机反制测绘在何种场合和条件下可能成为有用的政治工具。

title: Repoliticising multi-stakeholder standards processes: the Roundtable on Sustainable Biomaterials’ standards and certification scheme
abstract: The Roundtable on Sustainable Biomaterials (RSB) is one of a number of sustainability standards schemes that have been approved by the European Union under its 2009 Renewable Energy Directive (EU RED). The RSB scheme is often referred to positively not only because the sustainability standard is considered to exemplify greater rigour than many of the other EU-approved standards in terms of their claims to protect ‘sustainability’, but also because it provides an example of a ‘multi-stakeholder’ model of standards development that is assumed to confer greater legitimacy on the sustainability standards that are produced. In recognising that standards processes are part of wider processes of neoliberalisation, this paper explores the process in which the RSB standard was produced. In doing so it considers how notions of sustainability embodied in the RSB standards were shaped not only by its ‘multi-stakeholder’ process, but also by wider influences that were brought to bear in that process, including the growing spectre of a ‘standards market’ produced by the EU’s approval of different schemes.
title_zh: 重新政治化多利益相关方标准流程：可持续生物材料圆桌会议的标准与认证计划
abstract_zh: 可持续生物材料圆桌会议（RSB）是欧盟根据其2009年《可再生能源指令》（EU RED）批准的众多可持续性标准计划之一。RSB计划之所以常被正面提及，不仅因为其可持续性标准被认为在保护“可持续性”方面比许多其他欧盟批准的标准更具严格性，还因为它提供了“多利益相关方”标准开发模式的范例，这种模式被认为赋予所制定的可持续性标准更大的合法性。认识到标准流程是更广泛的新自由主义化进程的一部分，本文探讨了RSB标准的产生过程。在此过程中，它考虑了RSB标准中体现的可持续性概念如何不仅受到其“多利益相关方”过程的影响，还受到该过程中施加的更广泛影响，包括欧盟批准不同计划所产生的“标准市场”日益增长的阴影。

title: Service outsourcing and labour mobility in a digital age: transnational linkages between Japan and Dalian, China
journal_name: GLOBAL NETWORKS-A JOURNAL OF TRANSNATIONAL AFFAIRS
abstract: Abstract In this article, I examine the transnational mobility of digital workers and the control of their labour across multiple production sites. The digitalization of work has progressively allowed businesses to outsource IT‐enabled service jobs to cheaper production sites offshore. The growth of the ‘offshore outsourcing' of white‐collar service jobs in East Asia has produced the mobility of cheap digital labour from Japan to Dalian in northeast China. They work at call centres and other Japanese‐speaking workplaces in the lower echelons of the city's IT sector, typically earning salaries in Chinese yuan at, or even below, the average Japanese minimum wage. Based on ethnographic findings, I argue that in the global digital economy, digital services are rendered exploitable through their transnational mobility and that this form of labour migration has developed because of the partial, fluid and contingent nature of the transnational links between the two locations. I analyse how the neoliberal logic of exception underpins the creation of IT parks in China and the casualization of labour in Japan to enable new forms of transnational labour control and capital accumulation.
title_zh: 数字时代的服务外包与劳动力流动：日本与中国大连之间的跨国联系
abstract_zh: 摘要在本文中，我探讨了数字工人的跨国流动性以及他们在多个生产地点劳动的控制。工作的数字化逐渐允许企业将IT支持的服务工作外包到更便宜的离岸生产地点。东亚白领服务工作的“离岸外包”增长产生了从日本到中国东北大连的廉价数字劳动力的流动。他们在该市IT行业底层的呼叫中心和其他日语工作场所工作，通常以日元或甚至低于日本平均最低工资的水平赚取人民币工资。基于民族志调查结果，我认为在全球数字经济中，数字服务通过其跨国流动性变得可剥削，并且这种形式的劳动力迁移是由于两地之间跨国联系的部分性、流动性和偶然性而发展起来的。我分析了新自由主义的例外逻辑如何支撑中国IT园区的创建和日本劳动力的临时化，从而促成新的跨国劳动控制和资本积累形式。

title: Tapping into rubber: China’s opium replacement program and rubber production in Laos
abstract: Despite centuries of state-directed eradication efforts, opium cultivation persists in northern Laos and Myanmar. The most recent of these efforts is China’s Opium Replacement Program (ORP). Like other illicit crop substitution programmes, the ORP seeks to provide opium cultivators with licit livelihood alternatives. Unlike other programmes, it does so by supporting Chinese agribusiness investors in the region – predominantly rubber companies – instead of targeting opium producers directly. Rubber is not, however, economically or ecologically speaking, an optimal replacement for opium. Rubber and opium have contrasting production cycles and market characteristics, and are grown at different altitudes by different types of producers (large corporations and smallholders, respectively). Due to this apparent mismatch, critics have dismissed the ORP’s opium eradication aims, viewing it as a pretext for land grabs. I argue instead that rubber makes sense as an opium replacement crop based on Chinese and Lao state views that opium is a symptom of weak state control and underdevelopment in the borderlands and rubber a tried and true modernising crop. I thus offer that the ORP attempts replacement by displacement – not necessarily by physically replacing opium fields with rubber plantations, but rather by drawing land and labour into rubber, away from opium.
title_zh: 开发橡胶：中国的罂粟替代计划与老挝的橡胶生产
abstract_zh: 尽管经历了几个世纪的国家主导的根除努力，鸦片种植在老挝北部和缅甸仍然存在。其中最新的一项努力是中国的罂粟替代计划（ORP）。与其他非法作物替代计划一样，该计划旨在为鸦片种植者提供合法的替代生计。与其他计划不同的是，它通过支持该地区的中国农业企业投资者——主要是橡胶公司——来实现这一目标，而不是直接针对鸦片生产者。然而，从经济或生态角度来看，橡胶并不是罂粟的最佳替代品。橡胶和鸦片具有截然不同的生产周期和市场特征，并且由不同类型生产者（分别为大型企业和小型农户）在不同海拔地区种植。由于这种明显的不匹配，批评者否定了ORP根除鸦片的意图，将其视为土地掠夺的借口。相反，我认为，基于中国和老挝国家的观点，橡胶作为鸦片替代作物是有意义的，因为鸦片被视为边境地区国家控制薄弱和欠发达的象征，而橡胶则是一种经过验证的现代化作物。因此，我认为ORP试图通过置换来实现替代——不一定是用橡胶种植园物理替代罂粟田，而是将土地和劳动力从鸦片中吸引出来，转向橡胶。

title: Then press enter: digital payment technology and the history of telephone interface

authors.name: Michael Palm
institutions: University of North Carolina at Chapel Hill

abstract: The internet and other digital networks in the U.S. (and beyond) remain essentially an upgrade of the national telephone network built by AT&T over the first half of the twentieth century, and digital payment remains tethered to telephony at the level of infrastructure. Telephone history also continues to inform digital payment at the level of interface. Debit card readers feature a keypad nearly identical to those introduced (also by AT&T) to the dialling public a half-century ago on touch-tone telephones. In this essay I highlight the development of the touch-tone keypad as a transformative payment technology. There have been three great leaps forward in the history of telephone interface: the dial, the keypad and the touch screen. Each corresponds to a period of technological transformation in the telephone industry and society more broadly: the rotary dial and automation, touch-tone keypads and digitization, and touch screens and computerization. The successful careers of the dial and the keypad, especially when read in tandem, suggest that touch screens will alter the everyday economics of retail payment even more radically than its predecessors. I also describe a broader trajectory of digital naturalization, whereby telephone numbers have proliferated into a personal identification number, passwords and a plethora of personalized information. Payments increasingly circulate today as subsets of personal information within the vast sea of big data. Payment apps are demonstrating a capacity to reorganize retail transactions on a scale as vast as any technology since the cash register. The history of retail payment finds the point of sale heading from the till into shoppers’ pockets. As a result, consumers are increasingly shouldering the costs of purchasing, maintaining, upgrading and securing the technology used for everyday transactions.
title_zh: 数字支付技术与电话界面的历史
abstract_zh: 美国及其他地区的互联网和其他数字网络本质上仍是AT&T在20世纪上半叶建立的全国电话网络的升级，而数字支付在基础设施层面仍然与电话系统紧密相连。电话历史在界面层面也继续影响着数字支付。借记卡读卡器的键盘与半个世纪前AT&T在触摸式电话上推出的键盘几乎相同。本文重点介绍了触摸式键盘作为变革性支付技术的发展。电话界面历史上经历了三次重大飞跃：拨号盘、键盘和触摸屏。每一次都对应着电话行业及更广泛社会的技术变革时期：旋转拨号盘与自动化、触摸式键盘与数字化、触摸屏与计算机化。拨号盘和键盘的成功历程（尤其是两者结合来看）表明，触摸屏将比其前辈更彻底地改变零售支付的日常经济学。本文还描述了数字自然化的更广泛轨迹，电话号码已扩散为个人识别号、密码和大量个性化信息。如今，支付越来越多地作为个人信息在大数据海洋中流通。支付应用程序正展现出自收银机以来任何技术都无法比拟的规模重组零售交易的能力。零售支付的历史发现，销售点正从收银台走向消费者的口袋。因此，消费者日益承担购买、维护、升级和保障日常交易技术安全的成本。

title: Carbon as a Metric of the Human
abstract: In this article, carbon management is framed as a domain in which active reflection on the uncertain significance of climate change takes material form in the construction of new infrastructures of carbon accounting and carbon markets. “Carbon” refers not to a chemical, per se, but to an imaginative space of global atmospheric relations rendered material. The historical ontology of carbon and atmosphere together form a distinctive global medium, as I describe. The atmosphere as medium is manifest in the informational spaces of digital platforms meant to do work on the human subjects of climate change. I describe the carbon accounting practices of two Beijing‐based enterprises that are involved in building out the infrastructure of carbon accounting for the purpose of decarbonizing Chinese industry. Carbon is at the center of a contemporary formation that is imaginative, materialist, heavily quantified, and oriented toward the technical modification of human affairs. It supposes that humans as planetary agents have become significant in terms of collective activity that is historically recent, highly unequal, and global in scope. The human is configured not as a biological species, such as in debates on “life itself” or distinctions between humans and other species, or even in terms of an essential humanity that can provide the transcendent bonds of a moral community. Rather, carbon accounting formulates the human ecologically and geologically with an eye toward imagining the future forms these relations might take. Hence, climate change has identified the human as a contemporary problem with particular urgency.
title_zh: 碳作为人类的度量标准
abstract_zh: 在本文中，碳管理被构建为一个领域，其中对气候变化不确定意义的积极反思在碳核算和碳市场新基础设施的建设中采取了物质形式。 “碳”所指的并非一种化学物质，而是一个全球大气关系的想象空间，它被赋予了物质形态。如我所描述的，碳和大气的历史本体论共同构成了一个独特的全球媒介。作为媒介的大气体现在数字平台的信息空间中，这些平台旨在对气候变化的人类主体产生影响。我描述了两家北京企业的碳核算实践，它们参与建设碳核算基础设施，旨在实现中国工业的脱碳。碳处于当代构想的中心，这一构想富有想象力、唯物主义、高度量化，并面向人类事务的技术改造。它假设人类作为行星级行动者，其集体活动在历史上是近期的、高度不平等的、全球性的。人类不被视为一个生物物种——例如在关于“生命本身”或人类与其他物种区别的辩论中，甚至不是作为一个能够提供道德共同体超越纽带的本质人性。相反，碳核算从生态和地质角度构建人类，着眼于想象这些关系未来可能采取的形式。因此，气候变化已将人类识别为一个具有特殊紧迫性的当代问题。

title: Circuits and currents: Dynamics of disruption in New York City blackouts
abstract: Blackouts are technological breakdowns that result in social ruptures. Everyday patterns are disrupted, causing inversions of authority, creating new and spontaneous opportunities for social relationships, and offering unusual opportunities for economic benefit. Analysis of blackouts in New York City helps us to understand the role of electricity in the lives of city dwellers, their expectations of what energy should do for them, and when and how it should function. Absences of electricity provide a liminal context in which to examine the role of energy in creating and maintaining the technological and social order that we have come to expect—and demand. This article argues that, through the darkness of electrical disruption, blackouts illuminate two metaphors that connect the scientific properties of electricity with the social order shaped by electricity: circuits and currents. When the circuits of electricity are broken, currents of power in technical, social, economic, and political arenas are also disrupted.
title_zh: 电路与电流：纽约市停电中的中断动力学
abstract_zh: 停电是导致社会断裂的技术故障。日常模式被打乱，引起权威颠倒，创造出新的自发社会关系机会，并提供不寻常的经济收益机会。对纽约市停电的分析有助于我们理解电力在城市居民生活中的作用、他们对能源应为他们做什么的期望，以及能源应何时以及如何发挥作用。电力的缺失提供了一个阈限背景，用于审视能源在创造和维护我们所期望——并要求——的技术和社会秩序中的作用。本文认为，通过电气中断的黑暗，停电揭示了两个将电的科学属性与由电塑造的社会秩序联系起来的隐喻：电路和电流。当电路断开时，技术、社会、经济和政治领域的权力流也被中断。

title: District heating as heterotopia: Tracing the social contract through domestic energy infrastructure in Pimlico, London
abstract: The Pimlico District Heating Undertaking ( PDHU ) was London's first attempt at neighborhood heating. Built in the 1950s to supply landmark social housing project Churchill Gardens, the district heating system sent heat from nearby Battersea power station into the radiators of the housing estate. The network is a rare example in the United Kingdom, where, unlike other European states, district heating did not become widespread. Today the heating system supplies more than 3,000 homes in the London Borough of Westminster, having survived the closure of the power station and the privatization of the housing estate it supplies. Therefore, this article argues, the neighborhood can be understood as a heterotopia, a site of an alternative sociotechnical order. This concept is used to understand the layers of economic, political, and technological rationalities that have supported PDHU and to question how it has survived radical changes in housing and energy policy in the United Kingdom. This lens allows us to see the tension between the urban planning and engineering perspective, which celebrates this system as a future‐oriented “experiment,” and the reality of managing and using the system on the estate. The article analyzes this technology‐enabled standard of living as a social contract between state and citizen, suggesting this is a way to analyze contemporary questions of district energy.
title_zh: 作为异托邦的区域供热：追踪伦敦皮姆利科住宅能源基础设施的社会契约
abstract_zh: 皮姆利科区域供热工程（PDHU）是伦敦首次尝试社区供暖。该区域供热系统建于20世纪50年代，为标志性社会住房项目丘吉尔花园提供热量，将附近巴特西发电站的热量输送到住宅区的散热器中。该网络在英国是一个罕见的例子，与其他欧洲国家不同，区域供热在英国并未普及。如今，该供暖系统为威斯敏斯特伦敦自治市的3000多户家庭供热，它经受住了发电站关闭和其所供应的住宅区私有化的考验。因此，本文认为，该社区可以被理解为一个异托邦，一个替代性社会技术秩序的场所。这一概念被用来理解支撑PDHU的经济、政治和技术理性层次，并探讨它如何在英国住房和能源政策的剧烈变革中幸存下来。这种视角使我们能够看到城市规划与工程视角之间的张力，前者将这一系统视为面向未来的“实验”，而后者则是庄园上管理和使用该系统的现实。本文分析了这种技术驱动的生活标准作为国家与公民之间的社会契约，并认为这是分析当代区域能源问题的一种方式。

title: EL CAMIÓN EN LA PUNA DE ATACAMA (1930-1980): MECÁNICA, ESPACIO Y SABERES EN TORNO A UN OBJETO TÉCNICO LIMINAL

authors.name: Nicolás Richard
institutions: Centre National pour la Recherche Scientifique et Technique (CNRST)

abstract: El artculo estudia la diseminacin del objeto tcnico "camin" en la puna de Atacama, entre los aos 30 y hasta entrados los aos 80 del siglo pasado, a partir de un corpus de entrevistas y relatos recogidos en las punas boliviana, chilena y argentina. Se exploran tres hiptesis. Desde una perspectiva histrica, el camin vuelve problemtica la idea comnmente vehiculada de una crisis social y econmica que habra resultado del fin de la arriera animal transcordillerana. Desde una perspectiva ambiental, el camin opera una disyuncin entre agricultura y transporte -entre la "geografa del pasto" y la geografa emergente del transporte rodoviario-que va "deshaciendo" un paisaje, secando sus quebradas, abandonando pascanas y destecnificando o asalvajando animales: el camin produce desierto. Desde una perspectiva tcnica, por ltimo, esta entrada (por primera vez) de la rueda en la puna secreta muy rpidamente un conjunto de saberes, de tcnicas, de acomodos y usos locales del camin, que lo reconcilian con unos universos tcnicos anteriores y con una geografa particular. En estos tres sentidos, se trata de avanzar hacia una antropologa local del camin.
title_zh: 阿塔卡马高原上的卡车（1930-1980）：围绕一个临界技术对象的机械、空间与知识
abstract_zh: 本文基于在玻利维亚、智利和阿根廷的高原地区收集的访谈和故事，研究20世纪30年代至80年代期间“卡车”这一技术对象在阿塔卡马高原的传播。文章探讨了三个假设。从历史角度看，卡车使得一种普遍认为的、因跨安第斯山脉的牲畜运输终结而导致的社会经济危机的观点变得有问题。从环境角度看，卡车在农业和运输之间——在“牧草地理”与新兴的公路运输地理之间——造成了一种断裂，这种断裂正在“瓦解”景观，使其干涸，废弃驿站，并使动物去技术化或野化：卡车制造了沙漠。最后，从技术角度看，车轮首次进入高原，迅速催生了一套当地对卡车的知识、技术、适应和用途，使其与先前的技术世界和特定的地理环境相协调。在这三个意义上，本文旨在迈向一种当地卡车的民族志。

title: Electric activism: Analysis, alliances, and interventions
abstract: Abstract Electricity has been the unspoken bedrock of modern life. Decisions about how power is produced, transmitted, and delivered have been entrusted to technical experts and have been relatively unquestioned. In turn, the electricity sector has historically been an opaque one, impervious to public scrutiny. Yet liberalization of the sector, global and local environmental impacts, and new energy technologies are spurring a growing clamor to peel back the layers of technocracy and to prise open a space for new voices and actors. This article explores the ways in which the governance of the electricity sector is changing and being changed by a new politics of energy production and consumption. The article focuses on long‐term electricity planning to understand how critical independent experts and nonexperts have formed alliances that challenge entrenched decision‐making processes and assumptions. It presents case studies from South Africa and Thailand that document the struggle between reluctant departments of energy and nongovernmental initiatives demanding access to the processes underpinning the production of knowledge about electricity sector needs. The analysis places these cases within the shifts under way in energy sectors around the world, away from centralized command‐and‐control systems to those that are decentralized with multiple points of energy generation. It explores the implications for how governance is conceived, with special attention to the implications for both policy and activist agendas. What forms of interaction between experts and citizens can we conceive, and how can they be supported?
title_zh: 电力行动主义：分析、联盟与干预
abstract_zh: 摘要电力一直是现代生活不言而喻的基石。关于如何生产、传输和输送电力的决策被委托给技术专家，且相对不受质疑。反过来，电力部门历史上一直是一个不透明的领域，不受公众监督。然而，该部门的自由化、全球和当地的环境影响以及新能源技术正引发越来越多的呼声，要求揭开技术官僚主义的层层外衣，为新的声音和行动者开辟空间。本文探讨了电力部门治理方式的变化，以及如何被新的能源生产和消费政治所改变。文章聚焦于长期电力规划，以理解关键独立专家和非专家如何形成联盟，挑战根深蒂固的决策过程和假设。它介绍了来自南非和泰国的案例研究，记录了不情愿的能源部门与要求获取电力部门需求知识生产过程的非政府倡议之间的斗争。分析将这些案例置于全球能源部门正在发生的转变中，即从集中式指挥控制系统转向分散式、具有多个能源生产点的系统。它探讨了对治理概念化的影响，特别关注对政策和行动者议程的影响。我们能构想出专家和公民之间何种形式的互动，以及如何支持这些互动？

title: Everyday recomposition: Precarity and socialization in Thailand's migrant workforce
abstract: As a site of manufacturing growth since the 1990s, the Mae Sot industrial zone in northwest Thailand has increasingly employed migrant workers from Myanmar. Yet the social dynamics of Myanmar migrant groups employed in Mae Sot's garment sector do not align with North Atlantic narratives of class fragmentation. Rather, labor flexibilization at this site has had socially constitutive effects. As flexibilization has expanded in Thailand, the very practices by which the country's garment companies have sought to create low-wage, flexible workforces have themselves produced conditions of possibility for new forms of relationality and socialization among workers. The resulting social cohesion has formed, in turn, a basis for solidarity among workers when they carry out factory strikes. [flexible labor, precarity, solidarity, undocumented migrants, Thailand, Myanmar]
title_zh: 日常重组：泰国移民劳动力的不稳定与社会化
abstract_zh: 自20世纪90年代以来，泰国西北部的湄索工业区作为一个制造业增长点，越来越多地雇佣来自缅甸的移民工人。然而，在湄索服装行业就业的缅甸移民群体的社会动态并不符合北大西洋关于阶级碎片化的叙述。相反，该地的劳动力灵活化产生了社会构成性影响。随着灵活化在泰国的扩展，该国服装公司寻求创建低工资、灵活劳动力的做法本身，为工人之间新型关系性和社会化的可能性创造了条件。由此产生的社会凝聚力反过来构成了工人进行工厂罢工时的团结基础。[灵活劳动力，不稳定，团结，无证移民，泰国，缅甸]

title: Keeping the doctor in the loop: Ayurvedic pharmaceuticals in Kerala
abstract: Ethnographic inquiry into Ayurvedic commodification in Kerala revealed the prevalence of a distinct regional pharmaceutical market dominated by physician-manufacturers, oriented towards supplying classical medicines to Ayurvedic doctors. This stands in sharp contrast to mainstream Ayurveda that is observed to have undergone biomedicalization and pharmaceuticalization. This paper argues that Kerala's classical-medicine-centric pharmaceutical market constitutes an alternative modernity because it provided Kerala Ayurveda with a different route to modernization impervious to the biomedical regime, as well as endowing it with the institutional power to safeguard its regional identity. Although physician-entrepreneurs are its key architects, it is sustained by value regimes shaped by a unique regional medico-cultural milieu. Even when industrially produced, classical medicines remain embedded within Ayurveda's socio-technical network; unlike proprietary drugs sold as individual product-identities through non-Ayurvedic channels, they travel together as a pharmacopeia, distributed through exclusive doctor-mediated agencies. This clinic-centric distribution format is best conceptualized as an open-source business model as it made low-margin generics viable by packaging them with therapies and services. Besides ensuring better access and affordability, it provided resistance to pharmaceuticalization and intellectual property concentration. By keeping the doctor in the loop, it prevented medicines from degenerating into de-contextualized commodities; the service component of Ayurveda therein preserved went on become the unique selling point in the health-tourism market. The tourism-inspired proliferation of Brand Kerala eventually triggered a paradigm shift in mainstream Ayurveda - shifting focus from 'pharmaceuticals' to 'services' and from 'illness' to 'wellness'. Furthermore, interacting with hybrid Ayurvedas in transnational markets, Kerala Ayurveda co-produces new alterities countervailing the structurally dominant biomedical paradigm.
title_zh: 让医生参与其中：喀拉拉邦的阿育吠陀制药
abstract_zh: 对喀拉拉邦阿育吠陀商品化的民族志调查揭示了一个独特的区域制药市场的盛行，该市场由医生兼制造商主导，旨在向阿育吠陀医生供应经典药物。这与主流阿育吠陀形成鲜明对比，后者被认为经历了生物医学化和制药化。本文认为，喀拉拉邦以经典药物为中心的制药市场构成了一种另类现代性，因为它为喀拉拉阿育吠陀提供了一条不受生物医学体制影响的现代化途径，并赋予其维护区域认同的制度力量。尽管医生兼企业家是其关键构建者，但它由独特的区域医学文化环境塑造的价值体系所维系。即使以工业方式生产，经典药物仍嵌入阿育吠陀的社会技术网络中；与通过非阿育吠陀渠道作为独立产品身份销售的专利药不同，它们作为药典一起流通，通过独家医生中介机构分销。这种以诊所为中心的分配模式最好被概念化为一种开源商业模式，因为它通过将低利润仿制药与治疗和服务打包，使其变得可行。除了确保更好的可及性和可负担性，它还提供了对制药化和知识产权集中的抵抗。通过让医生参与其中，它防止药物退化为脱离背景的商品；其中保留下来的阿育吠陀服务成分后来成为健康旅游市场中的独特卖点。以旅游为导向的“喀拉拉品牌”扩散最终引发了主流阿育吠陀的范式转变——将焦点从“制药”转向“服务”，从“疾病”转向“健康”。此外，与跨国市场中的混合阿育吠陀互动，喀拉拉阿育吠陀共同生产出新的替代性，以对抗结构上占主导地位的生物医学范式。

title: LABOUR POLITICS AND AFRICANIZATION AT A TANZANIAN SCIENTIFIC RESEARCH INSTITUTE, 1949–66
abstract: ABSTRACT In this article we examine labour politics and unionization at a scientific research station: the former Institute of Malaria and Vector Borne Diseases (‘Amani’) in north-eastern Tanzania. Drawing on an analysis of an archive found at Amani, this paper approaches the process of decolonizing and Africanizing science and medical research from the perspective of African technicians. The technician cadre at Amani was drawn to scientific employment as it seemed to offer the promise of training, education and advancement. The union at Amani argued that African labour was crucial to the production of scientific knowledge at the station and that there ought to be a ‘ladder’ of promotion and progress that led from auxiliary scientific technician to independent researcher. The daily politics of the decolonization of science was conducted as everyday contentious labour relations and as increasingly vociferous claims upon the cultural power of science by African workers. Drawing attention to the social and spatial practices of African workers at Amani in the 1960s, we argue that Amani functioned not just within globalized networks of tropical medicine and scientific research but as a place bound both to local economies of labour and to larger geographies of African ambition and aspiration.
title_zh: 坦桑尼亚某科研机构的劳工政治与非洲化，1949–66年
abstract_zh: 摘要  在本文中，我们考察了一个科学研究站——坦桑尼亚东北部的前疟疾和媒介传播疾病研究所（'Amani'）的劳工政治和工会化。基于对在Amani发现的档案的分析，本文从非洲技术人员的角度探讨了科学和医学研究去殖民化和非洲化的过程。Amani的技术人员群体被科学就业所吸引，因为它似乎提供了培训、教育和晋升的承诺。Amani的工会认为，非洲劳动力对于该站科学知识的产生至关重要，并且应该有一条从辅助科学技术人员到独立研究者的晋升和进步'阶梯'。科学去殖民化的日常政治表现为日常的劳资对抗关系以及非洲工人对科学文化权力日益强烈的主张。通过关注1960年代Amani非洲工人的社会和实践空间，我们认为Amani不仅在全球化的热带医学和科学研究网络中运作，而且是一个与当地劳动力经济以及更大范围的非洲抱负和渴望的地理空间紧密相连的地方。

title: Living in darkness: Internet humour and the politics of Egypt's electricity infrastructure
abstract: Power cuts have become a lively subject of discussion in Egypt, and they have been extensively mocked in internet memes. Based on a selection of images from the popular Asa7be page, this article examines the visual techniques and joking conventions employed in online memes in order to criticize the Egyptian state's management of the country's electricity infrastructure.
title_zh: 生活在黑暗中：互联网幽默与埃及电力基础设施的政治
abstract_zh: 停电已成为埃及讨论热烈的话题，并在互联网模因中被广泛嘲讽。基于来自流行的Asa7be页面的一组图像，本文检视了在线模因中使用的视觉技术和玩笑惯例，以批评埃及国家对国家电力基础设施的管理。

title: Mines and signs: resource and political futures in Bangladesh
journal_name: JOURNAL OF THE ROYAL ANTHROPOLOGICAL INSTITUTE
abstract: In Bangladesh in 2007‐8, speculation about an energy catastrophe thrived alongside utopic visions of democracy. Two events consolidated the despair and hope for collective national futures: a movement against possible coal mines in Phulbari in the northwest and a nationwide political emergency. They are the focus of this essay. By bringing resource crisis and political crisis together, I argue, at one level, that resource and democracy have become two exemplary sites of thinking towards the future, and, at another, that the gaps in their varied imaginations are potential sites of politics. Drawing on my ethnography of the anti‐mining protests in Phulbari, I analyse the relationship between signification and anticipation in Bangladeshi politics. In so doing, I identify those emergent political moments that challenge the anticipatory politics of the state and the energy company.
title_zh: 矿山与符号：孟加拉国的资源与政治未来
abstract_zh: 在2007年至2008年的孟加拉国，关于能源灾难的猜测与对民主的乌托邦愿景同时盛行。两件事凝聚了人们对国家集体未来的绝望与希望：西北部反对可能建立的普尔巴里煤矿的运动，以及全国性的政治紧急状态。它们构成了本文的重点。通过将资源危机与政治危机结合起来，我认为，在第一个层面上，资源和民主已成为思考未来的两个典型领域，而在另一个层面上，它们不同想象中的空隙是潜在的政治领域。基于我在普尔巴里反采矿抗议活动中的民族志研究，我分析了孟加拉国政治中符号化与预期之间的关系。在此过程中，我识别出那些挑战国家和能源公司预期政治的新兴政治时刻。

title: Mining and the living materiality of mountains in Andean societies
abstract: This article explores indigenous Andean perspectives on the relationship between mining and mountains. It briefly elaborates on how, in Andean worlds, mountains are intentional agents that are crucial members of society. Paying central attention to the materiality of these beings, the article compares the different social logics at play in, on the one hand, contexts of underground mining and, on the other, those of the recent open-pit mines. Using ethnographic data from Cuzco and Ancash (Peru) as well as previous ethnographies of mining practices in Bolivia and Peru, the article analyses how underground mining involved indigenous workers and practices that engaged the mined earth-beings. In contrast, in recent open-pit mines, there are very few workers from the surrounding communities, and indigenous practices engaging earth-beings became invisible. Underground mining is assumed to damage and threaten the fertility of the mined earth-beings but it is not seen as endangering their existence. In contrast, recent open-pit mines are only made possible by destroying earth-beings and extracting metal from their corpses.
title_zh: 安第斯社会中的采矿与山脉的生命物质性
abstract_zh: 本文探讨了安第斯土著关于采矿与山脉关系的观点。文章简要阐述了在安第斯世界中，山脉是如何作为有意图的行动者，成为社会的重要成员的。通过重点关注这些存在物的物质性，本文比较了地下采矿与近期露天矿场这两种情境下所涉及的不同的社会逻辑。利用来自库斯科和安卡什（秘鲁）的民族志数据以及此前关于玻利维亚和秘鲁采矿实践的民族志研究，文章分析了地下采矿如何涉及土著工人和与采矿地灵互动的实践。相比之下，在近期的露天矿场中，来自周边社区的工人很少，而与地灵互动的土著实践也变得不可见。地下采矿被认为会损害和威胁被采矿地灵的生育力，但并未被视为危及它们的存在。相反，近期的露天矿场只有通过摧毁地灵并从其尸体中提取金属才成为可能。

title: Mining, expectations and turbulent times: locating accelerated change in rural Sierra Leone
abstract: In 2006 the iron mines in Marampa Chiefdom, in the Northern Province of Sierra Leone, re-opened. This event sparked a widespread feeling of excitement and hope among the local population, and gave rise to a landscape of expectations in which memories of both relative prosperous and “dark” pasts were invoked and imaginations of a better future flourished. However, soon after the re-opening and initial development of the mines, it appeared that the expected opportunities would not materialize everywhere and for everybody. Frustration, disappointment and loss of hope became part and parcel of the dynamics in this place, which is seen as a hot-spot, a notion that is applied to highlight the numerous frictions and negotiations within this investment landscape. This paper examines this momentum of rising expectations in the hot-spot by scrutinizing its connection to the area’s recent past of boom and bust, the increased global demand for raw materials, especially from China, national development agendas and life-cycles of mining operations. Subsequently, some spatial and social dynamics of accelerated change in Marampa will be discussed. Exploring these dynamics allows to see accelerated change in these investment landscapes from a diverse angle. Through highlighting these temporal, spatial and social dynamics of change in the hot-spot, the paper argues that overheating, a phenomenon often associated with accelerated change, may play out not only as a result of accelerated change, but also as a result of deceleration and the experience of being excluded from the potential opportunities of change.
title_zh: 采矿、期望与动荡时期：塞拉利昂乡村的加速变迁
abstract_zh: 2006年，塞拉利昂北部省份马兰帕酋长领地的铁矿重新开采。这一事件在当地民众中引发了广泛的兴奋和希望，催生了一种期望景观，其中既唤起了对相对繁荣和“黑暗”过去的记忆，也激发了对更美好未来的想象。然而，在矿山重新开放和初步开发后不久，预期的机遇并未在所有地方和所有人中实现。挫折、失望和希望的丧失成为此地动态的一部分，该地被视为一个热点，这一概念用于突出这一投资景观中的众多摩擦和谈判。本文通过审视该地近期繁荣与萧条的历史、全球原材料需求（尤其是来自中国）的增长、国家发展议程以及采矿作业的生命周期，考察了热点地区期望高涨的势头。随后，将讨论马兰帕加速变迁的一些空间和社会动态。探索这些动态使得从不同角度看待这些投资景观中的加速变迁成为可能。通过强调热点地区变迁的时间、空间和社会动态，本文认为，过热——一种通常与加速变迁相关的现象——可能不仅由加速变迁引起，也可能由减速和被排除在潜在机遇之外的经验引起。

title: Neoliberal Optimism: Applying Market Techniques to Global Health
abstract: Global health and neoliberalism are becoming increasingly intertwined as organizations utilize markets and profit motives to solve the traditional problems of poverty and population health. I use field work conducted over 14 months in a global health technology company to explore how the promise of neoliberalism re-envisions humanitarian efforts. In this company's vaccine refrigerator project, staff members expect their investors and their market to allow them to achieve scale and develop accountability to their users in developing countries. However, the translation of neoliberal techniques to the global health sphere falls short of the ideal, as profits are meager and purchasing power remains with donor organizations. The continued optimism in market principles amidst such a non-ideal market reveals the tenacious ideological commitment to neoliberalism in these global health projects.
title_zh: 新自由主义乐观主义：将市场技术应用于全球健康
abstract_zh: 全球健康与新自由主义日益交织，因为组织利用市场和利润动机来解决传统的贫困和人口健康问题。我利用在一家全球健康技术公司进行的14个月的实地工作，探讨新自由主义的承诺如何重新构想人道主义努力。在该公司的疫苗冰箱项目中，员工期望他们的投资者和市场使他们能够实现规模发展，并对发展中国家的用户负责。然而，新自由主义技术向全球健康领域的转化并未达到理想状态，因为利润微薄，购买力仍掌握在捐赠组织手中。在这种非理想的市场中，对市场原则的持续乐观揭示了这些全球健康项目中对新自由主义的顽强意识形态承诺。

title: New Expert Eyes Over Fukushima: Open Source Responses to the 3/11 Disaster in Japan
abstract: In this article, I explore the responses of the Open Source community to the Fukushima disaster by describing the development of collaborative technologies to measure radioactive contamination across Japan. Based on participant observation at Tokyo Hacker Space, this article addresses an emergent form of technoscientific expertise which is not confined to or legitimized by established institutions, but, rather, is distributed and organized around transnational networks of field specialists, companies, educational institutions, and volunteers. Both Tokyo Hacker Space, as an independent laboratory, and Safecast, as a spin-off project, advanced practices of hardware engineering and Open data management, which are examined in this article as manifestations of bricolage. As a concluding argument, I suggest that expertise and responsibility are interpretive keys for understanding the possibilities and impossibilities of collaboration and coordination in the context of Open Source-based responses to the Fukushima crisis. Responsibility has become an open question for Safecast and Tokyo Hacker Space, as both have championed “openness” as an ethical point of departure, a projected outcome, and a technical orientation in the context of the Fukushima disaster.
title_zh: 福岛上的新专家之眼：针对日本3/11灾难的开源响应
abstract_zh: 在本文中，我通过描述用于测量日本各地放射性污染的协作技术的发展，探讨了开源社区对福岛灾难的响应。基于在东京黑客空间的参与观察，本文探讨了一种新兴的技术科学专业知识形式，这种知识不限于既定机构或由其合法化，而是围绕领域专家、公司、教育机构和志愿者的跨国网络进行分布和组织。东京黑客空间作为一个独立实验室，以及其衍生项目Safecast，推动了硬件工程和开放数据管理的实践，本文将其视为拼凑的体现。作为结论，我认为专业知识和责任是理解在基于开源的对福岛危机的响应中合作与协调的可能性与不可能性的解释性关键。责任已成为Safecast和东京黑客空间的一个开放问题，因为两者都将“开放性”作为伦理出发点、预期结果和技术取向，在福岛灾难的背景下加以倡导。

title: Policing the unstable materialities of digital‐media piracy in Brazil
abstract: ABSTRACT Around the world, antipiracy NGOs train police to recognize the unauthorized use of music and films and to publicly destroy illicit CDs and DVDs. For those who enforce laws governing intellectual property (IP), music and film piracy underscores how digital reproduction can be conceived of as forgetful, inconstant, and promiscuous. In Brazil, discourses about “cleaning” ( limpeza ) unite incitements to greater security, more active governance, and stricter IP enforcement. Understanding the global dynamics of IP policing requires analysis of ideologies of material purity and the historicity associated with them. This ethnography of antipiracy NGOs, law enforcement, and informal economies in southern Brazil brings together the anthropologies of mediation and IP, arguing that producers and consumers of digital texts are becoming increasingly anxious about how those texts circulate. [ intellectual property, policing, piracy, materiality, digital media, NGOs, Brazil ] Em todo o mundo, ONGs anti‐pirataria capacitam as polícias para que estas reconheçam a utilização não autorizada de música e filmes e para que destruam publicamente CDs e DVDs ilícitos. Para aqueles que fazem cumprir as leis que regulam a propriedade intelectual (PI), a pirataria de música e filmes evidencia como a reprodução digital pode ser concebida como esquecida, inconstante e promíscua. No Brasil, discursos sobre limpeza unem incitamentos a uma maior segurança, uma governança mais activa, e um respeito mais estrito pela PI. Compreender as dinâmicas globais do policiamento da PI requer uma análise das ideologias da pureza material e da historicidade a elas associada.
