abstract_zh: 爱尔兰，包括北爱尔兰和南爱尔兰，近年来因其惊人的经济转型而获得了国际关注。许多国家研究爱尔兰共和国的案例，并试图学习“爱尔兰模式”的秘诀，正如上文所暗示的，技术和设计在其中发挥了作用。爱尔兰国家转型叙事的关键要素是由公司建立的制造和加工工厂，这些公司的名字唤起了当代高科技全球时代精神的感觉。微软、英特尔、惠普、兰克施乐等公司，都为其核心产品建立了主要工厂，这些产品可以经过生产线制造，但经过精密设计。其中几家公司还在都柏林设立了总部，监督其在欧洲的运营。因此，都柏林已成为高科技组件、软件工程和制药领域的国际领导者。

title: Assembling Women: The Feminization of Global Manufacturing by Teri L. Caraway
title_zh: 组装女性：全球制造业的女性化

title: Beyond economic and ecological standardisation
abstract: Supply chain capitalism forages among the ruins of military and industrial landscapes—and so do real foragers, such as Southeast Asian refugees picking wild mushrooms in the US Pacific Northwest for commercial shipment to Japan. This essay explores how supply chain dynamics thrive on deregulation and diversity, encouraging cultural and ecological variety as a source of profit. Supply chain values are created through diversity—and sometimes, disaster. I aim to provoke anthropologists to revive ethnography for the challenge of studying supply chains, as these erupt like mushrooms after a rain in the cracks of economic and ecological standardisation.
title_zh: 超越经济和生态标准化
abstract_zh: 供应链资本主义在军事和工业景观的废墟中觅食——真正的觅食者也是如此，例如在太平洋西北地区采摘野生蘑菇的东南亚难民，这些蘑菇被商业运往日本。本文探讨了供应链动态如何在放松管制和多样性的基础上蓬勃发展，鼓励文化和生态多样性作为利润的来源。供应链价值是通过多样性——有时是灾难——创造的。我旨在激发人类学家复兴民族志，以应对研究供应链的挑战，因为这些供应链像雨后蘑菇一样在经济和生态标准化的裂缝中爆发。

title: Cities, material flows and the geography of spatial interaction: urban places in the system of chains
journal_name: GLOBAL NETWORKS-A JOURNAL OF TRANSNATIONAL AFFAIRS
abstract: Abstract The emerging discourses on world cities and Global Commodity Chains are valuable spatial frameworks for conceptualizing globalization and its spatial consequences. However, both discourses have one thing in common: they neglect the territorial and thus physical dimension of global flows. Hence, in this article I take the perspective of material flows to reconnect the discourses on cities and chains. I aim to clarify the role of urban places and their ability to attract, manage and redirect flows in such networks. I do so by re‐examining classical concepts of spatial interaction and reorganization in human geography, with particular reference to centrality and intermediacy. The case of seaports and port cities is further explored to demonstrate the concrete conflicts and opportunities that arise with chain developments and insertion. To determine the relative position of places with regard to global chains and flows, Sheppard's concept of ‘positionality’ is discussed.
title_zh: 城市、物质流与空间交互地理学：链系统中的城市场所
abstract_zh: 关于世界城市和全球商品链的新兴论述为概念化全球化及其空间后果提供了有价值的空间框架。然而，这两种论述有一个共同点：它们忽略了全球流动的领土性及其物理维度。因此，在本文中，我从物质流的角度出发，重新连接关于城市和链的论述。我旨在阐明城市场所在这些网络中的作用，以及它们吸引、管理和重新定向流动的能力。我通过重新审视人文地理学中关于空间交互和重组的经典概念，特别是中心性和中介性，来做到这一点。进一步探讨港口和港口城市的案例，以展示随着链的发展和嵌入而产生的具体冲突和机遇。为了确定地方相对于全球链和流动的相对位置，讨论了Sheppard的“位置性”概念。

title: Non-hegemonic globalizations
abstract: Discussions on globalization tend to focus on processes commanded by powerful agents in a top-down perspective. In this article, I explore alter-native political and economic grassroots processes and agents as forms of non-hegemonic globalization. I analyze other political globalizations by considering the anti-globalization movement, and the alter-globalization initiatives represented by the World Social Forums. My arguments on economic globalization from below are based on the activities of ‘trader-tourists’, street vendors and markets of global gadgets or ‘pirated’ goods. I rely mostly on Brazilian and Paraguayan examples, but there are evidences of the existence of a veritable non-hegemonic world system. I want to call attention to other political and economic dynamics of globalization, a universe where the normative and repressive roles of nation-states are heavily bypassed.
title_zh: 非霸权全球化
abstract_zh: 关于全球化的讨论往往侧重于由强大行为体主导的自上而下的过程。本文探讨了另类的政治和经济草根过程及行为人，将其视为非霸权全球化的形式。通过分析反全球化运动以及世界社会论坛所代表的另类全球化倡议，我考察了其他政治全球化。我对自下而上经济全球化的论证基于“商贩-游客”、街头小贩以及全球小商品或“盗版”商品市场等活动。我主要依赖巴西和巴拉圭的例子，但有证据表明存在一个真正的非霸权世界体系。我想呼吁关注全球化的其他政治和经济动态，这是一个民族国家的规范性和镇压性角色被严重绕过的领域。

title: FOURTH WORLDS AND NEO-FORDISM
abstract: This article examines the strategies of the ‘sweatshop-free’ clothing company American Apparel in the context of ongoing debates over the cultural turn and cultural economy. American Apparel’s key selling point is that it does not outsource: it manufactures in Los Angeles, pays ‘good’ wages and provides healthcare, yet the workers are not unionised and the migrant labour it depends upon is often temporary. These same employees are used in promotional material to create its brand identity of an irreverent, hip and quasi-sexualised ‘community’ of consumers and workers. A design- and brand-led company that nonetheless doesn’t see itself as a brand in any conventional sense, and markets itself as ‘transparent’, the company’s ethos turns on consumer anxiety towards the socio-economic injustices of post-Fordism. Indeed, it marks a partial return to Fordist modes of production by aiming to manufacture everything under one roof, whilst deploying modes of informality (and technology) stereotypically associated with the post-Fordist creative industries. This paper considers the complex dynamics of American Apparel’s emergence in a reflexive marketplace (in relation to what Callon has termed an ‘economy of qualities’) and discusses its problematic negotiations with ‘fourth worlds’, or the zones of exclusion Castells terms ‘the black holes of informational capitalism’.
title_zh: 第四世界与新福特主义
abstract_zh: 本文在关于文化转向和文化经济的持续辩论背景下，考察了声称“无血汗工厂”的服装公司American Apparel的策略。American Apparel的关键卖点是不外包：它在洛杉矶制造，支付“优厚”工资并提供医疗保健，但工人并未组织工会，其依赖的移民劳动力常常是临时性的。这些员工还被用于宣传材料，以创造其品牌形象——一个由消费者和工人组成的无礼、时髦且带准性意味的“社区”。作为一家由设计和品牌驱动的公司，它却不以任何传统意义上的品牌自居，并将自己营销为“透明”的，其精神特质源于消费者对后福特主义社会经济不公的焦虑。事实上，它通过旨在将一切生产集中在一个屋檐下，同时部署通常与后福特主义创意产业相关的非正规模式（和技术），标志着向福特主义生产模式的部分回归。本文探讨了American Apparel在一个反思性市场（相对于Callon所称的“品质经济”）中崛起的复杂动态，并讨论了其与“第四世界”或Castells所称的“信息资本主义黑洞”这一排斥区域的有问题的协商。

title: Gun Culture in Kumasi
abstract: This article is about gun culture in Kumasi today. Gun use in Asante, and elsewhere in Ghana, has increased significantly in the last decade. In practice and in the public imagination this is associated with the rise of youth gangs and the criminalization of urban space. Much has been written about youths and violence elsewhere in Africa, but this article focuses on the neglected topic of guns themselves – their manufacture, sale, distribution, use and meanings. In Kumasi, which in Suame Magazine has the biggest indigenous metalwork and engineering complex in all of West Africa, skilled artisans now make copies of imported automatic assault rifles, like the Soviet AK-47, as well as shotguns and pistols. This development is explored in a number of ways, and most especially in terms of the relationship between guns and their local history, Kumasi youth, crime and shifting patterns of desire and consumption. It is the purpose of this article to add to the growing literature on ‘violent youth’ in Africa, but to do so from the viewpoint of the weapons that enable this violence.
title_zh: 库马西的枪支文化
abstract_zh: 本文探讨当今库马西的枪支文化。过去十年间，加纳阿散蒂地区及其他地方的枪支使用显著增加。在实践和公众想象中，这与青年帮派的兴起以及城市空间的刑事化相关。关于非洲其他地区青年与暴力的文献已有很多，但本文聚焦于被忽视的枪支本身——其制造、销售、分销、使用和意义。在库马西，苏阿梅·马加津拥有整个西非最大的本土金属加工和工程综合体，熟练工匠现正仿制进口自动突击步枪（如苏联AK-47）、霰弹枪和手枪。本文从多个角度探讨这一发展，特别是枪支与其地方历史、库马西青年、犯罪以及欲望与消费模式变迁之间的关系。本文旨在为日益增长的关于非洲“暴力青年”的文献作出贡献，但从促成这种暴力的武器角度出发。

title: Making Trash into Treasure: Struggles for Autonomy on a Brazilian Garbage Dump
abstract: Abstract In recent years, the expansion of types of work that fall outside the category of formal waged employment challenge many of our anthropological conceptions of labor, class politics and contemporary capitalism. This paper addresses the need to rethink the meaning of work in the context of neoliberal capitalism by exploring the formation of new worker subjectivities and practices among catadores: informal workers who collect and sell recyclable materials on a garbage dump in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil. Based on ethnographic research conducted among catadores from June through August of 2005 and in January 2007, this paper provides an analysis of the labor conditions, social relations, and forms of political organizing that have emerged on the garbage dump and which differ in significant ways from those found in situations of formal wage labor. Ultimately, this paper argues that while neoliberal capitalism has led to increased unemployment and underemployment among vulnerable populations in cities worldwide, the practices of those struggling to earn a living in urban informal economies are creating new spaces for alternative economic practices, social relations, and class politics today.
title_zh: 变废为宝：巴西垃圾场上的自主性斗争
abstract_zh: 摘要近年来，正式带薪雇佣之外的工作类型的扩展对我们关于劳动、阶级政治和当代资本主义的许多人类学概念提出了挑战。本文通过探讨在巴西里约热内卢一个垃圾场上收集和出售可回收材料的非正规工人（catadores）中新的工人主体性和实践的形成，论证了在新自由主义资本主义背景下重新思考工作意义的必要性。基于2005年6月至8月以及2007年1月对catadores进行的民族志研究，本文分析了垃圾场上出现的劳动条件、社会关系和政治组织方式，这些与正式带薪劳动的情况有显著差异。最终，本文认为，虽然新自由主义资本主义导致全球城市中弱势群体的失业和就业不足加剧，但那些在城市非正规经济中谋生的人们的实践正在为当今另类的经济实践、社会关系和阶级政治创造新的空间。

title: Neoliberal associations: Property, company, and family in the Argentine oil fields
abstract: ABSTRACT The transformation of Argentina's state‐owned oil company into a transnational joint‐stock corporation and a series of worker‐owned subcontracting microenterprises in northwestern Patagonia provides an example of an actually existing neoliberal project. In this article, I illustrate how this project was as much a process of sustaining affective relationality as it was a process of fostering calculative rationality. The privatization process generated corporate subjects attached through familial associations of property, company, and family. Kinship sentiment was also the crucial force that incorporated former state oil workers into the inequitable circuits of the global petroleum industry. I argue that this neoliberal process was effective inasmuch as it worked affectively. [ neoliberal, kinship, property, affect, corporations, structural adjustment, petroleum, Argentina ]
title_zh: 新自由主义联合：阿根廷油田中的财产、公司与家庭
abstract_zh: 摘要：阿根廷国有石油公司转变为跨国股份公司，并在巴塔哥尼亚西北部形成一系列工人所有的分包微型企业，这提供了一个实际存在的新自由主义项目的例子。在本文中，我阐述了该项目既是维持情感关系的过程，也是培养计算理性的过程。私有化过程产生了通过财产、公司和家庭的亲属关系联合起来的公司主体。亲属情感也是将前国有石油工人纳入全球石油工业不平等循环的关键力量。我认为，这一新自由主义过程之所以有效，是因为它在情感上发挥了作用。[新自由主义、亲属关系、财产、情感、公司、结构调整、石油、阿根廷]

title: Offshoring in the core: Russian software firms onshoring in the USA
journal_name: GLOBAL NETWORKS-A JOURNAL OF TRANSNATIONAL AFFAIRS
abstract: Abstract Offshoring and outsourcing have become the buzzwords of the IT community and the popular media discourse about the current era of globalization in services. Acknowledging the geographic perspective expressed in these dominant terms, in this article I examine the processes and activities that are oriented in the opposite direction. Capturing this inversion, I develop the concept of ‘onshoring’ and use research material from fieldwork conducted with IT firms in St Petersburg, Russia and their affiliates, agents and clients in the USA to provide an empirical case study. Onshoring encompasses the corporeal, representational, material and legal practices of offshore firms developing a presence onshore, with Russia as offshore and the USA as onshore in this case. The lack of an established Russian professional diaspora in the USA created a context in which developing a recognizable onshore presence was necessary for firms based in Russia. By explicitly recognizing that the efforts, risk‐taking and experimental strategies of offshore firms to create connections, networks and contacts onshore in the USA are a constitutive part of offshore outsourcing, I document and examine the less acknowledged complex flows and practices of onshoring. I argue that although these actors and processes may seem marginal to the widely recognized narrative of offshore outsourcing, in fact, they are creative and strategic compensations that reveal how the globalization of services is enacted at the micro‐level.
title_zh: 核心地带离岸外包：俄罗斯软件公司在美在岸外包
abstract_zh: 摘要离岸外包和外包已成为IT界和流行媒体关于当前服务全球化时代的话语流行词。认识到这些主导术语所表达的地理视角，本文考察了方向相反的过程和活动。捕捉这种反转，我发展了“在岸外包”的概念，并利用在俄罗斯圣彼得堡与IT公司及其在美国的附属公司、代理商和客户的实地调研材料，提供了一个实证案例研究。在岸外包涵盖了离岸公司在本土建立存在的实体、表征、物质和法律实践，在此案例中俄罗斯为离岸方，美国为在岸方。美国缺乏成熟的俄罗斯专业侨民，这为俄罗斯公司创造了必须在美国建立可识别的在岸存在的背景。通过明确承认离岸公司在美国本土建立联系、网络和接触的努力、冒险和实验策略是离岸外包的构成部分，我记录并考察了较少被承认的复杂的在岸外包流动与实践。我认为，尽管这些行动者和过程可能看似边缘于广泛认可的离岸外包叙事，但实际上，它们是创造性和战略性的补偿，揭示了服务全球化如何在微观层面得以实现。

title: Women Working Worldwide: transnational networks, corporate social responsibility and action research
journal_name: GLOBAL NETWORKS-A JOURNAL OF TRANSNATIONAL AFFAIRS
abstract: Abstract In this article we trace the history of a new form of labour internationalism that emerged in support of women workers’ organizations, in particular in the garment industry, from the 1980s. We tell the story of the emergence of Women Working Worldwide (WWW), a small UK‐based NGO that provides solidarity and support for a network of women workers’ organizations in the commodity producing zones of the global South. WWW grew along with other organizations that have succeeded in forcing global corporations to take some responsibility for the employment conditions along their supply chains. In what has become corporate social responsibility (CSR), companies now establish codes of conduct and workplace audits of employment conditions in those factories to which they subcontract manufacturing work. WWW played a key part in the establishment of the Clean Clothes Campaign, Labour Behind the Label and the Ethical Trading Initiative that continue to develop such practices today. WWW used the power of transnational networks to ensure that the needs and voices of women workers were put on the agenda for action. The story of WWW demonstrates the potential to effect change through transnational networking, the extent to which different local organizations can find common cause with each other and the benefits of engaging in locally‐focused but transnationally coordinated educational and action research projects.
title_zh: 全球工作的女性：跨国网络、企业社会责任与行动研究
abstract_zh: 在本文中，我们追溯了一种新的劳工国际主义形式的历史，这种形式自20世纪80年代以来支持妇女工人组织，特别是在服装行业。我们讲述了“全球工作的女性”（WWW）的成立故事，这是一个总部设在英国的小型非政府组织，为全球南方商品生产区的妇女工人组织网络提供团结和支持。WWW与其他组织一起成长，这些组织成功迫使全球公司对其供应链上的就业条件承担一些责任。在企业社会责任（CSR）中，公司现在建立行为准则，并对它们分包制造工作的工厂的就业条件进行工作场所审计。WWW在“清洁衣物运动”、“标签背后的劳工”和“道德贸易倡议”的建立中发挥了关键作用，这些倡议至今仍在继续发展这些实践。WWW利用跨国网络的力量，确保妇女工人的需求和声音被提上行动议程。WWW的故事展示了通过跨国网络实现变革的潜力，不同地方组织能够找到共同事业的程度，以及参与以地方为重点但跨国协调的教育和行动研究项目的好处。

title: Culturally Situated Design Tools: Ethnocomputing from Field Site to Classroom
abstract: Ethnomathematics is the study of mathematical ideas and practices situated in their cultural context. Culturally Situated Design Tools (CSDTs) are web‐based software applications that allow students to create simulations of cultural arts—Native American beadwork, African American cornrow hairstyles, urban graffiti, and so forth—using these underlying mathematical principles. This article is a review of the anthropological issues raised in the CSDT project: negotiating the representations of cultural knowledge during the design process with community members, negotiating pedagogical features with math teachers and their students, and reflecting on the software development itself as a cultural construction. The move from ethnomathematics to ethnocomputing results in an expressive computational medium that affords new opportunities to explore the relationships between youth identity and culture, the cultural construction of mathematics and computing, and the formation of cultural and technological hybridity.
title_zh: 文化情境设计工具：从田野到课堂的民族计算
abstract_zh: 民族数学是研究嵌于文化背景中的数学思想与实践的学科。文化情境设计工具（CSDT）是基于网络的软件应用，允许学生使用这些潜在的数学原理创建文化艺术的模拟——美洲原住民珠饰、非裔美国人玉米辫发型、城市涂鸦等。本文回顾了CSDT项目中引发的人类学问题：在设计过程中与社区成员协商文化知识的表征，与数学教师及其学生协商教学特征，以及将软件开发本身反思为一种文化建构。从民族数学到民族计算的转变产生了一种表达性的计算媒介，为探索青年身份与文化、数学与计算的文化建构以及文化与技术混合性的形成之间的关系提供了新的机会。

title: Geographies of Style: Taiwan's Bridal Photography Empire
abstract: ABSTRACT This article explores the cultural geography of a distinctive mode of bridal photography that developed in Taiwan beginning in the 1980s and by the 1990s had become virtually a universal cultural practice for weddings, cutting across the class and urban/rural social divisions. Characterized by large-scale high key portraits of brides and grooms dressed in a variety of finery, posed in numerous settings, and exuding varied emotional states, the photographs are a source of national pride for Taiwan as they are famous throughout the region. Using theories of competitive consumption, imagined community, and time-space compression, the article explores ways in which Taipei's bridal industry commands space and constructs place. Notes Field research was funded by grants from the J. William Fulbright Foreign Scholarship Board and the American Council of Learned Societies/Chiang Ching-kuo Foundation Fellowship Selection Committee with funds provided by the Chiang Ching-kuo Foundation. A National Science Foundation Graduate Fellowship and a Mellon Dissertation Fellowship at Yale University provided funding for initial write-up of the research on which this article is based. I presented parts of this study at a session organized by Roy Richard Grinker for the 1998 American Anthropological Association Annual Meetings in which Laurel Kendall provided useful criticism. I thank Sidney Cheung, who organized the IUAES session on wedding photography in East Asia that resulted in the present form of this article. I romanize Mandarin terms in pinyin, though pinyin is not the system of romanization in use in Taiwan, where romanizations are frustratingly inconsistent. I give common place names such as Taipei and Taichung, using the spellings in most common use in maps of Taiwan. Personal names and identifying markers have been changed to protect the privacy of the women and men among whom I conducted research and to whom I am most thankful. Xiezhen is the Mandarin pronunciation of the Japanese term for photography. Until the mass production of bridal gowns for the US market was moved to the PRC in the early 1990s, a high percentage of American bridal gowns were made in Taiwan. Today, Taiwanese investors own many of the bridal gown production facilities in China; gown design and business contracting for mass production occur in Taiwan. For Taiwanese consumers, European labels command higher status because U.S. bridal gowns are decidedly local. Additional informationNotes on contributorsBonnie Adrian Bonnie Adrian is Social Sciences Core Lecturer at the University of Denver, U.S.A. and author of Framing the Bride: Globalizing Beauty and Romance in Taipei's Bridal Industry [2003]. E-mail: badrian@du.edu
title_zh: 风格地理：台湾婚纱摄影帝国
abstract_zh: 本文探讨了台湾自20世纪80年代发展起来的一种独特婚纱摄影模式的文化地理，到90年代已成为几乎普遍的婚礼文化实践，跨越了阶级和城乡社会分化。这种婚纱照的特点是新娘和新郎穿着各种华丽服饰、在各种场景中摆姿势、流露出各种情感的大型高调肖像，这些照片在整个地区享有盛誉，是台湾民族自豪感的来源。本文运用竞争性消费、想象社区和时空压缩理论，探讨了台北婚纱产业如何支配空间和构建场所。注：实地研究由J. William Fulbright外国奖学金委员会和美国学术团体理事会/蒋经国基金会奖学金选委会资助，资金来自蒋经国基金会。国家科学基金会研究生奖学金和耶鲁大学梅隆论文奖学金为本文所依据研究的初步撰写提供了资金。我曾在1998年美国人类学协会年会上由Roy Richard Grinker组织的一场会议上展示了本研究的部分内容，Laurel Kendall提供了有益批评。感谢张展鸿组织了导致本文当前形式的国际人类学与民族学联合会东亚婚礼摄影会议。我用拼音罗马化普通话术语，尽管拼音不是台湾使用的罗马化系统，那里的罗马化令人沮丧地不一致。我给出了常见地名如台北和台中的拼写，使用台湾地图中最常用的拼写。个人姓名和识别标记已更改，以保护我进行研究并深表感谢的妇女和男性的隐私。Xiezhen是日语摄影术语的普通话发音。直到20世纪90年代初，美国市场婚纱的大规模生产转移到中国大陆之前，很高比例的美国婚纱产自台湾。如今，台湾投资者在中国拥有许多婚纱生产设施；礼服设计和批量生产业务承包在台湾进行。对台湾消费者而言，欧洲品牌地位更高，因为美国婚纱明显本土化。额外信息：作者简介 Bonnie Adrian是美国丹佛大学社会科学核心讲师，著有《框定新娘：台北婚纱产业中的全球化美丽与浪漫》（2003年）。电子邮箱：badrian@du.edu

title: Lebanese Traders in Cotonou: A Socio-Cultural Analysis of Economic Mobility and Capital Accumulation
abstract: Passenger cars and other small vehicles have for a long time been the backbone of transport in west Africa. The cars are usually second-hand, and they are sourced on overseas car markets, mostly in western Europe. During the 1990s the port town of Cotonou, Bénin, became one of the most prominent hubs in this car trade: car markets mushroomed, attracting large numbers and a wide variety of traders – including a prominent contingent of Lebanese. This article discusses the role of these Lebanese traders in the car trade through a reconstruction of their careers. It reveals that Lebanese business, which can go through a rapid succession of different economic activities, starts as kin-based enterprise, but gradually incorporates peers and friends. Close analysis of this practice suggests that Lebanese immigrant traders are to a large extent driven by the ideal of enjoying life by adopting an expatriate lifestyle.
title_zh: 科托努的黎巴嫩商人：经济流动性和资本积累的社会文化分析
abstract_zh: 长期以来，乘用车和其他小型车辆一直是西非运输的支柱。这些汽车通常是二手的，来自海外汽车市场，主要是西欧。20世纪90年代，贝宁的港口城市科托努成为这一汽车贸易中最突出的枢纽之一：汽车市场如雨后春笋般涌现，吸引了大量且种类繁多的贸易商——其中包括一支显著的黎巴嫩商人群体。本文通过重构黎巴嫩商人的职业生涯，讨论了他们在汽车贸易中的作用。研究表明，黎巴嫩人的商业活动可以快速经历不同经济活动的更替，始于基于亲属的企业，但逐渐融入同伴和朋友。对这一实践的仔细分析表明，黎巴嫩移民商人很大程度上受到享受外籍人士生活方式这一理想的驱动。

title: Made in China: Women Factory Workers in a Global Workplace (review)
abstract: Reviewed by: Made in China: Women Factory Workers in a Global Workplace Hillary Crane Pun Ngai , Made in China: Women Factory Workers in a Global Workplace. Durham, London, Hong Kong: Duke University Press and Hong Kong University Press, 2005, 227 pp. In Made in China Pun Ngai explores what globalization means for the lives of global capitalism's laborers by focusing on the lives of young Chinese women working in a factory. Based on ethnographic fieldwork in which Pun lived among women workers in factory dormitories, worked with them on factory floors, and joined in their activities during their days off, Pun investigates the reasons the women choose to migrate from rural areas to the special economic zone (SEZ) to look for work, the discrimination they face in the factory and the surrounding area, the limited overt resistance to the exploitative actions of the factory system, and the ways in which, through physical pain, their bodies resist. She examines the creation of a new female migrant laborer identity, that of the dagongmei, how it is shaped by multiple actors (the state, global capitalism, the patriarchal family system, and the women themselves), and how, although devalued for their class, rural origins, and gender, the dagongmei personifies multi-layered tensions and fusions of globalization and persisting cultural difference. Pun argues that the factories are a site of social violence committed against the dagongmei who are thrice exploited: first by global capitalism; second, through the hukou system of residence restrictions, by the state; finally, by the [End Page 385] familial patriarchy. Pun situates her study in a wide range of theoretical discourses. To examine the control the state and factory have over the laborers and their means of exploitation, she draws on Marx and Foucault. To identify a wide variety of possible sites of resistance, she draws again on Foucault, and also on the work of Kleinman, and finds most useful Deleuze and Guattari's idea of a "minor literature of resistance," which she retools as a "minor genre of resistance." Two of Pun's stories highlight one of the key apparent contradictions she seeks to understand in the lives of the dagongmei. At the beginning of the Introduction, she tells of going to a hospital to visit Xiaoming. Badly burned, Xiaoming was one of the survivors of a factory fire that killed more than eighty workers and burned or injured another fifty. Industrial accidents were not rare, and most women migrating to look for factory work were aware of this kind of risk, as well as the more mundane tolls factory work could exact through headaches, backaches, and eyestrain among other physical pains. They also knew that as migrants from rural villages they would face discrimination in the more cosmopolitan cities. Nevertheless, the story that opens chapter two, of hundreds of women lining up to compete for a handful of these jobs, illustrates that they are not daunted by the downside of the work. Indeed, Pun goes to great lengths to show that dagongmei are not naïve or tricked into working in the factories; nor are they coerced or forced by their families. She carefully avoids falling into the trap she identifies in previous scholarship on Chinese women which results in a portrait of a homogenous, difficult life that is inevitable for all of them. She emphasizes that these women freely choose to work in factories, although it seems the reality of factory life and its exploitations, discriminations, and dangers would stifle their desire to do so. She explains that their unflagging willingness to endure stems from a desire to separate from the less modern rural villages from which they come in order to become new modern selves, and that in part that modernity comes from the consumption of goods they can afford with the wages they receive as industrial producers. They also see this time away from their families and earning their own wages as a brief window during which they can be active agents in their own lives, exploring their individual desires and, as one of her field subjects says, living for themselves. title_zh: 《中国制造：全球工作场所中的女工》（书评）
abstract_zh: 《中国制造：全球工作场所中的女工》书评。作者潘毅通过民族志田野调查，聚焦在中国工厂工作的年轻女性，探讨全球化对全球资本主义劳工生活的影响。她研究了女性从农村迁移到经济特区找工作的原因、在工厂及周边面临的歧视、对工厂系统剥削的有限公开抵抗，以及身体如何通过疼痛进行抵抗。她考察了新的女性 migrant 劳工身份——打工妹——的创造，以及这一身份如何被国家、全球资本主义、父权家庭制度和女性自身等多重行动者塑造。潘毅认为，工厂是对打工妹施加社会暴力的场所，她们遭受三重剥削：全球资本主义、户籍制度下的国家限制，以及家庭父权制。

title: Networks, firms and upgrading within the blue‐jeans industry: evidence from Turkey
journal_name: GLOBAL NETWORKS-A JOURNAL OF TRANSNATIONAL AFFAIRS
abstract: Abstract Since the late 1980s, industry characteristics, country‐specific contingencies and international conditions have come together and turned Turkey into a major exporter of jeans. It now has a 6.5 per cent share of the world's market. In this article, I explore this transformation and point out that it has created, especially in the 1990s, significant upgrading opportunities for Turkish firms. A large number of Turkish manufacturing firms are now full‐package contractors for a diversified list of brand‐name jeans. Some of these manufacturers are also experimenting with functional upgrading by developing their own brands and selling them abroad. Local firms, despite their subordinate position in the value chain, can go beyond low value‐added manufacturing and encroach on the core competencies of lead firms.
title_zh: 蓝牛仔裤产业中的网络、企业与升级：来自土耳其的证据
abstract_zh: 自20世纪80年代末以来，行业特征、国家特定条件和国际环境共同作用，使土耳其成为牛仔裤的主要出口国。目前土耳其占世界市场份额的6.5%。本文探讨了这一转变，并指出尤其在90年代，这为土耳其企业创造了重要的升级机会。大量土耳其制造企业现在成为各种品牌牛仔裤的全包承包商。部分制造商还尝试功能性升级，开发自有品牌并在国外销售。尽管在价值链中处于从属地位，本地企业仍能超越低附加值制造，侵入领先企业的核心竞争力。

title: Outsourcing, Self-Service and the Telemobility of Work
abstract: This essay offers labor's advocates and ethnographers a conceptual and historical framework for outsourcing. Jobs being moved abroad are less the focus than work being transferred from the processes of production and distribution into the realms of consumption and everyday life. Call centers in India have attracted tremendous attention recently in the U.S. and have become an iconic site of outsourced jobs. The cultural politics animating these reactions are discussed, and comparisons are drawn between reactions to call centers and initial encounters with ATMs, in order to elaborate how we have approached outsourcing and automation as problems for labor. Both outsourcing and automation are analyzed in terms of the mobility of work, distinguishable from the mobility of labor and capital. Call center calls and ATM (automated teller machines) transactions are described as genres of outsourced work and as instances of customers working to serve themselves. Finally, self-service is conceptualized as collaborative, and some political implications of pursuing solidarity in call centers and at ATMs are noted. One upshot of this framework is that customers serving themselves emerge, alongside discounted labor and the newly unemployed, as another key group of outsourced workers who demand our ethnographic attention.
title_zh: 外包、自助服务与工作的远程移动性
abstract_zh: 本文为劳工倡导者和民族志学者提供了一个关于外包的概念和历史框架。与工作从生产和分配过程转移到消费和日常生活的领域相比，工作被转移到国外并不是重点。印度的呼叫中心近年来在美国引起了极大关注，并成为外包工作的标志性场所。本文讨论了引发这些反应的文化政治，并将对呼叫中心的反应与最初接触自动取款机（ATM）的反应进行比较，以阐述我们如何将外包和自动化视为劳动问题。外包和自动化都从工作的移动性角度进行分析，这与劳动力和资本的移动性有所区别。呼叫中心电话和ATM交易被描述为外包工作的类型，以及客户为自己服务的实例。最后，自助服务被概念化为协作性的，并指出了在呼叫中心和ATM中追求团结的一些政治意义。这一框架的一个结果是，自助服务的客户、折扣劳动力以及新失业者一起，成为另一类需要我们进行民族志关注的外包工人。

title: Perceptions of Risk from Industrial Pollution in China: a Comparison of Occupational Groups
abstract: As economic reforms have transformed the People’s Republic of China over the past several decades, rapid industrialization has resulted in air and water pollution problems that threaten the health of China’s citizens and damage the environment. Small-scale rural factories called “township and village enterprises” play a major role in China’s growing pollution problem. However, very little is known about how rural Chinese citizens perceive industrial pollution. This paper examines how community members in an industrial township in China’s southwestern province of Sichuan perceive the environmental risks associated with industrialization. The paper first focuses on identifying salient risks from pollution, as defined by local informants. Next, the risk perceptions of three occupational groups in the community (industrial workers, commercial and service sector workers, and farmers) are compared. title_zh: 中国工业污染风险认知：职业群体比较
abstract_zh: 过去几十年来，经济改革改变了中华人民共和国，快速工业化导致空气和水污染问题威胁公民健康并破坏环境。被称为“乡镇企业”的小型农村工厂在中国日益严重的污染问题中扮演重要角色。然而，关于中国农村居民如何认知工业污染的信息非常有限。本文考察了四川省西南部一个工业城镇的社区居民如何认知与工业化相关的环境风险。论文首先关注识别当地信息提供者所定义的重要污染风险。接着，比较了社区中三个职业群体（产业工人、商业和服务业工人、农民）的风险认知。与认为穷人和贫困社区较少担忧环境问题的普遍观点相反，大多数……

title: “Mixing” as an Ethnoetiology of HIV/AIDS in Malaysia's Multinational Factories
abstract: Minah Karan, the stigmatizing label appended to Malay factory women in the 1980s, signaled a dangerous female sexuality that risked spreading beyond the factory gates and infecting Malaysia's idea(l)s of its traditional kampung culture. This article narrates how Minah Karan, as the former antihero of development, was reconstituted in the 1990s, with the government's labeling of factories as "high-risk settings" for HIV/AIDS. This is an ethnoetiology based not on any evidential epidemiological data but on the racial and gendered "mixing" that transpires behind factory walls: a fear that the "mixing of the sexes" means ipso facto "sexual mixing" among the races. The article demonstrates how importation of the high-risk label articulates at the local level the new and contested linkages, economic, religious, and scientific, constitutive of globalization. The pragmatic nature and imperatives of this high-risk process are discerned in factory women's accounts of how they negotiate the interactional imperatives of factory work, because transnational structures of productivity violate the social boundaries that have long connoted political stability, moral integrity, ethnic community, and individual safety. The article concludes by questioning whether ethnoetiologies, especially when they concern sexual networks, become social etiologies, because this would locate ethnoetiologies as central to conventional public health praxis rather than as ethnographic exotica in the margins.
title_zh: “混合”作为马来西亚跨国工厂中HIV/AIDS的病原学
abstract_zh: Minah Karan，这个20世纪80年代加在马来工厂女工身上的污名化标签，标志着一种危险的女性性行为，可能蔓延到工厂大门之外，并感染马来西亚对其传统乡村文化的理念。本文叙述了Minah Karan，作为前发展反英雄，在20世纪90年代如何随着政府将工厂标记为HIV/AIDS的“高风险环境”而被重新构建。这是一种基于种族和性别“混合”的病原学，而不是基于任何证据性的流行病学数据：担心“性别混合”实际上意味着种族间的“性混合”。本文展示了高风险标签的导入如何在地方层面表达了全球化构成的新且相互竞争的经济、宗教和科学联系。工厂女工在协商工厂工作的互动要求时所叙述的如何应对这一高风险过程的实用性质和要求可见一斑，因为跨国生产结构侵犯了长期以来象征政治稳定、道德完整、族群社区和个人安全的社会边界。文章最后质疑，病原学，尤其是涉及性网络时，是否会成为社会病原学，因为这将把病原学置于传统公共卫生实践的核心，而不是边缘的民族志异域风情。

title: Engineers and Political Dreams
abstract: In 1976 Indonesia became the first country in the developing world to have its own satellite system. From the start, the satellite was celebrated as an exemplary national achievement with the capacity to unite the archipelago nation. This paper describes the contours of the satellite discourse and explains its historical genealogy. It focuses on a small group of mediators, including engineers, entrepreneurs, and officials, who were instrumental in building the satellite system and giving it a political meaning. Drawing on oral and textual historical documentation, the paper describes the complex local, national, and global contexts in which the satellite discourse emerged. These included such global circumstances as the space race and such local circumstances as antiChinese riots on the campus of the Bandung Institute of Technology, where some of the engineers were based. It then traces the manner in which the entrepreneurial ambitions of these engineers helped spread the satellite discourse beyond the confines of the national elite and how this ended up affecting the way the satellite system was built. Finally, the paper explores some of the limits of the nationalist discourse.
title_zh: 工程师与政治梦想
abstract_zh: 1976年，印度尼西亚成为发展中国家第一个拥有自己卫星系统的国家。从一开始，这颗卫星就被誉为杰出的国家成就，能够团结这个群岛国家。本文描述了卫星话语的轮廓，并解释了其历史谱系。它聚焦于一小群中介人，包括工程师、企业家和官员，他们在建设卫星系统并赋予其政治意义方面发挥了关键作用。基于口头和文本历史文献，本文描述了卫星话语出现所涉及的复杂地方、国家和全球背景。这些背景包括太空竞赛等全球性事件，以及万隆理工学院校园内的反华骚乱等地方性事件，其中一些工程师就在该校工作。然后，它追溯了这些工程师的企业家抱负如何帮助卫星话语超越国家精英的界限传播，以及这最终如何影响卫星系统的建设方式。最后，本文探讨了民族主义话语的一些局限性。

title: From Kinship to Link‐up
abstract: On the basis of lists of numbers saved on individuals cell phones and other evidence, it is argued here that lowincome Jamaicans use the cell phone to establish extensive networks, a practice identified as linkup. Linkup has many of the same characteristics as those found by R. T. Smith in a classic study of Jamaican kinship and genealogy. However, the new evidence suggests that kinship merely exemplifies a pattern that may be found in a wider range of Jamaican networking strategies including the creation of spiritual and church communities, the search for sexual partners, and the coping strategies adopted by lowincome households. Linkup also accounts for the rapid adoption of cell phones and the patterns of their use by lowincome Jamaicans and highlights the importance of understanding the local incorporation of cell phones and local forms of networking enacted through new communication technologies.
title_zh: 从亲属关系到联结
abstract_zh: 基于保存在个人手机上的号码列表及其他证据，本文论证了低收入的牙买加人使用手机建立广泛的网络，这一做法被识别为“联结”。联结具有许多与R. T. Smith在牙买加亲属关系与家谱的经典研究中发现的相同特征。然而，新的证据表明，亲属关系仅仅是牙买加更广泛的网络策略中可能存在的模式的一个例证，这些策略包括创建精神和教会社群、寻找性伴侣，以及低收入家庭采用的应对策略。联结也解释了低收入牙买加人迅速采纳手机及其使用模式的原因，并强调了理解手机在当地的本土化以及通过新通信技术实现的本地网络形式的重要性。

title: Geologies of power: Value transformations of mineral specimens from Guanajuato, Mexico
abstract: ABSTRACT In this article, I examine the extraction, circulation, and use of mineral specimens from Guanajuato, Mexico. I focus on the actions through which people in Guanajuato transform minerals into social objects and people in gem fairs, museums, and mineral clubs in the United States transform them into “natural” objects. Drawing on the work of Sidney Mintz, Nancy Munn, and others, I study how people use value transformations across global commodity systems to negotiate forms of autonomy within political and economic constraints. In the social relations through which minerals come to the United States and in refashioning stones as “pristine” objects, dealers and collectors also naturalize prevailing relations of power between Latin America and the United States.
title_zh: 权力的地质学：墨西哥瓜纳华托矿物标本的价值转变
abstract_zh: 摘要在本文中，我考察了来自墨西哥瓜纳华托的矿物标本的提取、流通和使用。我关注的是瓜纳华托的人们将矿物转化为社会物品的行为，以及美国宝石展会、博物馆和矿物俱乐部的人们将其转化为“自然”物品的行为。借鉴Sidney Mintz、Nancy Munn等人的研究，我研究了人们如何利用全球商品体系中的价值转变，在政治和经济约束下协商自主形式。在矿物进入美国的社会关系中，以及将石头重塑为“原始”物品的过程中，经销商和收藏者也使拉丁美洲与美国之间盛行的权力关系自然化。

title: Satellite Culture
abstract: Inuit hunters of the Igloolik region orient themselves on the land by understanding wind behaviour, snowdrift patterns, animal behaviour, tidal cycles, currents, and astronomical phenomena. Inuit wayfinding methods are burdensome to learn, requiring years of quiet tutoring and experience, but are perfectly reliable. Concern arose in the mid1990s that younger, less experienced hunters were beginning to rely too heavily on mechanized conveyances and electronic navigational aids. The use of global positioning system (GPS) units, particularly, has been steadily growing in Igloolik. This paper discusses the changes wrought by GPS use against the backdrop of interacting social and technological change. It argues that an understanding of these changes requires a model of technology that depends on the patterns created by devices rather than the devices (or systems of devices) themselves. A paradigmatic theory of technology based on the work of the philosopher Albert Borgmann is presented, and a distinction is made between technology that is physically and socially engaging and technology that reduces engagement with experience of the land, people, and local knowledge. It is suggested that there is a risk of turning landscapes into constructed entities or commodities, which is what happens figuratively when we are too attentive to the map and not the territory.
title_zh: 卫星文化
abstract_zh: 伊格卢利克地区的因纽特猎人通过理解风的行为、雪堆模式、动物行为、潮汐周期、洋流和天文现象来在陆地上定位。因纽特的寻路方法学习起来很费力，需要多年的安静指导和经验，但完全可靠。20世纪90年代中期，人们开始担忧，年轻、经验不足的猎人可能过度依赖机动车辆和电子导航辅助工具。特别是全球定位系统（GPS）设备的使用在伊格卢利克稳步增长。本文讨论了在技术和社会变革相互作用的背景下GPS使用所带来的变化。文章认为，理解这些变化需要一个依赖于设备所创造的模式而非设备（或设备系统本身）的技术模型。文章提出了基于哲学家阿尔伯特·博格曼工作的技术范例理论，并区分了在物理和社会上具有参与性的技术与减少对土地、人和地方知识体验参与度的技术。文章指出，存在将景观转化为构建实体或商品的风险，这在我们在过于关注地图而非领土时就会象征性地发生。

title: Travailler pour rien
abstract: L’apprentissage des métiers artisanaux du secteur informel urbain connaît une dégradation certaine par rapport à l’artisanat dit traditionnel, et s’apparente de plus en plus à un rapport d’exploitation pur et simple du travail non rémunéré de jeunes apprentis déqualifiés. Un rapport de dépendance personnelle lie étroitement les apprentis à leur patron à qui ils doivent non seulement leur travail gratuit mais aussi la rémunération de la formation reçue. Ce lien de dépendance personnelle rend possible l’exploitation des apprentis qui peut s’accomplir de trois manières, différemment combinées entre elles : la totale gratuité de l’œuvre des jeunes ; la prolongation arbitraire de la durée de leur formation ; la pleine disponibilité des apprentis à accomplir toute tâche demandée par le patron, même en dehors du lieu de formation.
title_zh: 无偿劳动
abstract_zh: 与非正规城市部门传统手工业相比，手工艺学徒制正在经历明显的退化，越来越像是对年轻无技能学徒无偿劳动的纯粹剥削。一种人身依附关系将学徒与老板紧密联系在一起，学徒不仅要提供免费劳动，还要为所接受的培训支付报酬。这种人身依附关系使得对学徒的剥削成为可能，剥削以三种方式实现（它们以不同方式组合）：年轻人劳动的完全无偿性；学徒期限的任意延长；学徒随时待命，完成老板要求的任何任务，即使在培训场所以外。

title: Working for Free
abstract: The conditions of apprenticeship in the informal sector in urban areas are worsening compared with so-called traditional apprenticeship.   They increasingly amount to a pure and simple exploitation of the unpaid labor of unskilled youth.   A personal relationship tightly links apprentices to their masters, to whom they owe not only their labor for free but even pay for the training received.   Made possible by this personal dependence, the exploitation of apprentices takes place in a combination of three different ways: the work performed by young people is totally free; their training might be arbitrarily prolonged; they have to be completely available to perform any task requested by their master, even outside the place of training.
title_zh: 免费工作
abstract_zh: 城市地区非正规部门的学徒条件与所谓的传统学徒制相比正在恶化。它们越来越等同于纯粹而简单地剥削无技能青年的无偿劳动。个人关系紧密地将学徒与其师傅联系在一起，学徒不仅无偿提供劳动，甚至还要为所接受的培训付费。在这种个人依赖关系的影响下，对学徒的剥削以三种方式结合进行：青年人进行的工作完全免费；他们的培训可能被任意延长；他们必须随时待命，完成师傅要求的任何任务，甚至在培训场所之外。

title: Fake logos, fake theory, fake globalization

authors.name: Hsiao‐hung Chang Translated by Yung-chao Liao

author_names: Hsiao‐hung Chang Translated by Yung-chao Liao
abstract: This essay attempts to map out the global networking of counter‐feit production and consumption by considering the historical and economic complications of fake superlogograms in Taiwan, Hong Kong and Mainland China as a point of departure. It traces not only the ‘capital logic’ of the counter‐feiting industry, which duplicates the international division of labour, but also its ‘cultural logic’, which creates the Euro‐American superlogograms under the spell of Western imperialist ideology. The essay is divided into three main parts to foreground the ‘glocal’ circulation of fake superlogos. The first part considers the famous French Louis Vuitton as a case study to explore the economic, historic and cultural formation of the logomania in East Asia piloted by Japan in the 1980s. The second part discusses the double cultural reproduction of fake logos in Taiwan as both an imitation of Japan and an imitation of Japanese imitation of Europe. The third part seeks to theorize the fake under the context of Asian ...
title_zh: 假标志、假理论、假全球化
abstract_zh: 本文试图以台湾、香港和中国大陆的假超级标志（superlogograms）的历史和经济复杂性为出发点，勾勒出仿冒生产和消费的全球网络。它不仅追踪了仿冒产业的‘资本逻辑’（复制国际劳动分工），还追踪了其‘文化逻辑’（在西方帝国主义意识形态的影响下创造欧美超级标志）。文章分为三个主要部分，以突出假超级标志的‘全球地方’流通。第一部分以著名的法国路易威登为案例，探讨1980年代由日本引领的东亚标志狂热（logomania）的经济、历史和文化形成。第二部分讨论了假标志在台湾的双重文化再生产，既是对日本的模仿，也是对日本模仿欧洲的模仿。第三部分试图在亚洲背景下理论化‘假’的概念。

title: In the Wake of Things: Speculating in and about Sapphires in Northern Madagascar
abstract: ABSTRACT This article discusses the interrelatedness of two sorts of speculation undertaken by Malagasy sapphire miners and traders involved in the northern Malagasy sapphire trade: first, the speculating that these people do in sapphires, and, second, the speculating that they do about the uses to which sapphires are put by foreigners. Although Malagasy people involved in the local trade know a great deal about how sapphires might be profitably traded, most of them do not know why foreigners are so interested in these stones. Dubious of foreign traders' assurances that sapphires are used in the production of jewelry, they speculate a variety of alternate, secret uses for them. In this article, it is argued that these speculations emerge out of a variety of locally developed assumptions about how the sapphire trade works, and specifically, the significant roles that deception and knowledge differentials play in its operation.
title_zh: 在事物的尾迹中：对马达加斯加北部蓝宝石的投机与推测
abstract_zh: 本文讨论了马达加斯加蓝宝石矿工和交易商参与北部马达加斯加蓝宝石贸易时所进行的两种投机活动的相互关联性：首先，这些人对蓝宝石进行的投机；其次，他们就外国人对蓝宝石的用途进行的推测。尽管参与当地贸易的马达加斯加人非常了解如何通过蓝宝石获利，但他们中的大多数人不知道外国人为何对这些石头如此感兴趣。他们对外国交易商保证蓝宝石用于珠宝生产表示怀疑，并推测了多种替代性的秘密用途。本文认为，这些推测源于当地对蓝宝石贸易运作方式的一系列假设，特别是欺骗和知识差异在其运作中所起的重要作用。

title: Like Exporting Baseball: Individualism and Global Competition in the High‐Tech Industry
abstract: Abstract Drawing on ethnographic fieldwork among high‐technology jobseekers in Dallas, Texas, during the period 2001‐04, this article examines the response of unemployed U.S. tech workers to the intensification of the offshore outsourcing of white‐collar work from the United States to lower‐cost locations overseas. The researcher found that while a vocal minority of tech workers denounces offshore outsourcing, or offshoring, as unethical, unpatriotic, and economically shortsighted, most high‐tech jobseekers see offshoring as a natural offshoot of an unstoppable and ultimately beneficial system of global capitalist competition. These “globalist” workers, who espouse a model of work that privileges individual responsibility and flexibility over loyalty and security, argue that nations and individuals must take the initiative in making themselves competitive with other countries' increasingly skilled, educated, and low‐cost workforces if they are to survive in this newly global economy. This perspective is buttressed by globalists' individualist ethos and their remarkably resilient faith in the logic of the market economy.
title_zh: 如出口棒球：高科技产业中的个人主义与全球竞争
abstract_zh: 基于2001-2004年期间在德克萨斯州达拉斯市对高科技求职者的民族志田野调查，本文考察了美国失业技术工人对白领工作从美国向低成本海外地点离岸外包加剧的回应。研究者发现，尽管少数技术工人发声谴责离岸外包为不道德、不爱国且经济短视，但大多数高科技求职者将离岸外包视为不可阻挡且最终有益的全球资本主义竞争体系的自然产物。这些“全球主义者”工人信奉一种强调个人责任和灵活性而非忠诚和保障的工作模式，认为国家和个人必须主动使自己与其他国家日益熟练、受过教育且低成本的劳动力竞争，才能在这一新型全球经济中生存。这一观点得到全球主义者个人主义精神气质及其对市场经济逻辑非凡韧性的信仰的支持。

title: Provincializing Capital: The Work of an Agrarian Past in South Indian Industry

authors.name: Sharad Chari
institutions: London School of Economics and Political Science

journal_name: COMPARATIVE STUDIES IN SOCIETY AND HISTORY
abstract: During the last two decades of the twentieth century, Tiruppur town in Tamilnadu state became India's centerpiece in the export of cotton knitted garments. Between 1986 and 1997, Tiruppur's export earnings skyrocketed from $25 million to $636 million, the number of garments exported increased more than nine-fold, and Tiruppur shifted from basic T-shirts to diversified multi-product exports of fashion garments. This industrial boom has been organized through networks of small firms integrated through intricate subcontracting arrangements controlled by local capital of the Gounder caste from modest agrarian and working-class origins. In effect the whole town works like a decentralized factory for the global economy, but with local capital of peasant-worker origins at the helm. What is more, these self-made men hinge their retrospective narratives of class mobility and industrial success on their propensity to ‘toil’: the word u l aippu is distinct from the conventional Tamil word for work. How did Gounder peasant-workers remake the dynamics of work through their toil, to make Tiruppur a powerhouse of global production?
title_zh: 地方化资本：南印度工业中的农业过往的作用
abstract_zh: 在二十世纪的最后二十年里，印度泰米尔纳德邦的蒂鲁普尔镇成为该国棉针织服装出口的中心。1986年至1997年间，蒂鲁普尔的出口收入从2500万美元飙升至6.36亿美元，服装出口数量增长了九倍以上，蒂鲁普尔从基本的T恤衫转向多样化的多产品时尚服装出口。这一工业繁荣是通过由本地资本组织的小企业网络实现的，这些企业通过复杂的分包安排整合，主导者是来自普通农业和工人阶级背景的冈德种姓。实际上，整个镇子就像一个为全球经济服务的分散化工厂，但由农民工人出身的本地资本掌舵。更重要的是，这些白手起家的人将其阶级流动和工业成功的回顾性叙事归因于他们“吃苦耐劳”的倾向：单词u laippu与传统的泰米尔语表示工作的词汇不同。冈德农民工人是如何通过他们的辛劳重塑工作动力学，使蒂鲁普尔成为全球生产强国的？

title: “Frame That Rug!”: Narratives of Zapotec Textiles as Art and Ethnic Commodity in the Global Marketplace
abstract: This article explores representations of Mexican Zapotec textiles as texts and as sites of contested values and meanings. Discussion of this indigenous cottage industry begins in the Oaxacan village of Teotitlán del Valle, the site of production, and follows the textile as it moves across social and cultural borders as a commodity in postindustrial consumer culture. The anthropologist's mediating role in brokering Zapotec textiles is considered within the social context of exchange relations between buyer and seller. Ethnographic stories about the production and aesthetics of Zapotec textiles are contrasted with consumers’ self-fashioning narratives of embodied experiences associated with their hand-woven possessions. The article concludes with reflections on the narrative threads of text that comprise a Zapotec textile's intrinsic value as both art and craft.
title_zh: “铺上那块地毯！”：瓦哈卡纺织物作为艺术和民族商品在全球市场中的叙事
abstract_zh: 本文探讨了墨西哥瓦哈卡纺织物作为文本以及作为争议价值和意义场所的表征。对这项土著家庭手工业的讨论始于生产地瓦哈卡的特奥蒂特兰德尔瓦莱村，并跟随纺织物作为后工业消费文化中的商品跨越社会和文化边界的移动。在中介瓦哈卡纺织物的过程中，人类学家在买卖双方的交换关系的社会语境中扮演的角色被考虑。关于瓦哈卡纺织物的生产和美学的民族志故事与消费者对与其手工编织物品相关的具身体验的自我塑造叙事形成对比。文章最后反思了构成瓦哈卡纺织物作为艺术和手工艺的内在价值的叙事线索。

title: Blind Ducks in Borneo
abstract: The appearance of Donald Duck and Mickey Mouse on hand-painted window blinds in East Kalimantan, Indonesia, presents an interesting convergence of globalization, local entrepreneurship, and artistic and cultural appropriation. In adopting these cartoon characters, the painter has created a livelihood for himself, but he has also identified with them in more personal ways and found in them an artistic focus. The result is not simply an instance of cultural hybridity but an example of the ability of local artisans to invest the products of international capitalism with new meanings drawn from their own experience and cultural traditions.'
title_zh: 婆罗洲的盲鸭
abstract_zh: 在印度尼西亚东加里曼丹手工绘制的百叶窗上出现唐老鸭和米老鼠，呈现了全球化、本地创业精神以及艺术和文化挪用的有趣交汇。采纳这些卡通角色，画师不仅为自己创造了生计，还以更个人的方式认同它们，并从中找到了艺术焦点。结果并非仅仅是文化杂糅的实例，而是本地工匠能够将国际资本主义的产品注入源自自身经验和文化传统的新意义的例证。

title: Notes on Mayan Youth and Rural Industrialization in Guatemala
abstract: This article explores the experiences of some Mayan youths as they are increasingly drawn into circuits of the world economy as wage workers in rural maquilas. It explores how fundamental restructuring of the world economy and the new international division of labor in the last quarter of the 20th century has directly impacted some households in rural Guatemala. The article sheds light on how maquila factories in rural Guatemala operate as new sites of exploitation by reinforcing and intensifying existing inequalities, intergenerational tensions and for manufacturing powerlessness among rural Mayan adolescents, while simultaneously seducing them with modernity’s desires.
title_zh: 关于危地马拉玛雅青年与农村工业化的笔记
abstract_zh: 本文探讨了一些玛雅青年作为农村出口加工厂的工资劳动者，日益被吸引进入世界经济循环的经历。文章探讨了20世纪最后25年世界经济的根本性重组和新的国际劳动分工如何直接影响了危地马拉农村的一些家庭。文章揭示了危地马拉农村的出口加工厂如何通过强化和加剧现有的不平等、代际紧张以及制造农村玛雅青少年的无力感，同时用现代性的欲望诱惑他们，从而作为新的剥削场所运作。

title: The Cell Phone and the Crowd: Messianic Politics in the Contemporary Philippines
abstract: T his essay explores a set of telecommunicative fantasies among middle-class Filipinos in the context of a recent historical event: the civilian-backed coup that overthrew President Joseph Estrada in January 2001. It does so with reference to two distinct media, the cell phone and the crowd. Various accounts of what has come to be known as "People Power II" (distinguished from the populist coup that unseated Ferdinand and Imelda Marcos in 1986) reveal certain pervasive beliefs of the middle classes. They believed, for example, in the power of communication technologies to transmit messages at a distance and in their own ability to possess that power. In the same vein, they believed they could master their relationship to the masses of people with whom they regularly shared Manila's crowded streets and utilize the power of crowds to speak to the state. Thus they imagined themselves able to communicate beyond the crowd, but also with it, transcending the sheer physical density of the masses through technology, while at the same time ordering its movements and using its energy to transmit
title_zh: 手机与人群：当代菲律宾的弥赛亚政治
abstract_zh: 本文探讨了菲律宾中产阶级在一项近期历史事件——2001年1月推翻总统约瑟夫·埃斯特拉达的平民支持政变——背景下的一系列电信幻想。它通过两种不同的媒介——手机和人群——来展开论述。对后来被称为“人民力量II”（区别于1986年推翻费迪南德和伊梅尔达·马科斯的民粹政变）的各种叙述揭示了中产阶级的某些普遍信念。例如，他们相信通信技术能够远距离传输信息，并相信自己有能力掌握这种力量。同样，他们相信自己能够掌控与经常共享马尼拉拥挤街道的大众之间的关系，并利用人群的力量向国家发声。因此，他们想象自己能够超越人群进行沟通，但同时也能与人群沟通，通过技术超越大众的纯粹物理密度，同时规范其行动，并利用其能量进行传输。

title: The City in a Shoe: redefining urban Africa through Sebago footwear consumption
abstract: In Dakar, footwear and clothing markets are unstoppable forces of urbanism and modernity They are packed with merchandise, and they sprawl beyond the official boundaries set by the municipality. For better or for worse, footwear and apparel keep the city in motion, give it life, and keep it current with global trends. The movement of traders and transmigrants through Dakar and globally‐dispersed Senegalese communities informs style and taste at “home” and “abroad.” This paper examines the production, exchange and consumption trajectory of a particular commodity, Sebago shoes, as a means to highlight the spatial dimensions of Dakar clothing markets and the city itself. The “social life” of Sebago and its various symbolic meanings assigned by Senegalese in Dakar and New York illustrates: 1) the complex nature of global flows and 2) that the city and its transmigrant communities share a continuous social space. This picture of complex flows and exchanges suggests the redefinition of city and market boundaries. [Dakar, transmigrant communities, commodity chains, Sebago shoes]
title_zh: 鞋子里的城市：通过Sebago鞋类消费重新定义非洲城市
abstract_zh: 在达喀尔，鞋类和服装市场是城市化和现代性不可阻挡的力量。它们堆满了商品，并蔓延到市政府设定的官方边界之外。无论好坏，鞋类和服装使城市运转，赋予其生命，并使其跟上全球潮流。通过达喀尔和全球分散的塞内加尔社区，商人和移民的流动影响着“国内”和“国外”的时尚和品味。本文考察了特定商品——Sebago鞋——的生产、交换和消费轨迹，以此强调达喀尔服装市场和城市本身的空间维度。Sebago的“社会生命”以及达喀尔和纽约的塞内加尔人赋予它的各种象征意义说明了：1）全球流动的复杂性，以及2）城市及其移民社区共享一个连续的社会空间。这种复杂流动和交换的图景暗示了城市和市场边界的重新定义。[达喀尔，移民社区，商品链，Sebago鞋]

title: The President of the gold diggers: Sources of power in a gold mine in Burkina Faso
abstract: The article provides an example of how 'formal' and 'informal' modes of power and legitimacy, as well as material and symbolic leadership resources, may intersect and interrelate. It analyses the sources of power that a Big Man in West Africa mobilised in order to appropriate mining rights and to establish leadership in a gold mining camp. As an entrepreneur in an economic field directly regulated by state laws and authorities, he has to operate within these structures while at the same time subverting them by creating a 'system of personal power' that resembles Sahlins' classic model of the Big Man in Melanesia. Although he is elected to represent the gold diggers, his leadership position rests not so much on a formal vote as on wealth, violence, and charisma. These attributes are underscored in performances that draw on symbols of power and prestige, linking commonly held ideas about traditional rule and conspicuous consumption to personal legitimacy.
title_zh: 淘金者的首领：布基纳法索金矿的权力来源
abstract_zh: 文章提供了一个关于权力和合法性的'正式'与'非正式'模式以及物质与象征领导资源如何交叉和相互关联的例子。它分析了西非的一位大人物为获取采矿权和在金矿营地建立领导地位而动员的权力来源。作为直接受国家法律和当局管制的经济领域的企业家，他必须在这些结构内运作，同时通过创建类似于萨林斯经典的美拉尼西亚大人物模型的'个人权力系统'来颠覆它们。尽管他被选举为代表淘金者，但他的领导地位更多地依赖于财富、暴力和魅力，而非正式投票。这些特质在借鉴权力和声望象征的表演中得到强化，将关于传统统治和炫耀性消费的普遍观念与个人合法性联系起来。

title: Upgrading, uneven development, and jobs in the North American apparel industry
journal_name: GLOBAL NETWORKS-A JOURNAL OF TRANSNATIONAL AFFAIRS
abstract: Abstract In this article we examine the developmental consequences of globalization at multiple scales, using a commodity chains framework to investigate the case of the North American apparel industry. In the first section we outline the apparel commodity chain and offer a brief typology of its lead firms. In the second section we discuss the concept of industrial upgrading and describe several main export roles in the global apparel industry. In the third section we focus on the regional dynamics resulting from the North American Free Trade Agreement (NAFTA). We contrast the Mexican experience with that of countries in the Caribbean Basin to show the impact of distinct trade policies on export‐oriented development. We argue that NAFTA is creating upgrading opportunities for some Mexican firms to move from the low value‐added export‐oriented assembly (or maquila) model to full‐package production. In the fourth section we explore the unevenness of upgrading dynamics through a comparison of two blue jeans manufacturing clusters in the United States and Mexico: El Paso and Torreon. Our conclusions about upgrading and uneven development in the North American apparel industry emphasize the importance of local, national and regional institutional contexts in shaping inter‐firm networks and their development impact.
title_zh: 升级、不均衡发展和北美服装业的就业
abstract_zh: 摘要：本文运用商品链框架，从多个尺度考察全球化的发展后果，以北美服装业为例。第一部分概述服装商品链，并对其领先企业进行简要分类。第二部分讨论产业升级的概念，并描述全球服装业的几种主要出口角色。第三部分聚焦北美自由贸易协定（NAFTA）带来的区域动态，对比墨西哥与加勒比盆地国家的经验，以展示不同贸易政策对出口导向型发展的影响。我们认为，NAFTA为一些墨西哥企业创造了升级机会，使其从低附加值的出口导向型组装（或maquila）模式转向全包生产。第四部分通过比较美国和墨西哥的两个牛仔裤制造集群——埃尔帕索和托雷翁，探讨升级动态的不均衡性。关于北美服装业升级和不均衡发展的结论强调了地方、国家和区域制度环境在塑造企业间网络及其发展影响中的重要性。

title: Constructing Working Selves: Silicon Valley Assemblers Meet the New Work Order
title_zh: 构建劳动自我：硅谷组装者遇见新工作秩序

title: Desire and the Prosthetics of Supervision: A Case of Maquiladora Flexibility
title_zh: 欲望与监督的假体：以马奎拉多拉工厂的灵活性为例

title: Handheld Computers as Tools for Writing and Managing Field Data
abstract: Pocket-size handheld computers are powerful, versatile, and rugged tools for taking down and managing ethnographic information. They can increase the speed of writing field data, allowing an ethnographer to take more detailed notes and retain information that might otherwise be lost. They also facilitate new, specifically electronic styles of data collection and management. As nonlinear inscription technologies, they can search, cross-reference, and crunch large data sets quickly in the field. Furthermore, they allow cultural data to be conceptualized and represented in many different configurations. This article specifically reviews the Sharp Wizard, Palm Pilot, Handspring Visor, and Psion.
title_zh: 手持计算机作为撰写和管理现场数据的工具
abstract_zh: 口袋大小的手持计算机是记录和管理民族志信息的强大、多功能且耐用的工具。它们可以提高撰写现场数据的速度，使民族志学者能够记录更详细的笔记并保留可能丢失的信息。它们还促进了新的、特别是电子化的数据收集和管理方式。作为非线性记录技术，它们可以在现场快速搜索、交叉引用和处理大型数据集。此外，它们允许文化数据以多种不同的配置进行概念化和表示。本文特别回顾了Sharp Wizard、Palm Pilot、Handspring Visor和Psion。

title: Defrosting the Freezer: From Novelty to Convenience
abstract: This article examines the ‘normalization’ of the British freezer. It defines three phases in this process: an initial period oriented around the utility of preserving home produce; a second stage marked by the development of a frozen food infrastructure and the establishment of the freezer as a part of the efficient domestic economy; and a third subtle but significant redefinition of the primary benefits of freezing in terms of convenience. Cast in their new role as ‘time machines’, freezers are sold as a means of managing contemporary pressures associated with the scheduling and co-ordination of domestic life. At one level, this is a story of the gradual acceptance of a relatively standardized object. Yet this narrative suggests that the freezer’s promised benefits and functions change along the way. Developing this point, we argue that the normalization of the chameleon-like freezer can only be understood in the context of similarly changing systems of food provisioning, patterns of domestic practice and allied technological devices.
title_zh: 解冻冰箱：从新奇到便利
abstract_zh: 本文考察了英国家用冰箱的‘规范化’过程。它定义了这一过程的三个阶段：最初以储存家庭农产品为导向的时期；第二阶段以冷冻食品基础设施的发展和冰箱作为高效家庭经济一部分的确立为标志；第三阶段微妙但重要的重新定义，将冷冻的主要好处转向便利。冰箱被赋予‘时间机器’的新角色，作为管理现代生活日程协调压力的手段出售。在某个层面上，这是一个相对标准化物品逐渐被接受的故事。然而，这种叙述表明，冰箱所承诺的好处和功能在此过程中发生了变化。基于这一点，我们论证，变色龙般的冰箱的规范化只能在同样变化的食品供应系统、家庭实践模式以及相关技术设备的背景下才能被理解。
